<h3 id="create-an-order-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|returnIds|query|boolean|false|Specify whether to return IDs associated with the numbers returned in the "Create an order" operation.<br>|
|zuora-version|header|string|false|<br>The minor version of the Zuora REST API. <br><br>You need to set this parameter if you use the following fields:<br>* subscriptions<br>* subscriptionNumbers<br>|
|body|body|[POSTOrderRequestType](#schemapostorderrequesttype)|true|none|
|» customFields|body|[OrderObjectCustomFields](#schemaorderobjectcustomfields)|false|Container for custom fields of an Order object.<br>|
|» description|body|string|false|A description of the order.|
|» existingAccountNumber|body|string|false|The account number that this order will be created under. It can be either the accountNumber or the account info provided. It will return an error if both are specified.<br>Note that this actually specifies the invoice owner account of the subscriptions included in this order.<br>|
|» newAccount|body|[Account](#schemaaccount)|false|none|
|» orderDate|body|string(date)|true|The date when the order is signed. All the order actions under this order will use this order date as the contract effective date if the contract effective date field is skipped or its value is left as null.|
|» orderLineItems|body|[[CreateOrderOrderLineItem](#schemacreateorderorderlineitem)]|false|[Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) are non subscription based items created by an Order, representing transactional charges such as one-time fees, physical goods, or professional service charges that are not sold as subscription services. <br><br>With the Order Line Items feature enabled, you can now launch non-subscription and hybrid monetization business models in Zuora, in addition to subscription business models.<br><br>**Note:** The [Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) feature is in the **Early Adopter** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing it as generally available. If you want to join this early adopter program, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/). <br>|
|» orderNumber|body|string|false|The order number of the new order. If not provided, system will auto-generate a number for this order.|
|» processingOptions|body|[ProcessingOptions](#schemaprocessingoptions)|false|Invoice or Payment.|
|» subscriptions|body|[object]|true|Each item includes a set of order actions, which will be applied to the same base subscription.|
|» » customFields|body|[SubscriptionObjectCustomFields](#schemasubscriptionobjectcustomfields)|false|Container for custom fields of a Subscription object.<br>|
|» » orderActions|body|[[CreateOrderOrderAction](#schemacreateorderorderaction)]|false|The actions to be applied to the subscription. Order actions will be stored with the sequence when it was provided in the request.|
|» » quote|body|[QuoteObjectFields](#schemaquoteobjectfields)|false|The fields populated for a quote when a quote is sent to Zuora Billing from Zuora Quote.<br>|
|» » ramp|body|[RampRequest](#schemaramprequest)|false|Container of the ramp definitions. It is used to create, update, or remove the ramp definition for the new subscription.<br>|
|» » subscriptionNumber|body|string|false|Leave this empty to represent new subscription creation. Specify a subscription number to update an existing subscription.<br>|

## List orders of an invoice owner

<a id="opIdGET_OrdersByInvoiceOwner"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/orders/invoiceOwner/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/orders/invoiceOwner/{accountNumber}`

**Note:** This feature is only available if you have the [Order Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders#Order_Metrics) feature enabled. As of Zuora Billing Release 284, Orders is generally available and the Order Metrics feature is no longer available as a standalone feature. If you are an existing Subscribe and Amend customer and want Order Metrics only, you must turn on [Orders Harmonization](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Orders_Harmonization/Orders_Harmonization). You can still keep the existing Subscribe and Amend API integrations to create and manage subscriptions.

**Note:** The [Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) feature is in the **Early Adopter** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing it as generally available. If you want to join this early adopter program, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/).

Retrieves the detailed information about all orders for a specified invoice owner.


<h3 id="list-orders-of-an-invoice-owner-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|accountNumber|path|string(string)|true|The invoice owner account number.|
|page|query|integer|false|The page number of the orders retrieved. The default is 1.<br>|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of rows returned per page.<br>|
|dateFilterOption|query|string|false|The date type to filter on. This field value can be orderDate or updatedDate. Default is orderDate.<br>|
|startDate|query|string(date)|false|The result will only contain the orders with the date of dateFilterOption later than or equal to this date.<br>|
|endDate|query|string(date)|false|The result will only contain the orders with the date of dateFilterOption earlier than or equal to this date.<br>|

`POST /v1/orders/preview`

**Note:** This operation is only available if you have the [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders#Orders) feature enabled. Orders is now generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 284 (August 2020). If you are an existing Zuora Subscribe and Amend customer and want to adopt Orders, see [What is Orders Harmonization](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Orders_Harmonization/Orders_Harmonization#What_is_Orders_Harmonization.3F) and join the [Orders Harmonization community group](https://community.zuora.com/t5/Orders-Harmonization/gp-p/Orders-Harmonization) for more information. If you want to enable Orders, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/).

**Note:** The [Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) feature is in the **Early Adopter** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing it as generally available. If you want to join this early adopter program, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/).        

Retrieves the preview of the charge metrics and invoice items of a specified order. Preview for subscriptions and order line items are both supported. This operation is only an order preview and no order is created.  

See [Preview a Subscription Creation Order](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-guides/#Create-a-subscription-for-a-new-customer) for a use case of the "Preview an order" operation.

The limit of orders allowed on a subscription is 1000.

The limit of order line items allowed in an order is 100.

Zuora has the following limits on the Orders synchronous API to prevent performance degradation: 
* Up to 50 subscriptions are allowed in a single [Create an order](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_Order) or [Preview an order](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PreviewOrder) operation call.
* Up to 50 order actions are allowed in a single [Create an order](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_Order) or [Preview an order](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PreviewOrder) operation call.
* Up to 50 order actions are allowed on a single subscription in a [Create an order](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_Order) or [Preview an order](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PreviewOrder) operation call.

If you have an Order that exceeds any limits of the above, Zuora recommends you use the following asynchronous API operations:
* [Create an order asynchronously](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CreateOrderAsynchronously)
* [Preview an order asynchronously](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PreviewOrderAsynchronously)

Zuora has the following limits on the Orders asynchronous API operations to prevent performance degradation:
* Up to 300 subscriptions are allowed in a single [Create an order asynchronously](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CreateOrderAsynchronously) or [Preview an order asynchronously](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PreviewOrderAsynchronously) operation call.
* Up to 300 order actions are allowed in a single [Create an order asynchronously](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CreateOrderAsynchronously) or [Preview an order asynchronously](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PreviewOrderAsynchronously) operation call.
* Up to 300 order actions are allowed on a single subscription in a [Create an order asynchronously](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CreateOrderAsynchronously) or [Preview an order asynchronously](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PreviewOrderAsynchronously) operation call.

If you have a need for a large order that exceeds any limits of the above, you can request a limit increase for the Orders asynchronous API by submitting a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com).

|body|body|[POSTOrderPreviewRequestType](#schemapostorderpreviewrequesttype)|true|none|
|» customFields|body|[OrderObjectCustomFields](#schemaorderobjectcustomfields)|false|Container for custom fields of an Order object.<br>|
|» description|body|string|false|A description of the order.|
|» existingAccountNumber|body|string|false|The account number that this order will be created under. It can be either the accountNumber or the account info. It will return an error if both are specified.<br>Note that invoice owner account of the subscriptions included in this order should be the same with the account of the order.<br>|
|» orderDate|body|string(date)|true|The date when the order is signed. All of the order actions under this order will use this order date as the contract effective date.|
|» orderLineItems|body|[[CreateOrderOrderLineItem](#schemacreateorderorderlineitem)]|false|[Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) are non subscription based items created by an Order, representing transactional charges such as one-time fees, physical goods, or professional service charges that are not sold as subscription services. <br><br>With the Order Line Items feature enabled, you can now launch non-subscription and hybrid monetization business models in Zuora, in addition to subscription business models. <br><br>**Note:** The [Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) feature is in the **Early Adopter** phase. If you want to join this early adopter program, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/). <br>|
|» orderNumber|body|string|false|The order number of this order.|
|» previewAccountInfo|body|[PreviewAccountInfo](#schemapreviewaccountinfo)|false|Information about the account that will own the order.<br>|
|» previewOptions|body|[PreviewOptions](#schemapreviewoptions)|true|none|
|» subscriptions|body|[object]|true|Each item includes a set of order actions, which will be applied to the same base subscription.|
|» » customFields|body|[SubscriptionObjectCustomFields](#schemasubscriptionobjectcustomfields)|false|Container for custom fields of a Subscription object.<br>|
|» » orderActions|body|[[PreviewOrderOrderAction](#schemaprevieworderorderaction)]|false|The actions to be applied to the subscription. Order actions will be stored with the sequence when it was provided in the request.|

|» » ramp|body|[RampRequest](#schemaramprequest)|false|Container of the ramp definitions. It is used to create, update, or remove the ramp definition for the new subscription.<br>|
|» » subscriptionNumber|body|string|false|Leave this field empty to represent new subscription creation, or specify a subscription number to update an existing subscription.<br>|

## List orders by subscription number

<a id="opIdGET_OrdersBySubscriptionNumber"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/orders/subscription/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/orders/subscription/{subscriptionNumber}`

**Note:** This feature is only available if you have the [Order Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders#Order_Metrics) feature enabled. As of Zuora Billing Release 284, Orders is generally available and the Order Metrics feature is no longer available as a standalone feature. If you are an existing Subscribe and Amend customer and want Order Metrics only, you must turn on [Orders Harmonization](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Orders_Harmonization/Orders_Harmonization). You can still keep the existing Subscribe and Amend API integrations to create and manage subscriptions.

**Note:** The [Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) feature is in the **Early Adopter** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing it as generally available. If you want to join this early adopter program, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/).

Retrieves the detailed information about all orders for a specified subscription. Any orders containing the changes on the specified subscription are returned.


<h3 id="list-orders-by-subscription-number-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|subscriptionNumber|path|string|true|The subscription number.|
|page|query|integer|false|The page number of the orders retrieved. The default is '1'.<br>|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of rows returned per page.<br>|
|dateFilterOption|query|string|false|The date type to filter on. This field value can be 'orderDate' or 'updatedDate'. Default is orderDate.<br>|
|startDate|query|string(date)|false|The result will only contain the orders with the date of 'dateFilterOption' later than or equal to this date.<br>|
|endDate|query|string(date)|false|The result will only contain the orders with the date of 'dateFilterOption' earlier than or equal to this date.<br>|

<a id="opIdGET_OrdersBySubscriptionOwner"></a>

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/orders/subscriptionOwner/string \

```

`GET /v1/orders/subscriptionOwner/{accountNumber}`

**Note:** This feature is only available if you have the [Order Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders#Order_Metrics) feature enabled. As of Zuora Billing Release 284, Orders is generally available and the Order Metrics feature is no longer available as a standalone feature. If you are an existing Subscribe and Amend customer and want Order Metrics only, you must turn on [Orders Harmonization](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Orders_Harmonization/Orders_Harmonization). You can still keep the existing Subscribe and Amend API integrations to create and manage subscriptions.

**Note:** The [Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) feature is in the **Early Adopter** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing it as generally available. If you want to join this early adopter program, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/).

Retrieves the detailed information about all orders for a specified subscription owner. Any orders containing the changes on the subscriptions owned by this account are returned.


<h3 id="list-orders-of-a-subscription-owner-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|accountNumber|path|string(string)|true|The subscription owner account number.|
|page|query|integer|false|The page number of the orders retrieved. The default is 1.<br>|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of rows returned per page.<br>|
|dateFilterOption|query|string|false|The date type to filter on.<br>This field value can be 'orderDate' or 'updatedDate'. Default is orderDate.<br>|
|startDate|query|string(date)|false|The result will only contain the orders with the date of 'dateFilterOption' later than or equal to this date.<br>|

Retrieves the terms of the specified subscription.


<h3 id="list-subscription-terms-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. If you are an existing Zuora Subscribe and Amend customer and want to adopt Orders, see [What is Orders Harmonization](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Orders_Harmonization/Orders_Harmonization#What_is_Orders_Harmonization.3F) and join the [Orders Harmonization community group](https://community.zuora.com/t5/Orders-Harmonization/gp-p/Orders-Harmonization) for more information. If you want to enable Orders, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/).

**Note:** The [Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) feature is in the **Early Adopter** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing it as generally available. If you want to join this early adopter program, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/).
       
Deletes a specified order. 

* All the subscriptions changed by this order are deleted. After the deletion, the subscriptions are rolled back to the previous version. 

* All the order line items created in this order are deleted.

You are not allowed to delete an order if the charges that are affected by this order are invoiced.

This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|orderNumber|path|string(string)|true|The number of the order to be deleted.|

## List order metrics for an evergreen subscription

<a id="opIdGET_OrderMetricsforEvergreenSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/v1/orders/string/evergreenMetrics/string?startDate=1970-01-01&endDate=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/orders/{orderNumber}/evergreenMetrics/{subscriptionNumber}`

**Note:** This feature is only available if you have the [Order Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders#Order_Metrics) feature enabled. As of Zuora Billing Release 284, Orders is generally available and the Order Metrics feature is no longer available as a standalone feature. If you are an existing Subscribe and Amend customer and want Order Metrics only, you must turn on [Orders Harmonization](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Orders_Harmonization/Orders_Harmonization). You can still keep the existing Subscribe and Amend API integrations to create and manage subscriptions.

**Note:** As of Zuora Billing Release 306, Zuora has upgraded the methodologies for calculating metrics in [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders). The new methodologies are reflected in the following Order Delta Metrics objects. 
* [Order Delta Mrr](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Delta_Metrics/Order_Delta_Mrr)
* [Order Delta Tcv](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Delta_Metrics/Order_Delta_Tcv)
* [Order Delta Tcb](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Delta_Metrics/Order_Delta_Tcb)

It is recommended that all customers use the new [Order Delta Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Delta_Metrics/AA_Overview_of_Order_Delta_Metrics). If you are an existing [Order Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders/Key_Metrics_for_Orders) customer and want to migrate to Order Delta Metrics, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/).

Whereas new customers, and existing customers not currently on [Order Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders/Key_Metrics_for_Orders), will no longer have access to Order Metrics, existing customers currently using Order Metrics will continue to be supported.

**Note:** As of Zuora Billing Release 306, any new customers who onboard on [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders) or [Orders Harmonization](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Orders_Harmonization/Orders_Harmonization) will no longer get this operation.

## Update order action trigger dates

<a id="opIdPUT_OrderTriggerDates"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/orders/string/triggerDates \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "subscriptions": [
      {
        "orderActions": [
          {
            "charges": [
              {
                "chargeNumber": "C-0000001",
                "specificTriggerDate": "2016-09-01"
              }
            ],
            "sequence": 0,
            "triggerDates": [
              {
                "name": "CustomerAcceptance",
                "triggerDate": "2016-09-01"
              }
            ]
          }
        ],
        "subscriptionNumber": "A-S00000009"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/orders/{orderNumber}/triggerDates`

**Note:** This operation is only available if you have the [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders#Orders) feature enabled. Orders is now generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 284 (August 2020). If you are an existing Zuora Subscribe and Amend customer and want to adopt Orders, see [What is Orders Harmonization](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Orders_Harmonization/Orders_Harmonization#What_is_Orders_Harmonization.3F) and join the [Orders Harmonization community group](https://community.zuora.com/t5/Orders-Harmonization/gp-p/Orders-Harmonization) for more information. If you want to enable Orders, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/).

Updates the triggering dates for either of the following order actions:
 * CreateSubscription
 * AddProduct
 * UpdateProduct
 * RemoveProduct
 * RenewSubscription
 * TermsAndConditions


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "subscriptions": [
    {
      "orderActions": [
        {
          "charges": [
            {
              "chargeNumber": "C-0000001",
              "specificTriggerDate": "2016-09-01"
            }
          ],
          "sequence": 0,
          "triggerDates": [
            {
              "name": "CustomerAcceptance",
              "triggerDate": "2016-09-01"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "subscriptionNumber": "A-S00000009"
    }
  ]
}
```

|» billTargetDate|body|string(date)|false|The target date for the Order Line Item (OLI) to be picked up by bill run for generating invoice.<br><br>To generate invoice for an OLI, you must set this field and set the `itemState` field to `SentToBilling`.<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» customFields|body|[OrderLineItemCustomFields](#schemaorderlineitemcustomfields)|false|Container for custom fields of an Order Line Item object.<br>|
|» deferredRevenueAccountingCode|body|string|false|The deferred revenue accounting code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» itemName|body|string|false|The name of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» itemNumber|body|string|false|The number for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» itemState|body|string|false|The state of the Order Line Item (OLI). See [Order Line Item states, Order states, and state transitions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AB_Order_Line_Item_States_and_Order_States) for more information.<br><br>To generate invoice for an OLI, you must set this field to `SentToBilling` and set the `billTargetDate` field .<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` or `SentToBilling`state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing` or `SentToBilling`).<br>|
|» itemType|body|string|false|The type of the Order Line Item (OLI). <br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» listPricePerUnit|body|number|false|The list price per unit for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» productCode|body|string|false|The product code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» purchaseOrderNumber|body|string|false|Used by customers to specify the Purchase Order Number provided by the buyer.<br><br>You can update this field for an Order Line Item (OLI) only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» quantity|body|number|false|The quantity of units, such as the number of authors in a hosted wiki service.<br><br>You can update this field for an Order Line Item (OLI) only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» recognizedRevenueAccountingCode|body|string|false|The recognized revenue accounting code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» revenueRecognitionRule|body|string|false|The Revenue Recognition rule for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» taxCode|body|string|false|The tax code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» taxMode|body|string|false|The tax mode for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|» transactionDate|body|string(date)|false|The transaction date of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|

|» itemState|SentToBilling|
|» itemState|Complete|
|» itemState|Cancelled|
|» itemType|Product|
|» itemType|Fee|
|» itemType|Services|
|» taxMode|TaxInclusive|
|» taxMode|TaxExclusive|

<h1 id="api-reference-billing-payment-gateway-reconciliation">Payment Gateway Reconciliation</h1>

## Reverse a payment

<a id="opIdPOST_ReversePayment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/gateway-settlement/payments/string/chargeback \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "amount": 100,
    "gatewayResponse": "Insufficient funds",
    "gatewayResponseCode": "023",
    "referenceId": "825522036728874689",
    "secondReferenceId": "825522036690700110",
    "settledOn": "2019-05-07 20:56:32.981"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/gateway-settlement/payments/{payment-id}/chargeback`

Sets the Payment status to "Reversed", creates a refund for the amount specified in the request, and returns the Refund object as response.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "amount": 100,
  "gatewayResponse": "Insufficient funds",
  "gatewayResponseCode": "023",
  "referenceId": "825522036728874689",
  "secondReferenceId": "825522036690700110",
  "settledOn": "2019-05-07 20:56:32.981"
}
```

<h3 id="reverse-a-payment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|payment-id|path|string|true|Unique ID of the payment.|
|body|body|[POSTReversePaymentRequest](#schemapostreversepaymentrequest)|true|none|
|» amount|body|number|true|The amount that needs to be reversed (chargeback). It cannot be greater than the total Payment amount. <br>|
|» gatewayResponse|body|string|false|The transaction response returned by the gateway for this transaction. If the transaction was declined, this reason is provided in the message.<br>|
|» gatewayResponseCode|body|string|false|Response message Code returned by the gateway about the transaction status.<br>|
|» referenceId|body|string|false|Unique Id generated by the gateway for each transaction. Use this ID to find the respective Zuora Payment ID. <br>|
|» secondReferenceId|body|string|false|The second reference Id. Some gateways use two unique transaction IDs.<br>|
|» settledOn|body|string(date-time)|false|The date and time of the transaction settlement. The format is `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss`.<br>|

## Reconcile a refund

<a id="opIdPOST_ReconcileRefund"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/refunds/string/reconcile \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "action": "settle",
    "actionDate": "2020-10-25 11:11:11",
    "gatewayReconciliationReason": "refund_paid",
    "gatewayReconciliationStatus": "paid",
    "payoutId": "PAYOUT123"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/refunds/{refund-id}/reconcile`

Reconciles a refund when receiving the gateway reconciliation request or event.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "settle",
  "actionDate": "2020-10-25 11:11:11",
  "gatewayReconciliationReason": "refund_paid",
  "gatewayReconciliationStatus": "paid",
  "payoutId": "PAYOUT123"
}
```

<h3 id="reconcile-a-refund-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|refund-id|path|string|true|Unique ID of the refund.|
|body|body|[POSTReconcileRefundRequest](#schemapostreconcilerefundrequest)|true|none|
|» action|body|string|false|The action of the refund reconciliation.<br>  - `settle`: Sets the gatewayState to "Settled" and returns the refund object as response.<br>  - `reject`: Sets the gatewayState to "FailedToSettle" and handle the event according to the settings configured in the Gateway Reconciliation Configuration in Payments Settings through Zuora UI. See [Configure how to handle refund rejected events](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/M_Payment_Gateways/Gateway_Reconciliation#Configure_how_to_handle_refund_rejected_events) for details.<br>|
|» actionDate|body|string(datetime)|false|The date and time of the refund reconciliation action, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|» gatewayReconciliationReason|body|string|false|The reason of gateway reconciliation.<br>|
|» gatewayReconciliationStatus|body|string|false|The status of gateway reconciliation.<br>|
|» payoutId|body|string|false|The payout ID of the refund from the gateway side.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» action|settle|
|» action|reject|

<h1 id="api-reference-billing-payment-method-snapshots">Payment Method Snapshots</h1>

## CRUD: Retrieve a payment method snapshot

<a id="opIdObject_GETPaymentMethodSnapshot"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/object/payment-method-snapshot/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/object/payment-method-snapshot/{id}`

This REST API reference describes how to retrieve a Payment Method Snapshot.

A Payment Method Snapshot is a copy of the particular Payment Method used in a transaction. If the Payment Method is deleted, the Payment Method Snapshot continues to retain the data used in each of the past transactions.

## Notes
The following Payment Method fields are not available in Payment Method Snapshots:

* `Active`
* `AchAddress1`
* `AchAddress2`
* `CreatedById`
* `CreatedDate`
* `UpdatedById`
* `UpdatedDate`

The Payment Method Snapshot field `PaymentMethodId` is not available in Payment Methods.


<h3 id="crud-retrieve-a-payment-method-snapshot-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|fields|query|string|false|Object fields to return|
|id|path|string|true|Object id|

This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|

|» AccountId|body|string|false|The ID of the customer account associated with this payment method.<br>To create an orphan payment method that is not associated with any customer account, you do not need to specify this field during creation. However, you must associate the orphan payment method with a customer account within 10 days. Otherwise, this orphan payment method will be deleted.|
|» AchAbaCode|body|string|false| The nine-digit routing number or ABA number used by banks. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `ACH`.<br><br>**Character limit**: 9 **Values**: a string of 9 characters or fewer |
|» AchAccountName|body|string|false| The name of the account holder, which can be either a person or a company. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `ACH`.<br><br>**Character limit**: 70 **Values**: a string of 70 characters or fewer |
|» AchAccountNumber|body|string|false|The bank account number associated with the ACH payment. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>**Character limit**: 30 **Values**: a string of 30 numeric characters or fewer |
|» AchAccountType|body|string|false| The type of bank account associated with the ACH payment. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**:<br>- `BusinessChecking`<br>- `Checking`<br>- `Saving`<br>|
|» AchAddress1|body|string|false| Line 1 for the ACH address. This field is required for creating a payment method for the Vantiv payment gateway. **Character limit**: 255 **Values**: an address |
|» AchAddress2|body|string|false| Line 2 for the ACH address. This field is required for creating a payment method for the Vantiv payment gateway. **Character limit**: 255 **Values**: an address |
|» AchBankName|body|string|false| The name of the bank where the ACH payment account is held. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>**Character limit**: 70 **Values**: a string of 70 characters or fewer |
|» AchCity|body|string|false|The city of the ACH address. Use this field for ACH payment methods. **Note**: This field is only specific to the NMI payment gateway.<br>**Character limit**: 40 **Values**: a string of 40 characters or fewer |
|» AchCountry|body|string|false|The country of the ACH address. <a id="opIdObject_GETPaymentMethod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/object/payment-method/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/object/payment-method/{id}`

<h3 id="crud-retrieve-a-payment-method-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|

|id|path|string|true|Object id|

## CRUD: Update a payment method

<a id="opIdObject_PUTPaymentMethod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/object/payment-method/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "CreditCardAddress1": "312 2nd Ave W_new",
    "Id": "2c93808457d787030157e02fced332a2"
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/object/payment-method/{id}`

For a use case of this operation, see [Configure Payment Methods](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-guides/#Configure-payment-methods).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "CreditCardAddress1": "312 2nd Ave W_new",
  "Id": "2c93808457d787030157e02fced332a2"
}
```

<h3 id="crud-update-a-payment-method-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rejectUnknownFields|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether the call fails if the request body contains unknown fields.<br>With `rejectUnknownFields` set to `true`, Zuora returns a 400 response if<br>the request body contains unknown fields. The body of the 400 response is:<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "message": "Error - unrecognised fields"<br>}<br>```<br><br>By default, Zuora ignores unknown fields in the request body.<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|

This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|id|path|string|true|Object id|
|body|body|[ProxyModifyPaymentMethod](#schemaproxymodifypaymentmethod)|true|none|
|» AccountId|body|string|false| The ID of the customer account associated with this payment method.<br><br>**Note:** If a payment method was created without an account ID associated, you can update the payment method to specify an account ID in this operation. However, if a payment method is already associated with a customer account, you cannot update the payment method to associate it with another account ID. You cannot remove the previous account ID and leave the `AccountId` filed empty in this operation. |

|» AchAccountName|body|string|false| The name of the account holder, which can be either a person or a company. Use this field for ACH payment methods.<br><br>**Character limit**: 70 **Values**: a string of 70 characters or fewer |
|» AchAccountType|body|string|false| The type of bank account associated with the ACH payment. Use this field for ACH payment methods.<br><br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**:<br><br>- `BusinessChecking`<br>- `Checking`<br>- `Saving`<br>|

|» AchAddress2|body|string|false| Line 2 for the ACH address. Required on create for the Vantiv payment gateway. Optional for other gateways.<br><br>**Character limit:** **Values:** an address |
|» AchBankName|body|string|false| The name of the bank where the ACH payment account is held. Use this field for ACH payment methods.<br><br>**Character limit**: 70 **Values**: a string of 70 characters or fewer |
|» AchCity|body|string|false|The city of the ACH address. Use this field for ACH payment methods. **Note**: This field is only specific to the NMI payment gateway.<br><br>**Character limit**: 40 **Values**: a string of 40 characters or fewer |
|» AchCountry|body|string|false|The country of the ACH address. Use this field for ACH methods.<br><br>**Note**: This field is only specific to the NMI payment gateway.<br><br>**Character limit**: 44 **Values**: a supported country name |
|» AchPostalCode|body|string|false|The billing address's zip code. This field is required only when you define an ACH payment method. **Note**: This field is only specific to the NMI payment gateway.<br><br>**Character limit**: 20 **Values**: a string of 40 characters or fewer |
|» AchState|body|string|false|The billing address's state. Use this field is if the `ACHCountry` value is either `Canada` or the `US`. State names must be spelled in full. This field is required only when you define an ACH payment method. **Note**: This field is only specific to the NMI payment gateway.<br><br>**Character limit**: 50 **Values**: a valid state name |
|» BankBranchCode|body|string|false| The branch code of the bank used for direct debit. Use this field for direct debit payment methods.<br><br>**Character limit**: 10 **Values**:  string of 10 characters or fewer |
|» BankCheckDigit|body|string|false|The check digit in the international bank account number, which confirms the validity of the account. Use this field for direct debit payment methods.<br><br>**Character limit**: 4 **Values**:  string of 4 characters or fewer |

To ensure PCI compliance, this value is not stored and cannot be queried.<br>**Values**: a valid CVV or CVV2 security code |
|» CreditCardState|body|string|false| The billing address's state. Use this field is if the `CreditCardCountry' value is either Canada or the US. State names must be spelled in full. |

|» State|body|string|false| The state of the customer's address. This field is used only for the direct debit payment method.<br>**Character limit**: 70 **Values**: a string of 70 characters or fewer |
|» StreetName|body|string|false| The street name of the customer's address. This field is used only for the direct debit payment method.<br>**Character limit**: 100 **Values**: a string of 100 characters or fewer |
|» StreetNumber|body|string|false| The street number of the customer's address. This field is used only for the direct debit payment method.<br>**Character limit**: 30 **Values**: a string of 30 characters or fewer |

## Create a payment method

<a id="opIdPOST_PaymentMethods"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/payment-methods \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "BAID": "I-1TJ3GAGG82Y9",
    "accountKey": "2c92c0f95be68649015bf14e001f2760",
    "email": "customer@example.com",
    "type": "PayPalEC"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/payment-methods`

You can use this operation to create either a payment method associated with a specific customer account, or an orphan payment method that is not associated with any customer account. The orphan payment method must be associated with a customer account within 10 days. Otherwise, it will be deleted.

This operation supports the payment methods listed below.

### PayPal Express Checkout
The following request body fields are specific to this payment method:
* `BAID` (required)
* `email` (required)

### PayPal Native Express Checkout
The following request body fields are specific to this payment method:
* `BAID` (required)
* `email` (optional)

### PayPal Adaptive
The following request body fields are specific to this payment method:
* `preapprovalKey` (required)
* `email` (required)

### Credit Card
The following request body fields are specific to this payment method:
* `cardHolderInfo` (`cardHolderName` required)
* `cardNumber` (required)
* `cardType` (required)
* `expirationMonth` (required)
* `expirationYear` (required)
* `mitConsentAgreementRef`
* `mitConsentAgreementSrc`
* `mitNetworkTransactionId`
* `mitProfileAction`
* `mitProfileType`
* `mitProfileAgreedOn`
* `securityCode`
* `checkDuplicated`



### ACH
The following request body fields are applicable to this payment method:
* `bankABACode` (required)
* `bankAccountName` (required)
* `bankAccountNumber` (required)
* `bankAccountType` (required)
* `bankName` (required)
* `addressLine1`
* `addressLine2`
* `phone`
* `email`
* `city`
* `country`
* `state`
* `zipCode`

### SEPA
The following request body fields are applicable to this payment method:
* `IBAN` (required)
* `accountHolderInfo` (required)
* `businessIdentificationCode`


### Betalingsservice (Direct Debit DK)
The following request body fields are applicable to this payment method:
* `accountNumber` (required)
* `identityNumber` (required)
* `bankCode` (required)
* `accountHolderInfo` (required)


### Autogiro (Direct Debit SE)
The following request body fields are applicable to this payment method:        
* `accountNumber` (required)
* `identityNumber` (required)
* `branchCode` (required)
* `accountHolderInfo` (required) 


### Bacs (Direct Debit UK)
The following request body fields are applicable to this payment method:        
* `accountNumber` (required)
* `bankCode` (required)
* `accountHolderInfo` (required)


### Becs (Direct Entry AU)
The following request body fields are applicable to this payment method:        
* `accountNumber` (required)
* `branchCode` (required)
* `accountHolderInfo` (required)


### Becsnz (Direct Debit NZ)
The following request body fields are applicable to this payment method:        
* `accountNumber` (required)
* `bankCode` (required)
* `branchCode` (required)
* `accountHolderInfo` (required)


### PAD (Pre-Authorized Debit)
The following request body fields are applicable to this payment method:        
* `accountNumber` (required)
* `bankCode` (required)
* `branchCode` (required)
* `accountHolderInfo` (required)


### Custom payment methods
Note: This feature is in the Early Adopter phase. If you want to use this feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/) to enable the Universal Payment Connector and Open Payment Method services that support this feature.

With the support of Universal Payment Connector (UPC) and Open Payment Method (OPM) services, you can create custom payment methods by using the fields defined in a definition file for this type of custom payment method. See [Set up custom payment gateways and payment methods](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/MB_Set_up_custom_payment_gateways_and_payment_methods) for details.


> Body parameter

```json
{
```

## Create a credit card payment method

<a id="opIdPOST_PaymentMethodsCreditCard"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/payment-methods/credit-cards \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "accountKey": "A00001115",
    "cardHolderInfo": {
      "addressLine1": "77 Fallon Glen",
      "addressLine2": "",
      "cardHolderName": "Leo",
      "city": "Fremont",
      "country": "USA",
      "email": "smith@example.com",
      "phone": "4155551234",
      "state": "California",
      "zipCode": "94020"
    },
    "creditCardNumber": "1111222233334444",
    "creditCardType": "Discover",
    "defaultPaymentMethod": false,
    "expirationMonth": 10,
    "expirationYear": 2021,
    "gatewayOptions": {
      "Comments": "Test comments",
      "IPAddress": "192.168.1.1"
    },
    "numConsecutiveFailures": 3,
    "securityCode": "123"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/payment-methods/credit-cards`

You can create a credit card payment method for a customer account or an orphan credit card payment method that is not associated with any customer account. The orphan payment method must be associated with a customer account within 10 days. Otherwise, it will be deleted.

This API call is CORS Enabled. Use client-side JavaScript to invoke the call. 

**Note**: If you use this operation to create credit card payment methods instead of using the [iFrame of Hosted Payment Pages](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/LA_Hosted_Payment_Pages/C_Hosted_Payment_Pages/B_Implementing_Hosted_Payment_Pages_on_Your_Website/C_Embed_and_Submit_the_iFrame), you are subject to PCI-compliance audit requirements.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "accountKey": "A00001115",
  "cardHolderInfo": {
    "addressLine1": "77 Fallon Glen",
    "addressLine2": "",
    "cardHolderName": "Leo",
    "city": "Fremont",
    "country": "USA",
    "email": "smith@example.com",
    "phone": "4155551234",
    "state": "California",
    "zipCode": "94020"
  },
  "creditCardNumber": "1111222233334444",
  "creditCardType": "Discover",
  "defaultPaymentMethod": false,
  "expirationMonth": 10,
  "expirationYear": 2021,
  "gatewayOptions": {
    "Comments": "Test comments",
    "IPAddress": "192.168.1.1"
  },
  "numConsecutiveFailures": 3,
  "securityCode": "123"
}
```

## List all credit card payment methods of an account

<a id="opIdGET_PaymentMethodsCreditCard"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/payment-methods/credit-cards/accounts/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/payment-methods/credit-cards/accounts/{account-key}`

This REST API reference describes how to retrieve all credit card
information for the specified customer account. 

## Notes
The response includes details of credit or debit cards for the specified customer account. Card numbers are masked, e.g., "************1234". Cards are returned in reverse chronological order of last update.

Though you can also send requests for bank transfer, ACH, or other supported payment methods, the response will not include effective details of these payment methods.


<h3 id="list-all-credit-card-payment-methods-of-an-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of rows returned per page.<br>|
|account-key|path|string|true|Account number or account ID.|

## Create an Apple Pay payment method

<a id="opIdPOST_PaymentMethodsDecryption"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/payment-methods/decryption \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "accountID": "402891a25a02e11c015a02f3c6100003",
    "integrationType": "ApplePay",
    "invoiceId": "INV000000005",
    "merchantID": "merchant.CN.com.zuora.services416",
    "paymentGateway": "CyberSourceOPG",
    "paymentToken": {
      "data": "xGc......JDxuYz1gug0KZRrGXJQ=",
      "header": {
        "ephemeralPublicKey": "MFkwEw......TMbLoojKBA==",
        "publicKeyHash": "HuLvfqvLon......9jEyX0w=",
        "transactionId": "abbadd18818baea1f37b40844c9e09afa9733b0eccb373905b811da43cf1753b"
      },
      "signature": "MIAGCSqGSIb......AEtrLSv7hE9gAAAAAAAA==",
      "version": "EC_v1"
    },
    "processPayment": true
  }'
```

`POST /v1/payment-methods/decryption`

The decryption API endpoint can conditionally perform 3 tasks in one atomic call:
  * Decrypt Apple Pay Payment token
  * Create Credit Card Payment Method in Zuora with decrypted Apple Pay information
  * Process Payment on a specified Invoice (optional)


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "accountID": "402891a25a02e11c015a02f3c6100003",
  "integrationType": "ApplePay",
  "invoiceId": "INV000000005",
  "merchantID": "merchant.CN.com.zuora.services416",
  "paymentGateway": "CyberSourceOPG",
  "paymentToken": {
    "data": "xGc......JDxuYz1gug0KZRrGXJQ=",
    "header": {
      "ephemeralPublicKey": "MFkwEw......TMbLoojKBA==",
      "publicKeyHash": "HuLvfqvLon......9jEyX0w=",
      "transactionId": "abbadd18818baea1f37b40844c9e09afa9733b0eccb373905b811da43cf1753b"
    },
    "signature": "MIAGCSqGSIb......AEtrLSv7hE9gAAAAAAAA==",
    "version": "EC_v1"
  },
  "processPayment": true
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-apple-pay-payment-method-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|body|body|[POSTPaymentMethodDecryption](#schemapostpaymentmethoddecryption)|true|none|
|» accountID|body|string|false|The ID of the customer account associated with this payment method.<br>To create an orphan payment method that is not associated with any customer account, you do not need to specify this field during creation. However, you must associate the orphan payment method with a customer account within 10 days. Otherwise, this orphan payment method will be deleted.|
|» cardHolderInfo|body|object|false|Container for cardholder information. If provided, Zuora will only use this information for this card. If not provided, Zuora will use the account's existing bill-to contact information for this card.|
|» » addressLine1|body|string|false|First address line, 255 characters or less.|
|» » addressLine2|body|string|false|Second address line, 255 characters or less.|
|» » cardHolderName|body|string|false|The card holder's full name as it appears on the card, e.g., "John J Smith", 50 characters or less.|
|» » city|body|string|false|City, 40 characters or less.|
|» » country|body|string|false|Country, must be a valid country name or abbreviation.|
|» » email|body|string|false|Card holder's email address, 80 characters or less.|
|» » phone|body|string|false|Phone number, 40 characters or less.|
|» » state|body|string|false|State; must be a valid state name or 2-character abbreviation.|
|» » zipCode|body|string|false|Zip code, 20 characters or less.|
|» integrationType|body|string|true|Field to identify the token decryption type.<br><br>**Note:** The only value at this time is `ApplePay`.<br><br>|
|» invoiceId|body|string|false|The id of invoice this payment will apply to.<br><br>**Note:** When `processPayment` is `true`, this field is required.<br>Only one invoice can be paid; for scenarios where you want to pay for multiple invoices, set `processPayment` to `false` and call payment API separately.<br>|
|» merchantID|body|string|true|The Merchant ID that was configured for use with Apple Pay in the Apple iOS Developer Center.<br>|
|» mitConsentAgreementSrc|body|string|false|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|» mitProfileAction|body|string|false|If you specify this field, Zuora creates a stored credential profile within the payment method.<br>    <br>**Note:** This feature is in the **Early Adopters** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing as generally available.<br>    <br>* `Activate` - Use this value if you are creating the stored credential profile after receiving the customer's consent. Zuora will create the stored credential profile then send a cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) to the payment gateway to validate the stored credential profile. If the CIT succeeds, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Active`. If the CIT does not succeed, Zuora will not create a stored credential profile. If the payment gateway does not support the stored credential transaction framework, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Agreed`.     <br>    <br>* `Persist` - Use this value if the stored credential profile represents a stored credential profile in an external system. The status of the payment method's stored credential profile will be `Active`.<br>    <br>|
|» mitProfileType|body|string|false|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|» paymentGateway|body|string|false|The label name of the gateway instance configured in Zuora that should process the payment. When creating a Payment, this must be a valid gateway instance ID and this gateway must support the specific payment method. If not specified, the default gateway on the Account will be used.<br><br>**Note:** When `processPayment` is `true`, this field is required.<br>|
|» paymentToken|body|object|true|The complete JSON Object representing the encrypted payment token payload returned in the response from the Apple Pay session.<br><br>|
|» processPayment|body|boolean|false|A boolean flag to control whether a payment should be processed after creating payment method. The payment amount will be equivalent to the amount the merchant supplied in the ApplePay session. Default is false.<br><br>When `processPayment` is set to `false`, it must be followed by a separate subscribe or payment API call. <br><br><br>**Note:** If you set this field to `true`, you must specify the `paymentGateway` field with the payment gateway instance name. If you set this field to `false`, you must select the **Verify new credit card** check box on the gateway instance settings page. Otherwise, the cryptogram will not be sent to the gateway.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» mitConsentAgreementSrc|External|
|» mitProfileAction|Activate|
|» mitProfileAction|Persist|
|» mitProfileType|Recurring|

## Update a payment method

<a id="opIdPUT_PaymentMethod"></a>

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/payment-methods/string \
```

`PUT /v1/payment-methods/{payment-method-id}`

This operation allows you to update an existing payment method. 

The following request body fields can be updated regardless of payment method types:
* `authGateway`
* `gatewayOptions`
* `accountHolderInfo`
* Custom fields

The following request body fields can be updated only for the Credit Card payment method:
* `expirationMonth` 
* `expirationYear`
* `securityCode`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "accountHolderInfo": {
    "addressLine1": "address 1",
    "phone": "1333333333"
  },
  "expirationMonth": 8,
  "expirationYear": 2024,
  "securityCode": "123"
}
```

If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|payment-method-id|path|string|true|Unique ID of the payment method to update.|
|body|body|[PUTPaymentMethodRequest](#schemaputpaymentmethodrequest)|true|none|
|» accountHolderInfo|body|[PUTPMAccountHolderInfo](#schemaputpmaccountholderinfo)|false|none|
|» authGateway|body|string|false|Specifies the ID of the payment gateway that Zuora will use to authorize the payments that are made with the payment method.<br>|
|» currencyCode|body|string|false|The currency used for payment method authorization.<br>|
|» gatewayOptions|body|object|false|The field used to pass gateway-specific parameters and parameter values.<br>|
|» » key|body|string|false|The name of a gateway-specific parameter.<br>|
|» » value|body|string|false|The value of the gateway-specific parameter.<br>|
|» expirationMonth|body|integer|false|One or two digits expiration month (1-12).<br>        <br>|

`DELETE /v1/payment-methods/{payment-method-id}`

Deletes a credit card payment method.

If the specified payment method is the account's default payment
method, the request will fail.  In that case, you must first designate a
different payment method for that customer to be the default.

For a use case of this operation, see [Configure Payment Methods](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-guides/#Configure-payment-methods).

## Create authorization

<a id="opIdPOST_CreateAuthorization"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/payment-methods/string/authorize \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "accountId": "402881e861bd8a7e0161c6a453750026",
    "accountNumber": "A00000004",
    "amount": 1.99,
    "gatewayOrderId": "A001",
    "softDescriptor": "Service fee",
    "softDescriptorPhone": "400-000-1234"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/payment-methods/{payment-method-id}/authorize`

**Note:** If you want to enable this feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).

Enables you to authorize the availability of funds for a transaction but delay the capture of funds until a later time. Subsequently, use [CRUD: Create a payment](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/Object_POSTPayment) or [Create a payment](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CreatePayment) to capture the authorized funds, or use [Cancel authorization](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CancelAuthorization) to cancel the authorization. 

The payment gateways that support this operation include:

* Adyen integration v2.0 - This gateway does not support [Cancel authorization](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CancelAuthorization).
* CyberSource 1.28
* CyberSource 1.97
* CyberSource 2.0 - This gateway does not support [Cancel authorization](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CancelAuthorization).
* Chase Paymentech Orbital
* Ingenico ePayments
* Verifi - This gateway does not support [Cancel authorization](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CancelAuthorization).

Note that CyberSource 2.0 supports the Delayed Capture feature for both Credit Cards and Credit Card Reference payment methods.

If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, use the [Create payment](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CreatePayment) operation to capture the funds instead of the [CRUD: Create payment](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/Object_POSTPayment) operation.
      


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "accountId": "402881e861bd8a7e0161c6a453750026",
  "accountNumber": "A00000004",
  "amount": 1.99,
  "gatewayOrderId": "A001",
  "softDescriptor": "Service fee",
  "softDescriptorPhone": "400-000-1234"
}
```

<h3 id="create-authorization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|payment-method-id|path|string|true|The unique ID of the payment method where the authorization is created.<br>|
|body|body|[POSTDelayAuthorizeCapture](#schemapostdelayauthorizecapture)|true|none|
|» accountId|body|string|true|The ID of the customer account.|
|» accountNumber|body|string|true|The number of the customer account.|
|» amount|body|number|true|The amount of the trasaction.|
|» gatewayOrderId|body|string|true|The order ID for the specific gateway.|
|» mitTransactionSource|body|string|false|Payment transaction source used to differentiate the transaction source in Stored Credential Transaction framework.<br>  - `C_Unscheduled`: Cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) that does not occur on scheduled or regularly occurring dates.<br>  - `M_Recurring`: Merchant-initiated transaction (MIT) that occurs at regular intervals.<br>  - `M_Unscheduled`: Merchant-initiated transaction (MIT) that does not occur on scheduled or regularly occurring dates.<br>|
|» softDescriptor|body|string|false|A text, rendered on a cardholder’s statement, describing a particular product or service purchased by the cardholder.|
|» softDescriptorPhone|body|string|false|The phone number that relates to the soft descriptor, usually the phone number of customer service.|

#### Enumerated Values

|» mitTransactionSource|C_Unscheduled|
|» mitTransactionSource|M_Recurring|
|» mitTransactionSource|M_Unscheduled|

```json
}
```
