<h1 id="api-reference-billing-product-rate-plan-charges">Product Rate Plan Charges</h1>

## CRUD: Create a product rate plan charge

<a id="opIdObject_POSTProductRatePlanCharge"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/object/product-rate-plan-charge \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "AccountingCode": "Deferred Revenue",
    "BillCycleType": "DefaultFromCustomer",
    "BillingPeriod": "Month",
    "ChargeModel": "Volume Pricing",
    "ChargeType": "Recurring",
    "DeferredRevenueAccount": "Deferred Revenue",
    "Name": "Recurring flat fee",
    "ProductRatePlanChargeTierData": {
      "ProductRatePlanChargeTier": [
        {
          "Currency": "USD",
          "Price": 10
        }
      ]
    },
    "ProductRatePlanId": "2c92c0f8628e007901628f1dc06a453d",
    "RecognizedRevenueAccount": "Accounts Receivable",
    "TriggerEvent": "ContractEffective",
    "UOM": "each",
    "UseDiscountSpecificAccountingCode": false
  }'
```

`POST /v1/object/product-rate-plan-charge`

Creates a product rate plan charge for a specified rate plan charge. 

Product rate plan charges can be of three types, one-time fees, recurring fees, and usage fees. 


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "AccountingCode": "Deferred Revenue",
  "BillCycleType": "DefaultFromCustomer",
  "BillingPeriod": "Month",
  "ChargeModel": "Volume Pricing",
  "ChargeType": "Recurring",
  "DeferredRevenueAccount": "Deferred Revenue",
  "Name": "Recurring flat fee",
  "ProductRatePlanChargeTierData": {
    "ProductRatePlanChargeTier": [
      {
        "Currency": "USD",
        "Price": 10
      }
    ]
  },
  "ProductRatePlanId": "2c92c0f8628e007901628f1dc06a453d",
  "RecognizedRevenueAccount": "Accounts Receivable",
  "TriggerEvent": "ContractEffective",
  "UOM": "each",
  "UseDiscountSpecificAccountingCode": false
}
```

One-Time Charges and Recurring Charges return `NULL`.<br>|

|» RevenueRecognitionRuleName|body|string|false|Determines when to recognize the revenue for this charge. **Character limit**: 25 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Recognize upon invoicing`<br>- `Recognize daily over time`<br>|

```bash
  }'
```

> Body parameter

```json

  "Id": "2c93808457d787030157e02da0d91852",
  "Name": "ProductRatePlan1476934869186_new"
}
```

<h3 id="crud-update-a-product-rate-plan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rejectUnknownFields|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether the call fails if the request body contains unknown fields.<br>With `rejectUnknownFields` set to `true`, Zuora returns a 400 response if<br>the request body contains unknown fields. The body of the 400 response is:<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "message": "Error - unrecognised fields"<br>}<br>```<br><br>By default, Zuora ignores unknown fields in the request body.<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|id|path|string|true|Object id|
|body|body|[ProxyModifyProductRatePlan](#schemaproxymodifyproductrateplan)|true|none|
|» ActiveCurrencies|body|[string]|false|A list of 3-letter currency codes representing active currencies for the product rate plan. Use a comma to separate each currency code.<br><br>If the request body contains this field, the value of this field must contain the desired list of active currencies. The new list can never have more than four differences from the existing list.<br><br>This field cannot be used to modify the status of more than four currencies in a single request. For example, in a single request, you can only activate four currencies, or deactivate four currencies, or activate two and deactivate two. Making more than four changes to currencies always requires more than one call.<br><br>When specifying this field in the update request, you must provide the full list of active currencies you want, not just incremental changes. For each active currency update, provide the following currencies in the list:<br><br>Current active currencies + at most four changes (additions or deletions)<br>|
|» Description|body|string|false|A description of the product rate plan. **Character limit**: 500 **Values**: a string of 500 characters or fewer |
|» EffectiveEndDate|body|string(date)|false| The date when the product rate plan expires and can't be subscribed to, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br>**Character limit**: 29 |
|» EffectiveStartDate|body|string(date)|false| The date when the product rate plan becomes available and can be subscribed to, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br>**Character limit**: 29 |
|» Name|body|string|false|The name of the product rate plan. The name doesn't have to be unique in a Product Catalog, but the name has to be unique within a product. **Character limit**: 100 **Values**: a string of 100 characters or fewer |
|» ProductId|body|string|false|The ID of the product that contains the product rate plan. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a string of 32 characters or fewer |
|» BillingPeriod__NS|body|string|false|Billing period associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» Class__NS|body|string|false|Class associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» Department__NS|body|string|false|Department associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» IncludeChildren__NS|body|string|false|Specifies whether the corresponding item in NetSuite is visible under child subsidiaries. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» IntegrationId__NS|body|string|false|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» IntegrationStatus__NS|body|string|false|Status of the product rate plan's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» ItemType__NS|body|string|false|Type of item that is created in NetSuite for the product rate plan. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» Location__NS|body|string|false|Location associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» MultiCurrencyPrice__NS|body|string|false|Multi-currency price associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|

|» Subsidiary__NS|body|string|false|Subsidiary associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|

<h1 id="api-reference-billing-quotes-document">Quotes Document</h1>

## Generate a quote document

<a id="opIdPOST_QuotesDocument"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/quotes/document \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "apiuser": "contact@example.com",
    "documentType": "pdf",
    "locale": "en_US",
    "quoteId": "a0Bi000000A71rp",
    "serverUrl": "https://c.na10.visual.force.com/services/Soap/u/10.0/00DF00000008VnX",
    "sessionId": "we764buuM03bkE0fmmc5zGMYp",
    "templateId": "4028925648fdb7830148fdc1246c0003",
    "useSFDCLocale": "1",
    "zquotesMajorVersion": "7",
    "zquotesMinorVersion": "0"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/quotes/document`

The `document` call generates a quote document and returns the generated document URL. You can directly access the generated quote file through the returned URL.

The `document` call should be only used from Zuora Quotes. 

## File Size Limitation 
The maximum export file size is 2047MB. If you have large data requests that go over this limit, you will get the following 403 HTTP response code from Zuora:
`security:max-object-size>2047MB</security:max-object-size>`

Submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/) if you require additional assistance.

We can work with you to determine if large file optimization is an option for you.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "apiuser": "contact@example.com",
  "documentType": "pdf",
  "locale": "en_US",
  "quoteId": "a0Bi000000A71rp",
  "serverUrl": "https://c.na10.visual.force.com/services/Soap/u/10.0/00DF00000008VnX",
  "sessionId": "we764buuM03bkE0fmmc5zGMYp",
  "templateId": "4028925648fdb7830148fdc1246c0003",
  "useSFDCLocale": "1",
  "zquotesMajorVersion": "7",
  "zquotesMinorVersion": "0"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|body|body|[POSTQuoteDocType](#schemapostquotedoctype)|true|none|
|» apiuser|body|string|false|If not using Salesforce locale, this API Zuora user will be used to retrieve the locale from Zuora.<br>|
|» documentType|body|string|true|Type of the document to generate: `PDF` or `DOC`.<br>|
|» locale|body|string|false|Salesforce locale value to use.<br>|
|» password|body|string|false|none|

<h1 id="api-reference-billing-ramps">Ramps</h1>

## List ramp metrics by order number

<a id="opIdGET_RampMetricsByOrderNumber"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/orders/string/ramp-metrics \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/orders/{orderNumber}/ramp-metrics`

**Note**: This operation is only available if you have the Ramps feature enabled. The [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders) feature must be enabled before you can access the [Ramps](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Ramps_and_Ramp_Metrics/A_Overview_of_Ramps_and_Ramp_Metrics) feature. The Ramps feature is available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information coming October 2020.

Retrieves key ramp metrics about a specified order, including the following metrics:

* TCB, TCV in the Ramp level
* TCB, TCV in the Interval level
* TCB, TCV, Quantity, and MRR in Interval Metrics
* Delta TCB, Delta TCV, Delta Quantity, and Delta MRR in Interval Delta Metrics

See [Key metrics for Ramps](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Ramps_and_Ramp_Metrics/F_Key_metrics_for_Ramps) for more information.


<h3 id="list-ramp-metrics-by-order-number-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|orderNumber|path|string|true|The number of the existing order.<br>|

The [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders) feature must be enabled before you can access the [Ramps](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Ramps_and_Ramp_Metrics/A_Overview_of_Ramps_and_Ramp_Metrics) feature. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information coming October 2020.

Retrieves key metrics about a specified ramp, including the following metrics:

* TCB, TCV in the Ramp level
* TCB, TCV in the Interval level
* TCB, TCV, Quantity, and MRR in Interval Metrics
* Delta TCB, Delta TCV, Delta Quantity, and Delta MRR in Interval Delta Metrics

See [Key metrics for Ramps](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Ramps_and_Ramp_Metrics/F_Key_metrics_for_Ramps) for more information.

```bash
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/object/rate-plan-charge/{id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "PriceIncreasePercentage": 10
}
```

<h3 id="crud-update-a-rate-plan-charge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rejectUnknownFields|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether the call fails if the request body contains unknown fields.<br>With `rejectUnknownFields` set to `true`, Zuora returns a 400 response if<br>the request body contains unknown fields. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|

This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|id|path|string|true|Object id|
|body|body|[ProxyModifyRatePlanCharge](#schemaproxymodifyrateplancharge)|true|none|
|» BillingTiming|body|string|false| The billing timing for the charge. You can choose to bill in advance or in arrears for recurring charge types. This field is not used in one-time or usage based charge types.<br>**Character limit**: **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `In Advance`<br>- `In Arrears`<br>**Note:** You can override the value inherited from the Product Rate Plan Charge when a subscription has a recurring charge type.<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>|
|» DiscountAmount|body|number(decimal)|false|Specifies the amount of a fixed-amount discount. You can provide a value for this field if the `ChargeModel` field value is `Discount-Fixed Amount`. **Character limit**: 16 **Values**: A valid currency amount<br>|
|» DiscountPercentage|body|number(decimal)|false|The percentage of discount for a percentage discount. Use this field if the value for `ProductRatePlanCharge.ChargeModel` is `Discount-Percentage` and you want to override the value in `ProductRatePlanChargeTier.DiscountPercentage`. **Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a decimal value between -100 and 100, exclusive<br>|
|» EndDateCondition|body|string|false| Defines when the charge ends after the charge trigger date. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`.<br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `SubscriptionEnd`: The charge ends on the subscription end date after the charge trigger date. This is the default value.<br>- `FixedPeriod`: The charge ends after a specified period based on the trigger date of the charge. If you set this field to `FixedPeriod`, you must specify the length of the period and a period type by defining the `UpToPeriods` and `UpToPeriodsType` fields.<br>- `SpecificEndDate`: The specific date on which the charge ends. If you set this field to `SpecificEndDate`, you must specify the specific date by defining the `SpecificEndDate` field.<br><br>**Note**: If the subscription ends before the charge end date, the charge ends when the subscription ends. But if the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge will end on the charge end date. |
|» ListPriceBase|body|string|false|The list price base for the product rate plan charge. **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Per Month`<br>- `Per Billing Period`<br>- `Per Week`<br>|
|» PriceChangeOption|body|string|false| Applies an automatic price change when a termed subscription is renewed.<br>**Character limit**: **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `NoChange` (default)<br>- `SpecificPercentageValue`<br>- `UseLatestProductCatalogPricing`<br>|
|» PriceIncreasePercentage|body|number(double)|false| Specifies the percentage to increase or decrease the price of renewed subscriptions.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a decimal value between -100 and 100 |
|» RatingGroup|body|string|false|Specifies a rating group based on which usage records are rated. <br><br>* `ByBillingPeriod` (default) - The rating is based on all the usages in a billing period. <br>* `ByUsageStartDate` - The rating is based on all the usages on the same usage start date.<br>* `ByUsageRecord` - The rating is based on each usage record.<br>* `ByUsageUpload` - The rating is based on all the usages in a uploaded usage file (`.xls` or `.csv`). If you import a mass usage in a single upload, which contains multiple usage files in `.xls` or `.csv` format, usage records are grouped for each usage file.<br>* `ByGroupId` - The rating is based on all the usages in the same custom group. <br><br><br>**Note:** <br>- The `ByBillingPeriod` value can be applied for all charge models. <br>- The `ByUsageStartDate`, `ByUsageRecord`, and `ByUsageUpload` values can only be applied for per unit, volume pricing, and tiered pricing charge models. <br>- The `ByGroupId` value is only available if you have the Active Rating feature enabled.<br>- Use this field only for Usage charges. One-Time Charges and Recurring Charges return `NULL`.<br><br><br>See [Usage Rating by Group](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/J_Billing_Operations/Usage/Usage_Rating_by_Group) for more information.<br>|
|» RevRecCode|body|string|false| Associates this product rate plan charge with a specific revenue recognition code.<br><br>**Character limit**: 70<br><br>**Values**: inherited from `ProductRatePlanCharge.RevRecCode` or a valid revenue recognition code<br><br>**Note**: Unless overridden, this value changes if `ProductRatePlanCharge.RevRecCode` is updated. The values of `UpdatedById` and `UpdatedDate` for the `RatePlanCharge` do not change when `ProductRatePlanCharge.RevRecCode` is updated. |
|» RevRecTriggerCondition|body|string|false| Specifies when revenue recognition begins.<br><br>**Character limit**: 22<br><br>**Values**: inherited from `ProductRatePlanCharge.RevRecTriggerCondition` or one of the following:<br><br>-  `ContractEffectiveDate`<br><br>-  `ServiceActivationDate`<br><br>-  `CustomerAcceptanceDate`<br><br>Note: Unless overridden, this value changes if `ProductRatePlanCharge.RevRecTriggerCondition` is updated. The values of `UpdatedById` and `UpdatedDate` for the `RatePlanCharge` do not change when `ProductRatePlanCharge.RevRecTriggerCondition` is updated. |
|» RevenueRecognitionRuleName|body|string|false| Specifies the Revenue Recognition Rule that you want the Rate Plan Charge to use. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. By default, the Revenue Recognition Rule is inherited from the Product Rate Plan Charge. For Amend calls, you can use this field only for NewProduct amendments. For Update calls, you can use this field only to update subscriptions in draft status. Note that if you use this field to specify a Revenue Recognition Rule for the Rate Plan Charge, the rule will remain as specified even if you later change the rule used by the corresponding Product Rate Plan Charge.<br><br>**Character limit**: n/a<br><br>**Values**: inherited from `ProductRatePlanCharge.RevenueRecognitionRuleName` or the name of an active Revenue Recognition Rule<br><br>**Note**: Unless overridden, this value changes if `ProductRatePlanCharge.RevenueRecognitionRuleName` is updated. The values of `UpdatedById` and `UpdatedDate` for the `RatePlanCharge` do not change when `ProductRatePlanCharge.RevenueRecognitionRuleName` is updated. |
|» SpecificEndDate|body|string(date)|false| The specific date on which the charge ends, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Note**:<br><br>- This field is only applicable when the `EndDateCondition` field is set to `SpecificEndDate`.<br>- If the subscription ends before the specific end date, the charge ends when the subscription ends. But if the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge will end on the specific end date.<br>|
|» TriggerDate|body|string(date)|false| The date when the charge becomes effective and billing begins, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. This field is required if the `TriggerEvent` field value is `SpecificDate`.<br>**Character limit**: 29 |
|» TriggerEvent|body|string|false|Specifies when to start billing the customer for the charge.<br><br>**Note:** This field can be passed through the Subscribe and Amend calls and will override the default value set on the Product Rate Plan Charge.<br><br>**Note:** When the [Update rate plan charge trigger condition?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings) setting is set to `Yes`, this field can be passed through the update() call and override the previous value. You can use this feature to directly update the trigger condition of a rate plan charge without creating an order action (or amendment). <br><br>**Character limit**: 18<br>**Values**: inherited from<br>`ProductRatePlanCharge.TriggerEvent` and can be one of the following values:<br><br><br> - `ContractEffective` is the date when the subscription's contract goes into effect and the charge is ready to be billed.<br><br> - `ServiceActivation` is when the services or products for a subscription have been activated and the customers have access.<br><br> - `CustomerAcceptance` is when the customer accepts the services or products for a subscription.<br><br> - `SpecificDate` is valid only on the RatePlanCharge. When this value is specified, use the `TriggerDate` field to set the specific date.<br>|
|» UpToPeriodsType|body|string|false| The period type used to define when the charge ends. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Billing Periods` (default)<br>- `Days`<br>- `Weeks`<br>- `Months`<br>- `Years`<br>**Note**:<br><br>- You must use this field together with the `UpToPeriods` field to specify the time period.<br>- This field is only applicable only when the `EndDateCondition` field is set to `FixedPeriod`.<br>|
|» WeeklyBillCycleDay|body|string|false| Specifies which day of the week as the bill cycle day (BCD) for the charge.<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Sunday`<br>- `Monday`<br>- `Tuesday`<br>- `Wednesday`<br>- `Thursday`<br>- `Friday`<br>- `Saturday`<br>|
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Rate Plan Charge object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

<h1 id="api-reference-billing-refunds">Refunds</h1>

## CRUD: Create a refund

<a id="opIdObject_POSTRefund"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/object/refund \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "AccountId": "2c93808457d787030157e03190e748ea",
    "Amount": 1.1,
    "Comment": "this is comments",
    "PaymentId": "2c93808457d787030157e03197714910",
    "ReasonCode": "Standard Refund",
    "RefundInvoicePaymentData": {
      "RefundInvoicePayment": [
        {
          "InvoiceId": "2c93808457d787030157e03195604902",
          "RefundAmount": 1.1
        }
      ]
    },
    "SoftDescriptor": "thisSD",
    "SoftDescriptorPhone": "contact@example.com",
    "SourceType": "Payment",
    "Type": "Electronic"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/object/refund`

Creates a refund. 

If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, you can use this operation to unapply the payment from an invoice or multiple invoices, and refund the payment. 

If the unapplied payment is left in the following scenarios, you have to reapply the unapplied payment to the original invoices:

- An electronic refund in Processing status is handled to change to Error. An unapplied payment is left. 
- An electronic refund gets to Error, and payment reapplying fails due to the concurrent issue. 
- The refund canceling operation updates the status of a refund from Processed to Canceled. When it is successful, an unapplied payment is left.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "AccountId": "2c93808457d787030157e03190e748ea",
  "Amount": 1.1,
  "Comment": "this is comments",
  "PaymentId": "2c93808457d787030157e03197714910",
  "ReasonCode": "Standard Refund",
  "RefundInvoicePaymentData": {
    "RefundInvoicePayment": [
      {
        "InvoiceId": "2c93808457d787030157e03195604902",
        "RefundAmount": 1.1
      }
    ]
  },
  "SoftDescriptor": "thisSD",
  "SoftDescriptorPhone": "contact@example.com",
  "SourceType": "Payment",
  "Type": "Electronic"
}
```

<h3 id="crud-create-a-refund-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rejectUnknownFields|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether the call fails if the request body contains unknown fields.<br>With `rejectUnknownFields` set to `true`, Zuora returns a 400 response if<br>the request body contains unknown fields. The body of the 400 response is:<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "message": "Error - unrecognised fields"<br>}<br>```<br><br>By default, Zuora ignores unknown fields in the request body.<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|body|body|[ProxyCreateRefund](#schemaproxycreaterefund)|true|none|
|» AccountId|body|string|false| The ID of the account associated with this refund. This field is only required if you create a non-referenced refund. Don't specify a value for any other type of refund; Zuora associates the refund automatically with the account from the associated payment.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid account ID |
|» Amount|body|number(double)|true| The amount of the refund. The amount can't exceed the amount of the associated payment. If the original payment was applied to a single invoice, you can create a partial refund by specifying an amount in this field or through the UI. If the payment was applied to multiple invoices, you can create a partial refund by using the `RefundInvoicePaymentData` field of this operation or through the UI.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a valid currency amount |
|» Comment|body|string|false| Use this field to record comments about the refund.<br>**Character limit**: 255 **Values**: a string of 255 characters or fewer |
|» GatewayOptionData|body|object|false|A field used to pass gateway options. Zuora allows you to pass in special gateway-specific parameters for payments that go through the Adyen, Autorize.et, CyberSource, Merchant eSolutions, Orbital (Chase Paymentech), QValent, Vantiv, and Verifi gateways.<br><br>For each of these special parameters, you supply the name-value pair and Zuora passes it to the gateway. This allows you to add functionality that's supported by a specific gateway but currently not supported by Zuora.<br>|
|» » GatewayOption|body|[[GatewayOption](#schemagatewayoption)]|true|none|
|» GatewayState|body|string|false| The status of the payment in the gateway.<br>**Character limit**: 19 **Values**: automatically generated |
|» MethodType|body|string|false| Indicates how an external refund was issued to a customer. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to ` External`. You can issue an external refund on an electronic payment. **Character limit**: 30 **Values**:<br><br>- `ACH`<br>- `Cash`<br>- `Check`<br>- `CreditCard`<br>- `Other`<br>- `PayPal`<br>- `WireTransfer`<br>- `DebitCard`<br>- `CreditCardReferenceTransaction`<br>|
|» PaymentId|body|string|false| The unique ID of the payment associated with this refund. Don't specify a value for this field if you're creating an electronic non-referenced refund.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid payment ID |
|» PaymentMethodId|body|string|false| The unique ID of the payment method that the customer used to make the payment. This field is only required if you create a non-referenced refund.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **V****alues**: a valid payment method ID |
|» ReasonCode|body|string|false| A code identifying the reason for the transaction. Must be an existing reason code or empty. If you do not specify a value, Zuora uses the default reason code.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **V****alues**: a valid reason code |
|» RefundDate|body|string(date)|false|The date of the refund, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. The date of the refund cannot be before the payment date. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to ` External`. Zuora automatically generates this field for electronic refunds.<br><br>With the Future Dated Credit Balance Adjustment feature enabled, you can create a non-referenced refund with a refund date. <br>* For external refunds, you can specify any date.<br>* For electronic refunds, you can only set the date to the date when the API operation is called or one day later.<br>|
|» RefundInvoicePaymentData|body|object|false|Container for the refund invoice payment data. This field is only required if you apply a full or partical refund against a payment attached to muliple invoices.<br>|
|» » RefundInvoicePayment|body|[[RefundInvoicePayment](#schemarefundinvoicepayment)]|true|none|
|» SoftDescriptor|body|string|false| A payment gateway-specific field that maps Zuora to other gateways . **Character limit**: 35 **Values**:<br><br>- 3-byte company identifier &quot;*&quot; 18-byte descriptor<br>- 7-byte company identifier &quot;*&quot; 14-byte descriptor<br>- 12-byte company identifier &quot;*&quot; 9-byte descriptor<br>|
|» SoftDescriptorPhone|body|string|false| A payment gateway-specific field that maps Zuora to other gateways . **Character limit**: 20 **Values**:<br><br>- Customer service phone number formatted as: `NNN-NNN-NNNN` or `NNN-AAAAAAA`<br>- URL (non-e-Commerce): Transactions sent with a URL do not qualify for the best interchange rate<br>- Email address<br>|
|» SourceType|body|string|false| Specifies whether the refund is a refund payment or a credit balance. This field is only required if you create a non-referenced refund. If you creating an non-referenced refund, then set this value to `CreditBalance`.<br>**Note**: If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, the value of this field can only be set to `Payment`.<br>**Character limit**: 13 **Values**:<br><br>- `Payment`<br>- `CreditBalance`<br>|
|» Type|body|string|true| Specifies if the refund is electronic or external.<br>**Character limit**: 10 **Values**:<br><br>- `Electronic`<br>- `External`<br>|
|» IntegrationId__NS|body|string|false|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» IntegrationStatus__NS|body|string|false|Status of the refund's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» Origin__NS|body|string|false|Origin of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» SyncDate__NS|body|string|false|Date when the refund was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» SynctoNetSuite__NS|body|string|false|Specifies whether the refund should be synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Refund object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

## List refunds

<a id="opIdGET_Refunds"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/refunds \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/refunds`

**Note:** This operation is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information. 

Retrieves the information about all refunds. Two types of refunds are available, electronic refunds and external refunds.

### Filtering

You can use query parameters to restrict the data returned in the response. Each query parameter corresponds to one field in the response body.

If the value of a filterable field is string, you can set the corresponding query parameter to `null` when filtering. Then, you can get the response data with this field value being `null`.

Examples:

- /v1/refunds?status=Processed

- /v1/refunds?amount=4&status=Processed

- /v1/refunds?status=Processed&type=External&sort=+number


<h3 id="list-refunds-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of rows returned per page.<br>|
|accountId|query|string|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `accountId` field.<br>|
|amount|query|number(double)|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `amount` field.<br>|
|createdById|query|string|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `createdById` field.<br>|
|createdDate|query|string(date-time)|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `createdDate` field.<br>|
|methodType|query|string|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `methodType` field.<br>|
|number|query|string|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `number` field.<br>|
|paymentId|query|string|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `paymentId` field.<br>|
|refundDate|query|string(date)|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `refundDate` field.<br>|
|status|query|string|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `status` field.<br>|
|type|query|string|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `type` field.<br>|
|updatedById|query|string|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `updatedById` field.<br>|
|updatedDate|query|string(date-time)|false|This parameter filters the response based on the `updatedDate` field.<br>|
|sort|query|string|false|This parameter restricts the order of the data returned in the response. You can use this parameter to supply a dimension you want to sort on.<br><br>A sortable field uses the following form: <br><br>*operator* *field_name*<br><br>You can use at most two sortable fields in one URL path. Use a comma to separate sortable fields. For example:  *operator* *field_name*, *operator* *field_name*  <br><br>*operator* is used to mark the order of sequencing. The operator is optional. If you only specify the sortable field without any operator, the response data is sorted in descending order by this field.<br><br>  - The `-` operator indicates an ascending order.<br>  - The `+` operator indicates a descending order.<br><br>By default, the response data is displayed in descending order by refund number.<br><br>*field_name* indicates the name of a sortable field. The supported sortable fields of this operation are as below:<br><br>  - number<br>  - accountId<br>  - amount<br>  - refundDate<br>  - paymentId<br>  - createdDate<br>  - createdById<br>  - updatedDate<br>  - updatedById<br>  <br>Examples:<br><br>- /v1/refunds?sort=+number<br><br>- /v1/refunds?status=Processed&sort=-number,+amount<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|
|methodType|ACH|
|methodType|Cash|
|methodType|Check|
|methodType|CreditCard|
|methodType|PayPal|
|methodType|WireTransfer|
|methodType|DebitCard|
|methodType|CreditCardReferenceTransaction|
|methodType|BankTransfer|
|methodType|Other|
|status|Processed|
|status|Canceled|
|status|Error|
|status|Processing|
|type|External|
|type|Electronic|

## Update a refund

<a id="opIdPUT_UpdateRefund"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/refunds/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "comment": "update comment",
    "financeInformation": {
      "transferredToAccounting": "No"
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/refunds/{refundId}`

**Note:** This operation is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information. 

Updates the basic and finance information about a refund.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "comment": "update comment",
  "financeInformation": {
    "transferredToAccounting": "No"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-refund-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|refundId|path|string|true|The unique ID of a refund. For example, 4028905f5a87c0ff015a889e590e00c9.<br>|
|body|body|[PUTRefundType](#schemaputrefundtype)|true|none|
|» comment|body|string|false|Comments about the refund.<br>|
|» financeInformation|body|object|false|Container for the finance information related to the refund.<br>|
|» » bankAccountAccountingCode|body|string|false|The accounting code that maps to a bank account in your accounting system.<br>|
|» » transferredToAccounting|body|string|false|Whether the payment was transferred to an external accounting system. Use this field for integration with accounting systems, such as NetSuite. <br>|
|» » unappliedPaymentAccountingCode|body|string|false|The accounting code for the unapplied payment.<br>|
|» reasonCode|body|string|false|A code identifying the reason for the transaction. The value must be an existing reason code or empty. If you do not specify a value, Zuora uses the default reason code.<br>|

|» IntegrationId__NS|body|string|false|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|

|» SyncDate__NS|body|string|false|Date when the refund was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» SynctoNetSuite__NS|body|string|false|Specifies whether the refund should be synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Refund object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

|» distributionType|body|string|false|How you want to distribute the revenue.<br><br>* Daily Distribution: Distributes revenue evenly across each day between the recognitionStart and recognitionEnd dates.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Back Load): Back loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the end only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Front Load): Front loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the beginning only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Proration by Days): Splits the revenue amount between the two partial months.<br><br>**Note:** To use any of the Monthly Distribution options, you must have the "Monthly recognition over time" model enabled in **Settings > Finance > Manage Revenue Recognition Models** in the Zuora UI.<br>|

Creates a revenue schedule for a debit memo item, and automatically distribute the revenue by specifying the recognition start and end dates.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "distributionType": "daily distribution",
  "notes": "notes",
  "recognitionEnd": "2016-12-31",
  "recognitionStart": "2016-01-01",
  "revenueEvent": {
    "eventType": "Debit Memo Posted",
    "eventTypeSystemId": "DebitMemoPosted__z",
    "notes": "some notes"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-revenue-schedule-for-a-debit-memo-item-distribute-by-date-range-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|dmi-id|path|string|true|The unique ID of a debit memo item. You can get the debit memo item ID from the response of [Get debit memo items](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/GET_DebitMemoItems).<br>|
|body|body|[POSTRevenueScheduleByTransactionRatablyDMType](#schemapostrevenueschedulebytransactionratablydmtype)|true|none|
|» distributionType|body|string|false|How you want to distribute the revenue.<br><br>* Daily Distribution: Distributes revenue evenly across each day between the recognitionStart and recognitionEnd dates.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Back Load): Back loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the end only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Front Load): Front loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the beginning only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Proration by Days): Splits the revenue amount between the two partial months.<br><br>**Note:** To use any of the Monthly Distribution options, you must have the "Monthly recognition over time" model enabled in **Settings > Finance > Manage Revenue Recognition Models** in the Zuora UI.<br>|
|» notes|body|string|false|Additional information about this record.<br>|
|» recognitionEnd|body|string(date)|true|The end date of a recognition period in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br><br>The maximum difference between the `recognitionStart` and `recognitionEnd` date fields is equal to 250 multiplied by the length of an accounting period.<br>|
|» recognitionStart|body|string(date)|true|The start date of a recognition period in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br><br>If there is a closed accounting period between the `recognitionStart` and `recognitionEnd` dates, the revenue that would be placed in the closed accounting period is instead placed in the next open accounting period.<br>|
|» revenueEvent|body|[POSTRevenueScheduleByTransactionRatablyTypeRevenueEvent](#schemapostrevenueschedulebytransactionratablytyperevenueevent)|false|Must specify at least one of `eventType` or `eventTypeSystemId`.<br>|
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Revenue Schedule object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/revenue-schedules/invoice-items/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "revenueDistributions": [
      {
        "accountingPeriodName": "Jan '\''16",
        "newAmount": "20"
      },
      {
        "accountingPeriodName": "Open-Ended",
        "newAmount": "30"
      }
    ],
    "revenueEvent": {
      "eventType": "Revenue Distributed",
      "eventTypeSystemId": "RevenueDistributed__z",
      "notes": "My notes"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/revenue-schedules/invoice-items/{invoice-item-id}`

Creates a revenue schedule for an Invoice Item and manually distribute the revenue.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "revenueDistributions": [
    {
      "accountingPeriodName": "Jan '16",
      "newAmount": "20"
    },
    {
      "accountingPeriodName": "Open-Ended",
      "newAmount": "30"
    }
  ],
  "revenueEvent": {
    "eventType": "Revenue Distributed",
    "eventTypeSystemId": "RevenueDistributed__z",
    "notes": "My notes"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-revenue-schedule-for-an-invoice-item-manual-distribution-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|invoice-item-id|path|string|true|ID of the Invoice Item, for example, e20b07fd416dcfcf0141c81164fd0a75.<br>If the specified Invoice Item is already associated with a revenue schedule, the call will fail.<br>|
|body|body|[POSTRevenueScheduleByTransactionType](#schemapostrevenueschedulebytransactiontype)|true|none|
|» notes|body|string|false|Additional information about this record.<br><br>Character Limit: 2,000<br>|
|» revenueDistributions|body|[[POSTDistributionItemType](#schemapostdistributionitemtype)]|false|An array of revenue distributions. Represents how you want to distribute revenue for this revenue schedule. You can distribute revenue into a maximum of 250 accounting periods with one revenue schedule.<br><br>The sum of new Amounts must equal the the Charge Amount of the specified Invoice Item.<br>|
|» revenueEvent|body|[POSTRevenueScheduleByTransactionTypeRevenueEvent](#schemapostrevenueschedulebytransactiontyperevenueevent)|false|Represents a change to a revenue schedule, such as posting an invoice or distributing revenue.<br><br>You must specify the `eventType` or the `eventTypeSystemID`, or both. If you have configured more than one revenue event type with the same label, you must specify the `eventTypeSystemId`.<br>|
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Revenue Schedule object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

```json
  "revenueScheduleNumber": "RS-00000002",
  "success": true
}
```

## Create a revenue schedule for an invoice item (distribute by date range)

<a id="opIdPOST_RSforInvoiceItem_DistributeByDateRange"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/revenue-schedules/invoice-items/string/distribute-revenue-with-date-range \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "distributionType": "Daily distribution",
    "notes": "Manually distribute revenue by usage",
    "recognitionEnd": "2016-12-31",
    "recognitionStart": "2016-12-1",
    "revenueEvent": {
      "eventType": "Revenue Distributed",
      "eventTypeSystemId": "RevenueDistributed__z",
      "notes": ""
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/revenue-schedules/invoice-items/{invoice-item-id}/distribute-revenue-with-date-range`

Creates a revenue schedule for an Invoice Item and distribute the revenue by specifying the recognition start and end dates.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "distributionType": "Daily distribution",
  "notes": "Manually distribute revenue by usage",
  "recognitionEnd": "2016-12-31",
  "recognitionStart": "2016-12-1",
  "revenueEvent": {
    "eventType": "Revenue Distributed",
    "eventTypeSystemId": "RevenueDistributed__z",
    "notes": ""
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-revenue-schedule-for-an-invoice-item-distribute-by-date-range-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|invoice-item-id|path|string|true|ID of the Invoice Item, for example, e20b07fd416dcfcf0141c81164fd0a75.<br>If the specified Invoice Item is already associated with a revenue schedule, the call will fail.<br>|
|body|body|[POSTRevenueScheduleByDateRangeType](#schemapostrevenueschedulebydaterangetype)|true|none|
|» distributionType|body|string|false|How you want to distribute the revenue. <br><br><br>* Daily Distribution: Distributes revenue evenly across each day between the recognitionStart and recognitionEnd dates.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Back Load): Back loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the end only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Front Load): Front loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the beginning only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Proration by Days): Splits the revenue amount between the two partial months.<br><br>**Note:** To use any of the Monthly Distribution options, you must have the "Monthly recognition over time" model enabled in **Settings > Finance > Manage Revenue Recognition Models** in the Zuora UI.<br>|
|» notes|body|string|false|Additional information about this record.<br>|
|» recognitionEnd|body|string(date)|true|The end date of a recognition period in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. <br><br>The maximum difference between the `recognitionStart` and `recognitionEnd` date fields is equal to 250 multiplied by the length of an accounting period.<br>|
|» recognitionStart|body|string(date)|true|The start date of a recognition period in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br><br>If there is a closed accounting period between the `recognitionStart` and `recognitionEnd` dates, the revenue that would be placed in the closed accounting period is instead placed in the next open accounting period.<br>|
|» revenueEvent|body|[POSTRevenueScheduleByDateRangeTypeRevenueEvent](#schemapostrevenueschedulebydaterangetyperevenueevent)|true|Must specify at least one of `eventType` or `eventTypeSystemId`.<br>|
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Revenue Schedule object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» distributionType|Daily Distribution|
|» distributionType|Monthly Distribution (Back Load)|
|» distributionType|Monthly Distribution (Front Load)|
|» distributionType|Monthly Distribution (Proration by Days)|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "revenueScheduleNumber": "RS-00000003",
  "success": true
}
```

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/revenue-schedules/product-charges/{charge-key}/{account-key}`

**Note:** This operation is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.

Retrieves the details about all revenue schedules of a product rate plan charge by specifying the charge ID and billing account ID.

|---|---|---|---|---|

This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|

If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|

|charge-key|path|string|true|The unique ID of a product rate plan charge. For example, 8a8082e65ba86084015bb323d3c61d82.<br>|

## Create a revenue schedule by subscription charge key

<a id="opIdPOST_RSforSubscCharge"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/revenue-schedules/subscription-charges/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "amount": "300",
    "deferredRevenueAccountingCode": "Deferred Revenue",
    "deferredRevenueAccountingCodeType": "Deferred Revenue",
    "overrideChargeAccountingCodes": "true",
    "recognizedRevenueAccountingCode": "Subscription Revenue",
    "recognizedRevenueAccountingCodeType": "Sales Revenue",
    "referenceId": "rs transaction ref",
    "revenueDistributions": [
      {
        "accountingPeriodName": "Jan'\''2013",
        "newAmount": "100"
      },
      {
        "accountingPeriodName": "Feb'\''2013",
        "newAmount": "200"
      }
    ],
    "revenueEvent": {
      "eventType": "Revenue Distributed",
      "eventTypeSystemId": "1111111",
      "notes": "Manually distribute revenue by usage"
    },
    "revenueScheduleDate": "2013-01-01"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/revenue-schedules/subscription-charges/{charge-key}`

Creates a revenue schedule by specifying the subscription charge. This method is for custom unlimited revenue recognition only.

**Note**: You can create a maximum of 3,000 revenue schedules for a subscription charge.


> Body parameter


|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|charge-key|path|string|true|ID of the subscription rate plan charge; for example, 402892793e173340013e173b81000012.|
|body|body|[POSTRevenueScheduleByChargeType](#schemapostrevenueschedulebychargetype)|true|none|
|» amount|body|string(decimal)|true|The revenue schedule amount, which is the sum of all revenue items. This field cannot be null and must be formatted based on the currency, such as `JPY 30` or `USD 30.15`. Test out the currency to ensure you are using the proper formatting otherwise, the response will fail and this error message is returned: `Allocation amount with wrong decimal places.`<br>|
|» deferredRevenueAccountingCode|body|string|false|The accounting code for deferred revenue, such as Monthly Recurring Liability. Required only when `overrideChargeAccountingCodes` is `true`. Otherwise, this value is ignored.<br>|
|» deferredRevenueAccountingCodeType|body|string|false|The type of the deferred revenue accounting code, such as Deferred Revenue. Required only when `overrideChargeAccountingCodes` is `true`. Otherwise, this value is ignored.<br>|
|» notes|body|string|false|Additional information about this record.<br><br>Character Limit: 2,000<br>|
|» overrideChargeAccountingCodes|body|boolean|false|When overriding accounting codes from a charge, `recognizedRevenueAccountingCode` and `deferredRevenue AccountingCode` must be in the request body and can have the empty value.<br>|

|» recognizedRevenueAccountingCodeType|body|string|false|The type of the recognized revenue accounting code, such as Sales Revenue or Sales Discount. Required only when `overrideChargeAccountingCodes` is `true`. Otherwise, this value is ignored.<br>|
|» referenceId|body|string|false|Reference ID is used only in the custom unlimited rule to create a revenue schedule. In this scenario, the revenue schedule is not linked to an invoice item or invoice item adjustment.<br><br>Character Limit: 100<br>|
|» revenueDistributions|body|[[POSTDistributionItemType](#schemapostdistributionitemtype)]|false|An array of revenue distributions. Represents how you want to distribute revenue for this revenue schedule. You can distribute revenue into a maximum of 250 accounting periods with one revenue schedule.<br><br>The sum of the newAmount fields must be equal to the amount field.<br>|
|» revenueEvent|body|[POSTRevenueScheduleByChargeTypeRevenueEvent](#schemapostrevenueschedulebychargetyperevenueevent)|false|Represents a change to a revenue schedule, such as posting an invoice or distributing revenue.<br>|
|» revenueScheduleDate|body|string(date)|true|The effective date of the revenue schedule. For example, the revenue schedule date for bookings-based revenue recognition is typically set to the order date or contract date.<br><br>The date cannot be in a closed accounting period. ## Delete a revenue schedule

<a id="opIdDELETE_RS"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/revenue-schedules/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`DELETE /v1/revenue-schedules/{rs-number}`

Deletes a revenue schedule by specifying its revenue schedule number
## Prerequisites
You must have the Delete Custom Revenue Schedule permissions in Zuora Finance.

The revenue schedule must not be associated with any invoice item, invoice item adjustment, or credit/debit memo item in Zuora Billing.


<h3 id="delete-a-revenue-schedule-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|rs-number|path|string|true|<br>Revenue schedule number of the revenue schedule you want to delete, for example, RS-00000256. To be deleted, the revenue schedule:<br>* Must be using a custom unlimited recognition rule.<br>* Cannot have any revenue in a closed accounting period.<br>* Cannot be included in a summary journal entry.<br>* Cannot have a revenue schedule date in a closed accounting period.<br>|

```json
}
```

## Distribute revenue in a recognition period

<a id="opIdPUT_RevenueByRecognitionStartandEndDates"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/revenue-schedules/string/distribute-revenue-with-date-range \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "distributionType": "Daily distribution",
    "eventType": "Revenue Distributed",
    "eventTypeSystemId": "RevenueDistributed__z",
    "notes": "manual distribute revenue by usage",
    "recognitionEnd": "2015-12-31",
    "recognitionStart": "2015-12-1"
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/revenue-schedules/{rs-number}/distribute-revenue-with-date-range`

Distributes revenue by specifying the recognition start and end dates. Request and response field descriptions and sample code are provided.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "distributionType": "Daily distribution",
  "eventType": "Revenue Distributed",
  "eventTypeSystemId": "RevenueDistributed__z",
  "notes": "manual distribute revenue by usage",
  "recognitionEnd": "2015-12-31",
  "recognitionStart": "2015-12-1"
}
```

<h3 id="distribute-revenue-in-a-recognition-period-parameters">Parameters</h3>

If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|rs-number|path|string|true|Revenue schedule number. Specify the revenue schedule whose revenue you want to distribute.<br>  <br>The revenue schedule number is always prefixed with "RS", for example, "RS-00000001".<br>|
|body|body|[PUTRSTermType](#schemaputrstermtype)|true|none|
|» distributionType|body|string|false|How you want to distribute the revenue. <br><br><br>* Daily Distribution: Distributes revenue evenly across each day between the recognitionStart and recognitionEnd dates.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Back Load): Back loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the end only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Front Load): Front loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the beginning only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Proration by Days): Splits the revenue amount between the two partial months.<br><br>**Note:** To use any of the Monthly Distribution options, you must have the "Monthly recognition over time" model enabled in **Settings > Finance > Manage Revenue Recognition Models** in the Zuora UI.<br>|

|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Revenue Event object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

<h1 id="api-reference-billing-rsa-signatures">RSA Signatures</h1>

## Generate an RSA signature

<a id="opIdPOST_RSASignatures"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/rsa-signatures \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "method": "POST",
    "pageId": "2c92c0f855e2b4630155ec9e6a1b6eec",
    "uri": "https://apisandbox.zuora.com/apps/PublicHostedPageLite.do"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/rsa-signatures`

The REST API used in Payment Pages 2.0 are CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) enabled and therefore requires a digital signature. The POST rsa_signatures call generates and returns the required digital signature and token for a Payment Pages 2.0 form. You need to pass the generated signature to your client for it to access Payment Pages 2.0. 
    
This REST service should be used only when you implement Payment Pages 2.0. 

**Note:** To avoid potential credit card fraud attacks, you should secure your Payment Pages from being accessed by fraudulent users before you issue client-side digital signatures and tokens. See [Manage Token Issuance](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/LA_Hosted_Payment_Pages/B_Payment_Pages_2.0/F_Generate_the_Digital_Signature_for_Payment_Pages_2.0#Manage_Token_Issuance) for more information.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "method": "POST",
  "pageId": "2c92c0f855e2b4630155ec9e6a1b6eec",
  "uri": "https://apisandbox.zuora.com/apps/PublicHostedPageLite.do"
}
```

<h3 id="generate-an-rsa-signature-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|body|body|[POSTRSASignatureType](#schemapostrsasignaturetype)|true|none|
|» method|body|string|true|The type of the request. Set it to POST.<br>|
|» pageId|body|string|true|The page id of your Payment Pages 2.0 form. Click **Show Page Id** next to the Payment Page name in the Hosted Page List to retrieve the page id.<br>|
|» uri|body|string|true|The URL that the Payment Page will be served from.<br>* For US Production environment: Use https://www.zuora.com/apps/PublicHostedPageLite.do<br>* For US API Sandbox environment: Use https://apisandbox.zuora.com/apps/PublicHostedPageLite.do<br>* For EU Cloud Production environment: Use https://eu.zuora.com/apps/PublicHostedPageLite.do<br>* For EU Cloud Sandbox environment: Use https://sandbox.eu.zuora.com/apps/PublicHostedPageLite.do<br>* For US Cloud Production environment: Use https://na.zuora.com/apps/PublicHostedPageLite.do<br>* For US Cloud Sandbox environment: Use https://sandbox.na.zuora.com/apps/PublicHostedPageLite.do<br>* For US Central Sandbox environment: Use https://test.zuora.com/apps/PublicHostedPageLite.do<br>* For EU Central Sandbox environment: Use https://test.eu.zuora.com/apps/PublicHostedPageLite.do<br>|

> Example responses

```json
  "signature": "",
  "success": true,
  "tenantId": "12270",
  "token": "E2BJEle7YrAlw93SjkaKthTmzMvXF341"
}
```

## Decrypt an RSA signature

<a id="opIdPOST_DecryptRSASignatures"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/rsa-signatures/decrypt \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "method": "POST",
    "publicKey": "",
    "signature": ""
  }'
```

`POST /v1/rsa-signatures/decrypt`

The REST API used in Payment Pages 2.0 are CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) enabled and therefore requires a digital signature. You use rsa_signatures to generate the required digital signature and token for a Payment Pages 2.0 form, and then you use the decrypt REST service to decrypt the signature to validate the signature and key.

This REST service should be used only when you implement Payment Pages 2.0. 


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "method": "POST",
  "publicKey": "",
  "signature": ""
}
```

<h3 id="decrypt-an-rsa-signature-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|body|body|[POSTDecryptionType](#schemapostdecryptiontype)|true|none|
|» method|body|string|true|The type of the request. Set it to POST.<br>|
|» publicKey|body|string|true|The public key generated by Zuora.<br>|
|» signature|body|string|true|The signature generated by Zuora.<br>|

> Example responses

```json
  "publicKey": "",
  "signature": "",
  "success": true
}
```

<h1 id="api-reference-billing-sequence-sets">Sequence Sets</h1>

## List sequence sets

<a id="opIdGET_SequenceSets"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/sequence-sets \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/sequence-sets`

Retrieves information about all sequence sets configured for billing documents, payments, and refunds. Billing documents include invoices, credit memos, and debit memos.

You can use query parameters to restrict the data returned in the response.

**Note**: The Credit and Debit Memos feature is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.

If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of rows returned per page.<br>|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number.<br>|
|name|query|string|false|The name of a specific sequence set.<br>|
