`POST /v1/sequence-sets`

Creates sequence sets, allowing distinct numbering sequences for billing documents, payments, and refunds. Billing documents include invoices, credit memos, and debit memos.

You can create a maximum of 100 sequence sets in one single request. A sequence set comprises a set of custom prefixes and starting numbers that are used for billing documents to generate, and payments and refunds to create.

See [Prefix and Numbering Configuration for Billing Documents](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Prefix_and_Numbering_Configuration_for_Billing_Documents) for more information about limitations.

**Note**: The Credit and Debit Memos feature is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.

<h1 id="api-reference-billing-settings">Settings</h1>

The Setting API provides a central API for managing settings in your Zuora tenant.

If you use Postman, you can import the Settings API endpoints as a collection into your Postman app and try out different requests to learn how the API works. Click the following button to get started:

[![Run in Postman](https://run.pstmn.io/button.svg)](https://www.getpostman.com/run-collection/1379901-d43e93a3-7d51-437c-b4cd-14163dd62fa2-SWLk4kiK)

You can sign up for a free account on the [Postman website](https://identity.getpostman.com/signup) and download the app in case you do not use Postman yet.


## Submit settings requests

<a id="opIdPOST_ProcessSettingsBatchRequest"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/settings/batch-requests \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "requests": [
      {
        "id": "1",
        "method": "GET",
        "url": "/billing-rules"
      },
      {
        "id": "2",
        "method": "GET",
        "url": "/accounting-rules"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /settings/batch-requests`

Submit a batch of settings requests by this single API operation.

By default, one batch settings request can contain a maximum of 100 single operation requests, including: 
* All the single requests in the process batch settings request.
* All the children requests of the single requests.

This maximum value is configurable.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "requests": [
    {
      "id": "1",
      "method": "GET",
      "url": "/billing-rules"
    },
    {
      "id": "2",
      "method": "GET",
      "url": "/accounting-rules"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="submit-settings-requests-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Authorization|header|string|true|`Bearer {token}` for a valid OAuth token.<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|body|body|[SettingsBatchRequest](#schemasettingsbatchrequest)|true|none|
|» requests|body|[[SettingValueRequest](#schemasettingvaluerequest)]|false|none|

## List all settings

<a id="opIdGET_ListAllSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/settings/listing \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /settings/listing`

Get a list of all available settings in your tenant. 

The response message is by default in JSON format. If you want to receive all the availabe settings in csv format, include `Accept` in the header parameters and set it to `application/csv`.
            
See a [200 response sample in JSON format](https://assets.zuora.com/zuora-documentation/ListAllSettingsResponseSample.json).

See a [200 response sample in CSV format](https://assets.zuora.com/zuora-documentation/ListAllSettingsResponseSample.csv).

You can find a specific operate of an available setting item in your tenant from the 200 response body of this call. See the following tutorials of Settings API for how to operate on a specifc setting item.

 * Billing Rules:
   * [Get a specific setting - Billing Rules](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/BB_C_Settings_API/Settings_API_tutorials/AA_Get_a_specific_setting_-_Billing_Rules)
   * [Update a specific setting - Billing Rules](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/BB_C_Settings_API/Settings_API_tutorials/AB_Update_a_specific_setting_-_Billing_Rules)

   * [Get Age Buckets](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/BB_C_Settings_API/Settings_API_tutorials/Get_Age_Buckets)
   * [Update Age Buckets](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/BB_C_Settings_API/Settings_API_tutorials/Update_Age_Buckets)
 * Invoice Templates:
   * [Get a specific Invoice Template](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/BB_C_Settings_API/Settings_API_tutorials/Get_a_specific_Invoice_Template)
   * [Get all Invoice Templates](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/BB_C_Settings_API/Settings_API_tutorials/Get_all_Invoice_Templates)

 * Communications Profiles:

   * [Create a new Communication Profile](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/BB_C_Settings_API/Settings_API_tutorials/Create_a_new_Communication_Profile)

   * [Get all Notifications under a particular Communication Profile](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/BB_C_Settings_API/Settings_API_tutorials/Get_all_Notifications_under_a_particular_Communication_Profile)

<a id="opIdObject_PUTSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/object/subscription/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \

  -d '{

  }'
```

`PUT /v1/object/subscription/{id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Name": "S_1476934934547_name",
  "Notes": "this is notes_new"
}
```

<h3 id="crud-update-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rejectUnknownFields|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether the call fails if the request body contains unknown fields.<br>With `rejectUnknownFields` set to `true`, Zuora returns a 400 response if<br>the request body contains unknown fields. The body of the 400 response is:<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "message": "Error - unrecognised fields"<br>}<br>```<br><br>By default, Zuora ignores unknown fields in the request body.<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|id|path|string|true|Object id|
|body|body|[ProxyModifySubscription](#schemaproxymodifysubscription)|true|none|
|» AccountId|body|string|false| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. The ID of a valid account ID. |
|» AutoRenew|body|boolean|false| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. Indicates if the subscription automatically renews at the end of the term.<br>**Values**: `true`, `false` |
|» CancelledDate|body|string(date)|false| The date of the Amendment object.<br>**Values**: inherited from `Amendment.EffectiveDate` |
|» ContractAcceptanceDate|body|string(date)|false|The date when the customer accepts the contract.<br><br>This field can be updated when **Status** is `Pending Acceptance`.<br><br>**Note** : This field is only required in the Subscribe call if the [Require Customer Acceptance of Orders?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_and_Order_Settings#Require_Customer_Acceptance_of_Orders.3F) setting is set to `Yes`. If this setting is set to `Yes`:<br><br> * If the `ServiceActivationDate` field is required, you must set this field, `ServiceActivationDate`, and `ContractEffectiveDate` fields in the Subscribe call to activate a subscription.<br> * If the `ServiceActivationDate` field is not required, you must set both this field and the `ContractEffectiveDate` field in the Subscribe call to activate a subscription. If you only set a valid date in the `ContractEffectiveDate` field, the Subscribe call still returns success, but the subscription is in `Pending Acceptance` status.<br><br>This field can also be updated when the subscription is still on version one (has not been amended before) and the [Allow update Subscription trigger dates?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_and_Order_Settings#Allow_update_Subscription_trigger_dates.3F) setting in Billing Settings is set to `Yes`. <br>|
|» ContractEffectiveDate|body|string(date)|false|The date when the contract takes effect.<br><br>This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`.<br><br>**Note**: This field is required in the Subscribe call. If you set the value of this field to null and both the ServiceActivationDate and ContractAcceptanceDate fields are not required, the Subscribe call still returns success, but the new subscription is in `DRAFT` status. To activate the subscription, you must set a valid date to this field.<br><br>This field can also be updated when the subscription is still on version one (has not been amended before) and the [Allow update Subscription trigger dates?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_and_Order_Settings#Allow_update_Subscription_trigger_dates.3F) setting in Billing Settings is set to "Yes".<br>|
|» CurrentTermPeriodType|body|string|false| The period type for the current subscription term. This field is used with the CurrentTerm field to specify the current subscription term.<br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>|
|» InitialTerm|body|integer(int32)|false| The length of the period for the first subscription term. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>**Required**: If TermType is Termed **Character limit**: 20 **Values**: any valid number. |
|» InitialTermPeriodType|body|string|false| The period type for the first subscription term.<br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>**Note**:<br><br>- This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>- This field is used with the InitialTerm field to specify the initial subscription term.<br>|
|» InvoiceOwnerId|body|string|false| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. A valid account ID. |
|» IsInvoiceSeparate|body|boolean|false| Determines if the subscription is invoiced separately. If `TRUE`, then all charges for this subscription are collected into the subscription's own invoice.<br>**Values**: `TRUE`, `FALSE `(default) |
|» Name|body|string|false| The unique identifier of the subscription. If you don't specify a value, then Zuora generates a name automatically. Whether auto-generated or manually specified, the subscription name must be unique. Otherwise an error will occur.<br>**Character limit**: 100 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- leave null to automatically generate<br>- a string of 100 characters or fewer<br>|
|» Notes|body|string|false| Use this field to record comments about the subscription.<br>**Character limit**: 500 **Values**: a string of 500 characters or fewer |
|» RenewalSetting|body|string|false| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. Specifies whether a termed subscription will remain termed or change to evergreen when it is renewed.<br>**Required**: If TermType is Termed **Values**: `RENEW_WITH_SPECIFIC_TERM `(default), `RENEW_TO_EVERGREEN` |
|» RenewalTerm|body|integer(int32)|false| The length of the period for the subscription renewal term. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. **Required**: If TermType is Termed.<br>**Character limit**: 20 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- leave null to default to `0`<br>- any number<br>|
|» RenewalTermPeriodType|body|string|false| The period type for the subscription renewal term.<br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>**Note**:<br><br>- This field is used with the RenewalTerm field to specify the subscription renewal term.<br>- This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>|
|» ServiceActivationDate|body|string(date)|false|The date when the subscription is activated. <br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br>This field can be updated when **Status** is `Pending Activation`.<br><br>**Note**: This field is only required in the Subscribe call if the [Require Service Activation of Orders?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_and_Order_Settings#Require_Service_Activation_of_Orders.3F) setting is set to `Yes`. If this setting is set to `Yes`:<br><br> * If the `ContractAcceptanceDate` field is required, you must set this field, `ContractAcceptanceDate`, and `ContractEffectiveDate` fields in the Subscribe call to activate a subscription.<br> * If the `ContractAcceptanceDate` field is not required, you must set both this field and the `ContractEffectiveDate` field in the Subscribe call to activate a subscription. If you only set a valid date in the `ContractEffectiveDate` field, the Subscribe call still returns success, but the subscription is in `Pending Activation` status.<br><br>This field can also be updated when the subscription is still on version one (has not been amended before) and the [Allow update Subscription trigger dates?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_and_Order_Settings#Allow_update_Subscription_trigger_dates.3F) setting in Billing Settings is set to "Yes". <br>|
|» Status|body|string|false| The status of the subscription.<br>**Character limit**: 17 **Values**: automatically generated **Possible values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Draft`<br>- `Pending Activation`<br>- `Pending Acceptance`<br>- `Active`<br>- `Cancelled`<br>- `Expired`<br>- `Suspended` (This value is in **Limited Availability**.)<br>|
|» TermStartDate|body|string(date)|false| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. The date when the subscription term begins. If this is a renewal subscription, then this date is different from the subscription start date.<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Version notes**: -- |
|» TermType|body|string|false| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. Indicates if a subscription is termed or evergreen.<br>**Character limit**: 9 **Values**: `TERMED`, `EVERGREEN` |
|» Version|body|integer(int32)|false| The version number of the subscription.<br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|» CpqBundleJsonId__QT|body|string|false|The Bundle product structures from Zuora Quotes if you utilize Bundling in Salesforce. Do not change the value in this field.<br>|
|» OpportunityCloseDate__QT|body|string(date)|false|The closing date of the Opportunity. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|» OpportunityName__QT|body|string|false|The unique identifier of the Opportunity. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|» QuoteBusinessType__QT|body|string|false|The specific identifier for the type of business transaction the Quote represents such as New, Upsell, Downsell, Renewal or Churn. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|» QuoteNumber__QT|body|string|false|The unique identifier of the Quote. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|» QuoteType__QT|body|string|false|The Quote type that represents the subscription lifecycle stage such as New, Amendment, Renew or Cancel. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|» IntegrationId__NS|body|string|false|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» IntegrationStatus__NS|body|string|false|Status of the subscription's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» Project__NS|body|string|false|The NetSuite project that the subscription was created from. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» SalesOrder__NS|body|string|false|The NetSuite sales order than the subscription was created from. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» SyncDate__NS|body|string|false|Date when the subscription was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Subscription object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

## Create a subscription

<a id="opIdPOST_Subscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/subscriptions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "accountKey": "A00001115",
    "autoRenew": true,
    "contractEffectiveDate": "2015-02-1",
    "initialTerm": "12",
    "initialTermPeriodType": "Week",
    "notes": "Test POST subscription from z-ruby-sdk",
    "renewalTerm": "3",
    "renewalTermPeriodType": "Week",
    "subscribeToRatePlans": [
      {
        "chargeOverrides": [
          {
            "billCycleDay": "5",
            "billCycleType": "SpecificDayofMonth",
            "billingPeriodAlignment": "AlignToCharge",
            "billingTiming": "IN_ARREARS",
            "description": "This is rate plan charge description",
            "number": "TestCharge",
            "price": 12.01,
            "productRatePlanChargeId": "ff8080811ca15d19011cddad8c953b53",
            "triggerDate": "2015-09-01",
            "triggerEvent": "USD"
          }
        ],
        "productRatePlanId": "ff8080811ca15d19011cdda9b0ad3b51"
      }
    ],
    "termType": "TERMED"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/subscriptions`

This REST API reference describes how to create a new subscription for an existing customer account.

## Notes

If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, it is best practice to set the `zuora-version` parameter to `211.0` or later. Otherwise, an error occurs.

If `invoiceCollect` is `true`, the call will not return `success` = `true` unless the subscription, invoice, and payment are all successful.

Default values for **customerAcceptanceDate** and **serviceActivationDate** are set as follows. This API operation does not support creating a pending subscription.

|        | serviceActivationDate(SA) specified          | serviceActivationDate (SA) NOT specified  |
| ------------- |:-------------:| -----:|
| customerAcceptanceDate (CA) specified| SA uses value in the request call; CA uses value in the request call| CA uses value in the request call;SA uses CE as default |
| customerAcceptanceDate (CA) NOT specified      | SA uses value in the request call; CA uses SA as default |   SA and CA use CE as default |


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "accountKey": "A00001115",
  "autoRenew": true,
  "contractEffectiveDate": "2015-02-1",
  "initialTerm": "12",
  "initialTermPeriodType": "Week",
  "notes": "Test POST subscription from z-ruby-sdk",
  "renewalTerm": "3",
  "renewalTermPeriodType": "Week",
  "subscribeToRatePlans": [
    {
      "chargeOverrides": [
        {
          "billCycleDay": "5",
          "billCycleType": "SpecificDayofMonth",
          "billingPeriodAlignment": "AlignToCharge",
          "billingTiming": "IN_ARREARS",
          "description": "This is rate plan charge description",
          "number": "TestCharge",
          "price": 12.01,
          "productRatePlanChargeId": "ff8080811ca15d19011cddad8c953b53",
          "triggerDate": "2015-09-01",
          "triggerEvent": "USD"
        }
      ],
      "productRatePlanId": "ff8080811ca15d19011cdda9b0ad3b51"
    }
  ],
  "termType": "TERMED"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|zuora-version|header|string|false|The minor version of the Zuora REST API. <br><br>You only need to set this parameter if you use the following fields:<br>* invoice<br>* collect<br>* runBilling<br>* targetDate<br>|
|body|body|[POSTSubscriptionType](#schemapostsubscriptiontype)|true|none|
|» accountKey|body|string|true|Customer account number or ID<br>|
|» applicationOrder|body|[string]|false|The priority order to apply credit memos and/or unapplied payments to an invoice. Possible item values are: `CreditMemo`, `UnappliedPayment`.<br><br>**Note:**<br>  - This field is valid only if the `applyCredit` field is set to `true`.<br>  - If no value is specified for this field, the default priority order is used, ["CreditMemo", "UnappliedPayment"], to apply credit memos first and then apply unapplied payments.<br>  - If only one item is specified, only the items of the spedified type are applied to invoices. For example, if the value is `["CreditMemo"]`, only credit memos are used to apply to invoices.<br>|
|» applyCredit|body|boolean|false|Whether to automatically apply credit memos or unapplied payments, or both to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit memo or unapplied payment, or both will be automatically applied to the invoice. If no value is specified or the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|» applyCreditBalance|body|boolean|false|Whether to automatically apply a credit balance to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit balance is applied to the invoice. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br><br>To view the credit balance adjustment, retrieve the details of the invoice using the Get Invoices method.<br><br>Prerequisite: `invoice` must be `true`. <br><br>**Note:** <br>  - If you are using the field `invoiceCollect` rather than the field `invoice`, the `invoiceCollect` value must be `true`.<br>  - This field is deprecated if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br>|
|» autoRenew|body|boolean|false|If true, this subscription automatically renews at the end of the subscription term.<br><br>This field is only required if the `termType` field is set to `TERMED`.<br>|
|» collect|body|boolean|false|Collects an automatic payment for a subscription. The collection generated in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer account.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the automatic payment is collected. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>Prerequisite: The `invoice` or `runBilling` field must be `true`. <br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `196.0` or later.<br>|
|» contractEffectiveDate|body|string(date)|true|Effective contract date for this subscription, as yyyy-mm-dd<br>|
|» customerAcceptanceDate|body|string(date)|false|The date on which the services or products within a subscription have been accepted by the customer, as yyyy-mm-dd.<br><br>Default value is dependent on the value of other fields. See **Notes** section for more details.<br>|
|» documentDate|body|string(date)|false|The date of the billing document, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. It represents the invoice date for invoices, credit memo date for credit memos, and debit memo date for debit memos.<br><br>- If this field is specified, the specified date is used as the billing document date. <br>- If this field is not specified, the date specified in the `targetDate` is used as the billing document date.<br>|
|» gatewayId|body|string|false|The ID of the payment gateway instance. For example, `2c92c0f86078c4d5016091674bcc3e92`.<br>|
|» initialTerm|body|integer(int64)|false|The length of the period for the first subscription term. If `termType` is `TERMED`, then this field is required, and the value must be greater than `0`. If `termType` is `EVERGREEN`, this field is ignored.<br>|
|» initialTermPeriodType|body|string|false|The period type for the first subscription term.<br><br>This field is used with the `InitialTerm` field to specify the initial subscription term.<br><br>Values are:<br><br>* `Month` (default)<br>* `Year`<br>* `Day`<br>* `Week`<br>|
|» invoice|body|boolean|false|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `runBilling` field. The<br>`invoice` field is only available for backward compatibility.<br><br><br>Creates an invoice for a subscription. The invoice generated in this<br>operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer<br>account.<br><br><br>If the value is `true`, an invoice is created. If the value is<br>`false`, no action is taken. The default value is `true`. <br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `196.0` and `207.0`. To use this field in the method, you<br>must set the zuora-version parameter to the minor version number in<br>the request header. <br>|
|» invoiceCollect|body|boolean|false|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `invoice` field<br>and the `collect` field. `invoiceCollect` is available only for backward compatibility.<br><br><br>If this field is set to `true`, an invoice is generated and payment collected automatically<br>during the subscription process. If `false`, no invoicing or payment takes<br>place. The invoice generated in this operation is only for this subscription,<br>not for the entire customer account.<br><br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `186.0`, `187.0`, `188.0`, or `189.0`.<br>|
|» invoiceOwnerAccountKey|body|string|false|Invoice owner account number or ID.<br><br>**Note:** This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br>|
|» invoiceSeparately|body|boolean|false|Separates a single subscription from other subscriptions and invoices the charge independently. <br><br>If the value is `true`, the subscription is billed separately from other subscriptions. If the value is `false`, the subscription is included with other subscriptions in the account invoice.<br><br>The default value is `false`.<br><br>Prerequisite: The default subscription setting Enable Subscriptions to be Invoiced Separately must be set to Yes.<br>|
|» invoiceTargetDate|body|string(date)|false|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `targetDate` field. The<br>`invoiceTargetDate` field is only available for backward<br>compatibility.<br><br><br>Date through which to calculate charges if an invoice is generated, as<br>yyyy-mm-dd. Default is current date.<br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `207.0` and earlier.  <br>|
|» notes|body|string|false|String of up to 500 characters.<br>|
|» paymentMethodId|body|string|false|The ID of the payment method used for the payment.<br>|
|» renewalSetting|body|string|false|Specifies whether a termed subscription will remain termed or change to evergreen when it is renewed.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `RENEW_WITH_SPECIFIC_TERM` (default)<br>* `RENEW_TO_EVERGREEN`<br>|
|» renewalTerm|body|integer(int64)|true|The length of the period for the subscription renewal term. Default is `0`.<br>|
|» renewalTermPeriodType|body|string|false|The period type for the subscription renewal term.<br><br>This field is used with the `renewalTerm` field to specify the subscription renewal term.<br><br>Values are:<br><br>* `Month` (default)<br>* `Year`<br>* `Day`<br>* `Week`<br>|
|» runBilling|body|boolean|false|Creates an invoice for a subscription. If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created based on the [invoice and credit memo generation rule](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Invoice_Settlement/Credit_and_Debit_Memos/Rules_for_Generating_Invoices_and_Credit_Memos).  <br><br><br>The billing documents generated<br>in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire<br>customer account.<br><br><br>Possible values:<br><br>- `true`: An invoice is created. If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created.<br><br><br>- `false`: No invoice is created.<br><br><br>**Note:** This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported<br>minor versions are `211.0` or later. To use this field in the method,<br>you must set the `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number<br>in the request header.<br>|
|» serviceActivationDate|body|string(date)|false|The date on which the services or products within a subscription have been activated and access has been provided to the customer, as yyyy-mm-dd.<br><br>Default value is dependent on the value of other fields. See **Notes** section for more details.<br>|
|» subscribeToRatePlans|body|[[POSTSrpCreateType](#schemapostsrpcreatetype)]|true|Container for one or more rate plans for this subscription.<br>|
|» subscriptionNumber|body|string|false|Subscription Number. The value can be up to 1000 characters.<br><br>If you do not specify a subscription number when creating a subscription, Zuora will generate a subscription number automatically.<br><br>If the account is created successfully, the subscription number is returned in the `subscriptionNumber` response field.<br>|
|» targetDate|body|string(date)|false|Date through which to calculate charges if an invoice or a credit memo is generated, as<br>yyyy-mm-dd. Default is current date.<br><br><br>**Note:** The credit memo is only available if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `211.0` and later. To use this field in the method, you<br>must set the  `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number in<br>the request header.<br>|
|» termStartDate|body|string(date)|false|The date on which the subscription term begins, as yyyy-mm-dd. If this is a renewal subscription, this date is different from the subscription start date.<br>|
|» termType|body|string|true|Possible values are: `TERMED`, `EVERGREEN`.<br>|
|» CpqBundleJsonId__QT|body|string|false|The Bundle product structures from Zuora Quotes if you utilize Bundling in Salesforce. Do not change the value in this field.<br>|
|» OpportunityCloseDate__QT|body|string(date)|false|The closing date of the Opportunity. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|» OpportunityName__QT|body|string|false|The unique identifier of the Opportunity. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|» QuoteBusinessType__QT|body|string|false|The specific identifier for the type of business transaction the Quote represents such as New, Upsell, Downsell, Renewal or Churn. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|» QuoteNumber__QT|body|string|false|The unique identifier of the Quote. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|» QuoteType__QT|body|string|false|The Quote type that represents the subscription lifecycle stage such as New, Amendment, Renew or Cancel. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|» IntegrationId__NS|body|string|false|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» IntegrationStatus__NS|body|string|false|Status of the subscription's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» Project__NS|body|string|false|The NetSuite project that the subscription was created from. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» SalesOrder__NS|body|string|false|The NetSuite sales order than the subscription was created from. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» SyncDate__NS|body|string|false|Date when the subscription was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Subscription object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

## List subscriptions by account key

<a id="opIdGET_SubscriptionsByAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/subscriptions/accounts/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/subscriptions/accounts/{account-key}`

Retrieves all subscriptions associated with the specified account. Zuora only returns the latest version of the subscriptions.

Subscription data is returned in reverse chronological order based on `updatedDate`.


<h3 id="list-subscriptions-by-account-key-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of rows returned per page.<br>|
|account-key|path|string|true|<br>Possible values are:<br>* an account number<br>* an account ID<br>|
|charge-detail|query|string|false|The segmented rate plan charges.<br><br>When an amendment results in a change to a charge, Zuora creates a segmented rate plan charge. Use this field to track segment charges.<br><br>Possible values are:<br><br>* __last-segment__: (Default) The last rate plan charge on the subscription. The last rate plan charge is the last one in the order of time on the subscription rather than the most recent changed charge on the subscription.<br> * __current-segment__: The segmented charge that is active on today’s date (effectiveStartDate <= today’s date < effectiveEndDate).<br> <br> * __all-segments__: All the segmented charges. The `chargeSegments` field is returned in the response. The `chargeSegments` field contains an array of the charge information for all the charge segments.<br><br> * __specific-segment&as-of-date=date__: The segmented charge that is active on a date you specified (effectiveStartDate <= specific date < effectiveEndDate). The format of the date is yyyy-mm-dd.<br>|

## Preview a subscription

<a id="opIdPOST_PreviewSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/subscriptions/preview \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "contractEffectiveDate": "2013-1-15",
    "initialTerm": 12,
    "initialTermPeriodType": "Week",
    "invoiceTargetDate": "2013-12-31",
    "previewAccountInfo": {
      "billCycleDay": 31,
      "billToContact": {
        "city": "Walnut Creek",
        "country": "United States",
        "county": "Contra Consta",
        "state": "California",
        "zipCode": "94549"
      },
      "currency": "USD"
    },
    "subscribeToRatePlans": [
      {
        "chargeOverrides": [
          {
            "productRatePlanChargeId": "ff8080811ca15d19011cddad8c953b53",
            "quantity": 100
          }
        ],
        "productRatePlanId": "ff8080811ca15d19011cdda9b0ad3b51"
      }
    ],
    "termType": "TERMED"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/subscriptions/preview`

The REST API reference describes how to create a new subscription in preview mode. This call does not require a valid customer account. It can be used to show potential new customers a preview of a subscription with complete details and charges before creating an account, or to let existing customers preview a subscription with all charges before committing.

## Notes
- The response of the Preview Subscription call is based on the REST API minor version you set in the request header. The response structure might be different if you use different minor version numbers. 

- If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, we recommend that you set the `zuora-version` parameter to `207.0` or later. Otherwise, an error is returned.


- Default values for **customerAcceptanceDate** and **serviceActivationDate** are set as follows.

|        | serviceActivationDate (SA) specified          | serviceActivationDate (SA) NOT specified  |
| ------------- |:-------------:| -----:|
| customerAcceptanceDate (CA) specified      | SA uses value in the request call; CA uses value in the request call| CA uses value in the request call;SA uses CE as default |
| customerAcceptanceDate (CA) NOT specified      | SA uses value in the request call; CA uses SA as default |   SA and CA use CE as default |


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "contractEffectiveDate": "2013-1-15",
  "initialTerm": 12,
  "initialTermPeriodType": "Week",
  "invoiceTargetDate": "2013-12-31",
  "previewAccountInfo": {
    "billCycleDay": 31,
    "billToContact": {
      "city": "Walnut Creek",
      "country": "United States",
      "county": "Contra Consta",
      "state": "California",
      "zipCode": "94549"
    },
    "currency": "USD"
  },
  "subscribeToRatePlans": [
    {
      "chargeOverrides": [
        {
          "productRatePlanChargeId": "ff8080811ca15d19011cddad8c953b53",
          "quantity": 100
        }
      ],
      "productRatePlanId": "ff8080811ca15d19011cdda9b0ad3b51"
    }
  ],
  "termType": "TERMED"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|zuora-version|header|string|false|<br>The minor version of the Zuora REST API. <br><br>You need to set this parameter if you use the following fields:<br>* targetDate<br>* includeExistingDraftDocItems<br>* previewType<br><br><br>If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, you need to specify this parameter. Otherwise, an error is returned.<br><br><br>See [Zuora REST API Versions](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#section/API-Versions) for more information. <br>|

## Retrieve a subscription by key

<a id="opIdGET_SubscriptionsByKey"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/subscriptions/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/subscriptions/{subscription-key}`

This REST API reference describes how to retrieve detailed information about a specified subscription in the latest version.


<h3 id="retrieve-a-subscription-by-key-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|subscription-key|path|string|true|Possible values are:<br>  * a subscription number<br>  * a subscription ID<br>|
|charge-detail|query|string|false|<br>The segmented rate plan charges. When an amendment results in a change to a charge, Zuora creates a segmented rate plan charge. Use this field to track segment charges.<br><br>Possible values are:<br><br> * __last-segment__: (Default) The last rate plan charge on the subscription. The last rate plan charge is the last one in the order of time on the subscription rather than the most recent changed charge on the subscription.<br> * __current-segment__: The segmented charge that is active on today’s date (effectiveStartDate <= today’s date < effectiveEndDate).<br> <br> * __all-segments__: All the segmented charges. The `chargeSegments` field is returned in the response. The `chargeSegments` field contains an array of the charge information for all the charge segments.<br><br> * __specific-segment&as-of-date=date__: The segmented charge that is active on a date you specified ((specific date = effectiveStartDate) OR (effectiveStartDate < specific date < effectiveEndDate)). The format of the date is yyyy-mm-dd.<br>|

## Update a subscription

<a id="opIdPUT_Subscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/subscriptions/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "autoRenew": false,
    "collect": false,
    "currentTerm": "10",
    "currentTermPeriodType": "Month",
    "notes": "Test UPDATE subscription from z-ruby-sdk",
    "renewalSetting": "RENEW_WITH_SPECIFIC_TERM",
    "renewalTerm": "4",
    "renewalTermPeriodType": "Month",
    "runBilling": true,
    "termType": "TERMED",
    "update": [
      {
        "chargeUpdateDetails": [
          {
            "quantity": 12,
            "ratePlanChargeId": "2c92c8f83dcbd8b1013dcce0eb510075"
          }
        ],
        "contractEffectiveDate": "2013-04-28",
        "ratePlanId": "2c92c8f83dcbd8b1013dcce0ea7e006f"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/subscriptions/{subscription-key}`

Use this call to make the following kinds of changes to a subscription:
  * Add a note
  * Change the renewal term or auto-renewal flag
  * Change the term length or change between evergreen and termed
  * Add a new product rate plan
  * Remove an existing subscription rate plan
  * Change the quantity or price of an existing subscription rate plan

## Notes
* The Update Subscription call creates a new subscription, which has the old subscription number but a new subscription ID.  The old subscription is canceled but remains in the system.
* In one request, this call can make:
  * Up to 9 combined add, update, and remove changes
  * No more than 1 change to terms & conditions
* Updates are performed in the following sequence:
  1. First change the notes on the existing subscription, if requested.
  2. Then change the terms and conditions, if requested.
  3. Then perform the remaining amendments based upon the effective dates specified. If multiple amendments have the same contract-effective dates, then execute adds before updates, and updates before removes.
* The update operation is atomic. If any of the updates fails, the entire operation is rolled back.
* The response of the Update Subscription call is based on the REST API minor version you set in the request header. The response structure might be different if you use different minor version numbers. 
* If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, it is best practice to set the `zuora-version` parameter to `211.0` or later. Otherwise, an error occurs.

## Override a Tiered Price
There are two ways you override a tiered price:

* Override a specific tier number
For example: `tiers[{tier:1,price:8},{tier:2,price:6}]`

* Override the entire tier structure
For example:  `tiers[{tier:1,price:8,startingUnit:1,endingUnit:100,priceFormat:"FlatFee"},
{tier:2,price:6,startingUnit:101,priceFormat:"FlatFee"}]`

If you just override a specific tier, do not include the `startingUnit` field in the request.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "autoRenew": false,
  "collect": false,
  "currentTerm": "10",
  "currentTermPeriodType": "Month",
  "notes": "Test UPDATE subscription from z-ruby-sdk",
  "renewalSetting": "RENEW_WITH_SPECIFIC_TERM",
  "renewalTerm": "4",
  "renewalTermPeriodType": "Month",
  "runBilling": true,
  "termType": "TERMED",
  "update": [
    {
      "chargeUpdateDetails": [
        {
          "quantity": 12,
          "ratePlanChargeId": "2c92c8f83dcbd8b1013dcce0eb510075"
        }
      ],
      "contractEffectiveDate": "2013-04-28",
      "ratePlanId": "2c92c8f83dcbd8b1013dcce0ea7e006f"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|zuora-version|header|string|false|<br>The minor version of the Zuora REST API. <br><br>You need to set this parameter if you use the following fields:<br>* collect<br>* invoice<br>* includeExistingDraftDocItems<br>* previewType<br>* runBilling<br>* targetDate<br><br><br>If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, you need to specify this parameter. Otherwise, an error is returned.<br><br><br>See [Zuora REST API Versions](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#section/API-Versions) for more information.<br>|
|subscription-key|path|string|true|Subscription number or ID.|
|body|body|[PUTSubscriptionType](#schemaputsubscriptiontype)|true|none|
|» add|body|[[PUTSrpAddType](#schemaputsrpaddtype)]|false|Container for adding one or more rate plans.<br>|
|» applicationOrder|body|[string]|false|The priority order to apply credit memos and/or unapplied payments to an invoice. Possible item values are: `CreditMemo`, `UnappliedPayment`.<br><br>**Note:**<br>  - This field is valid only if the `applyCredit` field is set to `true`.<br>  - If no value is specified for this field, the default priority order is used, ["CreditMemo", "UnappliedPayment"], to apply credit memos first and then apply unapplied payments.<br>  - If only one item is specified, only the items of the spedified type are applied to invoices. For example, if the value is `["CreditMemo"]`, only credit memos are used to apply to invoices.<br>|
|» applyCredit|body|boolean|false|Whether to automatically apply credit memos or unapplied payments, or both to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit memo or unapplied payment, or both will be automatically applied to the invoice. If no value is specified or the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|» applyCreditBalance|body|boolean|false|Whether to automatically apply a credit balance to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit balance is applied to the invoice. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br><br>To view the credit balance adjustment, retrieve the details of the invoice using the Get Invoices method.<br><br>Prerequisite: `invoice` must be `true`. <br><br>**Note:** <br>  - If you are using the field `invoiceCollect` rather than the field `invoice`, the `invoiceCollect` value must be `true`.<br>  - This field is deprecated if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br>|
|» autoRenew|body|boolean|false|If `true`, this subscription automatically renews at the end of the subscription term. Default is `false`.<br>|
|» collect|body|boolean|false|Collects an automatic payment for a subscription. The collection generated in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer account.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the automatic payment is collected. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>Prerequisite: The `invoice` or `runBilling` field must be `true`. <br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `196.0` or later.<br>|
|» currentTerm|body|integer(int64)|false|The length of the period for the current subscription term. If `termType` is `TERMED`, this field is required and must be greater than `0`. If `termType` is `EVERGREEN`, this value is ignored.<br>|
|» currentTermPeriodType|body|string|false|The period type for the current subscription term.<br><br>This field is used with the `CurrentTerm` field to specify the current subscription term.<br><br>Values are:<br><br>* `Month` (default)<br>* `Year`<br>* `Day`<br>* `Week`<br>|
|» documentDate|body|string(date)|false|The date of the billing document, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. It represents the invoice date for invoices, credit memo date for credit memos, and debit memo date for debit memos.<br><br>- If this field is specified, the specified date is used as the billing document date. <br>- If this field is not specified, the date specified in the `targetDate` is used as the billing document date.<br>|
|» includeExistingDraftDocItems|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether to include draft invoice items in subscription previews.<br>Values are:<br><br>* `true` (default). Includes draft invoice items in the preview result.<br>* `false`. Excludes draft invoice items in the preview result.<br><br>**Note:** This field is in Zuora REST API version control. ## Cancel a subscription

<a id="opIdPUT_CancelSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/subscriptions/string/cancel \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "cancellationEffectiveDate": "2019-05-31",
    "cancellationPolicy": "SpecificDate",
    "collect": false,
    "runBilling": true
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/subscriptions/{subscription-key}/cancel`

This REST API reference describes how to cancel an active subscription.

**Note**: If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, it is best practice to set the `zuora-version` parameter to `211.0` or later. Otherwise, an error occurs.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "cancellationEffectiveDate": "2019-05-31",
  "cancellationPolicy": "SpecificDate",
  "collect": false,
  "runBilling": true
}
```

<h3 id="cancel-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|zuora-version|header|string|false|The minor version of the Zuora REST API. <br><br>You only need to set this parameter if you use the following fields:<br>* invoice<br>* collect<br>* runBilling<br>* targetDate <br>|
|subscription-key|path|string|true|Subscription number or ID. Subscription status must be `Active`.|
|body|body|[POSTSubscriptionCancellationType](#schemapostsubscriptioncancellationtype)|true|none|
|» applicationOrder|body|[string]|false|The priority order to apply credit memos and/or unapplied payments to an invoice. Possible item values are: `CreditMemo`, `UnappliedPayment`.<br><br>**Note:**<br>  - This field is valid only if the `applyCredit` field is set to `true`.<br>  - If no value is specified for this field, the default priority order is used, ["CreditMemo", "UnappliedPayment"], to apply credit memos first and then apply unapplied payments.<br>  - If only one item is specified, only the items of the spedified type are applied to invoices. For example, if the value is `["CreditMemo"]`, only credit memos are used to apply to invoices.<br>|
|» applyCredit|body|boolean|false|Whether to automatically apply credit memos or unapplied payments, or both to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit memo or unapplied payment, or both will be automatically applied to the invoice. If no value is specified or the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|» applyCreditBalance|body|boolean|false|Whether to automatically apply a credit balance to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit balance is applied to the invoice. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br><br>To view the credit balance adjustment, retrieve the details of the invoice using the Get Invoices method.<br><br>Prerequisite: `invoice` must be `true`. <br><br>**Note:** <br>  - If you are using the field `invoiceCollect` rather than the field `invoice`, the `invoiceCollect` value must be `true`.<br>  - This field is deprecated if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br>|
|» cancellationEffectiveDate|body|string(date)|false|Date the cancellation takes effect, in the format yyyy-mm-dd.  Use only if `cancellationPolicy` is `SpecificDate`. Should not be earlier than the subscription contract-effective date, later than the subscription term-end date, or within a period for which the customer has been invoiced.<br>|
|» cancellationPolicy|body|string|true|Cancellation method. Possible values are: `EndOfCurrentTerm`, `EndOfLastInvoicePeriod`, `SpecificDate`. If using `SpecificDate`, the `cancellationEffectiveDate` field is required.<br>|
|» collect|body|boolean|false|Collects an automatic payment for a subscription. The collection generated in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer account.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the automatic payment is collected. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>Prerequisite: The `invoice` or `runBilling` field must be `true`. <br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `196.0` or later.<br>|
|» contractEffectiveDate|body|string(date)|false|The date when the customer notifies you that they want to cancel their subscription.<br>|
|» documentDate|body|string(date)|false|The date of the billing document, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. It represents the invoice date for invoices, credit memo date for credit memos, and debit memo date for debit memos.<br><br>- If this field is specified, the specified date is used as the billing document date. <br>- If this field is not specified, the date specified in the `targetDate` is used as the billing document date.<br>|
|» invoice|body|boolean|false|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `runBilling` field. The<br>`invoice` field is only available for backward compatibility.<br><br><br>Creates an invoice for a subscription. The invoice generated in this<br>operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer<br>account.<br><br><br>If the value is `true`, an invoice is created. If the value is<br>`false`, no action is taken. The default value is `false`. <br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `196.0` and `207.0`. To use this field in the method, you<br>must set the zuora-version parameter to the minor version number in<br>the request header. <br>|
|» invoiceCollect|body|boolean|true|This field has been replaced by the `invoice` field and the<br>`collect` field. `invoiceCollect` is available only for backward compatibility.<br><br>If this field is set to `true`, an invoice is generated and payment automatically collected.<br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `186.0`, `187.0`, `188.0`, or `189.0`.<br>|
|» invoiceTargetDate|body|string(date)|false|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `targetDate` field. The<br>`invoiceTargetDate` field is only available for backward<br>compatibility.<br><br><br>Date through which to calculate charges if an invoice is generated, as<br>yyyy-mm-dd. Default is current date.<br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `207.0` and earlier.  <br>|
|» runBilling|body|boolean|false|Creates an invoice for a subscription. If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created based on the [invoice and credit memo generation rule](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Invoice_Settlement/Credit_and_Debit_Memos/Rules_for_Generating_Invoices_and_Credit_Memos).  <br><br><br>The billing documents generated<br>in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire<br>customer account.<br><br><br>Possible values:<br><br>- `true`: An invoice is created. If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created.<br><br><br>- `false`: No invoice is created.<br><br><br>**Note:** This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported<br>minor versions are `211.0` or later. To use this field in the method,<br>you must set the `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number<br>in the request header.<br>|
|» targetDate|body|string(date)|false|Date through which to calculate charges if an invoice or a credit memo is generated, as<br>yyyy-mm-dd. Default is current date.<br><br><br>**Note:** The credit memo is only available if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `211.0` and later. To use this field in the method, you<br>must set the  `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number in<br>the request header.<br>|

|» runBilling|false|

```json
  "invoiceId": "8a8082c453cd2a620153e426c7eb78b3",
```

## Renew a subscription

<a id="opIdPUT_RenewSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/subscriptions/string/renew \

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \

  -d '{
    "collect": false,
    "runBilling": true
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/subscriptions/{subscription-key}/renew`

## Resume a subscription

<a id="opIdPUT_ResumeSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/subscriptions/string/resume \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "collect": false,
    "contractEffectiveDate": "2019-02-01",
    "extendsTerm": true,
    "resumePolicy": "SpecificDate",
    "resumeSpecificDate": "2019-10-01",
    "runBilling": true
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/subscriptions/{subscription-key}/resume`

This REST API reference describes how to resume a suspended subscription.  

**Note**: If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, it is best practice to set the `zuora-version` parameter to `211.0` or later. Otherwise, an error occurs.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "collect": false,
  "contractEffectiveDate": "2019-02-01",
  "extendsTerm": true,
  "resumePolicy": "SpecificDate",
  "resumeSpecificDate": "2019-10-01",
  "runBilling": true
}
```

If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created.<br><br><br>- `false`: No invoice is created.<br><br><br>**Note:** This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported<br>minor versions are `211.0` or later. To use this field in the method,<br>you must set the `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number<br>in the request header.<br>|
|» suspendPeriods|body|string|false|The length of the period used to specify when the subscription suspension takes effect. The subscription suspension takes effect after a specified period based on today's date. You must use this field together with the `suspendPeriodsType` field to specify the period.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only applicable only when the suspendPolicy field is set to FixedPeriodsFromToday.<br>|
|» suspendPeriodsType|body|string|false|The period type used to define when the subscription suspension takes effect. The subscription suspension takes effect after a specified period based on today's date. You must use this field together with the suspendPeriods field to specify the period.<br><br>Type: string (enum)<br><br>Values: `Day`, `Week`, `Month`, `Year`<br><br>**Note:** This field is only applicable only when the suspendPolicy field is set to FixedPeriodsFromToday.<br>|
|» suspendPolicy|body|string|true|Suspend methods. Specify a way to suspend a subscription. <br><br>Value:<br><br>* `Today`: The subscription suspension takes effect on today's date.<br>* `EndOfLastInvoicePeriod`: The subscription suspension takes effect at the end of the last invoice period. The suspend date defaults to a date that is one day after the last invoiced period. You can choose this option to avoid any negative invoices (credits) issued back to the customer after the subscription suspension. <br>* `SpecificDate`: The subscription suspension takes effect on a specific date. You must define the specific date in the `suspendSpecificDate` field.<br>* `FixedPeriodsFromToday`: The subscription suspension takes effect after a specified period based on today's date. You must specify the `suspendPeriods` and `suspendPeriodsType` fields to define the period.<br>|
|» suspendSpecificDate|body|string(date)|false|A specific date when the subscription suspension takes effect, in the format yyyy-mm-dd.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only applicable only when the suspendPolicy field is set to SpecificDate.<br><br>The value should not be earlier than the subscription contract effective date, later than the subscription term end date, or within a period for which the customer has been invoiced.<br>|
|» targetDate|body|string(date)|false|Date through which to calculate charges if an invoice or a credit memo is generated, as<br>yyyy-mm-dd. Default is current date.<br><br><br>**Note:** The credit memo is only available if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `211.0` and later. To use this field in the method, you<br>must set the  `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number in<br>the request header.<br>|

## Retrieve a subscription by key and version

<a id="opIdGET_SubscriptionsByKeyAndVersion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/subscriptions/string/versions/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/subscriptions/{subscription-key}/versions/{version}`

This REST API reference describes how to retrieve detailed information about a specified subscription in a specified version. When you create a subscription amendment, you create a new version of the subscription. You can use this method to retrieve information about a subscription in any version.


<h3 id="retrieve-a-subscription-by-key-and-version-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|subscription-key|path|string|true|Subscription number. For example, A-S00000135.<br>|
|version|path|string|true|Subscription version. For example, 1.<br>|
|charge-detail|query|string|false|<br>The segmented rate plan charges. When an amendment results in a change to a charge, Zuora creates a segmented rate plan charge. Use this field to track segment charges.<br><br>Possible values are:<br><br> * __last-segment__: (Default) The last rate plan charge on the subscription. The last rate plan charge is the last one in the order of time on the subscription rather than the most recent changed charge on the subscription.<br> * __current-segment__: The segmented charge that is active on today’s date (effectiveStartDate <= today’s date < effectiveEndDate).<br> <br> * __all-segments__: All the segmented charges. The `chargeSegments` field is returned in the response. The `chargeSegments` field contains an array of the charge information for all the charge segments.<br><br> * __specific-segment&as-of-date=date__: The segmented charge that is active on a date you specified (effectiveStartDate <= specific date < effectiveEndDate). The format of the date is yyyy-mm-dd.<br>|

<h1 id="api-reference-billing-summary-journal-entries">Summary Journal Entries</h1>

## Create a summary journal entry

<a id="opIdPOST_SummaryJournalEntry"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/journal-entries \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "accountingPeriodName": "Nov-2014",
    "currency": "USD",
    "journalEntryDate": "2014-09-09",
    "journalEntryItems": [
      {
        "accountingCodeName": "Accounts Receivable",
        "accountingCodeType": "Deferred Revenue",
        "amount": "400.9",
        "homeCurrencyAmount": "801.8",
        "type": "Credit"
      },
      {
        "accountingCodeName": "Subscription Revenue",
        "accountingCodeType": "Sales Revenue",
        "amount": "400.9",
        "homeCurrencyAmount": "801.8",
        "type": "Debit"
      }
    ],
    "notes": "my account",
    "segments": [
      {
        "segmentName": "billToCountry",
        "segmentValue": "United States"
      },
      {
        "segmentName": "billToState",
        "segmentValue": "California"
      }
    ],
    "transferredToAccounting": "No"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/journal-entries`

This REST API reference describes how to manually create a summary journal entry. Request and response field descriptions and sample code are provided.
## Requirements
1.The sum of debits must equal the sum of credits in the summary journal entry.

2.The following applies only if you use foreign currency conversion:
  * If you have configured Aggregate transactions with different currencies during a Journal Run to "Yes", the value of the **currency** field must be the same as your tenant's home currency. That is, you must create journal entries using your home currency.
  * All journal entries in an accounting period must either all be aggregated or all be unaggregated. You cannot have a mix of aggregated and unaggregated journal entries in the same accounting period.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "accountingPeriodName": "Nov-2014",
  "currency": "USD",
  "journalEntryDate": "2014-09-09",
  "journalEntryItems": [
    {
      "accountingCodeName": "Accounts Receivable",
      "accountingCodeType": "Deferred Revenue",
      "amount": "400.9",
      "homeCurrencyAmount": "801.8",
      "type": "Credit"
    },
    {
      "accountingCodeName": "Subscription Revenue",
      "accountingCodeType": "Sales Revenue",
      "amount": "400.9",
      "homeCurrencyAmount": "801.8",
      "type": "Debit"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "my account",
  "segments": [
    {
      "segmentName": "billToCountry",
      "segmentValue": "United States"
    },
    {
      "segmentName": "billToState",
      "segmentValue": "California"
    }
  ],
  "transferredToAccounting": "No"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-summary-journal-entry-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|body|body|[POSTJournalEntryType](#schemapostjournalentrytype)|true|none|
|» accountingPeriodName|body|string|true|Name of the accounting period. The open-ended accounting period is named `Open-Ended`.<br>|
|» currency|body|string|true|The type of currency used. Currency must be active.<br>|
|» journalEntryDate|body|string(date)|true|Date of the journal entry.<br>|
|» journalEntryItems|body|[[POSTJournalEntryItemType](#schemapostjournalentryitemtype)]|true|Key name that represents the list of journal entry items.<br>|
|» notes|body|string|false|The number associated with the revenue event.<br><br>Character limit: 2,000<br>|
|» segments|body|[[POSTJournalEntrySegmentType](#schemapostjournalentrysegmenttype)]|false|List of segments that apply to the summary journal entry.<br>|
|» transferredToAccounting|body|string|false|Status shows whether the journal entry has been transferred to an accounting system.<br>|
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Journal Entry object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

|» TaxAmount|body|number(double)|true| The amount of the tax applied to the charge.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a decimal value |

|» TaxRate|body|number(double)|true| The tax rate applied to the charge.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a valid decimal value |
|» TaxRateDescription|body|string|false| The description of the tax rate.<br>**Character limit**: 255 **Values**: a string of 255 characters or fewer |
|» TaxRateType|body|string|true| The type of the tax rate applied to the charge.<br>**Character limit**: 10 **Values**: `Percentage`, `FlatFee` |
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Taxation Item object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. The body of the 400 response is:<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "message": "Error - unrecognised fields"<br>}<br>```<br><br>By default, Zuora ignores unknown fields in the request body.<br>|

If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
