This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|id|path|string|true|Object id|
|body|body|[ProxyModifyTaxationItem](#schemaproxymodifytaxationitem)|true|none|
|» AccountingCode|body|string|false| The Chart of Accounts |
|» ExemptAmount|body|number(double)|false| The calculated tax amount excluded due to the exemption.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a decimal value |
|» Jurisdiction|body|string|false| The jurisdiction that applies the tax or VAT. This value is typically a state, province, county, or city.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a string of 32 characterrs or fewer |
|» LocationCode|body|string|false| The identifier for the location based on the value of the `TaxCode` field.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: automatically generated |
|» Name|body|string|false| The name of the tax rate, such as sales tax or GST. This name is displayed on invoices.<br>**Character limit**: 128 **Values**: a string of 128 characters or fewer |
|» TaxAmount|body|number(double)|false| The amount of the tax applied to the charge.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a decimal value |
|» TaxCode|body|string|false| The tax code identifies which tax rules and tax rates to apply to a specific charge.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a string of 32 characters or fewer |
|» TaxCodeDescription|body|string|false| The description for the tax code.<br>**Character limit**: 255 **Values**: a string of 255 characters or fewer |
|» TaxDate|body|string(date)|false| The date that the tax is applied to the charge, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br>**Character limit**: 29 |
|» TaxRate|body|number(double)|false| The tax rate applied to the charge.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a valid decimal value |
|» TaxRateDescription|body|string|false| The description of the tax rate.<br>**Character limit**: 255 **Values**: a string of 255 characters or fewer |
|» TaxRateType|body|string|false| The type of the tax rate applied to the charge.<br>**Character limit**: 10 **Values**: `Percentage`, `FlatFee` |
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Taxation Item object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

```json
  "Id": "string",
  "Success": true
}
```

```json
}
```

## CRUD: Create a unit of measure

<a id="opIdObject_POSTUnitOfMeasure"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/object/unit-of-measure \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "Active": true,
    "DecimalPlaces": 9,
    "DisplayedAs": "name_display_name_1476935033519",
    "RoundingMode": "UP",
    "UomName": "name_1476935033519"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/object/unit-of-measure`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Active": true,
  "DecimalPlaces": 9,
  "DisplayedAs": "name_display_name_1476935033519",
  "RoundingMode": "UP",
  "UomName": "name_1476935033519"
}
```

<h3 id="crud-create-a-unit-of-measure-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rejectUnknownFields|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether the call fails if the request body contains unknown fields.<br>With `rejectUnknownFields` set to `true`, Zuora returns a 400 response if<br>the request body contains unknown fields. The body of the 400 response is:<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "message": "Error - unrecognised fields"<br>}<br>```<br><br>By default, Zuora ignores unknown fields in the request body.<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|body|body|[ProxyCreateUnitOfMeasure](#schemaproxycreateunitofmeasure)|true|none|
|» Active|body|boolean|false| Indicates if the UOM is available for new product rate plans. The default value is `true`.<br>**Character limit**: 5 **Values**: `true`, `false ` |
|» DecimalPlaces|body|integer(int64)|true|The number of digits to the right of the decimal point that you want to measure for the unit. To use whole numbers only, set this value to 0. You can't change this value after this `UOM` is used in any product, subscription, or usage. **Character limit**: 1 **Values**: an integer between 0 and 9, exclusive |
|» DisplayedAs|body|string|false|The name of the UOM that you want displayed on invoices. The default value is the `UomName` field value. **Character limit**: 50 **Values**: A string of 50 characters or fewer |
|» RoundingMode|body|string|false| Specifies whether to round the UOM value up or down when the value exceeds the `DecimalPlaces` field value. The default value is `Up`.<br>**Character limit**: 4 **Values**: `Up`, `Down` |
|» UomName|body|string|true| The name of the UOM, such as license or GB. This name is displayed in query results and in the web-based UI labels. If you want a different name to be displayed on invoices, then use the `DisplayedAs` field to provide the invoice label.<br>**Character limit**: 50 **Values**: a string of 50 characters or fewer |

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/object/unit-of-measure/string \
```

```bash
  }'
```

|» DecimalPlaces|body|integer(int64)|false|The number of digits to the right of the decimal point that you want to measure for the unit. To use whole numbers only, set this value to 0. ## CRUD: Create a usage record

<a id="opIdObject_POSTUsage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/object/usage \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "AccountId": "2c92c0f956bc8fb40156d502fc3718b1",
    "ChargeNumber": "C-00000229",
    "Description": "test",
    "Quantity": 9,
    "StartDateTime": "2017-12-01T16:41:36.000+01:00",
    "SubscriptionNumber": "A-S00000100",
    "UOM": "Each"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/object/usage`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "AccountId": "2c92c0f956bc8fb40156d502fc3718b1",
  "ChargeNumber": "C-00000229",
  "Description": "test",
  "Quantity": 9,
  "StartDateTime": "2017-12-01T16:41:36.000+01:00",
  "SubscriptionNumber": "A-S00000100",
  "UOM": "Each"
}
```

<h3 id="crud-create-a-usage-record-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rejectUnknownFields|query|boolean|false|Specifies whether the call fails if the request body contains unknown fields.<br>With `rejectUnknownFields` set to `true`, Zuora returns a 400 response if<br>the request body contains unknown fields. The body of the 400 response is:<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "message": "Error - unrecognised fields"<br>}<br>```<br><br>By default, Zuora ignores unknown fields in the request body.<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|body|body|[ProxyCreateUsage](#schemaproxycreateusage)|true|none|
|» AccountId|body|string|false| The ID of the account associated with the usage data. This field is only required if no value is specified for the `AccountNumber` field.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid account ID. |
|» AccountNumber|body|string|false| The number of the account associated with the usage data. This field is only required if no value is specified for the `AccountId` field.<br>**Character limit**: 50 **Values**: a valid account number. |
|» ChargeId|body|string|false| The OrginalId of the rate plan charge related to the usage record, e.g., `2c9081a03c63c94c013c6873357a0117` **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid rate plan charge OriginalID. |
|» ChargeNumber|body|string|false|A unique number for the rate plan charge related to the usage record. For example, C-00000007.<br>|
|» Description|body|string|false|A description of the usage record.<br>|
|» EndDateTime|body|string(date-time)|false| The end date and time of a range of time when usage is tracked. Use this field for reporting; this field doesn't affect usage calculation.<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Values**: a valid date and time value. |
|» Quantity|body|number(double)|true| Indicates the number of units used.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a valid decimal amount equal to or greater than 0 |
|» StartDateTime|body|string(date-time)|true| The start date and time of a range of time when usage is tracked. Zuora uses this field value to determine the usage date. Unlike the `EndDateTime`, the `StartDateTime` field does affect usage calculation.<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Values**: a valid date and time value |
|» SubmissionDateTime|body|string(date-time)|false| The date when usage was submitted.<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Values**: automatically generated |
|» SubscriptionId|body|string|false|The ID of the subscription that contains the fees related to the usage data.<br><br>The ID of a subscription might change when you create amendments to the subscription. It is good practice to use the unique subscription number that you can specify in the `SubscriptionNumber` field.<br>|
|» SubscriptionNumber|body|string|false|The unique identifier number of the subscription that contains the fees related to the usage data.<br><br>It is good practice to use this field when creating usage records.<br>|
|» UOM|body|string|true| Specifies the units to measure usage. Units of measure are configured in the web-based UI. Your values depend on your configuration in **Billing Settings**.<br>**Character limit**: **Values**: a valid unit of measure |
|» **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Custom fields of the Usage object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

```json
}
```

```json
    }

}
```

## Upload a usage file

<a id="opIdPOST_Usage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/usage \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -F 'file=@/path/to/file'
```

`POST /v1/usage`

This REST API reference describes how to post or import usage data for one or more accounts in the CSV format. There are no path or query parameters. The data is uploaded using the HTTP multipart/form-data POST method and applied to the user's tenant. 

For a use case of this operation, see [Upload usage records](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-guides/#Upload-usage-records).

## How this REST API Call Works
The content of the uploaded usage file must follow the format used by the UI import tool. It must be a comma-separated (CSV) file with a corresponding .csv extension. The length of the file name must not exceed 50 characters. The file size must not exceed 4MB. See [Downloading the Usage Template](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/J_Billing_Operations/Usage/C_Import_Usage_Data#Downloading_the_Usage_Template) to learn about how to download the usage file template.

At the completion of the upload, before the file contents are actually being processed, the API returns a response containing the byte count of the received file and a URL for checking the status of the import process.  Of the five possible results displayed at that URL (Pending, Processing, Completed, Canceled, and Failed) only a Completed status indicates that the import was successful.  The operation is atomic; if any record fails, the file is rejected. In that case, the entire import is rolled back and all stored data is returned to its original state.

To view the actual import status, enter the resulting status URL from the checkImportStatus response using a tool such as POSTMAN. This additional step provides more information about why the import has failed.

To manage the information after a successful upload, use the web-based UI.

## Usage File Format
The usage file uses the following headings: 

| Heading         | Description   | Required |
|-----------------|--------|----------|
| ACCOUNT_ID      | Enter the account number, e.g., the default account number, such as A00000001, or your custom account number. Although this field is labeled as Account_Id, it is not the actual Account ID nor Account Name.  | Yes      |
| UOM             | Enter the unit of measure. This must match the UOM for the usage. | Yes      |
| QTY             | Enter the quantity.  | Yes      |
| STARTDATE       | Enter the start date of the usage. This date determines the invoice item service period the associated usage is billed to. Date format is based on locale of the current user. Default date format: `MM/DD/YYYY`. | Yes |
| ENDDATE         | Enter the end date of the usage. This is not used in calculations for usage billing and is optional. Date format is based on locale of the current user. Default date format: `MM/DD/YYYY`. <p>**Note:** The value of this column is optional, but the column header is required.</p> | No |
| SUBSCRIPTION_ID | Enter the subscription number or subscription name. If you created the subscription in the Zuora application, Zuora created a number automatically in a format similar to A-S00000001. If you do not provide a value for this field, the associated usage will be added to all subscriptions for the specified Account that use this Unit Of Measure. If your Accounts can have multiple subscriptions and you do not want double or triple counting of usage, you must specify the Subscription or Charge ID in each usage record.  <p>**Note:** The value of this column is optional, but the column header is required.</p>  | No   |
| CHARGE_ID       | Enter the charge number (not the charge name). You can see the charge ID, e.g., C-00000001, when you add your rate plan to your subscription and view your individual charges. If your Accounts can have multiple subscriptions and you do not want double or triple counting of usage, you must specify the specific Subscription or Charge ID in each usage record. This field is related to the Charge Number on the subscription rate plan.  <p>**Note:** The value of this column is optional, but the column header is required.</p>  | No      |
| DESCRIPTION     | Enter a description for the charge. | No       |


> Body parameter

```yaml
file: string
```

<h3 id="upload-a-usage-file-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» file|body|string(binary)|true|The usage data to import.<br>|

```json
  "size": 316,
  "success": true
}
```

## Multi-entity: Accept user access

<a id="opIdPUT_AcceptUserAccess"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/users/string/accept-access \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`PUT /v1/users/{username}/accept-access`

**Note:** The Multi-entity feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/). 

Accepts user access to an entity.

## User Access Permission
You must make the calls as an administrator of the entity that you want to accept the user access to. 


<h3 id="multi-entity-accept-user-access-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|username|path|string|true|Specify the login name of the user that you want to accept the access request for.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": true
}
```

Sends access requests to the entities that a user wants to access.

<h1 id="api-reference-billing-workflows">Workflows</h1>

## List workflows

<a id="opIdGET_Workflows"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/workflows \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /workflows`

Retrieves a list of workflows available in your Zuora tenant.      


<h3 id="list-workflows-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Authorization|header|string|true|`Bearer {token}` for a valid OAuth token.<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|callout_trigger|query|boolean|false|If set to true, the operation retrieves workflows that have the callout trigger enabled. If set to false, the operation retrieves workflows that have the callout trigger disabled. If not specified, the operation will not use this filter.<br>|
|interval|query|string|false|A CRON expession that specifies a schedule (for example, `0 0 * * *`). If specified, the operation retrieves the workflow that is run based on the specified schedule.<br>|
|name|query|string|false|If specified, the operation retrieves the workflow that is in the specified name.<br>|
|ondemand_trigger|query|boolean|false|If set to true, the operation retrieves workflows that have the ondemand trigger enabled. If set to false, the operation retrieves workflows that have the ondemand trigger disabled. If not specified, the operation will not use this filter.<br>|
|scheduled_trigger|query|boolean|false|If set to true, the operation retrieves workflows that have the scheduled trigger enabled. If set to false, the operation retrieves workflows that have the scheduled trigger disabled. If not specfied, the operation will not use this filter.<br>|
|page|query|integer|false|If you want to retrieve only the workflows on a specific page, you can specify the `page` number in the query.<br>|
|page_length|query|integer|false|The number of workflows shown in a single call. If the `page` parameter is not specified, the operation will return only the first page of results. If there are multiple pages of results, use it with the `page` parameter to get the results on subsequent pages.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "calloutTrigger": true,
      "createdAt": "2019-05-31T14:52:38.171Z",
      "description": "",
      "id": 48,
      "interval": null,
      "name": "New test workflow",
      "ondemandTrigger": true,
      "scheduledTrigger": false,
      "timezone": null,
      "type": "Workflow::Setup",
      "updatedAt": "2019-06-03T21:02:26.694Z"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "next_page": "https://rest.zuora.com/workflows?page=2&page_length=1",
    "page": 1,
    "page_length": 1
  }
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|Authorization|header|string|true|`Bearer {token}` for a valid OAuth token.<br>|

If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|id|query|string|false|If specified, the operation retrieves the task that is with specified id.<br>|
|name|query|string|false|If specified, the operation retrieves tasks that is in the specified name.<br>|

|workflow_id|query|string|false|If specified, the operation retrieves tasks that for the specified workflow id.<br>|
|tags|query|string|false|If specified, the operation retrieves tasks that with the specified filter tags.<br>|
|page|query|integer|false|If you want to retrieve only the workflows on a specific page, you can specify the `page` number in the query.<br>|

## Update a workflow definition

<a id="opIdPATCH_UpdateWorkflow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/workflows/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "callout_trigger": true,
    "description": "string",
    "interval": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "ondemand_trigger": true,
    "priority": "string",
    "scheduled_trigger": true,
    "status": "string",
    "timezone": "string"
  }'
```

`PATCH /workflows/{workflow_id}`

Updates the definition of a specific workflow by its ID, which allows you to [configure the settings of a workflow](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CE_Workflow/Using_Workflow/B_Configure_a_Workflow) via API.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "callout_trigger": true,
  "description": "string",
  "interval": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "ondemand_trigger": true,
  "priority": "string",
  "scheduled_trigger": true,
  "status": "string",
  "timezone": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-workflow-definition-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Authorization|header|string|true|`Bearer {token}` for a valid OAuth token.<br>|
|workflow_id|path|string|true|The unique ID of a workflow. For example, 19080.<br>|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» callout_trigger|body|boolean|false|If true, the workflow will run upon an API callout. This field must be `true` for integrating with the Configurable Payment Retry feature or the Collections Window feature in Collect.<br>|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the workflow defintion<br>|
|» interval|body|string|false|The cron expression for workflows with scheduled_trigger as `true`<br>|
|» name|body|string|false|The name of the workflow definition<br>|
|» ondemand_trigger|body|boolean|false|If true, the workflow will run when manually initiated.<br>|
|» priority|body|string|false|Can be `High`, `Medium`, or `Low`. Higher-priority workflows take precedence over lower-priority workflows. When a workflow of higher priority is initiated, it will be placed ahead of lower-priority workflows that are running. Depending on the available resources, lower-priority workflows may be paused until resources are released.<br>|
|» scheduled_trigger|body|boolean|false|If true, the workflow will run based on the configured schedule with the interval field.<br>|
|» status|body|string|false|Can be `Active` or `Inactive`. Active workfow definitions run like normal. Inactive workflow definitions cannot be run.<br>|
|» timezone|body|string|false|The timezone that corresponds with the cron expression in the interval field. See the [list of accepted timezone values](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1skhepi-q5l9LyaMUPZjU_V9gzTphNMqNyV6ST5mygEo/edit?usp=sharing).<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "calloutTrigger": true,
  "createdAt": "2021-03-24T19:52:37.254Z",
  "description": "This is my special workflow! It bills everybody",
  "id": 2,
  "interval": "0 0 /1 /1 * *",
  "name": "Bill Customers",
  "ondemandTrigger": true,
  "priority": "Low",
  "scheduledTrigger": true,
  "status": "Inactive",
  "timezone": "Eastern Time (US & Canada)",
  "type": "Workflow::Setup",
  "updatedAt": "2021-04-05T18:35:52.781Z"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    "Invalid ID / Multiple objects returned - SchemaId: 2 InstanceId: 2 ObjectId: 19080"
  ]
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "reasons": [
    {
      "fieldName": "status",
      "title": "on is not a valid status. Choose from Active or Inactive"
    },
    {
      "fieldName": "interval",
      "title": "The entered cron interval is not valid, rebuild schedule and submit again."
    }
  ],
  "success": false
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-workflow-definition-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|404|Not Found|The workflow for the given id does not exist|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Bad Request for one of the following reasons:<br>* The name or description fields are not strings.<br>* The ondemand_trigger, callout_trigger, or scheduled_trigger fields are not booleans.<br>* The timezone does not match one of the valid values in [this spread sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1skhepi-q5l9LyaMUPZjU_V9gzTphNMqNyV6ST5mygEo/edit?usp=sharing).<br>* The priority is not one of High, Medium, or Low.<br>* The status is not one of Active or Inactive.<br>* The scheduled_trigger is set to true but a valid timezone and interval were not passed.<br>|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|

## Run a workflow

<a id="opIdPOST_Run_Workflow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/workflows/0/run \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "accountId": "4028905f5a87c0ff015a87d25ae90025",
    "paymentId": "4028905f5a87c0ff015a889ddfb800c0"
  }'
```

`POST /workflows/{workflow_id}/run`

Run a specified workflow. In the request body, you can include parameters that you want to pass to the workflow. For the parameters to be recognized and picked up by tasks in the workflow, you need to define the parameters first. 

To learn about how to define parameters, see [Configure the settings of a workflow](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CE_Workflow/Using_Workflow/B_Configure_a_Workflow).


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "accountId": "4028905f5a87c0ff015a87d25ae90025",
  "paymentId": "4028905f5a87c0ff015a889ddfb800c0"
}
```

<h3 id="run-a-workflow-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Authorization|header|string|true|`Bearer {token}` for a valid OAuth token.<br>|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|workflow_id|path|integer|true|The ID of the workflow you want to run.|
|body|body|object|false|Include parameters you want to pass to the workflow.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "createdAt": "2019-09-19 18:25:33 UTC",
  "id": 400,
  "name": "WF-396-00000003",
  "originalWorkflowId": 396,
  "status": "Queued",
  "type": "Workflow::Instance",
  "updatedAt": "2019-09-19 18:25:33 UTC"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "invalid",
      "status": 400,
      "title": "Callout mode is not turned on in this workflow."
    }
  ]
}
```

> 406 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "invalid",
      "status": 406,
      "title": "Required field for Workflow-Message1 does not have a set value. Ensure parameter 'Message' is present."
    }
  ],
  "parameters": {
    "workflow": {}
  }
}
```

> 409 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "invalid",
      "status": 406,
      "title": "Workflow WF-396-00000002 with Id 399 is an instance/run."
    }
  ]
}
```

## Update a Zuora Revenue accounting code

<a id="opIdPUT_RevProAccountingCodes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v1/revpro-accounting-codes \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "adjustmentLiabilityAccount": "adjustL-1",
    "adjustmentRevenueAccount": "adjustRev-1",
    "contractAssetAccount": "CA-2",
    "contractLiabilityAccount": "CL-2",
    "productRatePlanChargeId": "2c92c0f962470b8101624b869fcd45fc",
    "recognizedRevenueAccount": "ContractRevRec-1",
    "unbilledReceivablesAccount": "unbilledR-1"
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/revpro-accounting-codes`

Update the Zuora Revenue accounting code that corresponds to a specific Product Rate Plan Charge Id in Zuora Billing.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "adjustmentLiabilityAccount": "adjustL-1",
  "adjustmentRevenueAccount": "adjustRev-1",
  "contractAssetAccount": "CA-2",
  "contractLiabilityAccount": "CL-2",
  "productRatePlanChargeId": "2c92c0f962470b8101624b869fcd45fc",
  "recognizedRevenueAccount": "ContractRevRec-1",
  "unbilledReceivablesAccount": "unbilledR-1"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-zuora-revenue-accounting-code-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Zuora-Entity-Ids|header|string|false|An entity ID. If you have [Zuora Multi-entity](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Multi-entity) enabled and the OAuth token is valid for more than one entity, you must use this header to specify which entity to perform the operation in. If the OAuth token is only valid for a single entity, or you do not have Zuora Multi-entity enabled, you do not need to set this header.<br>|
|Authorization|header|string|true|`Bearer {token}` for a valid OAuth token.<br>|
|Zuora-Track-Id|header|string|false|A custom identifier for tracing the API call. If you set a value for this header, Zuora returns the same value in the response headers. This header enables you to associate your system process identifiers with Zuora API calls, to assist with troubleshooting in the event of an issue.<br><br>The value of this field must use the US-ASCII character set and must not include any of the following characters: colon (`:`), semicolon (`;`), double quote (`"`), and quote (`'`).<br>|
|body|body|[RevproAccountingCodes](#schemarevproaccountingcodes)|true|none|
|» adjustmentLiabilityAccount|body|string|true|The name of the account where the Account Type is "Adjustment Liability".|
|» adjustmentRevenueAccount|body|string|true|The name of the account where the Account Type is "Adjustment Revenue".|
|» contractAssetAccount|body|string|true|The name of the account where the Account Type is "Contract Asset".|
|» contractLiabilityAccount|body|string|true|The name of the account where the Account Type is "Contract Liability".|
|» productRatePlanChargeId|body|string|true|The ID of your product rate plan charge.|
|» recognizedRevenueAccount|body|string|true|The name of the account where the Account Type is "Recognized Revenue".|
|» unbilledReceivablesAccount|body|string|true|The name of the account where the Account Type is "Unbilled Receivables".|

**Note:** This container is only available if you set the WSDL minor version to 107.0 or later in the request header, and you have  [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.

|AppliedToInvoiceItemId|string|false|none| Associates a discount invoice item to a specific invoice item.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: inherited from the ID of the charge that a discount applies to |
|ChargeAmount|number(double)|false|none| The amount being charged for the invoice item. This amount doesn't include taxes regardless if the charge's tax mode is inclusive or exclusive.<br><br><br>**Character limit**:<br><br>**Values**: automatically calculated from multiple fields in multiple objects |
|ChargeDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the Invoice Item is created .<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|ChargeDescription|string|false|none| A description of the invoice item's charge.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 500<br><br>**Values**: inherited from `RatePlanCharge.Description` |
|ChargeId|string|false|none| The ID of the rate plan charge that is associated with this invoice item upon object creation.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: inherited from `RatePlanCharge.Id` |
|ChargeName|string|false|none| The name of the invoice item's charge.<br>**Character limi**t: 50<br><br>**Values: **inherited from `RatePlanCharge.Name` |
|ChargeNumber|string|false|none| The unique identifier of the invoice item's charge.<br><br><br>**Character limit:** 50<br><br>**Values:** inherited from `RatePlanCharge.ChargeNumber` |
|ChargeType|string|false|none| Specifies the type of charge.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 9<br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `OneTime`<br>- `Recurring`<br>- `Usage`<br>|
|CreatedById|string|false|none| The user ID of the person who created the invoice item.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date the invoice item was created.<br><br><br>**Character limit:** 29<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AutoRenew|boolean|false|none| Determines whether the subscription is automatically renewed, or whether it expires at the end of the term and needs to be manually renewed. For amendment of type `TermsAndConditions`, this field is only required if you change the automatic renewal status of a subscription.<br><br><br>**Values**: true, false |
|Code|string|false|none| A unique alphanumeric string that identifies the amendment.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 50<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated<br>|
|ContractEffectiveDate|string(date)|true|none| The date when the amendment's changes become effective for billing purposes.<br>|
|CreatedById|string|false|none| The user ID of the person who created the amendment.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the amendment was created.<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CurrentTerm|integer(int64)|false|none| The length of the period for the current subscription term. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br><br>This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `TermsAndConditions` and `TermType` is set to `TERMED`. This field is not required if `TermType` is set to `EVERGREEN`.<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid number |
|CurrentTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the current subscription term. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `TermsAndConditions` and `TermType` is set to `TERMED`. This field is not required if `TermType` is set to `EVERGREEN`.<br><br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br><br><br>**Note**:<br><br>- This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>- This field is used with the CurrentTerm field to specify the current subscription term.<br>|
|CustomerAcceptanceDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the customer accepts the amendment's changes to the subscription.<br><br>This field is only required if [Zuora is configured to require customer acceptance in Z-Billing](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/W_Billing_and_Payments_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings) and the subscription is currently in the Pending Acceptance status (the value of the `Status` field is currently `PendingAcceptance`).<br><br>Use this field together with the `Status` field. When you set a date in this field as a customer acceptance date, you should also set the `Status` field as `Completed`.<br>|
|Description|string|false|none| A description of the amendment.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 500<br><br>**Values**: maximum 500 characters |
|DestinationAccountId|string|false|none| The ID of the subscription owner that the subscription is being transferred to.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: a valid account ID |
|DestinationInvoiceOwnerId|string|false|none| The ID of the invoice owner that the subscription is being transferred to.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: a valid invoice ID |
|EffectiveDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the amendment's changes take effective. This field validates that the amendment's changes are within valid ranges of products and product rate plans.<br>This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `Cancellation`.<br><br>|
|Name|string|true|none| The name of the amendment.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 100<br><br>**Values**: a string of 100 characters or fewer |
|RatePlanData|object|false|none|A container for one `RatePlanData`. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `NewProduct`, `RemoveProduct`, or `UpdateProduct`.<br>|
|RenewalSetting|string|false|none| Specifies whether a termed subscription will remain termed or change to evergreen when it is renewed.<br><br>This field is only required if the `TermType` field is set to `Termed`.<br><br><br>**Values**: RENEW_WITH_SPECIFIC_TERM (default), RENEW_TO_EVERGREEN |
|RenewalTerm|integer(int64)|false|none| The term of renewal for the amended subscription. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `TermsAndConditions`.<br><br><br>**Values:** a valid number |
|RenewalTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the subscription renewal term. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>**Required**: Only if the value of the Type field is set to `TermsAndConditions`. This field is used with the RenewalTerm field to specify the subscription renewal term.<br><br><br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>|
|ResumeDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the subscription resumption takes effect. See [Resume Date](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Subscriptions/Resume_a_Subscription#Resume_Date) for more information.<br><br>This field is only required if you resume a suspended subscription.<br>|
|ServiceActivationDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when service is activated.<br><br>This field is only required if [Zuora is configured to require service activation in Z-Billing](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/W_Billing_and_Payments_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings) and the subscription is currently in the Pending Activation status (the value of the `Status` field is currently `PendingActivation`).<br><br>Use this field together with the `Status` field. When you set a date in this field as a service activation date, you should also set the `Status` field as the expected next phase status: `Completed` or `PendingAcceptance`.<br>|
|SpecificUpdateDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the UpdateProduct amendment takes effect. This field is only applicable if there is already a future-dated UpdateProduct amendment on the subscription.<br><br><br>For the UpdateProduct amendments, this field is only required if there is already a future-dated UpdateProduct amendment on the subscription.<br>|
|Status|string|false|none| The status of the amendment. Type: string (enum)<br><br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- Draft (default, if left null)<br>- Pending Activation<br>- Pending Acceptance<br>- Completed<br>|
|SubscriptionId|string|true|none| The ID of the subscription that the amendment changes.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: a valid subscription ID |
|SuspendDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the subscription suspension takes effect. See [Suspend Date](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Subscriptions/Suspend_a_Subscription#Suspend_Date) for more information.<br><br>This field is only required if you suspend an active subscription.<br>|
|TermStartDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the new terms and conditions take effect.<br>This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to `TermsAndConditions`.<br>|
|TermType|string|false|none| Indicates if the subscription isTERMED or EVERGREEN.<br><br>- A TERMED subscription has an expiration date, and must be manually renewed.<br>- An EVERGREEN subscription doesn't have an expiration date, and must be manually ended.<br><br>When as part of an amendment of type `TermsAndConditions`, this field is required to change the term type of a subscription.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 9<br><br>**Values**: TERMED, EVERGREEN |
|Type|string|true|none| The type of amendment.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 18<br><br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- Cancellation<br>- NewProduct<br>- OwnerTransfer (If this value is chosen, the `ContractEffectiveDate`, `ServiceActivationDate`, and `CustomerAcceptanceDate` fields will all be automatically set to today's date, and any values passed from the API are ignored.)<br>- RemoveProduct<br>- Renewal<br>- UpdateProduct<br>- TermsAndConditions<br>- SuspendSubscription<br>- ResumeSubscription<br>|
|UpdatedById|string|false|none| The ID of the user who last updated the amendment.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|UpdatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the amendment was last updated.<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|BillingTiming|string|false|none| The billing timing for the charge. You can choose to bill in advance or in arrears for recurring charge types. This field is not used in one-time or usage based charge types.<br><br><br>**Character limit**:<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- I`n Advance`<br>- `In Arrears`<br>**Note:** You can override the value inherited from the Product Rate Plan Charge when a subscription has a recurring charge type.<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>|
|ChargeNumber|string|false|none| A unique number that identifies the charge. This number is returned as a string.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 50<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- automatically generated if left null<br>- a unique number of 50 characters or fewer<br>|

If this field is included in a query, the query will filter out the rate plans whose `ChargeModel` field is not of a Discount type. You cannot query this field with the following fields in a single query:<br><br>- Price<br>- IncludedUnits<br>- DiscountPercentage<br>- OveragePrice<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid currency amount |
|DiscountPercentage|string(decimal)|false|none| Query Filter |
|EndDateCondition|string|false|none| Defines when the charge ends after the charge trigger date. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`.<br><br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `SubscriptionEnd`: The charge ends on the subscription end date after the charge trigger date. This is the default value.<br>- `FixedPeriod`: The charge ends after a specified period based on the trigger date of the charge. If you set this field to `FixedPeriod`, you must specify the length of the period and a period type by defining the `UpToPeriods` and `UpToPeriodsType` fields.<br>- `SpecificEndDate`: The specific date on which the charge ends. If you set this field to `SpecificEndDate`, you must specify the specific date by defining the `SpecificEndDate` field.<br><br><br><br>**Note**: If the subscription ends before the charge end date, the charge ends when the subscription ends. But if the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge will end on the charge end date. |
|ListPriceBase|string|false|none|The list price base for the product rate plan charge.<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Per Month`<br>- `Per Billing Period`<br>- `Per Week`<br>|
|Price|string(decimal)|false|none| Query Filter |
|PriceChangeOption|string|false|none| Applies an automatic price change when a termed subscription is renewed.<br><br><br>**Character limit**:<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `NoChange` (default)<br>- `SpecificPercentageValue`<br>- `UseLatestProductCatalogPricing`<br>|
|PriceIncreasePercentage|string(decimal)|false|none| Specifies the percentage to increase or decrease the price of renewed subscriptions. Use this field if the `ProductRatePlanCharge`.`PriceChangeOption` value is set to `SpecificPercentageValue`.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br><br>**Values**: a decimal value between -100 and 100 |
|ProductRatePlanChargeId|string|true|none|none|
|Quantity|number(double)|false|none| The default quantity of units, such as the number of authors in a hosted wiki service. Valid for all charge models except for Flat Fee pricing. This field is only rquired if the charge model is tiered pricing or volume pricing.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid quantity value |
|RatingGroup|string|false|none|Specifies a rating group based on which usage records are rated. <br><br>Values:<br><br>* `ByBillingPeriod` (default): The rating is based on all the usages in a billing period.       <br>* `ByUsageStartDate`: The rating is based on all the usages on the same usage start date. <br>* `ByUsageRecord`: The rating is based on each usage record.<br>* `ByUsageUpload`: The rating is based on all the usages in a uploaded usage file (.xls or .csv).<br><br>**Note:**<br><br>The `ByBillingPeriod` value can be applied for all charge models.<br>The `ByUsageStartDate`, `ByUsageRecord`, and `ByUsageUpload` values can only be applied for per unit, volume pricing, and tiered pricing charge models.<br>Use this field only for Usage charges. One-Time Charges and Recurring Charges return `NULL`.<br>|
|RevRecCode|string|false|none| Associates this product rate plan charge with a specific revenue recognition code.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 70<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid revenue recognition code |
|RevRecTriggerCondition|string|false|none| Specifies when revenue recognition begins.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 22<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>-  `ContractEffectiveDate`<br><br>-  `ServiceActivationDate`<br><br>-  `CustomerAcceptanceDate`<br><br>|
|RevenueRecognitionRuleName|string|false|none| Specifies the Revenue Recognition Rule that you want the Rate Plan Charge to use. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. By default, the Revenue Recognition Rule is inherited from the Product Rate Plan Charge. For Amend<br>calls, you can use this field only for NewProduct amendments. For Update<br>calls, you can use this field only to update subscriptions in draft status. Note that if you use this field to specify a Revenue Recognition Rule for the Rate Plan Charge, the rule will remain as specified even if you later change the rule used by the corresponding Product Rate Plan Charge. See [Z-Billing User Role](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CF_Users_and_Administrators/A_Administrator_Settings/User_Roles/d_Billing_Roles) permission enabled to use this field.<br><br><br><br>**Character limit**: n/a<br><br><br>**Values**: name of an active Revenue Recognition Rule |
|SpecificBillingPeriod|integer(int64)|false|none| Customizes the number of months or weeks for the charges billing period. This field is only required if you set the value of the `BillingPeriod` field to `Specific Months` or `Specific Weeks`.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 5<br><br><br>**Values**: inherited from `ProductRatePlanCharge.BillingPeriod` **Note:** You can override the value inherited from the Product Rate Plan Charge, but only when creating a new subscription or a New Product amendment. |
|SpecificEndDate|string(date)|false|none| The specific date on which the charge ends, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br><br><br>**Note**:<br><br>- This field is only applicable when the `EndDateCondition` field is set to `SpecificEndDate`.<br>- If the subscription ends before the specific end date, the charge ends when the subscription ends. But if the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge will end on the specific end date.<br>|
|TriggerDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the charge becomes effective and billing begins, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. This field is only required if the `TriggerEvent` field is set to `SpecificDate`.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br>|
|TriggerEvent|string|false|none| Specifies when to start billing the customer for the charge.<br>**Note: **This field can be passed through the subscribe<br>and amend<br>calls and will override the default value set on the Product Rate Plan Charge.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 18<br><br><br>**Values**: inherited from `ProductRatePlanCharge.TriggerEvent` and can be one of the following values:<br><br>- `ContractEffective `is the date when the subscription's contract goes into effect and the charge is ready to be billed.<br>- `ServiceActivationDate `is when the services or products for a subscription have been activated and the customers have access.<br>- `CustomerAcceptance `is when the customer accepts the services or products for a subscription.<br>- SpecificDate is valid only on the RatePlanCharge.<br>|
|UpToPeriods|integer(int64)|false|none| Specifies the length of the period during which the charge is active. If this period ends before the subscription ends, the charge ends when this period ends.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 5<br><br><br>**Values**: inherited from `ProductRatePlanCharge.UpToPeriods`<br><br>**Note**:<br><br>- You must use this field together with the `UpToPeriodsType` field to specify the time period. This field is only applicable only when the `EndDateCondition` field is set to `FixedPeriod`.<br>- You can override the value inherited from the Product Rate Plan Charge, but only when creating a new subscription or a New Product amendment.<br>- Use this field to override the value in `ProductRatePlanCharge.UpToPeriod`.<br>- If you override the value in this field, enter a whole number between 0 and 65535, exclusive.<br>- If the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge end date will change accordingly up to the original period end.<br>|
|UpToPeriodsType|string|false|none| The period type used to define when the charge ends. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`.<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Billing Periods` (default)<br>- `Days`<br>- `Weeks`<br>- `Months`<br>- `Years`<br><br><br>**Note**:<br><br>- You must use this field together with the `UpToPeriods` field to specify the time period.<br>- This field is only applicable only when the `EndDateCondition` field is set to `FixedPeriod`.<br>|
|WeeklyBillCycleDay|string|false|none| Specifies which day of the week as the bill cycle day (BCD) for the charge.<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br><br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Sunday`<br>- `Monday`<br>- `Tuesday`<br>- `Wednesday`<br>- `Thursday`<br>- `Friday`<br>- `Saturday`<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Rate Plan Charge object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

Container for charge model configuration data.

**Note**: This field is only available if you have the High Water Mark, Pre-Rated Pricing, or Multi-Attribute Pricing charge models enabled. These charge models are available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customFieldPerUnitRate|string|false|none|The custom field that carries the per-unit rate for each usage record. For example, `perUnitAmount__c`.<br>    <br>This field is only available for the usage-based charges that use the Pre-Rated Per Unit Pricing charge model. The charge model is available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.<br>|
|customFieldTotalAmount|string|false|none|The custom field that carries the total amount to charge for a usage record. For example, `totalAmount__c`. <br>    <br>This field is only available for the usage-based charges that use the Pre-Rated Pricing charge model. The charge model is available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.<br>|
|formula|string|false|none|The pricing formula to calculate actual rating amount for each usage record.<br><br>This field is only available for the usage-based charges that use the Multi-Attribute Pricing charge model. The charge model is available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.<br>|

Charge associated with a rate plan.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|billing|object|false|none|Billing information about the charge.<br>|
|chargeNumber|string|false|none|Charge number of the charge. For example, C-00000307.<br><br>If you do not set this field, Zuora will generate the charge number.<br>|
|customFields|[RatePlanChargeObjectCustomFields](#schemarateplanchargeobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of a Rate Plan Charge object.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the charge.<br>|
|endDate|[EndConditions](#schemaendconditions)|false|none|Specifies when a charge becomes inactive.<br>|
|pricing|object|false|none|Pricing information about the charge.<br>|
|productRatePlanChargeId|string|true|none|Internal identifier of the product rate plan charge that the charge is based on.<br>|
|revRecCode|string|false|none|Revenue Recognition Code<br>|
|revRecTriggerCondition|string|false|none|Specifies the revenue recognition trigger condition.<br><br>  * `Contract Effective Date` <br>  * `Service Activation Date`<br>  * `Customer Acceptance Date`<br>|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|string|false|none|Specifies the revenue recognition rule.<br><br>  * `Recognize upon invoicing` <br>  * `Recognize daily over time`<br>|
|startDate|[TriggerParams](#schematriggerparams)|false|none|Specifies when a charge becomes active.<br>|
|uniqueToken|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the charge. This identifier enables you to refer to the charge before the charge has an internal identifier in Zuora.<br><br>For instance, suppose that you want to use a single order to add a product to a subscription and later update the same product. When you add the product, you can set a unique identifier for the charge. Then when you update the product, you can use the same unique identifier to specify which charge to modify.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|revRecTriggerCondition|Contract Effective Date|
|revRecTriggerCondition|Service Activation Date|
|revRecTriggerCondition|Customer Acceptance Date|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|Recognize upon invoicing|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|Recognize daily over time|

|description|string|false|none|none|
|effectiveDate|[TriggerParams](#schematriggerparams)|false|none|Specifies when a charge becomes active.<br>|
|pricing|[PricingUpdate](#schemapricingupdate)|false|none|none|
|uniqueToken|string|false|none|description: \|<br>  A unique string to represent the rate plan charge in the order. The unique token is used to perform multiple actions against a newly added rate plan. For example, if you want to add and update a product in the same order, you would assign a unique token to the product rate plan when added and use that token in future order actions.<br>|

|url|string|false|none|The relative URL of the setting. It is the same as in the `pathPattern` field in the response body of [Listing all settings](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/GET_ListAllSettings). For example, `/billing-rules`.<br>|

|---|---|

|method|POST|
|method|PUT|
|method|PATCH|
|method|DELETE|
|method|OPTIONS|
|method|TRACE|

Charge associated with a rate plan.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|billing|object|false|none|Billing information about the charge.<br>|
|chargeNumber|string|false|none|Charge number of the charge. For example, C-00000307.<br><br>If you do not set this field, Zuora will generate the charge number.<br>|
|customFields|[RatePlanChargeObjectCustomFields](#schemarateplanchargeobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of a Rate Plan Charge object.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the charge.<br>|
|endDate|[EndConditions](#schemaendconditions)|false|none|Specifies when a charge becomes inactive.<br>|
|pricing|object|false|none|Pricing information about the charge.<br>|
|productRatePlanChargeId|string|true|none|Internal identifier of the product rate plan charge that the charge is based on.<br>|
|revRecCode|string|false|none|Revenue Recognition Code<br>|
|revRecTriggerCondition|string|false|none|Specifies the revenue recognition trigger condition.<br><br>  * `Contract Effective Date` <br>  * `Service Activation Date`<br>  * `Customer Acceptance Date`<br>|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|string|false|none|Specifies the revenue recognition rule.<br><br>  * `Recognize upon invoicing` <br>  * `Recognize daily over time`<br>|
|startDate|[CreateOrderTriggerParams](#schemacreateordertriggerparams)|false|none|Specifies when a charge becomes active.<br>|
|uniqueToken|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the charge. This identifier enables you to refer to the charge before the charge has an internal identifier in Zuora.<br><br>For instance, suppose that you want to use a single order to add a product to a subscription and later update the same product. When you add the product, you can set a unique identifier for the charge. Then when you update the product, you can use the same unique identifier to specify which charge to modify.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|revRecTriggerCondition|Contract Effective Date|
|revRecTriggerCondition|Service Activation Date|
|revRecTriggerCondition|Customer Acceptance Date|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|Recognize upon invoicing|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|Recognize daily over time|

Information about an order action of type `CreateSubscription`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceSeparately|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the subscription appears on a separate invoice when Zuora generates invoices.<br>|
|newSubscriptionOwnerAccount|[CreateOrderCreateSubscriptionNewSubscriptionOwnerAccount](#schemacreateordercreatesubscriptionnewsubscriptionowneraccount)|false|none|none|
|notes|string|false|none|Notes about the subscription. These notes are only visible to Zuora users.<br>|
|subscribeToRatePlans|[[CreateOrderRatePlanOverride](#schemacreateorderrateplanoverride)]|false|none|List of rate plans associated with the subscription.<br>|
|subscriptionNumber|string|false|none|Subscription number of the subscription. For example, A-S00000001.<br><br>If you do not set this field, Zuora will generate the subscription number.<br>|
|subscriptionOwnerAccountNumber|string|false|none|Account number of an existing account that will own the subscription. For example, A00000001.<br><br>If you do not set this field or the `newSubscriptionOwnerAccount` field, the account that owns the order will also own the subscription. Zuora will return an error if you set this field and the `newSubscriptionOwnerAccount` field.<br>|
|terms|object|false|none|Container for the terms and renewal settings of the subscription.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountNumber|string|false|none|Account number. For example, A00000001.<br>|
|additionalEmailAddresses|string|false|none|List of additional email addresses to receive emailed invoices. Values should be a comma-separated list of email addresses.<br>|
|allowInvoiceEdit|boolean|false|none|Indicates if associated invoices can be edited.<br>Values are: <br><br>* `true`<br>* `false` (default)<br>|
|autoPay|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether future payments are automatically billed when they are due.<br>|
|batch|string|false|none|Name of the billing batch that the account belongs to. For example, Batch1.<br>|
|billCycleDay|integer|true|none|Day of the month that the account prefers billing periods to begin on. If set to 0, the bill cycle day will be set as "AutoSet".<br>|
|billToContact|[BillToContactPostOrder](#schemabilltocontactpostorder)|true|none|none|
|communicationProfileId|string|false|none|Internal identifier of the communication profile that Zuora uses when sending notifications to the account's contacts.<br>|
|creditCard|[creditCard](#schemacreditcard)|false|none|Default payment method associated with an account. Only credit card payment methods are supported.<br>|
|creditMemoTemplateId|string|false|none|**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br><br>The unique ID of the credit memo template, configured in **Billing Settings** > **Manage Billing Document Configuration** through the Zuora UI. For example, 2c92c08a6246fdf101626b1b3fe0144b.<br>|
|crmId|string|false|none|External identifier of the account in a CRM system.<br>|
|currency|string|true|none|ISO 3-letter currency code (uppercase). For example, USD.<br>|
|customFields|[AccountObjectCustomFields](#schemaaccountobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of an Account object.<br>|
|customerServiceRepName|string|false|none|Name of the account's customer service representative, if applicable.<br>|
|debitMemoTemplateId|string|false|none|**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br><br>The unique ID of the debit memo template, configured in **Billing Settings** > **Manage Billing Document Configuration** through the Zuora UI. For example, 2c92c08d62470a8501626b19d24f19e2.<br>|
|hpmCreditCardPaymentMethodId|string|false|none|The ID of the payment method associated with this account. The payment method specified for this field will be set as the default payment method of the account.<br><br>If the `autoPay` field is set to `true`, you must provide the credit card payment method ID for either this field or the `creditCard` field,<br>but not both.  <br>|
|invoiceDeliveryPrefsEmail|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether to turn on the invoice delivery method 'Email' for the new account. <br>Values are: <br><br>* `true` (default). Turn on the invoice delivery method 'Email' for the new account.<br>* `false`. Turn off the invoice delivery method 'Email' for the new account.         <br>|
|invoiceDeliveryPrefsPrint|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether to turn on the invoice delivery method 'Print' for the new account.<br>Values are: <br><br>* `true`. Turn on the invoice delivery method 'Print' for the new account.<br>* `false` (default). Turn off the invoice delivery method 'Print' for the new account.<br>|
|invoiceTemplateId|string|false|none|Internal identifier of the invoice template that Zuora uses when generating invoices for the account.<br>|
|name|string|true|none|Account name.<br>|
|notes|string|false|none|Notes about the account. These notes are only visible to Zuora users.<br>|
|parentId|string|false|none|Identifier of the parent customer account for this Account object. Use this field if you have customer hierarchy enabled.|
|paymentGateway|string|false|none|The payment gateway that Zuora uses when processing electronic payments and refunds for the account. If you do not specify this field or if the value of this field is null, Zuora uses your default payment gateway.<br>|
|paymentMethod|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|false|none|Payment method to create for this new account. Supports all the payment methods that are supported in the "Create payment method" operation. See for more information about how to use this field in [Create payment method](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PaymentMethods).<br>|
|paymentTerm|string|false|none|Name of the payment term associated with the account. For example, "Net 30". The payment term determines the due dates of invoices.<br>|
|purchaseOrderNumber|string|false|none|The number of the purchase order associated with this account. Purchase order information generally comes from customers.<br>|
|salesRep|string|false|none|The name of the sales representative associated with this account, if applicable.<br>|
|soldToContact|[SoldToContactPostOrder](#schemasoldtocontactpostorder)|false|none|none|
|taxInfo|[TaxInfo](#schemataxinfo)|false|none|Information about the tax exempt status of a customer account.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|string|false|none|Field for data access control. The name of the data access control field has the form <code>*customField*__h</code>. The data access control field is case sensitive. See [Data Access Control](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CF_Users_and_Administrators/A_Administrator_Settings/Data_Access_Control) for more information.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|addProduct|[CreateOrderRatePlanOverride](#schemacreateorderrateplanoverride)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `addProduct`. <br><br>If you want to create a pending order through the "Add product" order action, and if the charge's trigger condition is `Specific Date`, you must set a charge number in the `chargeNumber` field for the "Add product" order action. In this case, if you do not set it, Zuora will not generate the charge number for you.<br><br>See more information about pending orders in [Pending Order and Subscription](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/Pending_Order_and_Subscription). <br>|
|cancelSubscription|[CancelSubscription](#schemacancelsubscription)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `CancelSubscription`.<br>|
|createSubscription|[CreateOrderCreateSubscription](#schemacreateordercreatesubscription)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `CreateSubscription`.<br>|
|customFields|[OrderActionObjectCustomFields](#schemaorderactionobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of an Order Action object.<br>|
|ownerTransfer|[OwnerTransfer](#schemaownertransfer)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `OwnerTransfer`.<br><br>**Note:** The Owner Transfer feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br>|
|removeProduct|[RemoveProduct](#schemaremoveproduct)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `RemoveProduct`.<br>|
|resume|[CreateOrderResume](#schemacreateorderresume)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `Resume`.<br>|
|suspend|[CreateOrderSuspend](#schemacreateordersuspend)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `Suspend`.<br>|
|termsAndConditions|[CreateOrderTermsAndConditions](#schemacreateordertermsandconditions)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `TermsAndConditions`.<br>|
|triggerDates|[[TriggerDate](#schematriggerdate)]|false|none|Container for the contract effective, service activation, and customer acceptance dates of the order action. <br><br>If [Zuora is configured to require service activation](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Service_Activation_of_Orders.3F) and the `ServiceActivation` field is not set for a `CreateSubscription` order action, a `Pending` order and a `Pending Activation` subscription are created.<br><br>If [Zuora is configured to require customer acceptance](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Customer_Acceptance_of_Orders.3F) and the `CustomerAcceptance` field is not set for a `CreateSubscription` order action, a `Pending` order and a `Pending Acceptance` subscription are created. At the same time, if the service activation date field is also required and not set, a `Pending` order and a `Pending Activation` subscription are created instead.<br><br>If [Zuora is configured to require service activation](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Service_Activation_of_Orders.3F) and the `ServiceActivation` field is not set for either of the following order actions, a `Pending` order is created. The subscription status is not impacted. **Note:** This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you want to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br> * AddProduct<br> * UpdateProduct<br> * RemoveProduct<br> * RenewSubscription<br> * TermsAndConditions<br><br>If [Zuora is configured to require customer acceptance](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Customer_Acceptance_of_Orders.3F) and the `CustomerAcceptance` field is not set for either of the following order actions, a `Pending` order is created. The subscription status is not impacted. **Note:** This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you want to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br> * AddProduct<br> * UpdateProduct<br> * RemoveProduct<br> * RenewSubscription<br> * TermsAndConditions<br>|
|type|string|true|none|Type of order action.<br><br>Unless the type of order action is `RenewSubscription`, you must use the corresponding field to provide information about the order action. For example, if the type of order action is `AddProduct`, you must set the `addProduct` field.<br><br>Zuora returns an error if you set a field that corresponds to a different type of order action. For example, if the type of order action is `AddProduct`, Zuora returns an error if you set the `updateProduct` field.<br><br>A [pending order](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/Pending_Order_and_Subscription) supports the following order actions:<br> * CreateSubscription<br> * AddProduct<br> * UpdateProduct<br> * RemoveProduct<br> * RenewSubscription<br> * TermsAndConditions<br><br>However, pending orders created through all order actions except for "Create new subscription":<br> * Do not impact the subscription status.<br> * Are in **Limited Availability**. If you want to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com). <br><br>A pending order is created in either of the following conditions:<br> * [Zuora is configured to require service activation](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Service_Activation_of_Orders.3F) and the service activation date is not set in your "Create an order" call.<br> * [Zuora is configured to require customer acceptance](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Customer_Acceptance_of_Orders.3F) and the customer acceptance date is not set in your "Create an order" call.<br> * When a charge in the subscription has its `triggerEvent` field set as `SpecificDate` and the `specificTriggerDate` field is not set in your "Create an order" API call.<br>|
|updateProduct|[CreateOrderRatePlanUpdate](#schemacreateorderrateplanupdate)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `UpdateProduct`.<br>|
