|amountPerUnit|number|false|none|The actual charged amount per unit for the Order Line Item.<br>|
|billTargetDate|string(date)|false|none|The target date for the Order Line Item to be picked up by bill run for billing.<br>|
|customFields|[OrderLineItemCustomFields](#schemaorderlineitemcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of an Order Line Item object.<br>|
|deferredRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The deferred revenue accounting code for the Order Line Item.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the Order Line Item.<br>|
|itemName|string|false|none|The name of the Order Line Item.<br>|
|itemState|string|false|none|The state of an Order Line Item. If you want to generate invoice or preview invoice for order line items, you must set this field to `SentToBilling`.<br><br>See [Order Line Item states, Order states, and state transitions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AB_Order_Line_Item_States_and_Order_States) for more information.<br>|
|itemType|string|false|none|The type of the Order Line Item. <br>|
|listPricePerUnit|number|false|none|The list price per unit for the Order Line Item.<br>|
|productCode|string|false|none|The product code for the Order Line Item.<br>|
|productRatePlanChargeId|string(date)|false|none|Id of a Product Rate Plan Charge. Only one-time charges are supported.<br>|
|purchaseOrderNumber|string|false|none|Used by customers to specify the Purchase Order Number provided by the buyer.<br>|
|quantity|number|false|none|The quantity of units, such as the number of authors in a hosted wiki service.<br>|
|recognizedRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The recognized revenue accounting code for the Order Line Item.<br>|
|revenueRecognitionRule|string|false|none|The Revenue Recognition rule for the Order Line Item.<br>|
|soldTo|string|false|none|The Id of an existing account. Use this field to assign an existing account as the sold-to contact of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can either use this field to assign an existing account or use the `soldToData` field to create a new account as the sold-to contact of the OLI. <br><br>If neither this field nor the `soldToData` field is set, the system will automatically set the default sold-to contact under the OLI's invoice owner account as the sold-to contact of the OLI.<br>|
|soldToData|[OrderContact](#schemaordercontact)|false|none|Use this field to create a new account as the sold-to contact of the Order Line Item (OLI). <br><br>You can either use this field to create a new account or use the `soldTo` field to assign an existing account as the sold-to contact of the OLI. <br><br>If neither this field nor the `soldTo` field is set, the system will automatically set the default sold-to contact under the OLI's invoice owner account as the sold-to contact of the OLI.<br>|
|taxCode|string|false|none|The tax code for the Order Line Item.<br>|
|taxMode|string|false|none|The tax mode for the Order Line Item.<br>|

Information about an order action of type `addProduct`. 

If you want to create a pending order through the "Add product" order action, and if the charge's trigger condition is `Specific Date`, you must set a charge number in the `chargeNumber` field for the "Add product" order action. In this case, if you do not set it, Zuora will not generate the charge number for you.

See more information about pending orders in [Pending Order and Subscription](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/Pending_Order_and_Subscription).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargeOverrides|[[CreateOrderChargeOverride](#schemacreateorderchargeoverride)]|false|none|List of charges associated with the rate plan.<br>|
|customFields|[RatePlanObjectCustomFields](#schemarateplanobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of a Rate Plan object.<br>|
|productRatePlanId|string|true|none|Internal identifier of the product rate plan that the rate plan is based on.<br>|
|uniqueToken|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the rate plan. This identifier enables you to refer to the rate plan before the rate plan has an internal identifier in Zuora.<br><br>For instance, suppose that you want to use a single order to add a product to a subscription and later update the same product. When you add the product, you can set a unique identifier for the rate plan. Then when you update the product, you can use the same unique identifier to specify which rate plan to modify.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargeUpdates|[[CreateOrderChargeUpdate](#schemacreateorderchargeupdate)]|false|none|none|
|customFields|[RatePlanObjectCustomFields](#schemarateplanobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of a Rate Plan object.<br>|
|ratePlanId|string|false|none|The id of the rate plan to be updated. It can be the latest version or any history version id.<br>|
|specificUpdateDate|string(date)|false|none|<br>The date when the Update Product order action takes effect. This field is only applicable if there is already a future-dated Update Product order action on the subscription. The format of the date is yyyy-mm-dd.<br><br>See [Update a Product on Subscription with Future-dated Updates](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/AC_Orders_Tutorials/C_Update_a_Product_in_a_Subscription/Update_a_Product_on_Subscription_with_Future-dated_Updates) for more information about this feature.<br>|
|uniqueToken|string|false|none|A unique string to represent the rate plan charge in the order. The unique token is used to perform multiple actions against a newly added rate plan. For example, if you want to add and update a product in the same order, you would assign a unique token to the product rate plan when added and use that token in future order actions.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_CreateOrderResume">CreateOrderResume</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacreateorderresume"></a>
<a id="schema_CreateOrderResume"></a>
<a id="tocScreateorderresume"></a>
<a id="tocscreateorderresume"></a>

```json
{
  "extendsTerm": true,
  "resumePeriods": 0,
  "resumePeriodsType": "Day",
  "resumePolicy": "Today",
  "resumeSpecificDate": "1970-01-01"
}
```

Information about an order action of type `Resume`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|extendsTerm|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether to extend the subscription term by the length of time the suspension is in effect.<br>|
|resumePeriods|integer|false|none|This field is applicable only when the `resumePolicy` field is set to `FixedPeriodsFromToday` or `FixedPeriodsFromSuspendDate`. It must be used together with the `resumePeriodsType` field. <br><br>The total number of the periods used to specify when a subscription resumption takes effect. The subscription resumption will take place after the specified time frame (`suspendPeriods` multiplied by `suspendPeriodsType`) from today's date. <br>|
|resumePeriodsType|string|false|none|This field is applicable only when the `resumePolicy` field is set to `FixedPeriodsFromToday` or `FixedPeriodsFromSuspendDate`. It must be used together with the `resumePeriods` field.<br><br>The period type used to specify when a subscription resumption takes effect. The subscription suspension will take place after the specified time frame (`suspendPeriods` multiplied by `suspendPeriodsType`) from today's date. <br>|
|resumePolicy|string|true|none|Resume methods. Specify a way to resume a subscription. See [Resume Date](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Subscriptions/Resume_a_Subscription#Resume_Date) for more information.<br><br>If `SuspendDate` is specfied, the resumption will take place on the same day as the suspension. <br>|
|resumeSpecificDate|string(date)|false|none|This field is applicable only when the `resumePolicy` field is set to `SpecificDate`.<br><br>A specific date when the subscription resumption takes effect, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The value should not be earlier than the subscription suspension date.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|resumePeriodsType|Day|
|resumePeriodsType|Week|
|resumePeriodsType|Month|
|resumePeriodsType|Year|
|resumePolicy|Today|
|resumePolicy|FixedPeriodsFromSuspendDate|
|resumePolicy|FixedPeriodsFromToday|
|resumePolicy|SpecificDate|
|resumePolicy|SuspendDate|

It must be used together with the `suspendPeriodsType` field. <br><br>The total number of the periods used to specify when a subscription suspension takes effect. The subscription suspension will take place after the specified time frame (`suspendPeriods` multiplied by `suspendPeriodsType`) from today's date. <br>|
|suspendPeriodsType|string|false|none|This field is applicable only when the `suspendPolicy` field is set to `FixedPeriodsFromToday`. It must be used together with the `suspendPeriods` field.<br><br>The period type used to specify when a subscription suspension takes effect. The subscription suspension will take place after the specified time frame (`suspendPeriods` multiplied by `suspendPeriodsType`) from today's date. <br>|
|suspendPolicy|string|true|none|Suspend methods. Specify a way to suspend a subscription. See [Suspend Date](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Subscriptions/Suspend_a_Subscription#Suspend_Date) for more information.<br>|
|suspendSpecificDate|string(date)|false|none|This field is applicable only when the `suspendPolicy` field is set to `SpecificDate`.<br><br>A specific date when the subscription suspension takes effect, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The value should not be earlier than the subscription's contract effective date or later than the subscription's term end date.<br>|

```json
  },
```

```json
  "expirationYear": 0,
  "mitConsentAgreementRef": "string",
  "mitConsentAgreementSrc": "External",
  "mitNetworkTransactionId": "string",
  "mitProfileAction": "Activate",
  "mitProfileAgreedOn": "1970-01-01",
  "mitProfileType": "Recurring",

}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cardHolderInfo|[CreatePaymentMethodCardholderInfo](#schemacreatepaymentmethodcardholderinfo)|false|none|Container for cardholder information. If provided, Zuora will<br>only use this information for this card. Otherwise, Zuora will use<br>the account''s existing bill-to contact information for this card.<br>|
|cardNumber|string|false|none|Credit card number.<br>|
|cardType|string|false|none|The type of the credit card.<br><br>Possible values include `Visa`, `MasterCard`, `AmericanExpress`, `Discover`, `JCB`, and `Diners`. For more information about credit card types supported by different payment gateways, see [Supported Payment Gateways](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways).<br>|
|checkDuplicated|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the duplication check is performed when you create a new credit card payment method. The default value is `false`.<br><br>With this field set to `true`, Zuora will check all active payment methods associated with the same billing account to ensure that no duplicate credit card payment methods are created. An error is returned if a duplicate payment method is found.<br>        <br>The following fields are used for the duplication check:<br>  * `cardHolderName`<br>  * `expirationMonth`<br>  * `expirationYear`<br>  * `creditCardMaskNumber`. It is the masked credit card number generated by Zuora. For example, `****1234`. <br>|
|expirationMonth|integer|false|none|One or two digit expiration month (1-12) of the credit card.<br>|
|expirationYear|integer|false|none|Four-digit expiration year of the credit card.<br>|
|mitConsentAgreementRef|string|false|none|Specifies your reference for the stored credential consent agreement that you have established with the customer. Only applicable if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|string|false|none|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|mitNetworkTransactionId|string|false|none|Specifies the ID of a network transaction. Only applicable if you set the `mitProfileAction` field to `Persist`.<br>|
|mitProfileAction|string|false|none|If you set this field, Zuora creates a stored credential profile within the payment method.<br><br>**Note:** This feature is in the **Early Adopters** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing as generally available.<br><br>* `Activate` - Use this value if you are creating the stored credential profile after receiving the customer's consent.<br><br>  Zuora will create the stored credential profile then send a cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) to the payment gateway to validate the stored credential profile. If the CIT succeeds, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Active`. If the CIT does not succeed, Zuora will not create a stored credential profile.<br>  <br>  If the payment gateway does not support the stored credential transaction framework, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Agreed`.<br><br><br>* `Persist` - Use this value if the stored credential profile represents a stored credential profile in an external system. The status of the payment method's stored credential profile will be `Active`.<br>|
|mitProfileAgreedOn|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the profile is agreed. The date format is `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br>|
|mitProfileType|string|false|none|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field. Indicates the type of the stored credential profile to process recurring or unsecheduled transactions.<br>|
|securityCode|string|false|none|CVV or CVV2 security code of the credit card.<br><br>To ensure PCI compliance, this value is not stored and cannot be queried.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|External|
|mitProfileAction|Activate|
|mitProfileAction|Persist|
|mitProfileType|Recurring|
|mitProfileType|Unscheduled|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

Use this field for electronic payments, such as credit cards.<br><br>When capturing the authorized funds after authorization enablement, `authTransactionId` must be used together with `gatewayOrderId`.<br>|
|comment|string|false|none|Additional information related to the payment.<br>|
|currency|string|true|none|When Standalone Payment is not enabled, the `currency` of the payment must be the same as the payment currency defined in the customer account settings through Zuora UI.<br><br>When Standalone Payment is enabled and `standalone` is `true`, the `currency` of the standalone payment can be different from the payment currency defined in the customer account settings. The amount will not be summed up to the account balance or key metrics regardless of currency.<br>|
|debitMemos|[[PaymentDebitMemoApplicationCreateRequestType](#schemapaymentdebitmemoapplicationcreaterequesttype)]|false|none|Container for debit memos. The maximum number of debit memos is 1,000.<br>|
|effectiveDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the payment takes effect, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br>|
|financeInformation|object|false|none|Container for the finance information related to the payment.<br>|
|gatewayId|string|false|none|The ID of the gateway instance that processes the payment. The ID must be a valid gateway instance ID and this gateway must support the specific payment method. <br><br>- When creating electronic payments, this field is required. <br>- When creating external payments, this field is optional.<br>|
|gatewayOptions|object|false|none|The field used to pass gateway-specific parameters and parameter values.<br>|
|gatewayOrderId|string|false|none|A merchant-specified natural key value that can be passed to the electronic payment gateway when a payment is created. If not specified, the payment number will be passed in instead.<br><br>Gateways check duplicates on the gateway order ID to ensure that the merchant do not accidentally enter the same transaction twice. This ID can also be used to do reconciliation and tie the payment to a natural key in external systems. The source of this ID varies by merchant. Some merchants use their shopping cart order IDs, and others use something different. Merchants use this ID to track transactions in their eCommerce systems.<br><br>When capturing the authorized funds after authorization enablement, `gatewayOrderId` must be used together with `authTransactionId`.<br>|
|invoices|[[PaymentInvoiceApplicationCreateRequestType](#schemapaymentinvoiceapplicationcreaterequesttype)]|false|none|Container for invoices. The maximum number of invoices is 1,000.<br>|
|mitTransactionSource|string|false|none|Payment transaction source used to differentiate the transaction source in Stored Credential Transaction framework.<br>  - `C_Unscheduled`: Cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) that does not occur on scheduled or regularly occurring dates.<br>  - `M_Recurring`: Merchant-initiated transaction (MIT) that occurs at regular intervals.<br>  - `M_Unscheduled`: Merchant-initiated transaction (MIT) that does not occur on scheduled or regularly occurring dates.<br>|
|paymentMethodId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment method that the customer used to make the payment. <br><br>If no payment method ID is specified in the request body, the default payment method for the customer account is used automatically. If the default payment method is different from the type of payments that you want to create, an error occurs.<br>|
|referenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|softDescriptor|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.|
|softDescriptorPhone|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.|
|standalone|boolean|false|none|This field is only available if support for standalone payments is enabled.<br><br>Specify `true` to create a standalone payment that will be processed in Zuora through Zuora gateway integration but will be settled outside of Zuora.<br><br>When `standalone` is set to `true`:<br>  - `accountId`, `amount`, `currency`, and `type` are required. <br>  - `type` must be `Electronic`.<br>  - `currency` of the payment can be different from the payment currency in the customer account settings.<br>  - The amount will not be summed up into the account balance and key metrics regardless of the payment currency.<br>  - No settlement data will be created.<br>  - Either the applied amount or the unapplied amount of the payment is zero.<br>  - The standalone payment cannot be applied, unapplied, or transferred.<br><br>Specify `false` to create an ordinary payment that will be created, processed, and settled in Zuora. The `currency` of an ordinary payment must be the same as the currency in the customer account settings.<br>|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the payment.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the payment's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Origin__NS|string|false|none|Origin of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the payment was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Transaction__NS|string|false|none|Related transaction in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Payment object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

```json
  "status": "Active",

```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|action|string|false|none|Specifies how Zuora activates the stored credential profile. Only applicable if you set the `status` field to `Active`.<br><br>* `Activate` (default) - Use this value if you are creating the stored credential profile after receiving the customer's consent.<br><br>  Zuora will create the stored credential profile then send a cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) to the payment gateway to validate the stored credential profile. If the CIT succeeds, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Active`. If the CIT does not succeed, Zuora will not create a stored credential profile.<br>  <br>  If the payment gateway does not support the stored credential transaction framework, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Agreed`.<br><br><br>* `Persist` - Use this value if the stored credential profile represents a stored credential profile in an external system. The status of the payment method's stored credential profile will be `Active`.<br>|
|agreedOn|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the profile is agreed. The date format is `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br>|
|authGateway|string|false|none|Specifies the ID of the payment gateway that Zuora will use when activating the stored credential profile.<br>|
|cardSecurityCode|string|false|none|The security code of the credit card.<br>|
|consentAgreementRef|string|false|none|Specifies your reference for the consent agreement that you have established with the customer.<br>|
|consentAgreementSrc|string|true|none|none|
|networkTransactionId|string|false|none|The ID of a network transaction.<br>|
|status|string|true|none|Specifies the status of the stored credential profile.<br><br>* `Active` - Use this value if you are creating the stored credential profile after receiving the customer's consent, or if the stored credential profile represents a stored credential profile in an external system.<br><br>  You can use the `action` field to specify how Zuora activates the stored credential profile.<br><br><br>* `Agreed` - Use this value if you are migrating the payment method to the stored credential transaction framework.<br><br>  In this case, Zuora will not send a cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) to the payment gateway to validate the stored credential profile.<br>|
|type|string|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|action|Activate|
|action|Persist|
|consentAgreementSrc|External|
|status|Agreed|
|status|Active|
|type|Recurring|
|type|Unscheduled|

Information about an order action of type `CreateSubscription`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceSeparately|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the subscription appears on a separate invoice when Zuora generates invoices.<br>|
|newSubscriptionOwnerAccount|object|false|none|Information about a new account that will own the subscription. Only available if you have enabled the Owner Transfer feature.<br><br>**Note:** The Owner Transfer feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>If you do not set this field or the `subscriptionOwnerAccountNumber` field, the account that owns the order will also own the subscription. Zuora will return an error if you set this field and the `subscriptionOwnerAccountNumber` field.<br>|
|notes|string|false|none|Notes about the subscription. These notes are only visible to Zuora users.<br>|
|subscribeToRatePlans|[[RatePlanOverride](#schemarateplanoverride)]|false|none|List of rate plans associated with the subscription.<br>|
|subscriptionNumber|string|false|none|Subscription number of the subscription. For example, A-S00000001.<br><br>If you do not set this field, Zuora will generate the subscription number.<br>|
|subscriptionOwnerAccountNumber|string|false|none|Account number of an existing account that will own the subscription. For example, A00000001.<br><br>If you do not set this field or the `newSubscriptionOwnerAccount` field, the account that owns the order will also own the subscription. Zuora will return an error if you set this field and the `newSubscriptionOwnerAccount` field.<br>|
|terms|object|false|none|Container for the terms and renewal settings of the subscription.<br>|

A data query job.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|createdBy|string(uuid)|false|none|The query job creator's Id.<br>|
|id|string(uuid)|false|none|Internal identifier of the query job.<br>|
|query|string|false|none|The query that was submitted.<br>|
|remainingRetries|integer|false|none|The number of times that Zuora will retry the query if Zuora is unable to perform the query.<br>|
|updatedOn|string(date-time)|false|none|Date and time when the query job was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.<br>|
|dataFile|string(URL)|false|none|The URL of the query results. Only applicable if the value of the `queryStatus` field is `completed`.<br>|
|outputRows|integer|false|none|The number of rows the query results. Only applicable if the value of the `queryStatus` field is `completed`.<br>|
|processingTime|integer|false|none|Processing time of the query job, in milliseconds. Only applicable if the value of the `queryStatus` field is `completed`.<br>|
|queryStatus|string|false|none|Status of the query job.<br><br>* `submitted` - query submitted to query service for processing<br>* `accepted` - query accepted by the query service<br>* `in_progress` - query executed by the query service<br>* `completed` - query execution completed by the query service<br>* `failed` - query unable to be processed by the query service<br>* `cancelled` - query cancelled by the user<br><br>If the value of this field is `completed`, the `dataFile` field contains the location of the query results.<br><br>If the value of this field is `accepted` or `in_progress`, you can use [Cancel a data query job](#operation/DELETE_DataQueryJob) to prevent Zuora from performing the query. Zuora then sets the status of the query job to `cancelled`.<br>|

|queryStatus|accepted|
|queryStatus|in_progress|

<h2 id="tocS_DebitMemoCollectRequest">DebitMemoCollectRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadebitmemocollectrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_DebitMemoCollectRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSdebitmemocollectrequest"></a>
<a id="tocsdebitmemocollectrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "applicationOrder": [
    "CreditMemo",
    "UnappliedPayment"
  ],
  "applyCredit": true,
  "collect": true,
  "payment": {
    "gatewayId": "2c98902f6f1de6d1016f1ded559f3b9d",
    "paymentMethodId": "2c98902f6f1de6d1016f1dedba313ba2"
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|applicationOrder|[string]|false|none|The priority order to apply credit memos and/or unapplied payments to the debit memo. Possible item values are: `CreditMemo`, `UnappliedPayment`.<br><br>**Note:**<br>  - This field is valid only if the `applyCredit` field is set to `true`.<br>  - If no value is specified for this field, the default priority order is used, ["CreditMemo", "UnappliedPayment"], to apply credit memos first and then apply unapplied payments.<br>  - If only one item is specified, only the items of the spedified type are applied to invoices. For example, if the value is `["CreditMemo"]`, only credit memos are used to apply the debit memo.<br>|
|applyCredit|boolean|false|none|Whether to automatically apply credit memos or unapplied payments, or both to the debit memo.<br>If the value is `true`, the credit memo or unapplied payment, or both will be automatically applied to the debit memo. If no value is specified or the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br>|
|collect|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the current request needs to collect payment or not.<br>|
|payment|object|false|none|Some detail info that would be used to processed an electronic payment.<br>The info would only effect when `collect` set to `true`.<br>|

|endDateCondition|string|false|none|Condition for the charge to become inactive.<br><br>If the value of this field is `Fixed_Period`, the charge is active for a predefined duration based on the value of the `upToPeriodsType` and `upToPeriods` fields.<br><br>If the value of this field is `Specific_End_Date`, use the `specificEndDate` field to specify the date when then charge becomes inactive.<br>|
|specificEndDate|string(date)|false|none|Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Only applicable if the value of the `endDateCondition` field is `Specific_End_Date`.<br>|
|upToPeriods|integer|false|none|Duration of the charge in billing periods, days, weeks, months, or years, depending on the value of the `upToPeriodsType` field. Only applicable if the value of the `endDateCondition` field is `Fixed_Period`.<br>|
|upToPeriodsType|string|false|none|Unit of time that the charge duration is measured in. Only applicable if the value of the `endDateCondition` field is `Fixed_Period`.<br>|

|---|---|

|upToPeriodsType|Weeks|
|upToPeriodsType|Months|
|upToPeriodsType|Years|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string|false|none|The ID of the customer account that the payment is for.<br>|
|amount|number(double)|false|none|The total amount of the payment.<br>|
|appliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The applied amount of the payment.<br>|
|authTransactionId|string|false|none|The authorization transaction ID from the payment gateway.<br>|
|bankIdentificationNumber|string|false|none|The first six digits of the credit card or debit card used for the payment, when applicable.<br>|
|cancelledOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was cancelled, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|comment|string|false|none|Comments about the payment.<br>|
|createdById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who created the payment.<br>|
|createdDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was created, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2017-03-01 15:31:10.<br>|
|creditBalanceAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount that the payment transfers to the credit balance. The value is not `0` only for those payments that come from legacy payment operations performed without the Invoice Settlement feature.<br>|
|currency|string|false|none|When Standalone Payment is not enabled, the `currency` of the payment must be the same as the payment currency defined in the customer account settings through Zuora UI.<br><br>When Standalone Payment is enabled and `standalone` is `true`, the `currency` of the standalone payment can be different from the payment currency defined in the customer account settings. The amount will not be summed up to the account balance or key metrics regardless of currency.<br>|
|effectiveDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment takes effect, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|financeInformation|object|false|none|Container for the finance information related to the payment.<br>|
|gatewayId|string|false|none|The ID of the gateway instance that processes the payment.<br>|
|gatewayOrderId|string|false|none|A merchant-specified natural key value that can be passed to the electronic payment gateway when a payment is created.  If not specified, the payment number will be passed in instead.<br>|
|gatewayReconciliationReason|string|false|none|The reason of gateway reconciliation.<br>|
|gatewayReconciliationStatus|string|false|none|The status of gateway reconciliation.<br>|
|gatewayResponse|string|false|none|The message returned from the payment gateway for the payment. This message is gateway-dependent.<br>|
|gatewayResponseCode|string|false|none|The code returned from the payment gateway for the payment. This code is gateway-dependent.<br>|
|gatewayState|string|false|none|The status of the payment in the gateway; use for reconciliation.<br>|
|id|string|false|none|The unique ID of the created payment. For example, 4028905f5a87c0ff015a87eb6b75007f.<br>|
|markedForSubmissionOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when a payment was marked and waiting for batch submission to the payment process, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|number|string|false|none|The unique identification number of the payment. For example, P-00000001.<br>|
|paymentMethodId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment method that the customer used to make the payment.<br>|
|paymentMethodSnapshotId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment method snapshot which is a copy of the particular Payment Method used in a transaction.<br>|
|payoutId|string|false|none|The payout ID of the payment from the gateway side.<br>|
|referenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|refundAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of the payment that is refunded.<br>|
|secondPaymentReferenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway if there is an additional transaction for the payment. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|settledOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was settled in the payment processor, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. This field is used by the Spectrum gateway only and not applicable to other gateways.<br>|
|softDescriptor|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.<br>|
|softDescriptorPhone|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.<br>|
|standalone|boolean|false|none|This field is only available if the support for standalone payment is enabled. This field is not available for transferring, applying, or unapplying a payment.<br><br>The value `true` indicates this is a standalone payment that is created and processed in Zuora through Zuora gateway integration but will be settled outside of Zuora. No settlement data will be created. The standalone payment cannot be applied, unapplied, or transferred.<br><br>The value `false` indicates this is an ordinary payment that is created, processed, and settled in Zuora.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the payment.<br>|
|submittedOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was submitted, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|success|boolean|false|none|Returns `true` if the request was processed successfully.|
|type|string|false|none|The type of the payment.<br>|
|unappliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The unapplied amount of the payment.<br>|
|updatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who last updated the payment.<br>|
|updatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was last updated, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2017-03-02 15:36:10.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the payment's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Origin__NS|string|false|none|Origin of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the payment was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Transaction__NS|string|false|none|Related transaction in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Payment object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string|false|none|The ID of the customer account that the payment is for.<br>|
|amount|number(double)|false|none|The total amount of the payment.<br>|
|appliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The applied amount of the payment.<br>|
|authTransactionId|string|false|none|The authorization transaction ID from the payment gateway.<br>|
|bankIdentificationNumber|string|false|none|The first six digits of the credit card or debit card used for the payment, when applicable.<br>|
|cancelledOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was cancelled, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|comment|string|false|none|Comments about the payment.<br>|
|createdById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who created the payment part.<br>|
|createdDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was created, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2017-03-01 15:31:10.<br>|
|creditBalanceAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount that the payment transfers to the credit balance. The value is not `0` only for those payments that come from legacy payment operations performed without the Invoice Settlement feature.<br>|
|currency|string|false|none|When Standalone Payment is not enabled, the `currency` of the payment must be the same as the payment currency defined in the customer account settings through Zuora UI.<br><br>When Standalone Payment is enabled and `standalone` is `true`, the `currency` of the standalone payment can be different from the payment currency defined in the customer account settings. The amount will not be summed up to the account balance or key metrics regardless of currency.<br>|
|effectiveDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment takes effect, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|financeInformation|object|false|none|Container for the finance information related to the payment.<br>|
|gatewayId|string|false|none|The ID of the gateway instance that processes the payment.<br>|
|gatewayOrderId|string|false|none|A merchant-specified natural key value that can be passed to the electronic payment gateway when a payment is created.<br>|
|gatewayReconciliationReason|string|false|none|The reason of gateway reconciliation.<br>|
|gatewayReconciliationStatus|string|false|none|The status of gateway reconciliation.<br>|
|gatewayResponse|string|false|none|The message returned from the payment gateway for the payment. This message is gateway-dependent.<br>|
|gatewayResponseCode|string|false|none|The code returned from the payment gateway for the payment. This code is gateway-dependent.<br>|
|gatewayState|string|false|none|The status of the payment in the gateway; use for reconciliation. <br>|
|id|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment. For example, 4028905f5a87c0ff015a87eb6b75007f.<br>|
|markedForSubmissionOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when a payment was marked and waiting for batch submission to the payment process, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|number|string|false|none|The unique identification number of the payment. For example, P-00000001.<br>|
|paymentMethodId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment method that the customer used to make the payment.<br>|
|paymentMethodSnapshotId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment method snapshot which is a copy of the particular Payment Method used in a transaction.<br>|
|payoutId|string|false|none|The payout ID of the payment from the gateway side.<br>|
|referenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|refundAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of the payment that is refunded.<br>|
|secondPaymentReferenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway if there is an additional transaction for the payment. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|settledOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was settled in the payment processor, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. This field is used by the Spectrum gateway only and not applicable to other gateways.<br>|
|softDescriptor|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.<br>|
|softDescriptorPhone|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.<br>|
|standalone|boolean|false|none|This field is only available if the support for standalone payment is enabled.<br><br>The value `true` indicates this is a standalone payment that is created and processed in Zuora through Zuora gateway integration but will be settled outside of Zuora. No settlement data will be created. The standalone payment cannot be applied, unapplied, or transferred.<br><br>The value `false` indicates this is an ordinary payment that is created, processed, and settled in Zuora.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the payment.<br>|
|submittedOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was submitted, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|type|string|false|none|The type of the payment.<br>|
|unappliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The unapplied amount of the payment.<br>|
|updatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who last updated the payment.<br>|
|updatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was last updated, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2017-03-02 15:36:10.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the payment's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Origin__NS|string|false|none|Origin of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the payment was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Transaction__NS|string|false|none|Related transaction in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Payment object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of the credit memo item. For tax-inclusive credit memo items, the amount indicates the credit memo item amount including tax. For tax-exclusive credit memo items, the amount indicates the credit memo item amount excluding tax.<br>|

|appliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The applied amount of the credit memo item.<br>|
|appliedToItemId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the credit memo item that the discount charge is applied to.<br>|
|comment|string|false|none|Comments about the credit memo item.<br><br>**Note**: This field is not available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `257.0` or later.<br>|
|createdById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who created the credit memo item.<br>|
|createdDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the credit memo item was created, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2017-03-01 15:31:10.<br>|

|creditFromItemSource|string|false|none|The type of the credit from item.<br>|

|financeInformation|object|false|none|Container for the finance information related to the credit memo item.<br>|
|id|string|false|none|The ID of the credit memo item.<br>|
|processingType|string|false|none|The kind of the charge for the credit memo item. Its possible values are `Charge` and `Discount`. <br>|
|quantity|number(double)|false|none|The number of units for the credit memo item.<br>|
|refundAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of the refund on the credit memo item.<br>|
|serviceEndDate|string(date)|false|none|The service end date of the credit memo item.<br>|
|serviceStartDate|string(date)|false|none|The service start date of the credit memo item. If the associated charge is a one-time fee, this date is the date of that charge.<br>|
|sku|string|false|none|The SKU for the product associated with the credit memo item.<br>|
|skuName|string|false|none|The name of the SKU.<br>|
|sourceItemId|string|false|none|The ID of the source item.<br><br>- If the value of the `sourceItemType` field is `SubscriptionComponent` , the value of this field is the ID of the corresponding rate plan charge.<br>- If the value of the `sourceItemType` field is `InvoiceDetail`, the value of this field is the ID of the corresponding invoice item.<br>- If the value of the `sourceItemType` field is `ProductRatePlanCharge` , the value of this field is the ID of the corresponding product rate plan charge.<br>|
|sourceItemType|string|false|none|The type of the source item.<br><br>- If a credit memo is not created from an invoice or a product rate plan charge, the value of this field is `SubscriptionComponent`. <br>- If a credit memo is created from an invoice, the value of this field is `InvoiceDetail`.<br>- If a credit memo is created from a product rate plan charge, the value of this field is `ProductRatePlanCharge`.<br>|
|subscriptionId|string|false|none|The ID of the subscription associated with the credit memo item.<br>|
|success|boolean|false|none|Returns `true` if the request was processed successfully.|
|taxMode|string|false|none|The tax mode of the credit memo item, indicating whether the amount of the credit memo item includes tax.<br>|
|taxationItems|object|false|none|Container for the taxation items of the credit memo item. <br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `239.0` or later.<br>|
|unappliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The unapplied amount of the credit memo item.<br>|
|unitOfMeasure|string|false|none|The units to measure usage.<br>|
|unitPrice|number(double)|false|none|The per-unit price of the credit memo item.<br>|
|updatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who last updated the credit memo item.<br>|
|updatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the credit memo item was last updated, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2017-03-02 15:36:10.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string|false|none|The ID of the customer account associated with the credit memo.<br>|
|amount|number(double)|false|none|The total amount of the credit memo.<br>|
|appliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The applied amount of the credit memo.<br>|
|autoApplyUponPosting|boolean|false|none|Whether the credit memo automatically applies to the invoice upon posting.<br>|
|cancelledById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who cancelled the credit memo.<br>|
|cancelledOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the credit memo was cancelled, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|comment|string|false|none|Comments about the credit memo.<br>|
|createdById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who created the credit memo.<br>|
|createdDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the credit memo was created, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2017-03-01 15:31:10.<br>|
|creditMemoDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the credit memo takes effect, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. For example, 2017-05-20.<br>|
|currency|string|false|none|A currency defined in the web-based UI administrative settings.<br>|
|excludeFromAutoApplyRules|boolean|false|none|Whether the credit memo is excluded from the rule of automatically applying credit memos to invoices.<br>|
|id|string|false|none|The unique ID of the credit memo.<br>|
|latestPDFFileId|string|false|none|The ID of the latest PDF file generated for the credit memo.<br>|
|number|string|false|none|The unique identification number of the credit memo.<br>|
|postedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who posted the credit memo.<br>|
|postedOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the credit memo was posted, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|reasonCode|string|false|none|A code identifying the reason for the transaction. The value must be an existing reason code or empty.<br>|
|referredInvoiceId|string|false|none|The ID of a referred invoice.<br>|
|refundAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of the refund on the credit memo.<br>|
|source|string|false|none|The source of the credit memo.<br><br>Possible values:<br>- `BillRun`: The credit memo is generated by a bill run.<br>- `API`: The credit memo is created by calling the [Invoice and collect](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_TransactionInvoicePayment) operation.<br>- `ApiSubscribe`: The credit memo is created by calling the [Create subscription](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_Subscription) and [Create account](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_Account) operation.<br>- `ApiAmend`: The credit memo is created by calling the [Update subscription](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/PUT_Subscription) operation.<br>- `AdhocFromPrpc`: The credit memo is created from a product rate plan charge through the Zuora UI or by calling the [Create credit memo from charge](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CreditMemoFromPrpc) operation.<br>- `AdhocFromInvoice`: The credit memo is created from an invoice or created by reversing an invoice. You can create a credit memo from an invoice through the Zuora UI or by calling the [Create a credit memo from an invoice](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_CreditMemoFromInvoice) operation. You can create a credit memo by reversing an invoice through the Zuora UI or by calling the [Reverse an invoice](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/PUT_ReverseInvoice) operation.<br>|
|sourceId|string|false|none|The ID of the credit memo source.<br><br>If a credit memo is generated from a bill run, the value is the number of the corresponding bill run. Otherwise, the value is `null`.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the credit memo.<br>|
|success|boolean|false|none|Returns `true` if the request was processed successfully.|
|targetDate|string(date)|false|none|The target date for the credit memo, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. For example, 2017-07-20.<br>|
|taxAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of taxation.<br>|
|taxMessage|string|false|none|The message about the status of tax calculation related to the credit memo. If tax calculation fails in one credit memo, this field displays the reason for the failure.<br>|
|taxStatus|string|false|none|The status of tax calculation related to the credit memo.<br><br>**Note**: This field is only applicable to tax calculation by third-party tax engines.<br>|
|totalTaxExemptAmount|number(double)|false|none|The total amount of taxes or VAT for which the customer has an exemption.<br>|
|transferredToAccounting|string|false|none|Whether the credit memo was transferred to an external accounting system. Use this field for integration with accounting systems, such as NetSuite. <br>|
|unappliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The unapplied amount of the credit memo.<br>|
|updatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who last updated the credit memo.<br>|
|updatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the credit memo was last updated, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2017-03-01 15:36:10.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the credit memo's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Origin__NS|string|false|none|Origin of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the credit memo was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Transaction__NS|string|false|none|Related transaction in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Credit Memo object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

|totalCount|string|false|none|Total number of records in the uploaded mass action file.<br>When the mass action **status** is Pending, this field is null.<br>|

|billingTiming|string|false|none|The billing timing for the charge. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com). <br>|
|chargeModelConfigurations|object|false|none|This field is for Zuora Internal Use only. See the **pricing** field for the same information as this field.|

|description|string|false|none|Usually a brief line item summary of the Rate Plan Charge.<br>|
|discountClass|string|false|none|The class that the discount belongs to. |financeInformation|object|false|none|Container for finance information of a rate plan charge.<br>|

The charge model is available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. The charge model is available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.)<br>- `PreratedPricing` (available only if you have the Pre-rated Pricing charge model enabled. |pricing|[[GETProductRatePlanChargePricingType](#schemagetproductrateplanchargepricingtype)]|false|none|One or more price charge models with attributes that further describe the model. <br>Some attributes show as null values when not applicable.<br>|
|pricingSummary|[string]|false|none|A concise description of the charge model and pricing that is suitable to show to your customers. When the rate plan charge model is `Tiered` and multi-currency is enabled, this field includes an array of string of each currency, and each string of currency includes tier price description separated by comma.<br><br>For the following charge models, the value of this field is an empty string:<br>- Multi-Attribute Pricing<br>- High Water Mark Tiered Pricing<br>- High Water Mark Volume Pricing<br>- Pre-Rated Per Unit Pricing<br>- Pre-Rated Pricing<br><br>The charge models are available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.<br>|
|productDiscountApplyDetails|[[GETProductDiscountApplyDetailsType](#schemagetproductdiscountapplydetailstype)]|false|none|Container for the application details about a discount product rate plan charge. <br><br>Only discount product rate plan charges have values in this field.<br>|
|ratingGroup|string|false|none|Specifies a rating group based on which usage records are rated.<br><br>Possible values:<br><br>- `ByBillingPeriod` (default): The rating is based on all the usages in a billing period.<br>- `ByUsageStartDate`: The rating is based on all the usages on the same usage start date. <br>- `ByUsageRecord`: The rating is based on each usage record.<br>- `ByUsageUpload`: The rating is based on all the  usages in a uploaded usage file (`.xls` or `.csv`).<br>- `ByGroupId`: The rating is based on all the usages in a custom group.<br><br>**Note:** <br>- The `ByBillingPeriod` value can be applied for all charge models. <br>- The `ByUsageStartDate`, `ByUsageRecord`, and `ByUsageUpload` values can only be applied for per unit, volume pricing, and tiered pricing charge models. <br>- The `ByGroupId` value is only available if you have the Active Rating feature enabled.<br>- Use this field only for Usage charges. One-Time Charges and Recurring Charges return `NULL`.<br>|
|revRecCode|string|false|none|Associates this product rate plan charge with a specific revenue recognition code. The value is a valid revenue recognition code.<br>|
|revRecTriggerCondition|string|false|none|Specifies when revenue recognition begins.<br>|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|string|false|none|The name of the revenue recognition rule governing the revenue schedule.<br>|
|smoothingModel|string|false|none|Specifies the smoothing model for an overage smoothing charge model or an tiered with overage model, which is an advanced type of a usage model that avoids spikes in usage charges. If a customer's usage spikes in a single period, then an overage smoothing model eases overage charges by considering usage and multiple periods.<br><br>One of the following values shows which smoothing model will be applied to the charge when `Overage` or `Tiered with Overage` is used:<br><br>- `RollingWindow` considers a number of periods to smooth usage. The rolling window starts and increments forward based on billing frequency. When allowed usage is met, then period resets and a new window begins.<br>- `Rollover` considers a fixed number of periods before calculating usage. The net balance at the end of a period is unused usage, which is carried over to the next period's balance.<br>|
|specificBillingPeriod|integer(int64)|false|none|When the billing period is set to `Specific` Months then this positive integer reflects the number of months for billing period charges.<br>|
|taxCode|string|false|none|Specifies the tax code for taxation rules; used by Zuora Tax.<br>|
|taxMode|string|false|none|Specifies how to define taxation for the charge; used by Zuora Tax. Possible values are: `TaxExclusive`, `TaxInclusive`.<br>|
|taxable|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the charge is taxable; used by Zuora Tax. Possible values are:`true`, `false`.<br>|
|triggerEvent|string|false|none|Specifies when to start billing the customer for the charge.<br><br>Values: one of the following:<br>- `ContractEffective` is the date when the subscription's contract goes into effect and the charge is ready to be billed.<br>- `ServiceActivation` is the date when the services or products for a subscription have been activated and the customers have access.<br>- `CustomerAcceptance` is when the customer accepts the services or products for a subscription. <br>- `SpecificDate` is the date specified.<br>|
|type|string|false|none|The type of charge. Possible values are: `OneTime`, `Recurring`, `Usage`.<br>|
|uom|string|false|none|Describes the Units of Measure (uom) configured in **Settings > Billing** for the productRatePlanCharges.<br><br>Values: `Each`, `License`, `Seat`, or `null`<br>|
|upToPeriods|integer(int64)|false|none|Specifies the length of the period during which the charge is active. If this period ends before the subscription ends, the charge ends when this period ends.<br>If the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge end date will change accordingly up to the original period end.<br>|
|upToPeriodsType|string|false|none|The period type used to define when the charge ends.<br><br>Values:<br>- Billing_Periods<br>- Days<br>- Weeks<br>- Months<br>- Years<br>  <br>|
|usageRecordRatingOption|string|false|none|Determines how Zuora processes usage records for per-unit usage charges. <br>|
|useDiscountSpecificAccountingCode|boolean|false|none|Determines whether to define a new accounting code for the new discount charge.<br>Values: `true`, `false`<br>|
|useTenantDefaultForPriceChange|boolean|false|none|Shows the tenant-level percentage uplift value for an automatic price change to a termed subscription's renewal. You set the tenant uplift value in the web-based UI: **Settings > Billing > Define Default Subscription Settings**.<br><br>Values: `true`, `false`<br>|
|Class__NS|string|false|none|Class associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|DeferredRevAccount__NS|string|false|none|Deferrred revenue account associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Department__NS|string|false|none|Department associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IncludeChildren__NS|string|false|none|Specifies whether the corresponding item in NetSuite is visible under child subsidiaries. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the product rate plan charge's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|ItemType__NS|string|false|none|Type of item that is created in NetSuite for the product rate plan charge. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Location__NS|string|false|none|Location associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|RecognizedRevAccount__NS|string|false|none|Recognized revenue account associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|RevRecEnd__NS|string|false|none|End date condition of the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|RevRecStart__NS|string|false|none|Start date condition of the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|RevRecTemplateType__NS|string|false|none|Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Subsidiary__NS|string|false|none|Subsidiary associated with the corresponding item in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the product rate plan charge was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Product Rate Plan Charge object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|category|string|false|none|Category of the product. Used by Zuora Quotes Guided Product Selector.<br><br>Possible values are:<br>  - Base Products<br>  - Add On Services<br>  - Miscellaneous Products<br>|
|description|string|false|none|Optional product description.<br>|
|effectiveEndDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the product expires and cannot be subscribed to anymore, as `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br>|
|effectiveStartDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the product becomes available and can be subscribed to, as `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br>|
|id|string|false|none|Product ID.<br>|
|name|string|false|none|Product name, up to 100 characters.<br>|
|productFeatures|[[GetProductFeatureType](#schemagetproductfeaturetype)]|false|none|Container for one or more product features. Only available when the following settings are enabled:<br>- The Entitlements feature in your tenant<br>- The Enable Feature Specification in Product and Subscriptions setting in Settings > Billing<br>|
|productRatePlans|string(URL)|false|none|URL to retrieve information about all product rate plans of a specific product. For example, `/v1/rateplan/40289f466463d683016463ef8b7301a0/productRatePlan`. If you want to view the product rate plan details, call [List all product rate plans of a product](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/GET_ProductRatePlans) with the returned URL.<br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. If you set the `zuora-version` request header to `230.0` or later, the value of this field is a URL. Zuora recommends that you use the latest behavior to retrieve product information.<br><br>If you do not set the `zuora-version` request header or you set this header to `229.0` or earlier, the value of this field is an array of product rate plan details. For more information about the array, see the response body of [List all product rate plans of a product](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/GET_ProductRatePlans). **Note**: The array contains a maximum of 300 product rate plans. Additionally, across all product rate plans, at most 300 product rate plan charges are returned.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string|false|none|The ID of the account associated with this refund. Zuora associates the refund automatically with the account from the associated payment.<br>|
|amount|number(double)|false|none|The total amount of the refund.<br>|
|cancelledOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the refund was cancelled, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|comment|string|false|none|Comments about the refund.<br>|
|createdById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who created the refund.<br>|
|createdDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the refund was created, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2017-03-06 15:31:10.<br>|
|creditMemoId|string|false|none|The ID of the credit memo that is refunded.<br>|
|financeInformation|object|false|none|Container for the finance information related to the refund.<br>|
|gatewayId|string|false|none|The ID of the gateway instance that processes the refund.<br>|
|gatewayResponse|string|false|none|The message returned from the payment gateway for the refund. This message is gateway-dependent.<br>|
|gatewayResponseCode|string|false|none|The response code returned from the payment gateway for the refund. This code is gateway-dependent.<br>|
|gatewayState|string|false|none|The status of the refund in the gateway.<br>|
|id|string|false|none|The ID of the created refund.<br>|
|markedForSubmissionOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when a refund was marked and waiting for batch submission to the payment process, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|methodType|string|false|none|How an external refund was issued to a customer.<br>|
|number|string|false|none|The unique identification number of the refund.<br>|
|paymentId|string|false|none|The ID of the payment associated with the refund.<br>|
|paymentMethodId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment method that the customer used to make the refund.<br>|
|paymentMethodSnapshotId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment method snapshot, which is a copy of the particular payment method used in a transaction.<br>|
|reasonCode|string|false|none|A code identifying the reason for the transaction.<br>|
|referenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway for an electronic refund. Use this field to reconcile refunds between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|refundDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the refund takes effect, in yyyy-mm-dd format.<br>|
|refundTransactionTime|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the refund was issued, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|secondRefundReferenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway if there is an additional transaction for the refund. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|settledOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the refund was settled in the payment processor, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. This field is used by the Spectrum gateway only and not applicable to other gateways.<br>|
|softDescriptor|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.<br>|
|softDescriptorPhone|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the refund.<br>|
|submittedOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the refund was submitted, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|success|boolean|false|none|Returns `true` if the request was processed successfully.|
|type|string|false|none|The type of the refund.<br>|
|updatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who last updated the refund.<br>|
|updatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the refund was last updated, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2017-03-07 15:36:10.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the refund's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Origin__NS|string|false|none|Origin of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the refund was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SynctoNetSuite__NS|string|false|none|Specifies whether the refund should be synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Refund object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|
