### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|applyDiscountTo|string|false|none|Specifies the type of charges a specific discount applies to. <br><br>This field is only used when applied to a discount charge model. If you are not using a discount charge model, the value is null.<br><br>Possible values:<br><br>* `RECURRING`<br>* `USAGE`<br>* `ONETIMERECURRING`<br>* `ONETIMEUSAGE`<br>* `RECURRINGUSAGE`<br>* `ONETIMERECURRINGUSAGE`<br>|
|billingDay|string|false|none|Billing cycle day (BCD), which is when bill runs generate invoices<br>for charges associated with the product rate plan charge or the account.  <br><br>Values:<br><br>* `DefaultFromCustomer`<br>* `SpecificDayofMonth(#)`<br>* `SubscriptionStartDay`<br>* `ChargeTriggerDay`<br>* `SpecificDayofWeek/dayofweek`: in which dayofweek is the day in the week you define your billing periods to start.<br><br>In the response data, a day-of-the-month value (`1`-`31`) appears in place of the hash sign above ("#"). If this value exceeds the number of days in a particular month, the last day of the month is used as the BCD.<br>|
|billingPeriod|string|false|none|Allows billing period to be overridden on the rate plan charge.<br>|
|billingPeriodAlignment|string|false|none|Possible values:<br><br>* `AlignToCharge`<br>* `AlignToSubscriptionStart`<br>* `AlignToTermStart`<br>|
|billingTiming|string|false|none|The billing timing for the charge. This field is only used if the `ratePlanChargeType` value is `Recurring`.<br><br>Possible values are:<br><br>* `In Advance`<br>* `In Arrears`<br><br>**Note:** This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br>|
|chargeModelConfiguration|[ChargeModelConfigurationType](#schemachargemodelconfigurationtype)|false|none|Container for charge model configuration data.<br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you have the High Water Mark, Pre-Rated Pricing, or Multi-Attribute Pricing charge models enabled. These charge models are available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.<br>|
|chargedThroughDate|string(date)|false|none|The date through which a customer has been billed for the charge.<br>|
|currency|string|false|none|Currency used by the account. For example, `USD` or `EUR`.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the rate plan charge.<br>|
|discountAmount|number|false|none|The amount of the discount.<br>|
|discountApplyDetails|[[GETDiscountApplyDetailsType](#schemagetdiscountapplydetailstype)]|false|none|Container for the application details about a discount rate plan charge. <br><br>Only discount rate plan charges have values in this field.<br>|
|discountClass|string|false|none|The class that the discount belongs to. The discount class defines the order in which discount rate plan charges are applied.<br><br>For more information, see [Manage Discount Classes](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Product_Catalog/B_Charge_Models/Manage_Discount_Classes).<br>|
|discountLevel|string|false|none|The level of the discount. Values: `RatePlan`, `Subscription`, `Account`.<br>|
|discountPercentage|number|false|none|The amount of the discount as a percentage.<br>|
|dmrc|number|false|none|The change (delta) of monthly recurring charge exists when the change in monthly recurring revenue caused by an amendment or a new subscription.<br>|
|done|boolean|false|none|A value of `true` indicates that an invoice for a charge segment has been completed. A value of `false` indicates that an invoice has not been completed for the charge segment.<br>|
|dtcv|number|false|none|After an amendment or an AutomatedPriceChange event, `dtcv` displays the change (delta) for the total contract value (TCV) amount for this charge, compared with its previous value with recurring charge types.<br>|
|effectiveEndDate|string(date)|false|none|The effective end date of the rate plan charge.<br>|
|effectiveStartDate|string(date)|false|none|The effective start date of the rate plan charge.<br>|
|endDateCondition|string|false|none|Defines when the charge ends after the charge trigger date.<br><br>If the subscription ends before the charge end date, the charge ends when the subscription ends. But if the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge will end on the charge end date.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `Subscription_End`<br>* `Fixed_Period`<br>* `Specific_End_Date`<br>|
|id|string|false|none|Rate plan charge ID.<br>|
|includedUnits|number|false|none|Specifies the number of units in the base set of units.<br>|
|listPriceBase|string|false|none|List price base; possible values are:<br><br>* `Per_Billing_Period`<br>* `Per_Month`<br>* `Per_Week`<br>|
|model|string|false|none|Charge model; possible values are:<br><br>* `FlatFee`<br>* `PerUnit`<br>* `Overage`<br>* `Volume`<br>* `Tiered`<br>* `TieredWithOverage`<br>* `DiscountFixedAmount`<br>* `DiscountPercentage`<br>* `MultiAttributePricing`<br>* `PreratedPerUnit`<br>* `PreratedPricing`<br>* `HighWatermarkVolumePricing`<br>* `HighWatermarkTieredPricing`<br>|
|mrr|number|false|none|Monthly recurring revenue of the rate plan charge.<br>|
|name|string|false|none|Charge name.<br>|
|number|string|false|none|Charge number.<br>|
|numberOfPeriods|integer(int64)|false|none|Specifies the number of periods to use when calculating charges in an overage smoothing charge model.<br>|
|originalChargeId|string|false|none|The original ID of the rate plan charge.<br>|
|overageCalculationOption|string|false|none|Determines when to calculate overage charges.<br>|
|overagePrice|number|false|none|The price for units over the allowed amount.<br>|
|overageUnusedUnitsCreditOption|string|false|none|Determines whether to credit the customer with unused units of usage.<br>|
|price|number|false|none|The price associated with the rate plan charge expressed as a decimal.<br>|
|priceChangeOption|string|false|none|When the following is true:<br><br>1. AutomatedPriceChange setting is on<br><br>2. Charge type is not one-time<br><br>3. Charge model is not discount percentage<br><br>Then an automatic price change can have a value for when a termed subscription is renewed. <br><br>Values (one of the following):<br><br>* `NoChange` (default)<br>* `SpecificPercentageValue`<br>* `UseLatestProductCatalogPricing`<br>|
|priceIncreasePercentage|number|false|none|A planned future price increase amount as a percentage.<br>|
|pricingSummary|string|false|none|Concise description of rate plan charge model.<br>|
|processedThroughDate|string(date)|false|none|The date until when charges have been processed. When billing in arrears, such as usage, this field value is the the same as the `ChargedThroughDate` value. This date is the earliest date when a charge can be amended.<br>|
|productRatePlanChargeId|string|false|none|none|
|quantity|number|false|none|The quantity of units, such as the number of authors in a hosted wiki service. Valid for all charge models except for Flat Fee pricing.<br>|
|ratingGroup|string|false|none|Specifies a rating group based on which usage records are rated.<br><br>Possible values:<br><br>- `ByBillingPeriod` (default): The rating is based on all the usages in a billing period.<br>- `ByUsageStartDate`: The rating is based on all the usages on the same usage start date. <br>- `ByUsageRecord`: The rating is based on each usage record.<br>- `ByUsageUpload`: The rating is based on all the  usages in a uploaded usage file (`.xls` or `.csv`).<br>- `ByGroupId`: The rating is based on all the usages in a custom group.<br><br>**Note:** <br>- The `ByBillingPeriod` value can be applied for all charge models. <br>- The `ByUsageStartDate`, `ByUsageRecord`, and `ByUsageUpload` values can only be applied for per unit, volume pricing, and tiered pricing charge models. <br>- The `ByGroupId` value is only available if you have the Active Rating feature enabled.<br>- Use this field only for Usage charges. One-Time Charges and Recurring Charges return `NULL`.<br>|
|segment|integer(int64)|false|none|The identifying number of the subscription rate plan segment. Segments are numbered sequentially, starting with 1.<br>|
|smoothingModel|string|false|none|Specifies when revenue recognition begins. When charge model is `Overage` or `TieredWithOverage`, `smoothingModel` will be one of the following values:<br><br>* `ContractEffectiveDate`<br>* `ServiceActivationDate`<br>* `CustomerAcceptanceDate`<br>|
|specificBillingPeriod|integer(int64)|false|none|Customizes the number of month or week for the charges billing period. This field is required if you set the value of the `BillingPeriod` field to `Specific_Months` or `Specific_Weeks`.<br>|
|specificEndDate|string(date)|false|none|The specific date on which the charge ends. If the subscription ends before the specific end date, the charge ends when the subscription ends. But if the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge will end on the specific end date.<br>|
|tcv|number|false|none|The total contract value.<br>|
|tiers|[[GETTierType](#schemagettiertype)]|false|none|One or many defined ranges with distinct pricing.<br>|
|triggerDate|string(date)|false|none|The date that the rate plan charge will be triggered.<br>|
|triggerEvent|string|false|none|The event that will cause the rate plan charge to be triggered.<br><br>Possible values: <br><br>* `ContractEffective`<br>* `ServiceActivation`<br>* `CustomerAcceptance`<br>* `SpecificDate`<br>|
|type|string|false|none|Charge type. Possible values are: `OneTime`, `Recurring`, `Usage`.<br>|
|unusedUnitsCreditRates|number|false|none|Specifies the rate to credit a customer for unused units of usage. This field is applicable only for overage charge models when the <br>`OverageUnusedUnitsCreditOption` field value is `CreditBySpecificRate`.<br>|
|uom|string|false|none|Specifies the units to measure usage. <br>|
|upToPeriods|string|false|none|Specifies the length of the period during which the charge is active. If this period ends before the subscription ends, the charge ends when this period ends.<br><br>If the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge end date will change accordingly up to the original period end.<br>|
|upToPeriodsType|string|false|none|The period type used to define when the charge ends. <br><br>Values:<br><br>* `Billing_Periods`<br>* `Days`<br>* `Weeks`<br>* `Months`<br>* `Years`<br>|
|usageRecordRatingOption|string|false|none|Determines how Zuora processes usage records for per-unit usage charges. <br>|
|version|integer(int64)|false|none|Rate plan charge revision number.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Rate Plan Charge object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

get billingPreviewRun response

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assumeRenewal|string|false|none|none|
|batch|string|false|none|The customer batch included in the billing preview run. <br>|
|chargeTypeToExclude|string|false|none|The charge types excluded from the forecast run.<br>|
|createdById|string|false|none|The ID of the user who created the billing preview run.<br>|
|createdDate|string(datetime)|false|none|The date and time when the billing preview run was created.<br>|
|endDate|string(datetime)|false|none|The date and time when the billing preview run completes.<br>|
|errorMessage|string|false|none|The error message generated by a failed billing preview run.<br>|
|includingEvergreenSubscription|boolean|false|none|Indicates if evergreen subscriptions are included in the billing preview run.<br>|
|resultFileUrl|string|false|none|The URL of the zipped CSV result file generated by the billing preview run. This file contains the preview invoice item data and credit memo item data for the specified customers.<br><br>**Note:** The credit memo item data is only available if you have Invoice Settlement feature enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|runNumber|string|false|none|The run number of the billing preview run.<br>|
|startDate|string(datetime)|false|none|The date and time when the billing preview run starts.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the >billing preview run.<br><br>**Possible values:** <br><br>* 0: Pending<br>* 1: Processing<br>* 2: Completed<br>* 3: Error<br>* 4: Canceled<br>|
|succeededAccounts|integer|false|none|The number of accounts for which preview invoice item data and credit memo item data was successfully generated during the billing preview run.<br><br>**Note:** The credit memo item data is only available if you have Invoice Settlement feature enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|success|boolean|false|none|Returns `true` if the request was processed successfully.|
|targetDate|string(date)|false|none|The target date for the billing preview run.          <br>|
|totalAccounts|integer(int32)|false|none|The total number of accounts in the billing preview run.<br>|
|updatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the user who last updated the billing preview run.<br>|
|updatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the billing preview run was last updated.<br>|

```json
{
  "extendsTerm": true,
  "resumeDate": "1970-01-01",
  "resumePeriods": 0,
  "resumePeriodsType": "Day",
  "resumePolicy": "Today",
  "resumeSpecificDate": "1970-01-01"
}
```

Information about an order action of type `Resume`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|extendsTerm|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether to extend the subscription term by the length of time the suspension is in effect. Note this field is not applicable in a Resume order action auto-created by the Order Metrics migration.<br>|
|resumeDate|string(date)|false|none|The resume date when the resumption takes effect.<br>|
|resumePeriods|integer|false|none|This field is applicable only when the `resumePolicy` field is set to `FixedPeriodsFromToday` or `FixedPeriodsFromSuspendDate`. It must be used together with the `resumePeriodsType` field. Note this field is not applicable in a Resume order action auto-created by the Order Metrics migration.<br><br>The total number of the periods used to specify when a subscription resumption takes effect. The subscription resumption will take place after the specified time frame (`suspendPeriods` multiplied by `suspendPeriodsType`) from today's date. <br>|
|resumePeriodsType|string|false|none|This field is applicable only when the `resumePolicy` field is set to `FixedPeriodsFromToday` or `FixedPeriodsFromSuspendDate`. It must be used together with the `resumePeriods` field. Note this field is not applicable in a Resume order action auto-created by the Order Metrics migration.<br><br>The period type used to specify when a subscription resumption takes effect. The subscription suspension will take place after the specified time frame (`suspendPeriods` multiplied by `suspendPeriodsType`) from today's date. <br>|
|resumePolicy|string|false|none|Resume methods. Specify a way to resume a subscription. See [Resume Date](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Subscriptions/Resume_a_Subscription#Resume_Date) for more information. Note this field is not applicable in a Resume order action auto-created by the Order Metrics migration.<br><br>If `SuspendDate` is specfied, the resumption will take place on the same day as the suspension. <br>|
|resumeSpecificDate|string(date)|false|none|This field is applicable only when the `resumePolicy` field is set to `SpecificDate`. Note this field is not applicable in a Resume order action auto-created by the Order Metrics migration.<br><br>A specific date when the subscription resumption takes effect, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The value should not be earlier than the subscription suspension date.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|resumePeriodsType|Day|
|resumePeriodsType|Week|
|resumePeriodsType|Month|
|resumePeriodsType|Year|
|resumePolicy|Today|
|resumePolicy|FixedPeriodsFromSuspendDate|
|resumePolicy|FixedPeriodsFromToday|
|resumePolicy|SpecificDate|
|resumePolicy|SuspendDate|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cpuTime|string(time)|false|none|The overall CPU time for the execution of the workflow.<br>|
|createdAt|string(datetime)|false|none|The date and time when the workflow is created, in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format..<br>|
|finishedAt|string(datetime)|false|none|The date and time when the execution of the workflow completes, in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.<br>|

|name|string|false|none|The unique run number of the workflow.<br>|
|originalWorkflowId|string|false|none|The ID of the workflow setup.<br>|
|runTime|number(double)|false|none|The execution time of the workflow including the waiting time, in seconds.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the workflow:<br>  - Queued: The workflow is in queue for being processed.<br>  - Processing: The workflow is in process.<br>  - Stopping: The workflow is being stopped through Zuora UI.<br>  - Stopped: The workflow is stopped through Zuora UI.<br>  - Finished: The workflow is finished. When a workflow is finished, it might have tasks pending for retry or delay. Pending tasks do not block the onfinish branch of the workflow, but they block the oncomplete branch of the iterate. <br>|
|tasks|object|false|none|An object containing task counts.<br>|
|type|string|false|none|The type of the current workflow.<br>Possible values:<br>    - `Workflow::Setup`: The workflow is a setup and is used for creating workflow instances.<br>    - `Workflow::Instance`: The workflow is an execution that has data.<br>|
|updatedAt|string(datetime)|false|none|The date and time when the workflow is updated the last time, in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.<br>|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|status|Processing|
|status|Stopping|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|callout_trigger|boolean|false|none|If true, the workflow will run upon an API callout. This field must be `true` for integrating with the Configurable Payment Retry feature or the Collections Window feature in Collect.<br>|
|createdAt|string(datetime)|false|none|The date and time when the workflow was created, in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format<br>|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the workflow definition<br>|
|id|integer|false|none|The unique ID of the workflow definition<br>|
|interval|string|false|none|The cron expression for workflows with scheduled_trigger as `true`<br>|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the workflow definition<br>|
|ondemand_trigger|boolean|false|none|If true, the workflow will run when manually initiated.<br>|
|priority|string|false|none|Can be `High`, `Medium`, or `Low`. Higher-priority workflows take precedence over lower-priority workflows. When a workflow of higher priority is initiated, it will be placed ahead of lower-priority workflows that are running. Depending on the available resources, lower-priority workflows may be paused until resources are released.<br>|
|scheduled_trigger|boolean|false|none|If true, the workflow will run based on the configured schedule with the interval field.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|Can be `Active` or `Inactive`. Active workfow definitions run like normal. Inactive workflow definitions cannot be run.<br>|
|timezone|string|false|none|The timezone that corresponds with the cron expression in the interval field. See the [list of accepted timezone values](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1skhepi-q5l9LyaMUPZjU_V9gzTphNMqNyV6ST5mygEo/edit?usp=sharing).<br>|
|updatedAt|string(datetime)|false|none|The date and time when the workflow was updated the last time, in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|AdjustmentAmount|number(double)|false|none| The amount of the invoice adjustments associated with the invoice. **Character limi**t: 16<br><br>**Values**: a valid currency amount |
|Amount|number(double)|false|none| The sum of all charges and taxes associated with the invoice.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |

|CreatedById|string|false|none| The user ID of the person who created the invoice. If a bill run generated the invoice, then the value is the user ID of person who created the bill run.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the invoice was generated.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CreditBalanceAdjustmentAmount|number(double)|false|none| The currency amount of the adjustment applied to the customer's credit balance.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br>**Values**: a valid currency amount This field is only available if the [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/) to enable this feature.<br><br><br>|
|DueDate|string(date)|false|none| The date by which the payment for this invoice is due.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29 |
|IncludesOneTime|boolean|false|none| Specifies whether the invoice includes one-time charges.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 5<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated from one of the following: `True` (default), `False` |
|IncludesRecurring|boolean|false|none| Specifies whether the invoice includes recurring charges.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 5<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated from one of the following: `True` (default), `False` |
|IncludesUsage|boolean|false|none| Specifies whether the invoice includes usage charges.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 5<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated from one of the following: `True `(default), `False` |
|InvoiceDate|string(date)|false|none| Specifies the date on which to generate the invoice.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29 |
|InvoiceNumber|string|false|none| The unique identification number for the invoice. This number is returned as a string.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|LastEmailSentDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the invoice was last emailed.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|PaymentAmount|number(double)|false|none| The amount of payments applied to the invoice.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16 **Value**s: automatically generated |
|PostedBy|string|false|none| The user ID of the person who moved the invoice to Posted status.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|PostedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the invoice was posted.<br><br><br>**Character limit:** 29<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|RefundAmount|number(double)|false|none| Specifies the amount of a refund that was applied against an earlier payment on the invoice.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|RegenerateInvoicePDF|boolean|false|none| Regenerates a PDF of an invoice that was already generated.<br><br>**Character limit**: 5<br><br>**Values**: `True`, `False` |
|Status|string|false|none| The status of the invoice in the system. This status is not the status of the payment of the invoice, just the status of the invoice itself.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 8<br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>-  Draft (default, automatically set upon invoice creation)<br><br>-  Posted<br><br>-  Canceled<br><br>|
|TargetDate|string(date)|false|none| This date is used to determine which charges are to be billed. All charges that are to be billed on this date or prior will be included in this bill run.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29 |
|TaxAmount|number(double)|false|none| The total amount of the taxes applied to the invoice.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|TaxExemptAmount|number(double)|false|none| The total amount of the invoice that is exempt from taxation.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|TransferredToAccounting|string|false|none| Specifies whether or not the invoice was transferred to an external accounting system, such as NetSuite.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 10<br><br>**Values**: Processing, Yes, Error, Ignore |
|UpdatedById|string|false|none|none|
|UpdatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the invoice was last updated.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |

|Status|string|false|none| The status of the invoice in the system. This status is not the status of the payment of the invoice, just the status of the invoice itself.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 8<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>-  Draft (default, automatically set upon invoice creation)<br><br>-  Posted<br><br>-  Canceled<br><br>|
|TargetDate|string(date)|false|none| This date is used to determine which charges are to be billed. All charges that are to be billed on this date or prior will be included in this bill run.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29 |
|TaxAmount|number(double)|false|none| The total amount of the taxes applied to the invoice.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|TaxExemptAmount|number(double)|false|none| The total amount of the invoice that is exempt from taxation.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|TransferredToAccounting|string|false|none| Specifies whether or not the invoice was transferred to an external accounting system, such as NetSuite.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 10<br><br><br>**Values**: Processing, Yes, Error, Ignore |
|UpdatedById|string|false|none|none|
|UpdatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the invoice was last updated.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the invoice's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the invoice was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Invoice object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

```json
      "code": "string",

  ],
  "success": true,
  "accountId": "string",
```

**Note:** The schema of the `result` nested field is the same as the response body schema of either the ["Create an order"](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_Order) or the ["Preview an order"](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PreviewOrder) operation, depending on the purpose of the job.

The following schema for the nested `result` field is defined as the response body schema of "Create an order". See [Preview an Order](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PreviewOrder) for the response body schema of "Preview an order".

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|processId|string|false|none|The Id of the process that handle the operation.<br>|
|reasons|[object]|false|none|none|
|success|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the call succeeded.<br>|
|accountId|string|false|none|The account ID for the order. This field is returned only when the `returnIds` query parameter in the "Create an order asynchronously" operation is set to `true`.|
|accountNumber|string|false|none|The account number for the order.|
|creditMemoIds|[string]|false|none|An array of the credit memo IDs that are generated in the "Create an order asynchronously" operation. This field is returned only when the `returnIds` query parameter in the "Create an order asynchronously" operation is set to `true`.|
|creditMemoNumbers|[string]|false|none|An array of the credit memo numbers generated in this order request. The credit memo is only available if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.|
|invoiceId|string|false|none|An array of the invoice IDs that are generated in the "Create an order asynchronously" operation. This field is returned only when the `returnIds` query parameter in the "Create an order asynchronously" operation is set to `true`.|
|invoiceNumbers|[string]|false|none|An array of the invoice numbers generated in this order request. Normally it includes one invoice number only, but can include multiple items when a subscription was tagged as invoice separately.|
|orderId|string|false|none|The ID of the order created. This field is returned only when the `returnIds` query parameter in the "Create an order asynchronously" operation is set to `true`.|
|orderLineItems|[object]|false|none|none|
|orderNumber|string|false|none|The order number of the order created.|
|paidAmount|string|false|none|The total amount collected in this order request.|
|paymentId|string|false|none|The ID of the payment that is collected in the "Create an order asynchronously" operation. This field is returned only when the `returnIds` query parameter in the "Create an order asynchronously" operation is set to `true`.|
|paymentNumber|string|false|none|The payment number that collected in this order request.|
|ramps|[object]|false|none|**Note**: This field is only available if you have the Ramps feature enabled. The [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders) feature must be enabled before you can access the [Ramps](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Ramps_and_Ramp_Metrics/A_Overview_of_Ramps_and_Ramp_Metrics) feature. The Ramps feature is available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information coming October 2020.<br><br>The ramp definitions created by this order request.<br>|


Represents the order information that will be returned in the GET call.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|createdBy|string|false|none|The ID of the user who created this order.|
|createdDate|string(datetime)|false|none|The time that the order gets created in the system, in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.|
|currency|string|false|none|Currency code.|
|customFields|[OrderObjectCustomFields](#schemaorderobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of an Order object.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|A description of the order.|
|existingAccountNumber|string|false|none|The account number that this order has been created under. This is also the invoice owner of the subscriptions included in this order.|
|orderDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the order is signed. All the order actions under this order will use this order date as the contract effective date if no additinal contractEffectiveDate is provided.|
|orderLineItems|[[OrderLineItemRetrieveOrder](#schemaorderlineitemretrieveorder)]|false|none|[Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) are non subscription based items created by an Order, representing transactional charges such as one-time fees, physical goods, or professional service charges that are not sold as subscription services. <br><br>With the Order Line Items feature enabled, you can now launch non-subscription and hybrid monetization business models in Zuora, in addition to subscription business models. <br><br>**Note:** The [Order Line Items](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AA_Overview_of_Order_Line_Items) feature is in the **Early Adopter** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing it as generally available. If you want to join this early adopter program, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/). <br>|
|orderNumber|string|false|none|The order number of the order.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the order. If the order contains any `Pending Activation` or `Pending Acceptance` subscription, the order status will be `Pending`; otherwise the order status is `Completed`.|
|subscriptions|[object]|false|none|Represents a processed subscription, including the origin request (order actions) that create this version of subscription and the processing result (order metrics). The reference part in the request will be overridden with the info in the new subscription version.|
|updatedBy|string|false|none|The ID of the user who updated this order.|
|updatedDate|string(datetime)|false|none|The time that the order gets updated in the system(for example, an order description update), in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|Completed|
|status|Pending|

Represents the processed order action.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|addProduct|[RatePlanOverride](#schemarateplanoverride)|false|none|Rate plan associated with a subscription.<br>|
|cancelSubscription|[CancelSubscription](#schemacancelsubscription)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `CancelSubscription`.<br>|
|createSubscription|[CreateSubscription](#schemacreatesubscription)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `CreateSubscription`.<br>|
|customFields|[OrderActionObjectCustomFields](#schemaorderactionobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of an Order Action object.<br>|
|id|string|false|none|The Id of the order action processed in the order.|
|orderItems|[[OrderItem](#schemaorderitem)]|false|none|The `orderItems` nested field is only available to existing Orders customers who already have access to the field.<br><br>**Note:** The following Order Metrics have been deprecated. Any new customers who onboard on [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders) or [Orders Harmonization](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Orders_Harmonization/Orders_Harmonization) will not get these metrics.<br>* The Order ELP and Order Item objects <br>* The "Generated Reason" and "Order Item ID" fields in the Order MRR, Order TCB, Order TCV, and Order Quantity objects<br><br>Existing Orders customers who have these metrics will continue to be supported.<br>|
|orderMetrics|[[orderMetric](#schemaordermetric)]|false|none|The container for order metrics.<br><br>**Note:** The following Order Metrics have been deprecated. Any new customers who onboard on [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders) or [Orders Harmonization](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Orders_Harmonization/Orders_Harmonization) will not get these metrics.<br>* The Order ELP and Order Item objects <br>* The "Generated Reason" and "Order Item ID" fields in the Order MRR, Order TCB, Order TCV, and Order Quantity objects<br><br>Existing Orders customers who have these metrics will continue to be supported.<br><br>**Note:** As of Zuora Billing Release 306, Zuora has upgraded the methodologies for calculating metrics in [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders). The new methodologies are reflected in the following Order Delta Metrics objects. <br>* [Order Delta Mrr](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Delta_Metrics/Order_Delta_Mrr)<br>* [Order Delta Tcv](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Delta_Metrics/Order_Delta_Tcv)<br>* [Order Delta Tcb](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Delta_Metrics/Order_Delta_Tcb)<br><br>It is recommended that all customers use the new [Order Delta Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Delta_Metrics/AA_Overview_of_Order_Delta_Metrics). If you are an existing [Order Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders/Key_Metrics_for_Orders) customer and want to migrate to Order Delta Metrics, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>Whereas new customers, and existing customers not currently on [Order Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders/Key_Metrics_for_Orders), will no longer have access to Order Metrics, existing customers currently using Order Metrics will continue to be supported.<br>|
|ownerTransfer|[OwnerTransfer](#schemaownertransfer)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `OwnerTransfer`.<br><br>**Note:** The Owner Transfer feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br>|
|removeProduct|[RemoveProduct](#schemaremoveproduct)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `RemoveProduct`.<br>|
|resume|[GetOrderResume](#schemagetorderresume)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `Resume`.<br>|
|sequence|integer|false|none|The sequence of the order actions processed in the order.|
|suspend|[GetOrderSuspend](#schemagetordersuspend)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `Suspend`.<br>|
|termsAndConditions|[TermsAndConditions](#schematermsandconditions)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `TermsAndConditions`.<br>|
|triggerDates|[[TriggerDate](#schematriggerdate)]|false|none|Container for the contract effective, service activation, and customer acceptance dates of the order action. <br><br>If [Zuora is configured to require service activation](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Service_Activation_of_Orders.3F) and the `ServiceActivation` field is not set for a `CreateSubscription` order action, a `Pending` order and a `Pending Activation` subscription are created.<br><br>If [Zuora is configured to require customer acceptance](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Customer_Acceptance_of_Orders.3F) and the `CustomerAcceptance` field is not set for a `CreateSubscription` order action, a `Pending` order and a `Pending Acceptance` subscription are created. At the same time, if the service activation date field is also required and not set, a `Pending` order and a `Pending Activation` subscription are created instead.<br><br>If [Zuora is configured to require service activation](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Service_Activation_of_Orders.3F) and the `ServiceActivation` field is not set for either of the following order actions, a `Pending` order is created. The subscription status is not impacted. **Note:** This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you want to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br> * AddProduct<br> * UpdateProduct<br> * RemoveProduct<br> * RenewSubscription<br> * TermsAndConditions<br><br>If [Zuora is configured to require customer acceptance](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Customer_Acceptance_of_Orders.3F) and the `CustomerAcceptance` field is not set for either of the following order actions, a `Pending` order is created. The subscription status is not impacted. **Note:** This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you want to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br> * AddProduct<br> * UpdateProduct<br> * RemoveProduct<br> * RenewSubscription<br> * TermsAndConditions<br>|
|type|string|false|none|Type of the order action.|
|updateProduct|[RatePlanUpdate](#schemarateplanupdate)|false|none|Information about an order action of type `UpdateProduct`.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_OrderContact">OrderContact</h2>

```json
  "address2": "string",
  "city": "string",
  "country": "string",
  "county": "string",
  "firstName": "string",
  "lastName": "string",
  "postalCode": "string",
  "state": "string"
}
```

Use this field to create a new account as the sold-to contact of the Order Line Item (OLI). 

You can either use this field to create a new account or use the `soldTo` field to assign an existing account as the sold-to contact of the OLI. 

If neither this field nor the `soldTo` field is set, the system will automatically set the default sold-to contact under the OLI's invoice owner account as the sold-to contact of the OLI.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address1|string|false|none|First line of the contact's address. This is often a street address or a business name.<br>|
|address2|string|false|none|Second line of the contact's address.<br>|
|city|string|false|none|City of the contact's address.<br>|
|country|string|false|none|Country; must be a valid country name or abbreviation. If using Zuora Tax, you must specify a country in the bill-to contact to calculate tax.<br>|
|county|string|false|none|County of the contact's address.<br>|
|firstName|string|false|none|First name of the contact.<br>|
|lastName|string|false|none|Last name of the contact.<br>|
|postalCode|string|false|none|ZIP code or other postal code of the contact's address.<br>|
|state|string|false|none|State or province of the contact's address.<br>|

Represents the order information that will be returned in the GET call.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|createdBy|string|false|none|The ID of the user who created this order.|
|createdDate|string(datetime)|false|none|The time that the order gets created in the system, in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.|
|currency|string|false|none|Currency code.|
|customFields|[OrderObjectCustomFields](#schemaorderobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of an Order object.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|A description of the order.|
|existingAccountNumber|string|false|none|The account number that this order has been created under. This is also the invoice owner of the subscriptions included in this order.|
|orderDate|string(datetime)|false|none|The date when the order is signed. All the order actions under this order will use this order date as the contract effective date if no additinal contractEffectiveDate is provided.|
|orderNumber|string|false|none|The order number of the order.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the order.|
|subscriptions|[object]|false|none|Represents a processed subscription, including the origin request (order actions) that create this version of subscription and the processing result (order metrics). The reference part in the request will be overridden with the info in the new subscription version.|
|updatedBy|string|false|none|The ID of the user who updated this order.|
|updatedDate|string(datetime)|false|none|The time that the order gets updated in the system (for example, an order description update), in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.|

<h2 id="tocS_OrderItem">OrderItem</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorderitem"></a>
<a id="schema_OrderItem"></a>
<a id="tocSorderitem"></a>
<a id="tocsorderitem"></a>

```json
{
  "endDate": "1970-01-01",
  "id": "string",
  "orderActionId": "string",
  "quantity": 0,
  "scId": "string",
  "startDate": "1970-01-01"
}
```

Represents an order item. An order item is a sales item within an order in the context of the recurring subscription business model. It can be a unit of products or a service, but defined by both quantity and term (the start and end dates). 

For the one time and the recurring charge types, if an order action causes a quantity metric creation (when the delta quantity equals to or is greater than zero), an order item is created.

The following order actions will create an order item for the one time and recurring charges. The other order actions will refer to an existing order item. Also, the Owner Transfer order action always creates an order item whose quantity field is zero.

  * Create Subscription
  * Terms and Conditions - Extend Term
  * Renewal
  * Update Product - Increase Quantity
  * Add product
  * Owner Transfer

For the usage charge type, if the order action causes a usage increase, an order item is created, and the quantity field of the order item is always zero.

The following order actions will create an order item for for the usage charges.

  * Create Subscription
  * Terms and Conditions - Extend Term
  * Renewal
  * Add product
  * Owner Transfer

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|endDate|string(date)|false|none|The order item's effective end date, aligned with the end date of an increased quantity order metrics.|
|id|string|false|none|The ID of the order item.|
|orderActionId|string|false|none|Specify the order action that creates this order item.|
|quantity|number|false|none|The order item quantity. For the usage charge type, the value of this field is always zero. Also, the Owner Transfer order action always creates an order item whose Quantity field is zero.|
|scId|string|false|none|The ID of the charge segment that gets newly generated when the order item is created.|
|startDate|string(date)|false|none|The order item's effective start date, aligned with the start date of an increased quantity order metrics.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountNumber|string|false|none|A unique account number, up to 50 characters that do not begin with the default account number prefix.  If no account number is specified, one is generated.<br>|
|additionalEmailAddresses|[string]|false|none|A list of additional email addresses to receive emailed invoices. Use a comma to separate each email address.<br><br>**Note:** Invoices are emailed to the email addresses specified in this field only when the `invoiceDeliveryPrefsEmail` field is `true`.<br>|
|applicationOrder|[string]|false|none|The priority order to apply credit memos and/or unapplied payments to an invoice. Possible item values are: `CreditMemo`, `UnappliedPayment`.<br><br>**Note:**<br>  - This field is valid only if the `applyCredit` field is set to `true`.<br>  - If no value is specified for this field, the default priority order is used, ["CreditMemo", "UnappliedPayment"], to apply credit memos first and then apply unapplied payments.<br>  - If only one item is specified, only the items of the spedified type are applied to invoices. For example, if the value is `["CreditMemo"]`, only credit memos are used to apply to invoices.<br>|
|applyCredit|boolean|false|none|Whether to automatically apply credit memos or unapplied payments, or both to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit memo or unapplied payment, or both will be automatically applied to the invoice. If no value is specified or the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|applyCreditBalance|boolean|false|none|Applies a credit balance to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit balance is applied to the invoice. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>Prerequisite: `invoice` must be `true`.<br><br>To view the credit balance adjustment, retrieve the details of the invoice using the Get Invoices method.<br><br><br>**Note:** <br>  - If you are using the field `invoiceCollect` rather than the field `invoice`, the `invoiceCollect` value must be `true`.<br>  - This field is deprecated if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled. <br>|
|autoPay|boolean|false|none|Whether future payments are to be automatically billed when they are due. <br><br>- If this field is set to `true`, you must specify either the `creditCard` field or the `hpmCreditCardPaymentMethodId` field, but not both.<br>- If this field is set to `false`, you can specify neither the `creditCard` field nor the `hpmCreditCardPaymentMethodId` field.<br>|
|batch|string|false|none|The alias name given to a batch. A string of 50 characters or less.<br>|
|billCycleDay|integer(int64)|false|none|The account's bill cycle day (BCD), when bill runs generate invoices for the account.  Specify any day of the month (1-31, where 31 = end-of-month), or 0 for auto-set.<br><br>Required if no subscription will be created. <br><br>Optional if a subscription is created and defaults to the day-of-the-month of the subscription's `contractEffectiveDate`.<br>|
|billToContact|[POSTAccountTypeBillToContact](#schemapostaccounttypebilltocontact)|true|none|Container for bill-to contact information for this account. If you do not provide a sold-to contact, the bill-to contact is copied to sold-to contact. Once the sold-to contact is created, changes to billToContact will not affect soldToContact and vice versa.<br>|
|collect|boolean|false|none|Collects an automatic payment for a subscription. The collection generated in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer account.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the automatic payment is collected. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>Prerequisite: The `invoice` or `runBilling` field must be `true`. <br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `196.0` or later.<br>|
|communicationProfileId|string|false|none|The ID of a communication profile.          |
|creditCard|[POSTAccountTypeCreditCard](#schemapostaccounttypecreditcard)|false|none|**Note:** This field has been deprecated, and is currently available only for backward compatibility. Use the `paymentMethod` field instead to create a payment method associated with this account.<br><br>Container for information on a credit card to associate with this account. <br>  If the `autoPay` field is set to `true`, you must provide either this field or the `hpmCreditCardPaymentMethodId` field, but not both.<br>|
|creditMemoTemplateId|string|false|none|**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br><br>The unique ID of the credit memo template, configured in **Billing Settings** > **Manage Billing Document Configuration** through the Zuora UI. For example, 2c92c08a6246fdf101626b1b3fe0144b.<br>|
|crmId|string|false|none|CRM account ID for the account, up to 100 characters.<br>|
|currency|string|true|none|A currency as defined in Billing Settings in the Zuora UI.<br><br>For payment method authorization, if the `paymentMethod` > `currencyCode` field is specified, `currencyCode` is used. Otherwise, this `currency` field is used for payment method authorization. If no currency is specified for the account, the default currency of the account is then used.<br>|
|debitMemoTemplateId|string|false|none|**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br><br>The unique ID of the debit memo template, configured in **Billing Settings** > **Manage Billing Document Configuration** through the Zuora UI. For example, 2c92c08d62470a8501626b19d24f19e2.<br>|
|documentDate|string(date)|false|none|The date of the billing document, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. It represents the invoice date for invoices, credit memo date for credit memos, and debit memo date for debit memos.<br><br>- If this field is specified, the specified date is used as the billing document date. <br>- If this field is not specified, the date specified in the `targetDate` is used as the billing document date.<br>|
|hpmCreditCardPaymentMethodId|string|false|none|The ID of the payment method associated with this account. The payment method specified for this field will be set as the default payment method of the account.<br><br>If the `autoPay` field is set to `true`, you must provide the credit card payment method ID for either this field or the `creditCard` field, but not both.  <br>|
|invoice|boolean|false|none|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `runBilling` field. The<br>`invoice` field is only available for backward compatibility. <br><br>Creates an invoice for a subscription. The invoice generated in this<br>operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer<br>account.<br><br>If the value is `true`, an invoice is created. If the value is<br>`false`, no action is taken.<br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `196.0` or `207.0`.<br>|

Default is current date.<br><br><br>This field is in REST API minor version control. To use this field in<br>the method, you can set the `zuora-version` parameter to the minor<br>version number in the request header. Supported minor versions are<br>`207.0` and earlier. <br>|

To create a credit card payment method when creating an account, Zuora recommends that you use this field instead of the `creditCard` field.<br><br>Note that you can not use this field together with `creditCard` or `hpmCreditCardPaymentMethodId` to create a payment method.<br>|

If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created based on the [invoice and credit memo generation rule.](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Invoice_Settlement/Credit_and_Debit_Memos/Rules_for_Generating_Invoices_and_Credit_Memos). <br><br><br>The billing documents generated<br>in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire<br>customer account.<br><br><br>Possible values:<br><br>- `true`: An invoice is created. If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created.<br><br><br>- `false`: No invoice is created.<br><br><br>**Note:** This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported<br>minor versions are `211.0` or later. To use this field in the method,<br>you must set the `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number<br>in the request header.<br>|

Container for bill-to contact information for this account. If you do not provide a sold-to contact, the bill-to contact is copied to sold-to contact. Once the sold-to contact is created, changes to billToContact will not affect soldToContact and vice versa.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address1|string|false|none|First address line, 255 characters or less.<br>|
|address2|string|false|none|Second address line, 255 characters or less.<br>|
|city|string|false|none|City, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|country|string|false|none|Country; must be a valid country name or abbreviation. If using Zuora Tax, you must specify a country in the sold-to contact to calculate tax. A bill-to contact may be used if no sold-to contact is provided.<br>|
|county|string|false|none|County; 32 characters or less. May optionally be used by Zuora Tax to calculate county tax.<br>|
|fax|string|false|none|Fax phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|firstName|string|true|none|First name, 100 characters or less.<br>|
|homePhone|string|false|none|Home phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|lastName|string|true|none|Last name, 100 characters or less.<br>|
|mobilePhone|string|false|none|Mobile phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|nickname|string|false|none|Nickname for this contact<br>|
|otherPhone|string|false|none|Other phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|otherPhoneType|string|false|none|Possible values are: `Work`, `Mobile`, `Home`, `Other`.<br>|
|personalEmail|string|false|none|Personal email address, 80 characters or less.<br>|
|state|string|false|none|State; must be a valid state or province name or 2-character abbreviation. If using Zuora Tax, be aware that Zuora tax requires a state (in the US) or province (in Canada) in this field for the sold-to contact to calculate tax, and that a bill-to contact may be used if no sold-to contact is provided.<br>|
|taxRegion|string|false|none|If using Zuora Tax, a region string as optionally defined in your tax rules. Not required.<br>|
|workEmail|string|false|none|Work email address, 80 characters or less.<br>|
|workPhone|string|false|none|Work phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|zipCode|string|false|none|Zip code, 20 characters or less.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Contact object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

**Note:** This field has been deprecated, and is currently available only for backward compatibility. Use the `paymentMethod` field instead to create a payment method associated with this account.

Container for information on a credit card to associate with this account. 
  If the `autoPay` field is set to `true`, you must provide either this field or the `hpmCreditCardPaymentMethodId` field, but not both.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cardHolderInfo|object|true|none|Container for cardholder information. If provided, Zuora<br>      will only use this information for this card.  If not provided, Zuora<br>      will use the account''s existing bill-to contact information for this<br>      card.<br>|
|cardNumber|string|true|none|Card number, up to 16 characters. Once created, this field can't be updated or queried, and is only available in masked format (e.g., XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-1234).<br>|
|cardType|string|true|none|The type of the credit card.<br><br>Possible values  include `Visa`, `MasterCard`, `AmericanExpress`, `Discover`, `JCB`, and `Diners`. For more information about credit card types supported by different payment gateways, see [Supported Payment Gateways](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways).<br>|
|expirationMonth|string|true|none|Two-digit expiration month (01-12).<br>|
|expirationYear|string|true|none|Four-digit expiration year.<br>|
|securityCode|string|false|none|The CVV or CVV2 security code of the card. To ensure PCI compliance, this value is not stored and cannot be queried.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the payment method. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

Container for information on payment methods to associate with this account. To create a credit card payment method when creating an account, Zuora recommends that you use this field instead of the `creditCard` field.

Note that you can not use this field together with `creditCard` or `hpmCreditCardPaymentMethodId` to create a payment method.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|Type of payment method. Possible values include:<br><br>* `PayPalEC` - PayPal Express Checkout payment method. Use this type if you are using a [PayPal Payflow Pro Gateway](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways/PayPal_Payflow_Pro%2C_Website_Payments_Payflow_Edition%2C_Website_Pro_Payment_Gateway) instance.<br>* `PayPalNativeEC` - PayPal Native Express Checkout payment method. Use this type if you are using a [PayPal Express Checkout Gateway](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways/PayPal_Express_Checkout_Gateway) instance.<br>* `PayPalAdaptive` - PayPal Adaptive payment method. Use this type if you are using a [PayPal Adaptive Payment Gateway](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways/PayPal_Adaptive_Payments_Gateway) instance.<br>* `CreditCard` - Credit card payment method.<br>* `ACH` - ACH payment method.<br>* `SEPA` - Single Euro Payments Area.<br>* `Betalingsservice` - Direct Debit DK.<br>* `Autogiro` - Direct Debit SE.<br>* `Bacs` - Direct Debit UK.<br>* You can also specify a custom payment method type. This type is only available if the Universal Payment Connector and Open Payment Method services are enabled. See [Set up custom payment gateways and payment methods](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/MB_Set_up_custom_payment_gateways_and_payment_methods) for details.<br>|
|BAID|string|false|none|ID of a PayPal billing agreement. For example, I-1TJ3GAGG82Y9.<br>|
|email|string|false|none|Email address associated with the payment method. This field is required if you want to create a PayPal Express Checkout payment method or a PayPal Adaptive payment method.<br>|
|preapprovalKey|string|false|none|The PayPal preapproval key.<br>|
|cardHolderInfo|[CreatePaymentMethodCardholderInfo](#schemacreatepaymentmethodcardholderinfo)|false|none|Container for cardholder information. If provided, Zuora will<br>only use this information for this card. Otherwise, Zuora will use<br>the account''s existing bill-to contact information for this card.<br>|
|cardNumber|string|false|none|Credit card number.<br>|
|cardType|string|false|none|The type of the credit card.<br><br>Possible values include `Visa`, `MasterCard`, `AmericanExpress`, `Discover`, `JCB`, and `Diners`. For more information about credit card types supported by different payment gateways, see [Supported Payment Gateways](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways).<br>|
|checkDuplicated|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the duplication check is performed when you create a new credit card payment method. The default value is `false`.<br><br>With this field set to `true`, Zuora will check all active payment methods associated with the same billing account to ensure that no duplicate credit card payment methods are created. An error is returned if a duplicate payment method is found.<br>        <br>The following fields are used for the duplication check:<br>  * `cardHolderName`<br>  * `expirationMonth`<br>  * `expirationYear`<br>  * `creditCardMaskNumber`. It is the masked credit card number generated by Zuora. For example, `****1234`. <br>|
|expirationMonth|integer|false|none|One or two digit expiration month (1-12) of the credit card.<br>|
|expirationYear|integer|false|none|Four-digit expiration year of the credit card.<br>|
|mitConsentAgreementRef|string|false|none|Specifies your reference for the stored credential consent agreement that you have established with the customer. Only applicable if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|string|false|none|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|mitNetworkTransactionId|string|false|none|Specifies the ID of a network transaction. Only applicable if you set the `mitProfileAction` field to `Persist`.<br>|
|mitProfileAction|string|false|none|If you set this field, Zuora creates a stored credential profile within the payment method.<br><br>**Note:** This feature is in the **Early Adopters** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing as generally available.<br><br>* `Activate` - Use this value if you are creating the stored credential profile after receiving the customer's consent.<br><br>  Zuora will create the stored credential profile then send a cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) to the payment gateway to validate the stored credential profile. If the CIT succeeds, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Active`. If the CIT does not succeed, Zuora will not create a stored credential profile.<br>  <br>  If the payment gateway does not support the stored credential transaction framework, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Agreed`.<br><br><br>* `Persist` - Use this value if the stored credential profile represents a stored credential profile in an external system. The status of the payment method's stored credential profile will be `Active`.<br>|
|mitProfileAgreedOn|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the profile is agreed. The date format is `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br>|
|mitProfileType|string|false|none|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field. Indicates the type of the stored credential profile to process recurring or unsecheduled transactions.<br>|
|securityCode|string|false|none|CVV or CVV2 security code of the credit card.<br><br>To ensure PCI compliance, this value is not stored and cannot be queried.<br>|
|addressLine1|string|false|none|First address line, 255 characters or less.<br>|
|addressLine2|string|false|none|Second address line, 255 characters or less.<br>|
|bankABACode|string|false|none|The nine-digit routing number or ABA number used by banks. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankAccountName|string|false|none|The name of the account holder, which can be either a person or a company. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankAccountNumber|string|false|none|The bank account number associated with the ACH payment. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankAccountType|string|false|none|The type of bank account associated with the ACH payment. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankName|string|false|none|The name of the bank where the ACH payment account is held. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|city|string|false|none|City, 40 characters or less.<br>    <br>|
|country|string|false|none|Country, must be a valid country name or abbreviation.<br>|
|phone|string|false|none|Phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|state|string|false|none|State, must be a valid state name or 2-character abbreviation.<br>|
|zipCode|string|false|none|Zip code, 20 characters or less.<br>|
|accountKey|string|false|none|Internal ID of the customer account that will own the payment method. <br><br>To create an orphan payment method that is not associated with any customer account, you do not need to specify this field during creation. However, you must associate the orphan payment method with a customer account within 10 days. Otherwise, this orphan payment method will be deleted.<br>|
|authGateway|string|false|none|Internal ID of the payment gateway that Zuora will use to authorize the payments that are made with the payment method.<br><br>If you do not set this field, Zuora will use one of the following payment gateways instead:<br><br>* The default payment gateway of the customer account that owns the payment method, if the `accountKey` field is set.<br>* The default payment gateway of your Zuora tenant, if the `accountKey` field is not set.<br>|
|makeDefault|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the payment method will be the default payment method of the customer account that owns the payment method. Only applicable if the `accountKey` field is set.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the payment method. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|
|IBAN|string|false|none|The International Bank Account Number. This field is used to create the SEPA payment method.<br>|
|accountHolderInfo|object|false|none|none|
|accountNumber|string|false|none|The number of the customer's bank account. Use this field for direct debit payment methods.<br>|
|bankCode|string|false|none|The sort code or number that identifies the bank. This is also known as the sort code. <br>|
|branchCode|string|false|none|The branch code of the bank used for direct debit.  <br>|
|businessIdentificationCode|string|false|none|The BIC code used for SEPA.<br>|
|currencyCode|string|false|none|The currency used for payment method authorization.<br><br>If this field is not specified, `currency` specified for the account is used for payment method authorization. If no currency is specified for the account, the default currency of the account is then used.<br>|
|identityNumber|string|false|none|The identity number used for Bank Transfer.<br>|

Container for optional sold-to contact; uses the same field structure as the bill-to contact (above). If a sold-to contact is not specified, one is created from the bill-to contact. Once created, these are two separate data entities, and future changes to one do not affect the other.

|city|string|false|none|City, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|country|string|false|none|Country; must be a valid country name or abbreviation. If using Zuora Tax, you must specify a country in the sold-to contact to calculate tax. A bill-to contact may be used if no sold-to contact is provided.<br>|
|county|string|false|none|County; 32 characters or less. May optionally be used by Zuora Tax to calculate county tax.<br>|
|fax|string|false|none|Fax phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|firstName|string|true|none|First name, 100 characters or less.<br>|
|homePhone|string|false|none|Home phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|lastName|string|true|none|Last name, 100 characters or less.<br>|
|mobilePhone|string|false|none|Mobile phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|nickname|string|false|none|Nickname for this contact<br>|
|otherPhone|string|false|none|Other phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|otherPhoneType|string|false|none|Possible values are: `Work`, `Mobile`, `Home`, `Other`.<br>|
|personalEmail|string|false|none|Personal email address, 80 characters or less.<br>|
|state|string|false|none|State; must be a valid state or province name or 2-character abbreviation. If using Zuora Tax, be aware that Zuora Tax requires a state (in the US) or province (in Canada) in this field for the sold-to contact to calculate tax, and that a bill-to contact may be used if no sold-to contact is provided.<br>|
|taxRegion|string|false|none|If using Zuora Tax, a region string as optionally defined in your tax rules. Not required.<br>|
|workEmail|string|false|none|Work email address, 80 characters or less.<br>|
|workPhone|string|false|none|Work phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|zipCode|string|false|none|Zip code, 20 characters or less.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Contact object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|
