Container for subscription information, used if creating a subscription for the new account at the time of account creation.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|autoRenew|boolean|false|none|If `true`, auto-renew is enabled. Default is `false`.<br>|
|contractEffectiveDate|string(date)|true|none|Effective contract date for this subscription, as `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br>|
|customerAcceptanceDate|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the services or products within a subscription have been accepted by the customer, as `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br><br>Default value is dependent on the value of other fields. See Notes section for more details.<br>|
|initialTerm|integer(int64)|false|none|Duration of the initial subscription term in whole months.  Default is 0. <br>|
|invoiceOwnerAccountKey|string|false|none|Invoice owner account number or ID.<br><br>**Note:** This feature is in Limited Availability. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com). <br>|
|invoiceSeparately|boolean|false|none|Separates a single subscription from other subscriptions and invoices the charge independently. <br><br>If the value is `true`, the subscription is billed separately from other subscriptions. If the value is `false`, the subscription is included with other subscriptions in the account invoice.<br>The default value is `false`.<br><br>Prerequisite: The default subscription setting `Enable Subscriptions to be Invoiced Separately` must be set to `Yes`.<br>|
|notes|string|false|none|none|
|renewalTerm|integer(int64)|false|none|Duration of the renewal term in whole months. Default is 0.<br>|
|serviceActivationDate|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the services or products within a subscription have been activated and access has been provided to the customer, as `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br><br>Default value is dependent on the value of other fields. See Notes section for more details.<br>|
|subscribeToRatePlans|[[POSTSrpCreateType](#schemapostsrpcreatetype)]|false|none|Container for one or more rate plans for this subscription.<br>|
|subscriptionNumber|string|false|none|Subscription Number. The value can be up to 1000 characters.<br><br>If you do not specify a subscription number when creating a subscription for the new account, Zuora will generate a subscription number automatically.<br><br>If the account is created successfully, the subscription number is returned in the `subscriptionNumber` response field.<br>|
|termStartDate|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the subscription term begins, as `yyyy-mm-dd`. If this is a renewal subscription, this date is different from the subscription start date.<br>|
|termType|string|true|none|Possible values are: `TERMED`, `EVERGREEN`.<br>|
|CpqBundleJsonId__QT|string|false|none|The Bundle product structures from Zuora Quotes if you utilize Bundling in Salesforce. Do not change the value in this field.<br>|
|OpportunityCloseDate__QT|string(date)|false|none|The closing date of the Opportunity. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|OpportunityName__QT|string|false|none|The unique identifier of the Opportunity. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|QuoteBusinessType__QT|string|false|none|The specific identifier for the type of business transaction the Quote represents such as New, Upsell, Downsell, Renewal or Churn. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|QuoteNumber__QT|string|false|none|The unique identifier of the Quote. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|QuoteType__QT|string|false|none|The Quote type that represents the subscription lifecycle stage such as New, Amendment, Renew or Cancel. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the subscription's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Project__NS|string|false|none|The NetSuite project that the subscription was created from. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SalesOrder__NS|string|false|none|The NetSuite sales order than the subscription was created from. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the subscription was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Subscription object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

If this field is omitted<br>and `invoiceId` is not specified, the current date is used by default. <br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `214.0` and earlier.<br>|
|invoiceId|string|false|none|The ID of an existing invoice for which to collect payment using<br>the account's default payment method. If this value is specified, no new<br>invoice is generated, and the following fields are ignored:<br>  - `invoiceDate` and `invoiceTargetDate` (if the Zuora REST API version is 214.0 or earlier)<br>  - `documentDate` and `targetDate` (if the Zuora REST API version is 215.0 or later)<br>|
|invoiceTargetDate|string(date)|false|none|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `targetDate` field in Zuora REST API version `215.0` and later. If this field is omitted<br>and `invoiceId` is not specified, the current date is used by default. <br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `214.0` and earlier.  <br>|
|paymentGateway|string|false|none|The name of the gateway that will be used for the payment. Must be a valid gateway name and the gateway must support the specific payment method. If a value is not specified, the default gateway on the Account will be used.<br>|
|targetDate|string(date)|false|none|The date through which to calculate charges on this account if an invoice or a credit memo is generated, <br>in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. If this field is omitted<br>and `invoiceId` is not specified, the current date is used by default. <br><br><br>**Note:** The credit memo is only available if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `215.0` and later. To use this field in the method, you<br>must set the  `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number in<br>the request header.<br>|

|targetEndDate|string(date)|false|none|The target end date of the journal run.<br><br>If you include `accountingPeriodName`, the `targetEndDate` must be empty or the same as the end date of the accounting period specified in `accountingPeriodName`.<br>|
|targetStartDate|string(date)|false|none|The target start date of the journal run.<br><br>Required if you include targetEndDate.<br><br>If you include `accountingPeriodName`, the `targetStartDate` must be empty or the same as the start date of the accounting period specified in `accountingPeriodName`.<br>|
|transactionTypes|[[POSTJournalRunTransactionType](#schemapostjournalruntransactiontype)]|true|none|Transaction types included in the journal run.<br><br>You can include one or more transaction types.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_POSTPMMandateInfo">POSTPMMandateInfo</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostpmmandateinfo"></a>
<a id="schema_POSTPMMandateInfo"></a>
<a id="tocSpostpmmandateinfo"></a>
<a id="tocspostpmmandateinfo"></a>

```json
{
  "existingMandateStatus": true,
  "mandateCreationDate": "1970-01-01",
  "mandateId": "string",
  "mandateReason": "string",
  "mandateReceivedStatus": true,
  "mandateStatus": "string",
  "mandateUpdateDate": "1970-01-01",
  "mitConsentAgreementRef": "string",
  "mitConsentAgreementSrc": "External",
  "mitProfileAction": "Activate",
  "mitProfileAgreedOn": "1970-01-01",
  "mitProfileType": "string",
  "mitTransactionId": "string"
}
```

The mandate information for the Credit Card, ACH, or Bank Transfer payment method.

The following mandate fields are specific to the ACH and Bank Transfer payment methods:
* `mandateId`
* `mandateReceivedStatus`
* `existingMandateStatus`
* `mandateCreationDate`
* `mandateUpdateDate`
* `mandateStatus`
* `mandateReason`

The following mandate fields are specific to the Credit Card payment method:
* `mitTransactionId`
* `mitProfileAgreedOn`
* `mitConsentAgreementRef`
* `mitConsentAgreementSrc`
* `mitProfileType`
* `mitProfileAction`

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|existingMandateStatus|string|false|none|Indicates whether the mandate is an existing mandate.<br>|
|mandateCreationDate|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the mandate was created.<br>|
|mandateId|string|false|none|The mandate ID.<br>|
|mandateReason|string|false|none|The reason of the mandate from the gateway side.<br>|
|mandateReceivedStatus|string|false|none|Indicates whether the mandate is received from the gateway<br>|
|mandateStatus|string|false|none|The status of the mandate from the gateway side.<br>|
|mandateUpdateDate|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the mandate was updated.<br>|
|mitConsentAgreementRef|string|false|none|Reference for the consent agreement that you have established with the customer.  <br>|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|string|false|none|none|
|mitProfileAction|string|false|none|Specifies how Zuora activates the stored credential profile. Only applicable if you set the `status` field to `Active`.<br><br>* `Activate` (default) - Use this value if you are creating the stored credential profile after receiving the customer's consent.<br><br>  Zuora will create the stored credential profile then send a cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) to the payment gateway to validate the stored credential profile. If the CIT succeeds, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Active`. If the CIT does not succeed, Zuora will not create a stored credential profile.<br>  <br>  If the payment gateway does not support the stored credential transaction framework, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Agreed`.<br><br><br>* `Persist` - Use this value if the stored credential profile represents a stored credential profile in an external system. The status of the payment method's stored credential profile will be `Active`.<br>|
|mitProfileAgreedOn|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the stored credential profile is agreed. The date format is `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br>|
|mitProfileType|string|false|none|Indicates the type of the stored credential profile.<br>|
|mitTransactionId|string|false|none|Specifies the ID of the transaction. Only applicable if you set the `mitProfileAction` field to `Persist`.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|existingMandateStatus|true|
|existingMandateStatus|false|
|mandateReceivedStatus|true|
|mandateReceivedStatus|false|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|External|
|mitProfileAction|Activate|
|mitProfileAction|Persist|

<h2 id="tocS_POSTPaymentMethodDecryption">POSTPaymentMethodDecryption</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostpaymentmethoddecryption"></a>
<a id="schema_POSTPaymentMethodDecryption"></a>
<a id="tocSpostpaymentmethoddecryption"></a>
<a id="tocspostpaymentmethoddecryption"></a>

```json
{
  "accountID": "402891a25a02e11c015a02f3c6100003",
  "integrationType": "ApplePay",
  "invoiceId": "INV000000005",
  "merchantID": "merchant.CN.com.zuora.services416",
  "paymentGateway": "CyberSourceOPG",
  "paymentToken": {
    "data": "xGc......JDxuYz1gug0KZRrGXJQ=",
    "header": {
      "ephemeralPublicKey": "MFkwEw......TMbLoojKBA==",
      "publicKeyHash": "HuLvfqvLon......9jEyX0w=",
      "transactionId": "abbadd18818baea1f37b40844c9e09afa9733b0eccb373905b811da43cf1753b"
    },
    "signature": "MIAGCSqGSIb......AEtrLSv7hE9gAAAAAAAA==",
    "version": "EC_v1"
  },
  "processPayment": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountID|string|false|none|The ID of the customer account associated with this payment method.<br>To create an orphan payment method that is not associated with any customer account, you do not need to specify this field during creation. However, you must associate the orphan payment method with a customer account within 10 days. Otherwise, this orphan payment method will be deleted.|
|cardHolderInfo|object|false|none|Container for cardholder information. If provided, Zuora will only use this information for this card. If not provided, Zuora will use the account's existing bill-to contact information for this card.|
|integrationType|string|true|none|Field to identify the token decryption type.<br><br>**Note:** The only value at this time is `ApplePay`.<br><br>|
|invoiceId|string|false|none|The id of invoice this payment will apply to.<br><br>**Note:** When `processPayment` is `true`, this field is required.<br>Only one invoice can be paid; for scenarios where you want to pay for multiple invoices, set `processPayment` to `false` and call payment API separately.<br>|
|merchantID|string|true|none|The Merchant ID that was configured for use with Apple Pay in the Apple iOS Developer Center.<br>|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|string|false|none|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|mitProfileAction|string|false|none|If you specify this field, Zuora creates a stored credential profile within the payment method.<br>    <br>**Note:** This feature is in the **Early Adopters** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing as generally available.<br>    <br>* `Activate` - Use this value if you are creating the stored credential profile after receiving the customer's consent. Zuora will create the stored credential profile then send a cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) to the payment gateway to validate the stored credential profile. If the CIT succeeds, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Active`. If the CIT does not succeed, Zuora will not create a stored credential profile. If the payment gateway does not support the stored credential transaction framework, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Agreed`.     <br>    <br>* `Persist` - Use this value if the stored credential profile represents a stored credential profile in an external system. The status of the payment method's stored credential profile will be `Active`.<br>    <br>|
|mitProfileType|string|false|none|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|paymentGateway|string|false|none|The label name of the gateway instance configured in Zuora that should process the payment. When creating a Payment, this must be a valid gateway instance ID and this gateway must support the specific payment method. If not specified, the default gateway on the Account will be used.<br><br>**Note:** When `processPayment` is `true`, this field is required.<br>|
|paymentToken|object|true|none|The complete JSON Object representing the encrypted payment token payload returned in the response from the Apple Pay session.<br><br>|
|processPayment|boolean|false|none|A boolean flag to control whether a payment should be processed after creating payment method. The payment amount will be equivalent to the amount the merchant supplied in the ApplePay session. Default is false.<br><br>When `processPayment` is set to `false`, it must be followed by a separate subscribe or payment API call. <br><br><br>**Note:** If you set this field to `true`, you must specify the `paymentGateway` field with the payment gateway instance name. If you set this field to `false`, you must select the **Verify new credit card** check box on the gateway instance settings page. Otherwise, the cryptogram will not be sent to the gateway.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|External|
|mitProfileAction|Activate|
|mitProfileAction|Persist|
|mitProfileType|Recurring|

<h2 id="tocS_POSTPaymentMethodRequest">POSTPaymentMethodRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->

|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|Type of the payment method. Possible values include:<br><br>* `PayPalEC` - PayPal Express Checkout payment method. Use this type if you are using a [PayPal Payflow Pro Gateway](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways/PayPal_Payflow_Pro%2C_Website_Payments_Payflow_Edition%2C_Website_Pro_Payment_Gateway) instance.<br>* `PayPalNativeEC` - PayPal Native Express Checkout payment method. Use this type if you are using a [PayPal Express Checkout Gateway](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways/PayPal_Express_Checkout_Gateway) instance.<br>* `PayPalAdaptive` - PayPal Adaptive payment method. Use this type if you are using a [PayPal Adaptive Payment Gateway](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways/PayPal_Adaptive_Payments_Gateway) instance.<br>* `CreditCard` - Credit card payment method.<br>* `ACH` - ACH payment method.<br>* `SEPA` - Single Euro Payments Area.<br>* `Betalingsservice` - Direct Debit DK.<br>* `Autogiro` - Direct Debit SE.<br>* `Bacs` - Direct Debit UK.<br>* `Becs` - Direct Entry AU.<br>* `Becsnz` - Direct Debit NZ.<br>* `PAD` - Pre-Authorized Debit.<br>* You can also specify a custom payment method type. This type is only available if the Universal Payment Connector and Open Payment Method services are enabled. See [Set up custom payment gateways and payment methods](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/MB_Set_up_custom_payment_gateways_and_payment_methods) for details.<br><br>Note that Zuora is continuously adding new payment method types.<br>|
|BAID|string|false|none|ID of a PayPal billing agreement. For example, I-1TJ3GAGG82Y9.<br>|
|email|string|false|none|Email address associated with the payment method. This field is required if you want to create a PayPal Express Checkout payment method or a PayPal Adaptive payment method.<br>|
|preapprovalKey|string|false|none|The PayPal preapproval key.<br>|
|cardHolderInfo|[CreatePaymentMethodCardholderInfo](#schemacreatepaymentmethodcardholderinfo)|false|none|Container for cardholder information. If provided, Zuora will<br>only use this information for this card. Otherwise, Zuora will use<br>the account''s existing bill-to contact information for this card.<br>|
|cardNumber|string|false|none|Credit card number.<br>|
|cardType|string|false|none|The type of the credit card.<br><br>Possible values include `Visa`, `MasterCard`, `AmericanExpress`, `Discover`, `JCB`, and `Diners`. For more information about credit card types supported by different payment gateways, see [Supported Payment Gateways](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways).<br>|
|checkDuplicated|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the duplication check is performed when you create a new credit card payment method. The default value is `false`.<br><br>With this field set to `true`, Zuora will check all active payment methods associated with the same billing account to ensure that no duplicate credit card payment methods are created. An error is returned if a duplicate payment method is found.<br>        <br>The following fields are used for the duplication check:<br>  * `cardHolderName`<br>  * `expirationMonth`<br>  * `expirationYear`<br>  * `creditCardMaskNumber`. It is the masked credit card number generated by Zuora. For example, `****1234`. <br>|
|expirationMonth|integer|false|none|One or two digit expiration month (1-12) of the credit card.<br>|
|expirationYear|integer|false|none|Four-digit expiration year of the credit card.<br>|
|mitConsentAgreementRef|string|false|none|Specifies your reference for the stored credential consent agreement that you have established with the customer. Only applicable if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|string|false|none|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|mitNetworkTransactionId|string|false|none|Specifies the ID of a network transaction. Only applicable if you set the `mitProfileAction` field to `Persist`.<br>|
|mitProfileAction|string|false|none|If you set this field, Zuora creates a stored credential profile within the payment method.<br><br>**Note:** This feature is in the **Early Adopters** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing as generally available.<br><br>* `Activate` - Use this value if you are creating the stored credential profile after receiving the customer's consent.<br><br>  Zuora will create the stored credential profile then send a cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) to the payment gateway to validate the stored credential profile. If the CIT succeeds, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Active`. If the CIT does not succeed, Zuora will not create a stored credential profile.<br>  <br>  If the payment gateway does not support the stored credential transaction framework, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Agreed`.<br><br><br>* `Persist` - Use this value if the stored credential profile represents a stored credential profile in an external system. The status of the payment method's stored credential profile will be `Active`.<br>|
|mitProfileAgreedOn|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the profile is agreed. The date format is `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br>|
|mitProfileType|string|false|none|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field. Indicates the type of the stored credential profile to process recurring or unsecheduled transactions.<br>|
|securityCode|string|false|none|CVV or CVV2 security code of the credit card.<br><br>To ensure PCI compliance, this value is not stored and cannot be queried.<br>|
|addressLine1|string|false|none|First address line, 255 characters or less.<br>|
|addressLine2|string|false|none|Second address line, 255 characters or less.<br>|
|bankABACode|string|false|none|The nine-digit routing number or ABA number used by banks. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankAccountName|string|false|none|The name of the account holder, which can be either a person or a company. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankAccountNumber|string|false|none|The bank account number associated with the ACH payment. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankAccountType|string|false|none|The type of bank account associated with the ACH payment. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankName|string|false|none|The name of the bank where the ACH payment account is held. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|city|string|false|none|City, 40 characters or less.<br>    <br>|
|country|string|false|none|Country, must be a valid country name or abbreviation.<br>|
|phone|string|false|none|Phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|state|string|false|none|State, must be a valid state name or 2-character abbreviation.<br>|
|zipCode|string|false|none|Zip code, 20 characters or less.<br>|
|accountKey|string|false|none|Internal ID of the customer account that will own the payment method. <br><br>To create an orphan payment method that is not associated with any customer account, you do not need to specify this field during creation. However, you must associate the orphan payment method with a customer account within 10 days. Otherwise, this orphan payment method will be deleted.<br>|
|authGateway|string|false|none|Internal ID of the payment gateway that Zuora will use to authorize the payments that are made with the payment method.<br><br>If you do not set this field, Zuora will use one of the following payment gateways instead:<br><br>* The default payment gateway of the customer account that owns the payment method, if the `accountKey` field is set.<br>* The default payment gateway of your Zuora tenant, if the `accountKey` field is not set.<br>|
|makeDefault|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the payment method will be the default payment method of the customer account that owns the payment method. Only applicable if the `accountKey` field is set.<br>|
|IBAN|string|false|none|The International Bank Account Number. This field is used to create the SEPA payment method.<br>|
|accountHolderInfo|object|false|none|none|
|accountNumber|string|false|none|The number of the customer's bank account. Use this field for direct debit payment methods.<br>|
|bankCode|string|false|none|The sort code or number that identifies the bank. This is also known as the sort code. <br>|
|branchCode|string|false|none|The branch code of the bank used for direct debit.  <br>|
|businessIdentificationCode|string|false|none|The BIC code used for SEPA.<br>|
|currencyCode|string|false|none|The currency used for payment method authorization.<br><br>If this field is not specified, `currency` specified for the account is used for payment method authorization. If no currency is specified for the account, the default currency of the account is then used.<br>|
|identityNumber|string|false|none|The identity number used for Bank Transfer.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the payment method. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

|---|---|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|External|
|mitProfileAction|Activate|
|mitProfileAction|Persist|
|mitProfileType|Recurring|
|mitProfileType|Unscheduled|
|bankAccountType|BusinessChecking|
|bankAccountType|Checking|
|bankAccountType|Saving|

If the CIT succeeds, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Active`. If the CIT does not succeed, Zuora will not create a stored credential profile.<br>  <br>  If the payment gateway does not support the stored credential transaction framework, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Agreed`.<br><br><br>* `Persist` - Use this value if the stored credential profile represents a stored credential profile in an external system. The status of the payment method's stored credential profile will be `Active`.<br>|

|securityCode|string|false|none|The CVV or CVV2 security code for the credit card or debit card. Only required if changing expirationMonth, expirationYear, or cardHolderName. To ensure PCI compliance, this value isn't stored and can't be queried.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_POSTPaymentRunDataElementRequest">POSTPaymentRunDataElementRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostpaymentrundataelementrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_POSTPaymentRunDataElementRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSpostpaymentrundataelementrequest"></a>
<a id="tocspostpaymentrundataelementrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "accountId": "string",
  "amount": 0,
  "comment": "string",
  "documentId": "string",
  "documentType": "Invoice",
  "paymentGatewayId": "string",
  "paymentMethodId": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string|true|none|A valid account ID associated with the payment run.<br><br>If `consolidatedPayment` is set to `true`, this field is used in processing a single payment for invoices/debit memos due on an account.<br>|
|amount|number|false|none|The amount to be collected for the specified invoice/debit memo. `amount` must be a positive numeric value no more than the balance of the specified invoice/debit memo.<br><br>This field is only available when `documentId` is specified. If `amount` is not specified, whole balance of the invoice/debit memo is collected.<br>|
|comment|string|false|none|Additional comments.<br>|
|documentId|string|false|none|The ID of a billing document associated with the payment run. `documentId` must be valid and match with `documentType`.<br><br>You must either specify both `documentId` and `documentType`, or specify neither of them.<br><br>If neither of `documentType` and `documentId` is specified, all invoices/debit memos with open balance of the account are collected.<br>|
|documentType|string|false|none|The type of a billing document associated with the payment run. The value can be `Invoice` or `DebitMemo`, but `DebitMemo` is only supported if the Invoice Settlement feature is enabled.<br><br>You must either specify both `documentType` and `documentId`, or specify neither of them.<br><br>If neither of `documentType` and `documentId` is specified, all invoices/debit memos with open balance of the account are collected.<br>|
|paymentGatewayId|string|false|none|The ID of the payment gateway for collecting invoices/debit memos. The specified payment gateway must be valid and active. If it is not specified, the default payment gateway of the account is used. If no payment gateway is configured for the account, the default payment gateway of the tenant is used.<br><br>If `consolidatedPayment` is set to `true`, this field is used in processing a single payment for invoices/debit memos due on an account.<br>|
|paymentMethodId|string|false|none|The ID of the payment method for collecting invoices/debit memos. The specified payment method must be a valid non-system payment method. If it is not specified, the default payment method of the account is used regardless of the `autoPay` value of the account.<br><br>If `processPaymentWithClosedPM` is set to `false`, the payment method cannot be closed.<br><br>If the payment retry rules are enabled, the payment method must meet the rules.<br><br>If `consolidatedPayment` is set to `true`, this field is used in processing a single payment for invoices/debit memos due on an account.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|documentType|Invoice|
|documentType|DebitMemo|

<h2 id="tocS_POSTPaymentRunRequest">POSTPaymentRunRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostpaymentrunrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_POSTPaymentRunRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSpostpaymentrunrequest"></a>
<a id="tocspostpaymentrunrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "accountId": "402890245f097f39015f0e9fcdd60558",
  "autoApplyCreditMemo": "true",
  "autoApplyUnappliedPayment": "true",
  "consolidatedPayment": "true",
  "processPaymentWithClosedPM": "true",
  "targetDate": "2017-10-10"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string(uuid)|false|none|The ID of the customer account associated with the payment run.<br><br>This field conflicts with each of the `batch`, `billCycleDay`, `currency`, `paymentGatewayId`, and `billingRunId` fields. If there are such conflicts, an error occurs and an error message is returned.<br>|
|applyCreditBalance|boolean|false|none|**Note:** This field is only available if you have the Credit Balance feature enabled and the Invoice Settlement feature disabled.<br><br>Whether to apply credit balances in the payment run. This field is only available when you have Invoice Settlement feature disabled.<br>|
|autoApplyCreditMemo|boolean|false|none|**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br><br>Whether to automatically apply a posted credit memo to one or more receivables in the payment run.<br>|
|autoApplyUnappliedPayment|boolean|false|none|**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br><br>Whether to automatically apply unapplied payments to  one or more receivables in the payment run.<br>|
|batch|string|false|none|The alias name given to a batch. The batch name is a string of 50 characters or less.<br><br>This field conflicts with the `accountId` field. If they are both specified in the request body, an error occurs and an error message is returned. <br>|
|billCycleDay|string|false|none|The billing cycle day (BCD), the day of the month when a bill run generates invoices for the account. The value must be equal to or less then 31, and 31 is mean the EOM.<br><br>This field conflicts with the `accountId` field. If they are both specified in the request body, an error occurs and an error message is returned.<br>|
|billingRunId|string(uuid)|false|none|The ID of a bill run.<br><br>This field conflicts with the `accountId` field. If they are both specified in the request body, an error occurs and an error message is returned.<br>|
|collectPayment|boolean|false|none|Whether to process electronic payments during the execution of payment runs. <br><br>If the Payment user permission "Process Electronic Payment" is disabled, this field will be ignored.<br>|
|consolidatedPayment|boolean|false|none|**Note:** The **Process Electronic Payment** permission also needs to be allowed for a Manage Payment Runs role to work. See [Payments Roles](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CF_Users_and_Administrators/A_Administrator_Settings/User_Roles/e_Payments_Roles) for more information. <br><br>Whether to process a single payment for all receivables that are due on an account.<br>|
|currency|string|false|none|A currency defined in the web-based UI administrative settings.<br><br>This field conflicts with the `accountId` field. If they are both specified in the request body, an error occurs and an error message is returned.<br>|
|data|[[POSTPaymentRunDataElementRequest](#schemapostpaymentrundataelementrequest)]|false|none|<br>The array of data for specifying records of accounts and invoices/debit memos that will be collected and processed by a payment run. A maximum of 50K records are allowed to be passed into the `data` array.<br><br>Here is an example:<br>```<br>  {<br>    "accountId": "60c81b5bc51649e8a7d1b48303194790",<br>    "documentId": "2c9081a03c63c94c013c6894af5602dd",<br>    "documentType": "Invoice",<br>    "amount": 80,<br>    "paymentMethodId": "2c9081a03c6d7b51013c6d7e4ada0a1c",<br>    "paymentGatewayId": "d2abe8342e1811ea80e774b9452e17ea",<br>    "comment": "Payment Comments"<br>  }<br>```<br>|
|paymentGatewayId|string(uuid)|false|none|The ID of the gateway instance that processes the payment.<br><br>This field conflicts with the `accountId` field. If they are both specified in the request body, an error occurs and an error message is returned.<br>|
|processPaymentWithClosedPM|boolean|false|none|**Note:** The **Process Electronic Payment** permission also needs to be allowed for a Manage Payment Runs role to work. See [Payments Roles](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CF_Users_and_Administrators/A_Administrator_Settings/User_Roles/e_Payments_Roles) for more information. <br><br>Whether to process payments even if the default payment method is closed.<br>|
|runDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the scheduled payment run is to be executed, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. The backend will ignore mintues and seconds in the field value. For example, if you specify `2017-03-01 11:30:37` for this value, this payment run will be run at 2017-03-01 11:00:00.<br><br>You must specify either the `runDate` field or the `targetDate` field in the request body. If you specify the `runDate` field, the scheduced payment run is to be executed on the run date. If you specify the `targetDate` field, the payment run is executed immediately after it is created. <br>|
|targetDate|string(date)|false|none|The target date used to determine which receivables to be paid in the payment run. The payments are collected for all receivables with the due date no later than the target date.<br><br>You must specify either the `runDate` field or the `targetDate` field in the request body. If you specify the `runDate` field, the scheduced payment run is to be executed on the run date. If you specify the `targetDate` field, the payment run is executed immediately after it is created. <br>|

{
  "amount": "300",

  "deferredRevenueAccountingCodeType": "Deferred Revenue",

    {

      "newAmount": "200"
    }
  ],

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|string(decimal)|true|none|The revenue schedule amount, which is the sum of all revenue items. This field cannot be null and must be formatted based on the currency, such as `JPY 30` or `USD 30.15`. Test out the currency to ensure you are using the proper formatting otherwise, the response will fail and this error message is returned: `Allocation amount with wrong decimal places.`<br>|
|deferredRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The accounting code for deferred revenue, such as Monthly Recurring Liability. Required only when `overrideChargeAccountingCodes` is `true`. Otherwise, this value is ignored.<br>|
|deferredRevenueAccountingCodeType|string|false|none|The type of the deferred revenue accounting code, such as Deferred Revenue. Required only when `overrideChargeAccountingCodes` is `true`. Otherwise, this value is ignored.<br>|
|notes|string|false|none|Additional information about this record.<br><br>Character Limit: 2,000<br>|
|overrideChargeAccountingCodes|boolean|false|none|When overriding accounting codes from a charge, `recognizedRevenueAccountingCode` and `deferredRevenue AccountingCode` must be in the request body and can have the empty value.<br>|
|recognizedRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The accounting code for recognized revenue, such as Monthly Recurring Charges or Overage Charges. Required only when `overrideChargeAccountingCodes` is `true`. Otherwise, the value is ignored.<br>|
|recognizedRevenueAccountingCodeType|string|false|none|The type of the recognized revenue accounting code, such as Sales Revenue or Sales Discount. Required only when `overrideChargeAccountingCodes` is `true`. Otherwise, this value is ignored.<br>|
|referenceId|string|false|none|Reference ID is used only in the custom unlimited rule to create a revenue schedule. In this scenario, the revenue schedule is not linked to an invoice item or invoice item adjustment.<br><br>Character Limit: 100<br>|
|revenueDistributions|[[POSTDistributionItemType](#schemapostdistributionitemtype)]|false|none|An array of revenue distributions. Represents how you want to distribute revenue for this revenue schedule. You can distribute revenue into a maximum of 250 accounting periods with one revenue schedule.<br><br>The sum of the newAmount fields must be equal to the amount field.<br>|
|revenueEvent|[POSTRevenueScheduleByChargeTypeRevenueEvent](#schemapostrevenueschedulebychargetyperevenueevent)|false|none|Represents a change to a revenue schedule, such as posting an invoice or distributing revenue.<br>|
|revenueScheduleDate|string(date)|true|none|The effective date of the revenue schedule. For example, the revenue schedule date for bookings-based revenue recognition is typically set to the order date or contract date.<br><br>The date cannot be in a closed accounting period. The date must be in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Revenue Schedule object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_POSTRevenueScheduleByDateRangeType">POSTRevenueScheduleByDateRangeType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostrevenueschedulebydaterangetype"></a>
<a id="schema_POSTRevenueScheduleByDateRangeType"></a>
<a id="tocSpostrevenueschedulebydaterangetype"></a>
<a id="tocspostrevenueschedulebydaterangetype"></a>

```json
{
  "distributionType": "Daily distribution",
  "notes": "Manually distribute revenue by usage",
  "recognitionEnd": "2016-12-31",
  "recognitionStart": "2016-12-1",
  "revenueEvent": {
    "eventType": "Revenue Distributed",
    "eventTypeSystemId": "RevenueDistributed__z",
    "notes": ""
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|distributionType|string|false|none|How you want to distribute the revenue. <br><br><br>* Daily Distribution: Distributes revenue evenly across each day between the recognitionStart and recognitionEnd dates.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Back Load): Back loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the end only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Front Load): Front loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the beginning only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Proration by Days): Splits the revenue amount between the two partial months.<br><br>**Note:** To use any of the Monthly Distribution options, you must have the "Monthly recognition over time" model enabled in **Settings > Finance > Manage Revenue Recognition Models** in the Zuora UI.<br>|
|notes|string|false|none|Additional information about this record.<br>|
|recognitionEnd|string(date)|true|none|The end date of a recognition period in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. <br><br>The maximum difference between the `recognitionStart` and `recognitionEnd` date fields is equal to 250 multiplied by the length of an accounting period.<br>|
|recognitionStart|string(date)|true|none|The start date of a recognition period in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br><br>If there is a closed accounting period between the `recognitionStart` and `recognitionEnd` dates, the revenue that would be placed in the closed accounting period is instead placed in the next open accounting period.<br>|
|revenueEvent|[POSTRevenueScheduleByDateRangeTypeRevenueEvent](#schemapostrevenueschedulebydaterangetyperevenueevent)|true|none|Must specify at least one of `eventType` or `eventTypeSystemId`.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Revenue Schedule object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|distributionType|Daily Distribution|
|distributionType|Monthly Distribution (Back Load)|
|distributionType|Monthly Distribution (Front Load)|
|distributionType|Monthly Distribution (Proration by Days)|

|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Revenue Event object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. |Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|applyDiscountTo|string|false|none|Specifies the type of charges that you want a specific discount to apply to.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `ONETIME`<br>* `RECURRING`<br>* `USAGE`<br>* `ONETIMERECURRING`<br>* `ONETIMEUSAGE`<br>* `RECURRINGUSAGE`<br>* `ONETIMERECURRINGUSAGE`<br>|
|billCycleDay|string|false|none|Sets the bill cycle day (BCD) for the charge. The BCD determines which day of the month the customer is billed.<br><br>Values: `1`-`31`<br>|
|billCycleType|string|false|none|Specifies how to determine the billing day for the charge. When this field is set to `SpecificDayofMonth`, set the `BillCycleDay` field. When this field is set to `SpecificDayofWeek`, set the `weeklyBillCycleDay` field.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `DefaultFromCustomer`<br>* `SpecificDayofMonth`<br>* `SubscriptionStartDay`<br>* `ChargeTriggerDay`<br>* `SpecificDayofWeek`<br>|
|billingPeriod|string|false|none|Billing period for the charge. The start day of the billing period is also called the bill cycle day (BCD).<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `Month`<br>* `Quarter`<br>* `Semi_Annual`<br>* `Annual`<br>* `Eighteen_Months`<br>* `Two_Years`<br>* `Three_Years`<br>* `Five_Years`<br>* `Specific_Months`<br>* `Subscription_Term`<br>* `Week`<br>* `Specific_Weeks`<br>|
|billingPeriodAlignment|string|false|none|Aligns charges within the same subscription if multiple charges begin on different dates.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `AlignToCharge`<br>* `AlignToSubscriptionStart`<br>* `AlignToTermStart`<br>|
|billingTiming|string|false|none|Billing timing for the charge for recurring charge types. Not avaliable for one time, usage, and discount charges.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `IN_ADVANCE` (default)<br>* `IN_ARREARS`<br>|
|chargeModelConfiguration|[ChargeModelConfigurationType](#schemachargemodelconfigurationtype)|false|none|Container for charge model configuration data.<br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you have the High Water Mark, Pre-Rated Pricing, or Multi-Attribute Pricing charge models enabled. These charge models are available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the charge.<br>|
|discountAmount|number|false|none|Specifies the amount of fixed-amount discount.<br>|
|discountLevel|string|false|none|Specifies if the discount applies to the product rate plan only, the entire subscription, or to any activity in the account.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `rateplan`<br>* `subscription`<br>* `account`<br>|
|discountPercentage|number|false|none|Percentage of discount for a percentage discount. <br>|
|endDateCondition|string|false|none|Defines when the charge ends after the charge trigger date. If the subscription ends before the charge end date, the charge ends when the subscription ends. But if the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge will end on the charge end date.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `Subscription_End`<br>* `Fixed_Period`<br>* `Specific_End_Date`<br>|
|includedUnits|number|false|none|Specifies the number of units in the base set of units for this charge. Must be >=`0`.<br>|
|listPriceBase|string|false|none|The list price base for the product rate plan charge.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `Per_Billing_Period`<br>* `Per_Month`<br>* `Per_Week`<br>|
|number|string|false|none|Unique number that identifies the charge. Max 50 characters. System-generated if not provided.<br>|
|numberOfPeriods|integer(int64)|false|none|Specifies the number of periods to use when calculating charges in an overage smoothing charge model.<br>|
|overagePrice|number|false|none|Price for units over the allowed amount.<br>|
|overageUnusedUnitsCreditOption|string|false|none|Determines whether to credit the customer with unused units of usage.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `NoCredit`<br>* `CreditBySpecificRate`<br>|
|price|number|false|none|Price for units in the subscription rate plan.<br>|
|priceChangeOption|string|false|none|Applies an automatic price change when a termed subscription is renewed. The Billing Admin setting **Enable Automatic Price Change When Subscriptions are Renewed?** must be set to Yes to use this field.<br>Values:<br><br>* `NoChange` (default)<br>* `SpecificPercentageValue`<br>* `UseLatestProductCatalogPricing`<br>|
|priceIncreasePercentage|number|false|none|Specifies the percentage to increase or decrease the price of a termed subscription's renewal. Required if you set the `PriceChangeOption` field to `SpecificPercentageValue`. <br><br>Value must be a decimal between `-100` and `100`.<br>|
|productRatePlanChargeId|string|true|none|ID of a product rate-plan charge for this subscription.<br>|
|quantity|number|false|none|Number of units. Must be a decimal >=`0`. <br><br>When using `chargeOverrides` for creating subscriptions with recurring charge types, the `quantity` field must be populated when the charge model is "Tiered Pricing" or "Volume Pricing". It is not required for "Flat Fee Pricing" charge model.<br>|
|ratingGroup|string|false|none|Specifies a rating group based on which usage records are rated.<br><br>Possible values:<br><br>- `ByBillingPeriod` (default): The rating is based on all the usages in a billing period.<br>- `ByUsageStartDate`: The rating is based on all the usages on the same usage start date. <br>- `ByUsageRecord`: The rating is based on each usage record.<br>- `ByUsageUpload`: The rating is based on all the  usages in a uploaded usage file (`.xls` or `.csv`).<br>- `ByGroupId`: The rating is based on all the usages in a custom group.<br><br>**Note:** <br>- The `ByBillingPeriod` value can be applied for all charge models. <br>- The `ByUsageStartDate`, `ByUsageRecord`, and `ByUsageUpload` values can only be applied for per unit, volume pricing, and tiered pricing charge models. <br>- The `ByGroupId` value is only available if you have the Active Rating feature enabled.<br>- Use this field only for Usage charges. One-Time Charges and Recurring Charges return `NULL`.<br>|
|specificBillingPeriod|integer(int64)|false|none|Specifies the number of month or week for the charges billing period. Required if you set the value of the `billingPeriod` field to `Specific_Months` or `Specific_Weeks`.<br>|
|specificEndDate|string(date)|false|none|Defines when the charge ends after the charge trigger date.<br><br>**note:**<br><br>* This field is only applicable when the `endDateCondition` field is set to `Specific_End_Date`.<br><br>* If the subscription ends before the specific end date, the charge ends when the subscription ends. But if the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge will end on the specific end date.<br>|
|tiers|[[POSTTierType](#schemaposttiertype)]|false|none|Container for Volume, Tiered, or Tiered with Overage charge models. Supports the following charge types:<br><br>* One-time<br>* Recurring<br>* Usage-based<br>|
|triggerDate|string(date)|false|none|Specifies when to start billing the customer for the charge. Required if the `triggerEvent` field is set to `USD`.<br>|
|triggerEvent|string|false|none|Specifies when to start billing the customer for the charge.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `UCE`<br>* `USA`<br>* `UCA`<br>* `USD`<br>|
|unusedUnitsCreditRates|number|false|none|Specifies the rate to credit a customer for unused units of usage. This field applies only for overage charge models when the `OverageUnusedUnitsCreditOption` field is set to `CreditBySpecificRate`.<br>|
|upToPeriods|integer(int64)|false|none|Specifies the length of the period during which the charge is active. If this period ends before the subscription ends, the charge ends when this period ends.<br><br>**Note:** You must use this field together with the `upToPeriodsType` field to specify the time period.<br><br>* This field is applicable only when the `endDateCondition` field is set to `Fixed_Period`. <br>* If the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge end date will change accordingly up to the original period end.<br>|
|upToPeriodsType|string|false|none|<br>The period type used to define when the charge ends. <br><br>Values:<br><br>* `Billing_Periods`<br>* `Days`<br>* `Weeks`<br>* `Months`<br>* `Years`<br><br>You must use this field together with the `upToPeriods` field to specify the time period.<br><br>This field is applicable only when the `endDateCondition` field is set to `Fixed_Period`. <br>|
|weeklyBillCycleDay|string|false|none|Specifies which day of the week is the bill cycle day (BCD) for the charge. <br><br>Values:<br><br>* `Sunday`<br>* `Monday`<br>* `Tuesday`<br>* `Wednesday`<br>* `Thursday`<br>* `Friday`<br>* `Saturday`<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Rate Plan Charge object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string|false|none|The ID of the customer account that the payment is for.<br>|
|amount|number(double)|false|none|The total amount of the payment.<br>|
|appliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The applied amount of the payment.<br>|
|authTransactionId|string|false|none|The authorization transaction ID from the payment gateway.<br>|
|bankIdentificationNumber|string|false|none|The first six digits of the credit card or debit card used for the payment, when applicable.<br>|
|cancelledOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was cancelled, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|comment|string|false|none|Comments about the payment.<br>|
|createdById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who created the refund.<br>|
|createdDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the chargeback is created, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2019-03-01 15:31:10.<br>|
|creditBalanceAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount that the payment transfers to the credit balance. The value is not `0` only for those payments that come from legacy payment operations performed without the Invoice Settlement feature.<br>|
|currency|string|false|none|A currency defined in the web-based UI administrative settings.<br>|
|effectiveDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment takes effect, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|financeInformation|object|false|none|Container for the finance information related to the refund.<br>|
|gatewayId|string|false|none|The ID of the gateway instance that processes the payment.<br>|
|gatewayOrderId|string|false|none|A merchant-specified natural key value that can be passed to the electronic payment gateway when a payment is created. If not specified, the payment number will be passed in instead.<br>|
|gatewayResponse|string|false|none|The message returned from the payment gateway for the payment. This message is gateway-dependent.<br>|
|gatewayResponseCode|string|false|none|The code returned from the payment gateway for the payment. This code is gateway-dependent.<br>|
|gatewayState|string|false|none|The status of the payment in the gateway; used for reconciliation.<br>|
|id|string|false|none|The ID of the payment chargeback.<br>|
|markedForSubmissionOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when a charge was marked and waiting for batch submission to the payment process, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|number|string|false|none|The unique identification number of the payment. For example, P-00000001.<br>|
|paymentMethodId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment method that the customer used to make the payment.<br>|
|paymentMethodSnapshotId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment method snapshot which is a copy of the particular Payment Method used in a transaction.<br>|
|referenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway for an electronic refund. Use this field to reconcile refunds between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|refundAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of the payment that is refunded.<br>|
|secondPaymentReferenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway if there is an additional transaction for the payment. <br>|
|settledOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the transaction is settled, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|softDescriptor|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps Zuora to other gateways.<br>|
|softDescriptorPhone|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps Zuora to other gateways.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the payment.<br>|
|submittedOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was submitted, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format.<br>|
|success|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the request is processed successfully.<br>|
|type|string|false|none|The type of the payment.<br>|
|unappliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The unapplied amount of the payment.<br>|
|updatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who last updated the payment.<br>|
|updatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was last updated, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. For example, 2019-03-02 15:36:10.<br>|

|gatewayState|Submitted|
|gatewayState|Settled|
|gatewayState|NotSubmitted|
|gatewayState|FailedToSettle|
|type|External|
|type|Electronic|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cancelledDate|string(date)|false|none|The date that the subscription was canceled.<br>|
|creditMemoId|string|false|none|The credit memo ID, if a credit memo is generated during the subscription process.<br><br>**Note:** This container is only available if you set the Zuora REST API minor version to 207.0 or later in the request header, and you have  [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|invoiceId|string|false|none|ID of the invoice, if one is generated.<br>|
|paidAmount|number|false|none|Amount paid.<br>|
|paymentId|string|false|none|ID of the payment, if a payment is collected.<br>|
|subscriptionId|string|false|none|The subscription ID.<br>|
|success|boolean|false|none|Returns `true` if the request was processed successfully.<br>|
|totalDeltaMrr|number|false|none|Change in the subscription monthly recurring revenue as a result of the update.<br>|
|totalDeltaTcv|number|false|none|Change in the total contracted value of the subscription as a result of the update.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_POSTSubscriptionCancellationType">POSTSubscriptionCancellationType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostsubscriptioncancellationtype"></a>
<a id="schema_POSTSubscriptionCancellationType"></a>
<a id="tocSpostsubscriptioncancellationtype"></a>
<a id="tocspostsubscriptioncancellationtype"></a>

```json
{
  "cancellationEffectiveDate": "2019-05-31",
  "cancellationPolicy": "SpecificDate",
  "collect": false,
  "runBilling": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|applicationOrder|[string]|false|none|The priority order to apply credit memos and/or unapplied payments to an invoice. Possible item values are: `CreditMemo`, `UnappliedPayment`.<br><br>**Note:**<br>  - This field is valid only if the `applyCredit` field is set to `true`.<br>  - If no value is specified for this field, the default priority order is used, ["CreditMemo", "UnappliedPayment"], to apply credit memos first and then apply unapplied payments.<br>  - If only one item is specified, only the items of the spedified type are applied to invoices. For example, if the value is `["CreditMemo"]`, only credit memos are used to apply to invoices.<br>|
|applyCredit|boolean|false|none|Whether to automatically apply credit memos or unapplied payments, or both to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit memo or unapplied payment, or both will be automatically applied to the invoice. If no value is specified or the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|applyCreditBalance|boolean|false|none|Whether to automatically apply a credit balance to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit balance is applied to the invoice. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br><br>To view the credit balance adjustment, retrieve the details of the invoice using the Get Invoices method.<br><br>Prerequisite: `invoice` must be `true`. <br><br>**Note:** <br>  - If you are using the field `invoiceCollect` rather than the field `invoice`, the `invoiceCollect` value must be `true`.<br>  - This field is deprecated if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br>|
|cancellationEffectiveDate|string(date)|false|none|Date the cancellation takes effect, in the format yyyy-mm-dd.  Use only if `cancellationPolicy` is `SpecificDate`. Should not be earlier than the subscription contract-effective date, later than the subscription term-end date, or within a period for which the customer has been invoiced.<br>|
|cancellationPolicy|string|true|none|Cancellation method. Possible values are: `EndOfCurrentTerm`, `EndOfLastInvoicePeriod`, `SpecificDate`. If using `SpecificDate`, the `cancellationEffectiveDate` field is required.<br>|
|collect|boolean|false|none|Collects an automatic payment for a subscription. The collection generated in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer account.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the automatic payment is collected. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>Prerequisite: The `invoice` or `runBilling` field must be `true`. <br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `196.0` or later.<br>|
|contractEffectiveDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the customer notifies you that they want to cancel their subscription.<br>|
|documentDate|string(date)|false|none|The date of the billing document, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. It represents the invoice date for invoices, credit memo date for credit memos, and debit memo date for debit memos.<br><br>- If this field is specified, the specified date is used as the billing document date. <br>- If this field is not specified, the date specified in the `targetDate` is used as the billing document date.<br>|
|invoice|boolean|false|none|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `runBilling` field. The<br>`invoice` field is only available for backward compatibility.<br><br><br>Creates an invoice for a subscription. The invoice generated in this<br>operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer<br>account.<br><br><br>If the value is `true`, an invoice is created. If the value is<br>`false`, no action is taken. The default value is `false`. <br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `196.0` and `207.0`. To use this field in the method, you<br>must set the zuora-version parameter to the minor version number in<br>the request header. <br>|
|invoiceCollect|boolean|true|none|This field has been replaced by the `invoice` field and the<br>`collect` field. `invoiceCollect` is available only for backward compatibility.<br><br>If this field is set to `true`, an invoice is generated and payment automatically collected.<br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `186.0`, `187.0`, `188.0`, or `189.0`.<br>|
|invoiceTargetDate|string(date)|false|none|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `targetDate` field. The<br>`invoiceTargetDate` field is only available for backward<br>compatibility.<br><br><br>Date through which to calculate charges if an invoice is generated, as<br>yyyy-mm-dd. Default is current date.<br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `207.0` and earlier.  <br>|
|runBilling|boolean|false|none|Creates an invoice for a subscription. If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created based on the [invoice and credit memo generation rule](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Invoice_Settlement/Credit_and_Debit_Memos/Rules_for_Generating_Invoices_and_Credit_Memos).  <br><br><br>The billing documents generated<br>in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire<br>customer account.<br><br><br>Possible values:<br><br>- `true`: An invoice is created. If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created.<br><br><br>- `false`: No invoice is created.<br><br><br>**Note:** This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported<br>minor versions are `211.0` or later. To use this field in the method,<br>you must set the `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number<br>in the request header.<br>|
|targetDate|string(date)|false|none|Date through which to calculate charges if an invoice or a credit memo is generated, as<br>yyyy-mm-dd. Default is current date.<br><br><br>**Note:** The credit memo is only available if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `211.0` and later. To use this field in the method, you<br>must set the  `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number in<br>the request header.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|runBilling|true|
|runBilling|false|

<h2 id="tocS_POSTSubscriptionPreviewTypePreviewAccountInfo">POSTSubscriptionPreviewTypePreviewAccountInfo</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostsubscriptionpreviewtypepreviewaccountinfo"></a>
<a id="schema_POSTSubscriptionPreviewTypePreviewAccountInfo"></a>
<a id="tocSpostsubscriptionpreviewtypepreviewaccountinfo"></a>
<a id="tocspostsubscriptionpreviewtypepreviewaccountinfo"></a>

```json
{
  "billCycleDay": 0,
  "billToContact": {
    "city": "string",
    "country": "string",
    "county": "string",
    "state": "string",
    "taxRegion": "string",
    "zipCode": "string"
  },
  "currency": "string",
  "Class__NS": "string",
  "CustomerType__NS": "Company",
  "Department__NS": "string",
  "IntegrationId__NS": "string",
  "IntegrationStatus__NS": "string",
  "Location__NS": "string",
  "Subsidiary__NS": "string",
  "SyncDate__NS": "string",
  "SynctoNetSuite__NS": "Yes",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

A container for providing a customer account information if you do not have an existing customer account. This customer account information is only used for subscription preview.

You must specify the account information either in this field or in the `accountKey` field with the following conditions:

* If you already have a customer account, specify the account number or ID in the accountKey field.
* If you do not have a customer account, provide account information in this field.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|billCycleDay|integer(int64)|true|none|The account's bill cycle day (BCD), when bill runs generate invoices for the account. Specify any day of the month (`1`-`31`, where `31` = end-of-month), or `0` for auto-set.<br>|
|billToContact|object|true|none|Container for bill-to contact information of this account.<br>|
|currency|string|true|none|A currency as defined in Billing Settings.<br>|
|Class__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Class field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|CustomerType__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Customer Type field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. The Customer Type field is used when the customer account is created in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Department__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Department field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the account's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Location__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Location field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Subsidiary__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Subsidiary field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. The Subsidiary field is required if you use NetSuite OneWorld. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the account was sychronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SynctoNetSuite__NS|string|false|none|Specifies whether the account should be synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Account object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|CustomerType__NS|Company|
|CustomerType__NS|Individual|
|SynctoNetSuite__NS|Yes|
|SynctoNetSuite__NS|No|

  "creditMemoId": "string",
  "invoiceId": "string",

  "success": true,

}

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|contractedMrr|number|false|none|Monthly recurring revenue of the subscription.<br>|
|creditMemoId|string|false|none|The credit memo ID, if a credit memo is generated during the subscription process.<br><br>**Note:** This container is only available if you set the Zuora REST API minor version to 207.0 or later in the request header, and you have  [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|invoiceId|string|false|none|Invoice ID, if an invoice is generated during the subscription process.<br>|
|paidAmount|number|false|none|Payment amount, if a payment is collected.<br>|
|paymentId|string|false|none|Payment ID, if a payment is collected.<br>|
|subscriptionId|string|false|none|none|
|subscriptionNumber|string|false|none|none|
|success|boolean|false|none|Returns `true` if the request was processed successfully.<br>|
|totalContractedValue|number|false|none|Total contracted value of the subscription.<br>|

### Properties

Possible item values are: `CreditMemo`, `UnappliedPayment`.<br><br>**Note:**<br>  - This field is valid only if the `applyCredit` field is set to `true`.<br>  - If no value is specified for this field, the default priority order is used, ["CreditMemo", "UnappliedPayment"], to apply credit memos first and then apply unapplied payments.<br>  - If only one item is specified, only the items of the spedified type are applied to invoices. |SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the credit memo was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Transaction__NS|string|false|none|Related transaction in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Credit Memo object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. |amountPerUnit|number|false|none|The actual charged amount per unit for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|billTargetDate|string(date)|false|none|The target date for the Order Line Item (OLI) to be picked up by bill run for generating invoice.<br><br>To generate invoice for an OLI, you must set this field and set the `itemState` field to `SentToBilling`.<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|customFields|[OrderLineItemCustomFields](#schemaorderlineitemcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of an Order Line Item object.<br>|
|deferredRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The deferred revenue accounting code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|itemName|string|false|none|The name of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|itemNumber|string|false|none|The number for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|itemState|string|false|none|The state of the Order Line Item (OLI). See [Order Line Item states, Order states, and state transitions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AB_Order_Line_Item_States_and_Order_States) for more information.<br><br>To generate invoice for an OLI, you must set this field to `SentToBilling` and set the `billTargetDate` field .<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` or `SentToBilling`state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing` or `SentToBilling`).<br>|
|itemType|string|false|none|The type of the Order Line Item (OLI). <br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|listPricePerUnit|number|false|none|The list price per unit for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|productCode|string|false|none|The product code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|purchaseOrderNumber|string|false|none|Used by customers to specify the Purchase Order Number provided by the buyer.<br><br>You can update this field for an Order Line Item (OLI) only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|quantity|number|false|none|The quantity of units, such as the number of authors in a hosted wiki service.<br><br>You can update this field for an Order Line Item (OLI) only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|recognizedRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The recognized revenue accounting code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|revenueRecognitionRule|string|false|none|The Revenue Recognition rule for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|taxCode|string|false|none|The tax code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|taxMode|string|false|none|The tax mode for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|transactionDate|string(date)|false|none|The transaction date of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
