The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br><br>Whether to automatically apply a posted credit memo to one or more receivables in the payment run.<br>|
|autoApplyUnappliedPayment|boolean|false|none|**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br><br>Whether to automatically apply unapplied payments to  one or more receivables in the payment run.<br>|
|batch|string|false|none|The alias name given to a batch. The batch name is a string of 50 characters or less.<br><br>This field conflicts with the `accountId` field. If they are both specified in the request body, an error occurs and an error message is returned. <br>|
|billCycleDay|string|false|none|The billing cycle day (BCD), the day of the month when a bill run generates invoices for the account. The value must be equal to or less then 31, and 31 is mean the EOM.<br><br>This field conflicts with the `accountId` field. If they are both specified in the request body, an error occurs and an error message is returned.<br>|
|billingRunId|string(uuid)|false|none|The ID of a bill run.<br><br>This field conflicts with the `accountId` field. If they are both specified in the request body, an error occurs and an error message is returned.<br>|
|collectPayment|boolean|false|none|Whether to process electronic payments during the execution of payment runs. <br><br>If the Payment user permission "Process Electronic Payment" is disabled, this field will be ignored.<br>|
|consolidatedPayment|boolean|false|none|**Note:** The **Process Electronic Payment** permission also needs to be allowed for a Manage Payment Runs role to work. See [Payments Roles](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CF_Users_and_Administrators/A_Administrator_Settings/User_Roles/e_Payments_Roles) for more information. <br><br>Whether to process a single payment for all receivables that are due on an account.<br>|
|currency|string|false|none|A currency defined in the web-based UI administrative settings.<br><br>This field conflicts with the `accountId` field. If they are both specified in the request body, an error occurs and an error message is returned.<br>|
|paymentGatewayId|string(uuid)|false|none|The ID of the gateway instance that processes the payment.<br><br>This field conflicts with the `accountId` field. If they are both specified in the request body, an error occurs and an error message is returned.<br>|
|processPaymentWithClosedPM|boolean|false|none|**Note:** The **Process Electronic Payment** permission also needs to be allowed for a Manage Payment Runs role to work. See [Payments Roles](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CF_Users_and_Administrators/A_Administrator_Settings/User_Roles/e_Payments_Roles) for more information. <br><br>Whether to process payments even if the default payment method is closed.<br>|
|runDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the scheduled payment run is to be executed, in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` format. The backend will ignore mintues and seconds in the field value. For example, if you specify `2017-03-01 11:30:37` for this value, this payment run will be run at 2017-03-01 11:00:00.<br>|
|targetDate|string(date)|false|none|The target date used to determine which receivables to be paid in the payment run. The payments are collected for all receivables with the due date no later than the target date.<br>|

```json
  "distributionType": "Daily distribution",

  "recognitionStart": "2015-12-1"
```

|distributionType|string|false|none|How you want to distribute the revenue. <br><br><br>* Daily Distribution: Distributes revenue evenly across each day between the recognitionStart and recognitionEnd dates.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Back Load): Back loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the end only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Front Load): Front loads the revenue so you distribute the monthly amount in the partial month in the beginning only.<br>* Monthly Distribution (Proration by Days): Splits the revenue amount between the two partial months.<br><br>**Note:** To use any of the Monthly Distribution options, you must have the "Monthly recognition over time" model enabled in **Settings > Finance > Manage Revenue Recognition Models** in the Zuora UI.<br>|
|eventType|string|false|none|Label of the revenue event type. Revenue event type labels can be duplicated. You can configure your revenue event type labels by navigating to **Settings > Finance > Configure Revenue Event Types** in the Zuora UI.<br><br>Note that `Credit Memo Posted` and `Debit Memo Posted` are only available if you enable the Invoice Settlement feature.<br>|
|eventTypeSystemId|string|false|none|System ID of the revenue event type. Each eventType has a unique system ID. You can configure your revenue event type system IDs by navigating to **Settings > Finance > Configure Revenue Event Types** in the Zuora UI.<br>|
|notes|string|false|none|Additional information about this record.<br>|
|recognitionEnd|string(date)|true|none|The end date of a recognition period in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. <br><br>The maximum difference between the `recognitionStart` and `recognitionEnd` date fields is equal to 250 multiplied by the length of an accounting period.<br>|
|recognitionStart|string(date)|true|none|The start date of a recognition period in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.<br><br>If there is a closed accounting period between the `recognitionStart` and `recognitionEnd` dates, the revenue that would be placed in the closed accounting period is instead placed in the next open accounting period.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Revenue Event object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|

|totalDeltaMrr|number|false|none|Change in the subscription monthly recurring revenue as a result of the update. For a renewal, this is the MRR of the subscription in the new term.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_PUTRenewSubscriptionType">PUTRenewSubscriptionType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaputrenewsubscriptiontype"></a>
<a id="schema_PUTRenewSubscriptionType"></a>

<a id="tocsputrenewsubscriptiontype"></a>

```json
{
  "collect": false,
  "runBilling": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|applicationOrder|[string]|false|none|The priority order to apply credit memos and/or unapplied payments to an invoice. Possible item values are: `CreditMemo`, `UnappliedPayment`.<br><br>**Note:**<br>  - This field is valid only if the `applyCredit` field is set to `true`.<br>  - If no value is specified for this field, the default priority order is used, ["CreditMemo", "UnappliedPayment"], to apply credit memos first and then apply unapplied payments.<br>  - If only one item is specified, only the items of the spedified type are applied to invoices. For example, if the value is `["CreditMemo"]`, only credit memos are used to apply to invoices.<br>|
|applyCredit|boolean|false|none|Whether to automatically apply credit memos or unapplied payments, or both to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit memo or unapplied payment, or both will be automatically applied to the invoice. If no value is specified or the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|applyCreditBalance|boolean|false|none|Whether to automatically apply a credit balance to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit balance is applied to the invoice. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br><br>To view the credit balance adjustment, retrieve the details of the invoice using the Get Invoices method.<br><br>Prerequisite: `invoice` must be `true`. <br><br>**Note:** <br>  - If you are using the field `invoiceCollect` rather than the field `invoice`, the `invoiceCollect` value must be `true`.<br>  - This field is deprecated if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br>|
|collect|boolean|false|none|Collects an automatic payment for a subscription. The collection generated in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer account.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the automatic payment is collected. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>Prerequisite: The `invoice` or `runBilling` field must be `true`. <br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `196.0` or later.<br>|
|documentDate|string(date)|false|none|The date of the billing document, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. It represents the invoice date for invoices, credit memo date for credit memos, and debit memo date for debit memos.<br><br>- If this field is specified, the specified date is used as the billing document date. <br>- If this field is not specified, the date specified in the `targetDate` is used as the billing document date.<br>|
|invoice|boolean|false|none|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `runBilling` field. The<br>`invoice` field is only available for backward compatibility.<br><br><br>Creates an invoice for a subscription. The invoice generated in this<br>operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer<br>account.<br><br><br>If the value is `true`, an invoice is created. If the value is<br>`false`, no action is taken. The default value is `false`. <br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `196.0` and `207.0`. To use this field in the method, you<br>must set the zuora-version parameter to the minor version number in<br>the request header. <br>|
|invoiceCollect|boolean|false|none|**Note:** This field has been replaced by the `invoice` field<br>and the `collect` field. `invoiceCollect` is available only for backward compatibility.<br><br><br>If this field is set to `true`, an invoice is generated and payment collected automatically during the subscription process. If `false`, no invoicing or payment takes place. The invoice generated in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer account.<br><br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `186.0`, `187.0`, `188.0`, or `189.0`.<br>|

The<br>`invoiceTargetDate` field is only available for backward<br>compatibility.<br><br><br>Date through which to calculate charges if an invoice is generated, as<br>yyyy-mm-dd. Default is current date.<br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `207.0` and earlier.  <br>|
|runBilling|boolean|false|none|Creates an invoice for a subscription. If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created based on the [invoice and credit memo generation rule](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Invoice_Settlement/Credit_and_Debit_Memos/Rules_for_Generating_Invoices_and_Credit_Memos).  <br><br><br>The billing documents generated<br>in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire<br>customer account.<br><br><br>Possible values:<br><br>- `true`: An invoice is created. If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, a credit memo might also be created.<br><br><br>- `false`: No invoice is created.<br><br><br>**Note:** This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported<br>minor versions are `211.0` or later. To use this field in the method,<br>you must set the `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number<br>in the request header.<br>|
|targetDate|string(date)|false|none|Date through which to calculate charges if an invoice or a credit memo is generated, as<br>yyyy-mm-dd. Default is current date.<br><br><br>**Note:** The credit memo is only available if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br><br><br>This field is in Zuora REST API version control. Supported minor<br>versions are `211.0` and later. To use this field in the method, you<br>must set the  `zuora-version` parameter to the minor version number in<br>the request header.<br>|

|discountAmount|number|false|none|Specifies the amount of fixed-amount discount.<br><br>Available for the following charge type for the Discount-Fixed Amount charge model:<br><br>* Recurring<br>|

|listPriceBase|string|false|none|The list price base for the product rate plan charge.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `Per_Billing_Period`<br>* `Per_Month`<br>* `Per_Week`<br><br>Available for the following charge type for the Flat Fee, Per Unit, Volume Pricing, and Tiered Pricing charge models:<br><br>* Recurring<br>|
|number|string|false|none|Unique number that identifies the charge. System-generated if not provided.<br>|

|price|number|false|none|Price for units in the subscription rate plan.<br><br>Supports all charge types for the Flat Fee and Per Unit charge models<br>|

|priceIncreasePercentage|number|false|none|Specifies the percentage to increase or decrease the price of a termed subscription's renewal. |productRatePlanChargeId|string|true|none|none|
|quantity|number|false|none|Number of units. Must be >=`0`.<br><br>Available for the following charge types for the Per Unit, Volume Pricing, and Tiered Pricing charge models:<br><br>* One-time<br>* Recurring<br>|
|ratingGroup|string|false|none|Specifies a rating group based on which usage records are rated.<br><br>Possible values:<br><br>- `ByBillingPeriod` (default): The rating is based on all the usages in a billing period.<br>- `ByUsageStartDate`: The rating is based on all the usages on the same usage start date. <br>- `ByUsageRecord`: The rating is based on each usage record.<br>- `ByUsageUpload`: The rating is based on all the  usages in a uploaded usage file (`.xls` or `.csv`).<br>- `ByGroupId`: The rating is based on all the usages in a custom group.<br><br>**Note:** <br>- The `ByBillingPeriod` value can be applied for all charge models. <br>- The `ByUsageStartDate`, `ByUsageRecord`, and `ByUsageUpload` values can only be applied for per unit, volume pricing, and tiered pricing charge models. <br>- The `ByGroupId` value is only available if you have the Active Rating feature enabled.<br>- Use this field only for Usage charges. One-Time Charges and Recurring Charges return `NULL`.<br>|
|specificBillingPeriod|integer(int64)|false|none|Specifies the number of month or week for the charges billing period. |tiers|[[POSTTierType](#schemaposttiertype)]|false|none|Container for Volume, Tiered or Tiered with Overage charge models. Supports the following charge types:<br><br>* One-time<br>* Recurring<br>* Usage-based<br>|
|triggerDate|string(date)|false|none|Specifies when to start billing the customer for the charge. Required if the `triggerEvent` field is set to `USD`.<br>|
|triggerEvent|string|false|none|Specifies when to start billing the customer for the charge.<br><br>Values:<br><br>* `UCE`<br>* `USA`<br>* `UCA`<br>* `USD`<br>|
|unusedUnitsCreditRates|number|false|none|Specifies the rate to credit a customer for unused units of usage. |upToPeriods|integer(int64)|false|none|The period type used to define when the charge ends. <br><br>Values:<br><br>* `Billing_Periods`<br>* `Days`<br>* `Weeks`<br>* `Months`<br>* `Years`<br><br>You must use this field together with the `upToPeriods` field to specify the time period.<br><br>This field is applicable only when the `endDateCondition` field is set to `Fixed_Period`. <br>|
|upToPeriodsType|string|false|none|The period type used to define when the charge ends. <br><br>Values:<br><br>* `Billing_Periods`<br>* `Days`<br>* `Weeks`<br>* `Months`<br>* `Years`<br><br>You must use this field together with the `upToPeriods` field to specify the time period.<br><br>This field is applicable only when the `endDateCondition` field is set to `Fixed_Period`. <br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Rate Plan Charge object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. <!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaputsubscriptionresumetype"></a>

<a id="tocSputsubscriptionresumetype"></a>
<a id="tocsputsubscriptionresumetype"></a>

```json
{
  "collect": false,
  "contractEffectiveDate": "2019-02-01",
  "extendsTerm": true,
  "resumePolicy": "SpecificDate",
  "resumeSpecificDate": "2019-10-01",
  "runBilling": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|applicationOrder|[string]|false|none|The priority order to apply credit memos and/or unapplied payments to an invoice. Possible item values are: `CreditMemo`, `UnappliedPayment`.<br><br>**Note:**<br>  - This field is valid only if the `applyCredit` field is set to `true`.<br>  - If no value is specified for this field, the default priority order is used, ["CreditMemo", "UnappliedPayment"], to apply credit memos first and then apply unapplied payments.<br>  - If only one item is specified, only the items of the spedified type are applied to invoices. For example, if the value is `["CreditMemo"]`, only credit memos are used to apply to invoices.<br>|
|applyCredit|boolean|false|none|Whether to automatically apply credit memos or unapplied payments, or both to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit memo or unapplied payment, or both will be automatically applied to the invoice. If no value is specified or the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|applyCreditBalance|boolean|false|none|Whether to automatically apply a credit balance to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit balance is applied to the invoice. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br><br>To view the credit balance adjustment, retrieve the details of the invoice using the Get Invoices method.<br><br>Prerequisite: `invoice` must be `true`. <br><br>**Note:** <br>  - If you are using the field `invoiceCollect` rather than the field `invoice`, the `invoiceCollect` value must be `true`.<br>  - This field is deprecated if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br>|
|collect|boolean|false|none|Collects an automatic payment for a subscription. The collection generated in this operation is only for this subscription, not for the entire customer account.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the automatic payment is collected. If the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>Prerequisite: The `invoice` or `runBilling` field must be `true`. <br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you set the `zuora-version` request header to `196.0` or later.<br>|
|contractEffectiveDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the customer notifies you that they want to resume their subscription.<br>|
|documentDate|string(date)|false|none|The date of the billing document, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. It represents the invoice date for invoices, credit memo date for credit memos, and debit memo date for debit memos.<br><br>- If this field is specified, the specified date is used as the billing document date. <br>- If this field is not specified, the date specified in the `targetDate` is used as the billing document date.<br>|
|extendsTerm|boolean|false|none|Whether to extend the subscription term by the length of time the suspension is in effect.<br><br>Values: `true`, `false`.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_PaymentMethod">PaymentMethod</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapaymentmethod"></a>

<a id="tocspaymentmethod"></a>

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "BAID": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "preapprovalKey": "string",
  "cardHolderInfo": {
    "addressLine1": "string",
    "addressLine2": "string",
    "cardHolderName": "string",
    "city": "string",
    "country": "string",
    "email": "string",
    "phone": "string",
    "state": "string",
    "zipCode": "string"
  },
  "cardNumber": "string",
  "cardType": "string",
  "checkDuplicated": true,
  "expirationMonth": 0,
  "expirationYear": 0,
  "mitConsentAgreementRef": "string",
  "mitConsentAgreementSrc": "External",
  "mitNetworkTransactionId": "string",
  "mitProfileAction": "Activate",
  "mitProfileAgreedOn": "1970-01-01",
  "mitProfileType": "Recurring",
  "securityCode": "string",
  "addressLine1": "string",
  "addressLine2": "string",
  "bankABACode": "string",
  "bankAccountName": "string",
  "bankAccountNumber": "string",
  "bankAccountType": "BusinessChecking",
  "bankName": "string",
  "city": "string",
  "country": "string",
  "phone": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "zipCode": "string",
  "accountKey": "string",
  "authGateway": "string",
  "makeDefault": false,
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null,
  "IBAN": "string",
  "accountHolderInfo": {
    "accountHolderName": "string",
    "addressLine1": "string",
    "addressLine2": "string",
    "city": "string",
    "email": "string",
    "firstName": "string",
    "lastName": "string",
    "phone": "string",
    "state": "string",
    "zipCode": "string"
  },
  "accountNumber": "string",
  "bankCode": "string",
  "branchCode": "string",
  "businessIdentificationCode": "string",
  "currencyCode": "string",
  "identityNumber": "string"
}
```

Payment method to create for this new account. Supports all the payment methods that are supported in the "Create payment method" operation. See for more information about how to use this field in [Create payment method](https://www.zuora.com/developer/api-reference/#operation/POST_PaymentMethods).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|Type of payment method. The following types of the payment method are supported:<br><br>* `PayPalEC` - PayPal Express Checkout payment method. Use this type if you are using a [PayPal Payflow Pro Gateway](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways/PayPal_Payflow_Pro%2C_Website_Payments_Payflow_Edition%2C_Website_Pro_Payment_Gateway) instance.<br>* `PayPalNativeEC` - PayPal Native Express Checkout payment method. Use this type if you are using a [PayPal Express Checkout Gateway](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways/PayPal_Express_Checkout_Gateway) instance.<br>* `PayPalAdaptive` - PayPal Adaptive payment method. Use this type if you are using a [PayPal Adaptive Payment Gateway](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways/PayPal_Adaptive_Payments_Gateway) instance.<br>* `CreditCard` - Credit card payment method.<br>* `ACH` - ACH payment method.<br>* `SEPA` - Single Euro Payments Area.<br>* `Betalingsservice` - Direct Debit DK.<br>* `Autogiro` - Direct Debit SE.<br>* `Bacs` - Direct Debit UK.<br>* You can also specify a custom payment method type. This type is only available if the Universal Payment Connector and Open Payment Method services are enabled. See [Set up custom payment gateways and payment methods](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/MB_Set_up_custom_payment_gateways_and_payment_methods) for details.<br>|
|BAID|string|false|none|ID of a PayPal billing agreement. For example, I-1TJ3GAGG82Y9.<br>|
|email|string|false|none|Email address associated with the payment method. This field is required if you want to create a PayPal Express Checkout payment method or a PayPal Adaptive payment method.<br>|
|preapprovalKey|string|false|none|The PayPal preapproval key.<br>|
|cardHolderInfo|[CreatePaymentMethodCardholderInfo](#schemacreatepaymentmethodcardholderinfo)|false|none|Container for cardholder information. If provided, Zuora will<br>only use this information for this card. Otherwise, Zuora will use<br>the account''s existing bill-to contact information for this card.<br>|
|cardNumber|string|false|none|Credit card number.<br>|
|cardType|string|false|none|The type of the credit card.<br><br>Possible values include `Visa`, `MasterCard`, `AmericanExpress`, `Discover`, `JCB`, and `Diners`. For more information about credit card types supported by different payment gateways, see [Supported Payment Gateways](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/M_Payment_Gateways/Supported_Payment_Gateways).<br>|
|checkDuplicated|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the duplication check is performed when you create a new credit card payment method. The default value is `false`.<br><br>With this field set to `true`, Zuora will check all active payment methods associated with the same billing account to ensure that no duplicate credit card payment methods are created. An error is returned if a duplicate payment method is found.<br>        <br>The following fields are used for the duplication check:<br>  * `cardHolderName`<br>  * `expirationMonth`<br>  * `expirationYear`<br>  * `creditCardMaskNumber`. It is the masked credit card number generated by Zuora. For example, `****1234`. <br>|
|expirationMonth|integer|false|none|One or two digit expiration month (1-12) of the credit card.<br>|
|expirationYear|integer|false|none|Four-digit expiration year of the credit card.<br>|
|mitConsentAgreementRef|string|false|none|Specifies your reference for the stored credential consent agreement that you have established with the customer. Only applicable if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|string|false|none|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field.<br>|
|mitNetworkTransactionId|string|false|none|Specifies the ID of a network transaction. Only applicable if you set the `mitProfileAction` field to `Persist`.<br>|
|mitProfileAction|string|false|none|If you set this field, Zuora creates a stored credential profile within the payment method.<br><br>**Note:** This feature is in the **Early Adopters** phase. We are actively soliciting feedback from a small set of early adopters before releasing as generally available.<br><br>* `Activate` - Use this value if you are creating the stored credential profile after receiving the customer's consent.<br><br>  Zuora will create the stored credential profile then send a cardholder-initiated transaction (CIT) to the payment gateway to validate the stored credential profile. If the CIT succeeds, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Active`. If the CIT does not succeed, Zuora will not create a stored credential profile.<br>  <br>  If the payment gateway does not support the stored credential transaction framework, the status of the stored credential profile will be `Agreed`.<br><br><br>* `Persist` - Use this value if the stored credential profile represents a stored credential profile in an external system. The status of the payment method's stored credential profile will be `Active`.<br>|
|mitProfileAgreedOn|string(date)|false|none|The date on which the profile is agreed. The date format is `yyyy-mm-dd`.<br>|
|mitProfileType|string|false|none|Required if you set the `mitProfileAction` field. Indicates the type of the stored credential profile to process recurring or unsecheduled transactions.<br>|
|securityCode|string|false|none|CVV or CVV2 security code of the credit card.<br><br>To ensure PCI compliance, this value is not stored and cannot be queried.<br>|
|addressLine1|string|false|none|First address line, 255 characters or less.<br>|
|addressLine2|string|false|none|Second address line, 255 characters or less.<br>|
|bankABACode|string|false|none|The nine-digit routing number or ABA number used by banks. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankAccountName|string|false|none|The name of the account holder, which can be either a person or a company. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankAccountNumber|string|false|none|The bank account number associated with the ACH payment. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankAccountType|string|false|none|The type of bank account associated with the ACH payment. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|bankName|string|false|none|The name of the bank where the ACH payment account is held. This field is only required if the `type` field is set to `ACH`.<br>|
|city|string|false|none|City, 40 characters or less.<br>    <br>|
|country|string|false|none|Country, must be a valid country name or abbreviation.<br>|
|phone|string|false|none|Phone number, 40 characters or less.<br>|
|state|string|false|none|State, must be a valid state name or 2-character abbreviation.<br>|
|zipCode|string|false|none|Zip code, 20 characters or less.<br>|
|accountKey|string|false|none|Internal ID of the customer account that will own the payment method. <br><br>To create an orphan payment method that is not associated with any customer account, you do not need to specify this field during creation. However, you must associate the orphan payment method with a customer account within 10 days. Otherwise, this orphan payment method will be deleted.<br>|
|authGateway|string|false|none|Internal ID of the payment gateway that Zuora will use to authorize the payments that are made with the payment method.<br><br>If you do not set this field, Zuora will use one of the following payment gateways instead:<br><br>* The default payment gateway of the customer account that owns the payment method, if the `accountKey` field is set.<br>* The default payment gateway of your Zuora tenant, if the `accountKey` field is not set.<br>|
|makeDefault|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the payment method will be the default payment method of the customer account that owns the payment method. Only applicable if the `accountKey` field is set.<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the payment method. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|
|IBAN|string|false|none|The International Bank Account Number. This field is used to create the SEPA payment method.<br>|
|accountHolderInfo|object|false|none|none|
|accountNumber|string|false|none|The number of the customer's bank account. Use this field for direct debit payment methods.<br>|
|bankCode|string|false|none|The sort code or number that identifies the bank. This is also known as the sort code. <br>|
|branchCode|string|false|none|The branch code of the bank used for direct debit.  <br>|
|businessIdentificationCode|string|false|none|The BIC code used for SEPA.<br>|
|currencyCode|string|false|none|The currency used for payment method authorization.<br><br>If this field is not specified, `currency` specified for the account is used for payment method authorization. If no currency is specified for the account, the default currency of the account is then used.<br>|
|identityNumber|string|false|none|The identity number used for Bank Transfer.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|mitConsentAgreementSrc|External|
|mitProfileAction|Activate|
|mitProfileAction|Persist|
|mitProfileType|Recurring|
|mitProfileType|Unscheduled|
|bankAccountType|BusinessChecking|
|bankAccountType|Checking|
|bankAccountType|Saving|

<h2 id="tocS_PostBillingPreviewParam">PostBillingPreviewParam</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostbillingpreviewparam"></a>
<a id="schema_PostBillingPreviewParam"></a>
<a id="tocSpostbillingpreviewparam"></a>
<a id="tocspostbillingpreviewparam"></a>

```json
{
  "accountId": "402890b75972406c0159724cd4d00011",
  "assumeRenewal": "None",
  "chargeTypeToExclude": "",
  "includingEvergreenSubscription": "true",
  "targetDate": "2017-05-10"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string|true|none|ID of the customer account to which the billing preview applies.<br>|
|assumeRenewal|string|false|none|Indicates whether to generate a preview of future invoice items and credit memo items with the assumption that the subscriptions are renewed.<br><br>Set one of the following values in this field to decide how the assumption is applied in the billing preview.<br><br>  * **All:** The assumption is applied to all the subscriptions. Zuora generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the target date.<br>  <br>  * **None:** (Default) The assumption is not applied to the subscriptions. Zuora generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data based on the current term end date and the target date.<br>  <br>    * If the target date is later than the current term end date, Zuora generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the current term end date.<br><br>    * If the target date is earlier than the current term end date, Zuora generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the target date.<br><br>  * **Autorenew:** The assumption is applied to the subscriptions that have auto-renew enabled. Zuora generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the target date.<br><br>**Note:** <br>  - This field can only be used if the subscription renewal term is not set to 0.  <br>  <br>  <br>  - The credit memo item data is only available if you have Invoice Settlement feature enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|chargeTypeToExclude|string|false|none|The charge types to exclude from the billing preview.<br><br>**Possible values:** OneTime, Recurring, Usage, and any combination of these values.<br>|
|includingEvergreenSubscription|boolean|false|none|Indicates if evergreen subscriptions are included in the billingPreview call.<br>|
|targetDate|string(date)|true|none|The target date for the billingPreview call. The billingPreview call generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the TargetDate. <br><br>If the TargetDate is later than the subscription current term end date, the preview invoice item data and credit memo item data is generated from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the current term end date. If you want to generate preview invoice item data and credit memo item data past the end of the subscription current term, specify the `AssumeRenewal` field in the request.<br><br><br>**Note:** The credit memo item data is only available if you have Invoice Settlement feature enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_PostBillingPreviewRunParam">PostBillingPreviewRunParam</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostbillingpreviewrunparam"></a>
<a id="schema_PostBillingPreviewRunParam"></a>
<a id="tocSpostbillingpreviewrunparam"></a>
<a id="tocspostbillingpreviewrunparam"></a>

```json
{
  "assumeRenewal": "None",
  "batch": "",
  "chargeTypeToExclude": "",
  "includingEvergreenSubscription": "true",
  "targetDate": "2017-01-10"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assumeRenewal|string|false|none|Indicates whether to generate a preview of future invoice items and credit memo items with the assumption that the subscriptions are renewed.<br><br>Set one of the following values in this field to decide how the assumption is applied in the billing preview.<br><br>  * **All:** The assumption is applied to all the subscriptions. Zuora generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the target date.<br>  <br>  * **None:** (Default) The assumption is not applied to the subscriptions. Zuora generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data based on the current term end date and the target date.<br>  <br>    * If the target date is later than the current term end date, Zuora generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the current term end date.<br><br>    * If the target date is earlier than the current term end date, Zuora generates preview invoice item data and credit memeo item data from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the target date.<br><br>  * **Autorenew:** The assumption is applied to the subscriptions that have auto-renew enabled. Zuora generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the target date.<br>  <br>**Note:** <br>  - This field can only be used if the subscription renewal term is not set to 0.  <br>  <br>  <br>  - The credit memo item data is only available if you have Invoice Settlement feature enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information. <br>  <br>|
|batch|string|false|none|The customer batch to include in the billing preview run. If not specified, all customer batches are included.<br>|
|chargeTypeToExclude|string|false|none|The charge types to exclude from the forecast run.<br><br>**Possible values:** OneTime, Recurring, Usage, and any comma-separated combination of these values.<br>|
|includingEvergreenSubscription|boolean|false|none|Indicates if evergreen subscriptions are included in the billing preview run. By default, evergreen subscriptions are not included.<br>|
|targetDate|string(date)|true|none|The target date for the billing preview run. The billing preview run generates preview invoice item data and credit memo item data from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the TargetDate. <br><br>If the TargetDate is later than the subscription current term end date, the preview invoice item data and credit memo item data is generated from the first day of the customer's next billing period to the current term end date. If you want to generate preview invoice item data and credit memo item data past the end of the subscription current term, specify the AssumeRenewal field in the request.<br><br>**Note:** The credit memo item data is only available if you have Invoice Settlement feature enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|

<a id="schemapostinvoiceemailrequesttype"></a>
<a id="schema_PostInvoiceEmailRequestType"></a>
<a id="tocSpostinvoiceemailrequesttype"></a>
<a id="tocspostinvoiceemailrequesttype"></a>

```json
{
  "emailAddresses": "contact1@example.com,contact2@example.com",
  "includeAdditionalEmailAddresses": false,
  "useEmailTemplateSetting": false
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|emailAddresses|string|false|none|The valid email addresses you want to email an invoice to. Use commas to separate email addresses.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only applicable if you set the `useEmailTemplateSetting` field to `false`.<br>|
|includeAdditionalEmailAddresses|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether to send an invoice to the additional email addresses of the invoice account. <br><br><br>You can set the additional email addresses in the **Additional Email Addresses** field on the account detail page from the Zuora UI. See [Create a Customer Account](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Customer_Accounts/B_Create_a_Customer_Account#section_2) for more information.<br>|
|useEmailTemplateSetting|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether to email an invoice based on the email template setting. <br><br>If you set this field to `true`, the invoice is sent to the email addresses specified in the **To Email** field of the email template. The email template is the one you set in the **Delivery Options** panel of the **Edit notification** dialog from the Zuora UI. See [Edit Email Templates](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CF_Users_and_Administrators/Notifications/Create_Email_Templates) for more information about how to edit the **To Email** field in the email template.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|includeAdditionalEmailAddresses|true|
|includeAdditionalEmailAddresses|false|
|useEmailTemplateSetting|true|
|useEmailTemplateSetting|false|

```json
  "revRecTriggerCondition": "ContractEffectiveDate",
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountingCode|string|false|none|The accounting code associated with the invoice item.<br>|
|amount|string(number)|true|none|The amount of the invoice item. <br><br>- For tax-inclusive invoice items, the amount indicates the invoice item amount including tax. <br>- For tax-exclusive invoice items, the amount indicates the invoice item amount excluding tax.<br>|
|bookingReference|string|false|none|The booking reference of the invoice item.<br>|
|chargeDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date when the invoice item is charged.<br>|
|chargeName|string|false|none|The name of the charge associated with the invoice item. <br><br>This field is required if the `productRatePlanChargeId` field is not specified in the request.<br>|
|deferredRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The accounting code for the deferred revenue, such as Monthly Recurring Liability.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have Zuora Finance enabled.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the invoice item.<br>|
|itemType|string|false|none|The type of the invoice item.<br>|
|productRatePlanChargeId|string|false|none|The ID of the product rate plan charge that the invoice item is created from.<br><br>If you specify a value for the `productRatePlanChargeId` field in the request, Zuora directly copies the values of the following fields from the corresponding product rate plan charge, regardless of the values specified in the request body:<br>- `chargeName`<br>- `sku`<br>- `uom`<br>- `taxCode`<br>- `taxMode`<br>- `accountingCode`<br>- `deferredRevenueAccountingCode` <br>- `recognizedRevenueAccountingCode`<br>|
|purchaseOrderNumber|string|false|none|The purchase order number associated with the invoice item.<br>|
|quantity|string(number)|false|none|The number of units for the invoice item.<br>|
|recognizedRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The accounting code for the recognized revenue, such as Monthly Recurring Charges or Overage Charges.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have Zuora Finance enabled.<br>|
|revRecCode|string|false|none|The revenue recognition code.<br>|
|revRecTriggerCondition|string|false|none|The date when revenue recognition is triggered.<br>|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|string|false|none|The name of the revenue recognition rule governing the revenue schedule.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have Zuora Finance enabled.<br>|
|serviceEndDate|string(date)|false|none|The service end date of the invoice item.<br>|
|serviceStartDate|string(date)|true|none|The service start date of the invoice item.<br>|
|sku|string|false|none|The SKU of the invoice item.<br>|
|taxCode|string|false|none|The tax code identifies which tax rules and tax rates to apply to the invoice item.<br><br>**Note** This field is only available only when Taxation enabled.<br>|
|taxItems|[[PostTaxationItemType](#schemaposttaxationitemtype)]|false|none|Container for taxation items. The maximum number of taxation items is 5.<br>|
|taxMode|string|false|none|The tax mode of the invoice item, indicating whether the amount of the invoice item includes tax.<br><br>**Note** This field is only available only when Taxation enabled.<br>|
|unitPrice|string(number)|false|none|The per-unit price of the invoice item.<br>|
|uom|string|false|none|The unit of measure.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the invoice item's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the invoice item was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Invoice Item object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|revRecTriggerCondition|ContractEffectiveDate|
|revRecTriggerCondition|ServiceActivationDate|
|revRecTriggerCondition|CustomerAcceptanceDate|
|taxMode|TaxInclusive|
|taxMode|TaxExclusive|

```json
  "amount": "string",
  "amountWithoutTax": "string",
  "autoPay": true,
  "comments": "string",
  "dueDate": "1970-01-01",
  "id": "string",
  "invoiceDate": "1970-01-01",
  "invoiceNumber": "string",
  "status": "Draft",
  "taxAmount": "string",
  "taxExemptAmount": "string",
  "transferredToAccounting": "Processing",
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string|false|none|The ID of the customer account associated with the invoice.<br>|
|amount|string(number)|false|none|The total amount of the invoice.<br>|
|amountWithoutTax|string(number)|false|none|The invoice amount excluding tax.<br>|
|autoPay|boolean|false|none|Whether invoices are automatically picked up for processing in the corresponding payment run.<br>|
|comments|string|false|none|Comments about the invoice.<br>|
|dueDate|string(date)|false|none|The date by which the payment for this invoice is due.<br>|
|id|string|false|none|The unique ID of the invoice.<br>|
|invoiceDate|string(date)|false|none|The date that appears on the invoice being created.<br>|
|invoiceNumber|string|false|none|The unique identification number of the invoice.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the invoice.<br>|
|taxAmount|string(number)|false|none|The amount of taxation.<br>|
|taxExemptAmount|string(number)|false|none|The total amount of taxes or VAT for which the customer has an exemption.<br>|
|transferredToAccounting|string|false|none|Whether the invoice was transferred to an external accounting system.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the invoice's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the invoice was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Invoice object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

|Property|Value|

|status|Draft|
|status|Posted|
|transferredToAccounting|Processing|
|transferredToAccounting|Error|

<h2 id="tocS_PostNonRefRefundType">PostNonRefRefundType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostnonrefrefundtype"></a>
<a id="schema_PostNonRefRefundType"></a>
<a id="tocSpostnonrefrefundtype"></a>
<a id="tocspostnonrefrefundtype"></a>

```json
{
  "gatewayOptions": {
    "Comments": "test",
    "IPAddress": "192.168.1.1"
  },
  "items": [
    {
      "amount": 7,
      "creditMemoItemId": "4028905f5a890526015a8d73f74b0016"
    },
    {
      "amount": 0.1,
      "creditTaxItemId": "4028905f5a890526015a8d73f90c0018"
    }
  ],
  "methodType": "CreditCard",
  "refundDate": "2017-03-02",
  "totalAmount": 7.1,
  "type": "External"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|comment|string|false|none|Comments about the refund.<br>|
|financeInformation|object|false|none|Container for the finance information related to the refund.<br>|
|gatewayId|string|false|none|The ID of the gateway instance that processes the refund. This field can be specified only for electronic refunds. The ID must be a valid gateway instance ID, and this gateway must support the specific payment method. <br><br>If no gateway ID is specified, the default gateway in the billing account configuration will be used. If no gateway is specified in the billing account, the default gateway of the corresponding tenant will be used.<br>|
|gatewayOptions|object|false|none|The field used to pass gateway-specific parameters and parameter values.<br>|
|items|[[RefundCreditMemoItemType](#schemarefundcreditmemoitemtype)]|false|none|Container for credit memo items. The maximum number of items is 1,000.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have the [Invoice Item Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/C_Invoice_Item_Settlement) feature enabled. Invoice Item Settlement must be used together with other Invoice Settlement features (Unapplied Payments, and Credit and Debit memos).  If you wish to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|methodType|string|false|none|How an external refund was issued to a customer. This field is required for an external refund and must be left empty for an electronic refund. You can issue an external refund on a credit memo.<br>|
|paymentMethodId|string|false|none|The ID of the payment method used for the refund. This field is required for an electronic refund, and the value must be an electronic payment method ID. This field must be left empty for an external refund. <br>|
|reasonCode|string|false|none|A code identifying the reason for the transaction. The value must be an existing reason code or empty. If you do not specify a value, Zuora uses the default reason code.<br>|
|referenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway for an electronic refund. Use this field to reconcile refunds between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|refundDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the refund takes effect, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. The date of the refund cannot be before the credit memo date. Specify this field only for external refunds. Zuora automatically generates this field for electronic refunds.<br>|
|secondRefundReferenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway if there is an additional transaction for the refund. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|softDescriptor|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.|
|softDescriptorPhone|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.|
|totalAmount|number(double)|true|none|The total amount of the refund. The amount cannot exceed the unapplied amount of the associated credit memo. If the original credit memo was applied to one or more invoices or debit memos, you have to unapply a full or partial credit memo from the invoices or debit memos, and then refund the full or partial unapplied credit memo to your customers.<br>|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the refund.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the refund's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Origin__NS|string|false|none|Origin of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the refund was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SynctoNetSuite__NS|string|false|none|Specifies whether the refund should be synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Refund object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

|---|---|

|methodType|Cash|
|methodType|Check|
|methodType|CreditCard|
|methodType|PayPal|
|methodType|WireTransfer|
|methodType|DebitCard|
|methodType|CreditCardReferenceTransaction|
|methodType|BankTransfer|
|methodType|Other|
|type|External|
|type|Electronic|

```json
  },

  "description": "string",

  "itemNumber": "string",
  "itemState": "Executing",
  "itemType": "Product",
  "listPricePerUnit": 0,
  "productCode": "string",

  "quantity": 0,
  "recognizedRevenueAccountingCode": "string",
  "revenueRecognitionRule": "string",

  "taxMode": "TaxInclusive",
  "transactionDate": "1970-01-01"
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string(UUID)|true|none|The sytem generated Id for the Order Line Item(OLI). Use this field to specify which OLI to update.<br>|
|UOM|string|false|none|Specifies the units to measure usage.<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|accountingCode|string|false|none|The accountingCode for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|amountPerUnit|number|false|none|The actual charged amount per unit for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|billTargetDate|string(date)|false|none|The target date for the Order Line Item (OLI) to be picked up by bill run for generating invoice.<br><br>To generate invoice for an OLI, you must set this field and set the `itemState` field to `SentToBilling`.<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|customFields|[OrderLineItemCustomFields](#schemaorderlineitemcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of an Order Line Item object.<br>|
|deferredRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The deferred revenue accounting code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|itemName|string|false|none|The name of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|itemNumber|string|false|none|The number for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|itemState|string|false|none|The state of the Order Line Item (OLI). See [Order Line Item states, Order states, and state transitions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AB_Order_Line_Item_States_and_Order_States) for more information.<br><br>To generate invoice for an OLI, you must set this field to `SentToBilling` and set the `billTargetDate` field .<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` or `SentToBilling`state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing` or `SentToBilling`).<br>|
|itemType|string|false|none|The type of the Order Line Item (OLI). <br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|listPricePerUnit|number|false|none|The list price per unit for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|productCode|string|false|none|The product code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|purchaseOrderNumber|string|false|none|Used by customers to specify the Purchase Order Number provided by the buyer.<br><br>You can update this field for an Order Line Item (OLI) only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|quantity|number|false|none|The quantity of units, such as the number of authors in a hosted wiki service.<br><br>You can update this field for an Order Line Item (OLI) only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|recognizedRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The recognized revenue accounting code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|revenueRecognitionRule|string|false|none|The Revenue Recognition rule for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|taxCode|string|false|none|The tax code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|taxMode|string|false|none|The tax mode for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|transactionDate|string(date)|false|none|The transaction date of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|comment|string|false|none|Comments about the refund.<br>|
|financeInformation|object|false|none|Container for the finance information related to the refund.<br>|
|gatewayOptions|object|false|none|The field used to pass gateway-specific parameters and parameter values.<br>|
|methodType|string|false|none|How an external refund was issued to a customer. This field is required for an external refund and must be left empty for an electronic refund. You can issue an external refund on an electronic payment.<br>|
|reasonCode|string|false|none|A code identifying the reason for the transaction. The value must be an existing reason code or empty. If you do not specify a value, Zuora uses the default reason code.<br>|
|referenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway for an electronic refund. Use this field to reconcile refunds between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|refundDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the refund takes effect, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. The date of the refund cannot be before the payment date. Specify this field only for external refunds. Zuora automatically generates this field for electronic refunds.<br>|
|secondRefundReferenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway if there is an additional transaction for the refund. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|softDescriptor|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.|
|softDescriptorPhone|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.|
|totalAmount|number(double)|true|none|The total amount of the refund. The amount cannot exceed the unapplied amount of the associated payment. If the original payment was applied to one or more invoices or debit memos, you have to unapply a full or partial payment from the invoices or debit memos, and then refund the full or partial unapplied payment to your customers. <br>|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the refund.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the refund's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Origin__NS|string|false|none|Origin of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the refund was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SynctoNetSuite__NS|string|false|none|Specifies whether the refund should be synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Refund object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

Information about the account that will own the order.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|billCycleDay|integer|true|none|Day of the month that the account prefers billing periods to begin on. If set to 0, the bill cycle day will be set as "AutoSet".|
|currency|string|true|none|ISO 3-letter currency code (uppercase). For example, USD.<br>|
|customFields|[AccountObjectCustomFields](#schemaaccountobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of an Account object.<br>|
|soldToContact|[PreviewContactInfo](#schemapreviewcontactinfo)|false|none|none|
|taxInfo|[TaxInfo](#schemataxinfo)|false|none|Information about the tax exempt status of a customer account.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_PreviewOptions">PreviewOptions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapreviewoptions"></a>
<a id="schema_PreviewOptions"></a>
<a id="tocSpreviewoptions"></a>
<a id="tocspreviewoptions"></a>

```json
{
  "previewNumberOfPeriods": 0,
  "previewThruType": "SpecificDate",
  "previewTypes": [
    "ChargeMetrics"
  ],
  "specificPreviewThruDate": "1970-01-01"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|previewNumberOfPeriods|integer|false|none|The number of periods to preview when the value of the `previewThroughType` field is set to `NumberOfPeriods`.|
|previewThruType|string|false|none|The options on how the preview through date is calculated. Available for preview only. The 'TermEnd' option is invalid when any subscription included in this order is evergreen. <br><br>If set the value of this field to `SpecificDate`, you must specify a specific date in the 'specificPreviewThruDate' field.<br><br>If set the value of this field to `NumberOfPeriods`, you must use the `previewNumberOfPeriods` field to specify how many periods you want to preview.<br>|
|previewTypes|[string]|false|none|One or more types of the preview. It can include:<br><br>* ChargeMetrics: charge level metrics will be returned in the response, including: `cmrr`, `tcv`, `tcb`, and `tax`.<br>* BillingDocs: `invoices` and `creditMemos` will be returned in the response. Note `creditMemos` is only available if the Invoice Settlement feature is enabled.<br>* OrderDeltaMetrics: order delta metrics will be returned in the response, including: `orderDeltaMrr`, `orderDeltaTcb` and  `orderDeltaTcv`.<br>* OrderMetrics: order metrics will be returned in the response, including: `quantity`, `mrr`, `tcb`, `tcv`, and `elp`. **Note:** As of Zuora Billing Release 306, Zuora has upgraded the methodologies for calculating metrics in [Orders](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders). The new methodologies are reflected in the OrderDeltaMetrics. It is recommended that all customers use the [Order Delta Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Delta_Metrics/AA_Overview_of_Order_Delta_Metrics). If you are an existing [Order Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders/Key_Metrics_for_Orders) customer and want to migrate to Order Delta Metrics, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](https://support.zuora.com/). Whereas new customers, and existing customers not currently on [Order Metrics](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/AA_Overview_of_Orders/Key_Metrics_for_Orders), will no longer have access to Order Metrics, existing customers currently using Order Metrics will continue to be supported.<br>* RampMetrics: ramp metrics will be returned in the response, including: `quantity`, `mrr`, `tcb`, `tcv` metrics for each charge and each ramp interval.<br>* RampDeltaMetrics: ramp metrics changes will be returned in the response, including: `deltaQuantity`, `deltaMrr`, `deltaTcb`, `deltaTcv` metrics for each charge and each ramp interval.<br>|
|specificPreviewThruDate|string(date)|false|none|The end date of the order preview. You can preview the invoice charges through the preview through date. (Invoice preview only)<br><br><br>**Note:** This field is only applicable if the 'previewThruType' field is set to 'SpecificDate'.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|previewThruType|SpecificDate|
|previewThruType|TermEnd|
|previewThruType|NumberOfPeriods|
|previewTypes|ChargeMetrics|
|previewTypes|BillingDocs|
|previewTypes|OrderDeltaMetrics|
|previewTypes|OrderMetrics|
|previewTypes|RampMetrics|
|previewTypes|RampDeltaMetrics|

Charge associated with a rate plan.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|billing|object|false|none|Billing information about the charge.<br>|
|chargeNumber|string|false|none|Charge number of the charge. For example, C-00000307.<br><br>If you do not set this field, Zuora will generate the charge number.<br>|
|customFields|[RatePlanChargeObjectCustomFields](#schemarateplanchargeobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of a Rate Plan Charge object.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the charge.<br>|
|endDate|[EndConditions](#schemaendconditions)|false|none|Specifies when a charge becomes inactive.<br>|
|pricing|object|false|none|Pricing information about the charge.<br>|
|productRatePlanChargeId|string|true|none|Internal identifier of the product rate plan charge that the charge is based on.<br>|
|revRecCode|string|false|none|Revenue Recognition Code<br>|
|revRecTriggerCondition|string|false|none|Specifies the revenue recognition trigger condition.<br><br>  * `Contract Effective Date` <br>  * `Service Activation Date`<br>  * `Customer Acceptance Date`<br>|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|string|false|none|Specifies the revenue recognition rule.<br><br>  * `Recognize upon invoicing` <br>  * `Recognize daily over time`<br>|
|startDate|[PreviewOrderTriggerParams](#schemapreviewordertriggerparams)|false|none|Specifies when a charge becomes active.<br>|
|uniqueToken|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the charge. This identifier enables you to refer to the charge before the charge has an internal identifier in Zuora.<br><br>For instance, suppose that you want to use a single order to add a product to a subscription and later update the same product. When you add the product, you can set a unique identifier for the charge. Then when you update the product, you can use the same unique identifier to specify which charge to modify.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|revRecTriggerCondition|Contract Effective Date|
|revRecTriggerCondition|Service Activation Date|
|revRecTriggerCondition|Customer Acceptance Date|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|Recognize upon invoicing|
|revenueRecognitionRuleName|Recognize daily over time|


Information about an order action of type `CreateSubscription`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceSeparately|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the subscription appears on a separate invoice when Zuora generates invoices.<br>|
|newSubscriptionOwnerAccount|object|false|none|Information about a new account that will own the subscription. Only available if you have enabled the Owner Transfer feature.<br><br>**Note:** The Owner Transfer feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>If you do not set this field or the `subscriptionOwnerAccountNumber` field, the account that owns the order will also own the subscription. Zuora will return an error if you set this field and the `subscriptionOwnerAccountNumber` field.<br>|
|notes|string|false|none|Notes about the subscription. These notes are only visible to Zuora users.<br>|
|subscribeToRatePlans|[[PreviewOrderRatePlanOverride](#schemaprevieworderrateplanoverride)]|false|none|List of rate plans associated with the subscription.<br>|
|subscriptionNumber|string|false|none|Subscription number of the subscription. For example, A-S00000001.<br><br>If you do not set this field, Zuora will generate the subscription number.<br>|
|subscriptionOwnerAccountNumber|string|false|none|Account number of an existing account that will own the subscription. For example, A00000001.<br><br>If you do not set this field or the `newSubscriptionOwnerAccount` field, the account that owns the order will also own the subscription. Zuora will return an error if you set this field and the `newSubscriptionOwnerAccount` field.<br>|
|terms|object|false|none|Container for the terms and renewal settings of the subscription.<br>|

If the service activation date field is at the same time required and skipped (or set as null), it will be a `Pending Activation` subscription.<br>|

For example, if the type of order action is `AddProduct`, Zuora returns an error if you set the `updateProduct` field.<br>|

Rate plan associated with a subscription.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|productRatePlanId|string|true|none|Internal identifier of the product rate plan that the rate plan is based on.<br>|
|uniqueToken|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the rate plan. This identifier enables you to refer to the rate plan before the rate plan has an internal identifier in Zuora.<br><br>For instance, suppose that you want to use a single order to add a product to a subscription and later update the same product. When you add the product, you can set a unique identifier for the rate plan. Then when you update the product, you can use the same unique identifier to specify which rate plan to modify.<br>|

Information about an order action of type `UpdateProduct`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargeUpdates|[[PreviewOrderChargeUpdate](#schemaprevieworderchargeupdate)]|false|none|Array of the JSON objects containing the information for a charge update in the `updateProduct` type of order action.<br><br>When previewing an `updateProduct` order action, either the `chargeNumber` or `uniqueToken` field is required to specify the charge to update.<br>|
|customFields|[RatePlanObjectCustomFields](#schemarateplanobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of a Rate Plan object.<br>|
|ratePlanId|string|false|none|The id of the rate plan to be updated. It can be the latest version or any history version id.<br>|
|specificUpdateDate|string(date)|false|none|<br>The date when the Update Product order action takes effect. This field is only applicable if there is already a future-dated Update Product order action on the subscription. The format of the date is yyyy-mm-dd.<br><br>See [Update a Product on Subscription with Future-dated Updates](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/AC_Orders_Tutorials/C_Update_a_Product_in_a_Subscription/Update_a_Product_on_Subscription_with_Future-dated_Updates) for more information about this feature.<br>|
|uniqueToken|string|false|none|A unique string to represent the rate plan charge in the order. The unique token is used to perform multiple actions against a newly added rate plan. For example, if you want to add and update a product in the same order, you would assign a unique token to the product rate plan when added and use that token in future order actions.<br>|

|specificTriggerDate|string(date)|false|none|Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Only applicable if the value of the `triggerEvent` field is `SpecificDate`. <br><br>While this field is applicable, if this field is not set, your `CreateSubscription` order action creates a `Pending` order and a `Pending Acceptance` subscription. If at the same time the service activation date is required and not set, a `Pending Activation` subscription is created.<br>|
|triggerEvent|string|false|none|Condition for the charge to become active.<br><br>If the value of this field is `SpecificDate`, use the `specificTriggerDate` field to specify the date when the charge becomes active.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|triggerEvent|ContractEffective|
|triggerEvent|ServiceActivation|
|triggerEvent|CustomerAcceptance|
|triggerEvent|SpecificDate|

|Property|Value|

|priceChangeOption|NoChange|
|priceChangeOption|SpecificPercentageValue|
