Invoice or Payment.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|applicationOrder|[string]|false|none|The priority order to apply credit memos and/or unapplied payments to an invoice. Possible item values are: `CreditMemo`, `UnappliedPayment`.<br><br>**Note:**<br>  - This field is valid only if the `applyCredit` field is set to `true`.<br>  - If no value is specified for this field, the default priority order is used, ["CreditMemo", "UnappliedPayment"], to apply credit memos first and then apply unapplied payments.<br>  - If only one item is specified, only the items of the spedified type are applied to invoices. For example, if the value is `["CreditMemo"]`, only credit memos are used to apply to invoices.<br>|
|applyCredit|boolean|false|none|Whether to automatically apply credit memos or unapplied payments, or both to an invoice.<br><br>If the value is `true`, the credit memo or unapplied payment, or both will be automatically applied to the invoice. If no value is specified or the value is `false`, no action is taken.<br><br>**Note:** This field is only available if you have [Invoice Settlement](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement) enabled. The Invoice Settlement feature is generally available as of Zuora Billing Release 296 (March 2021). This feature includes Unapplied Payments, Credit and Debit Memo, and Invoice Item Settlement. If you want to enable Invoice Settlement, see [Invoice Settlement Enablement and Checklist Guide](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Invoice_Settlement/Invoice_Settlement_Migration_Checklist_and_Guide) for more information.<br>|
|applyCreditBalance|boolean|false|none|Indicates if any credit balance on a customer's account is automatically applied to invoices. If no value is specified then this field defaults to false. This feature is not available if you have enabled the Invoice Settlement feature.|
|billingOptions|[BillingOptions](#schemabillingoptions)|false|none|none|
|collectPayment|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the current request needs to collect payments. This value can not be 'true' when 'runBilling' flag is 'false'.|
|electronicPaymentOptions|object|false|none|Container for the electronic payment options.|
|runBilling|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the current request needs to generate an invoice. The invoice will be generated against all subscriptions included in this order.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountId|string|false|none|ID of the account used for single account bill run.<br><br>This field is only required if you create ad hoc bill run for a single customer account.<br><br>**Character limit:** 32<br>|
|AutoEmail|boolean|false|none|Determines whether to auto send email or not by this bill run once the bill run completes.<br><br>**Note:** You must enable the [Support Bill Run Auto-Post Billing](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Billing_Rules) rule to pass this field.<br>|
|AutoPost|boolean|false|none|Determines whether to auto post bill run or not once the bill run completes.<br><br>**Note:** You must enable the [Support Bill Run Auto-Post Billing](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Billing_Rules) rule to pass this field.<br>|
|AutoRenewal|boolean|false|none|Determines whether to auto renew subscription or not by this bill run once the bill run completes.<br>|
|Batch|string|false|none|Batch of accounts for this bill run. <br><br>When creating ad hoc bill run for multiple customer accounts, this field is only required if the `BillCycleDay`<br> field is not specified.<br><br>**Character limit:** 20<br><br>**Values:** AllBatches or Batchn where n is a number between 1 and 50.<br>|
|BillCycleDay|string|false|none|The day of the bill cycle.<br><br>When creating ad hoc bill run for multiple customer accounts, this field is only required if the `Batch` field is not specified.<br><br>**Character limit:** 32<br><br>**Values:** `AllBillCycleDays` or 01 - 31.<br>|
|ChargeTypeToExclude|string|false|none|Charge type or types to be excluded, separated with comma.<br><br>**Possible Values:** `OneTime`, `Recurring`, `Usage`, or a combination of these values. <br><br>**Character limit:** 50<br>|
|InvoiceDate|string(date)|true|none|Invoice date for this bill run.<br><br>**Character limit:** 29<br>|
|NoEmailForZeroAmountInvoice|boolean|false|none|Determines whether to suppress email for invoices with zero total or not for this bill run once the bill run completes. (Do not email invoices with 0 Invoice Total).<br>|
|TargetDate|string(date)|true|none|Target date for this bill run. See [Create Bill Run](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/J_Billing_Operations/G_Bill_Runs/Creating_Bill_Runs) for more information.<br><br>**Character limit:** 29<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountingCode|string|false|none|An active accounting code in your Zuora [Chart of Accounts](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/W_Billing_and_Payments_Settings/V_Configure_Accounting_Codes/D_Set_Up_Chart_of_Accounts).<br><br>The [accounting code](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Product_Catalog/A_Product_Catalog_Concepts/Accounting_Codes) for the credit balance adjustment. Typically, an accounting code for a credit balance adjustment maps to a bank account in your accounting system.<br>|
|AdjustmentDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the credit balance adjustment is applied.<br><br>With the Future Dated Credit Balance Adjustment feature enabled, you can use this field to specify when the credit balance adjustment is applied. If not specified, the value defaults to the latter date of the date when the API operation is called and the invoice date.<br><br>With the Future Dated Credit Balance Adjustment feature disabled, if no value is specified for this field, the value defaults to the date when the API operation is called. Container for charge model configuration data.

**Notes**:

* This field is only available if you have the Pre-Rated Pricing or Multi-Attribute Pricing charge models enabled. These charge models are available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.
* To use this field, you must set the `X-Zuora-WSDL-Version` request header to `102` or later. Otherwise, an error occurs with "Code: INVALID_VALUE".

If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.)<br>* `customFieldPerUnitRate` (only available if you have the Pre-Rated Per Unit Pricing charge model enabled. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.)<br>* `customFieldTotalAmount` (only available if you have the Pre-Rated Pricing model enabled. The charge model is available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.)<br>|
|Value|string|false|none|The value of the field that is specified in the `Key` field.<br><br>Possible values are follows:<br><br>* A valid pricing formula to calculate actual rating amount for each usage record. The charge model is available for customers with Enterprise and Nine editions by default. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.<br>* A name of a usage custom field that carries the per-unit rate for a usage record. If you are a Growth customer, see [Zuora Editions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/C_Zuora_Editions) for pricing information.<br>* A name of a usage custom field that carries the total amount for a usage record. For example, `totalAmount__c`. Use it with Key `customFieldTotalAmount` when the Pre-Rated Pricing model is used. ### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountId|string|true|none|The unique account ID for the customer that the payment is for.<br>|
|AccountingCode|string|false|none|The accounting code for the payment. Accounting codes group transactions that contain similar accounting attributes.<br>|
|Amount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of the payment.<br><br>If Invoice Settlement is enabled, this field is required.<br>|
|AppliedCreditBalanceAmount|number(double)|false|none|If you have the Invoice Settlement feature disabled, the value of this field is the amount of the payment to apply to a credit balance. This field is only required if the `AppliedInvoiceAmount` field value is null.<br><br>If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, the value of this field is created as the unapplied amount.<br>|
|AppliedInvoiceAmount|number(decimal)|false|none|The amount of the payment to apply to an invoice. This field is only required if either the `InvoiceId` or `InvoiceNumber` field is not null.<br>|
|AuthTransactionId|string|false|none|The authorization transaction ID from the payment gateway. Use this field for electronic payments, such as credit cards.<br>|
|Comment|string|false|none|Additional information related to the payment.<br>|
|EffectiveDate|string(date)|true|none|The date when the payment takes effect.<br>|
|Gateway|string|false|none|The name of the gateway instance that processes the payment. When creating a payment, the value of this field must be a valid gateway instance name, and this gateway must support the specific payment method. If no value is specified, the default gateway on the Account will be used.<br>|
|GatewayOptionData|object|false|none|A field used to pass gateway options. Zuora allows you to pass in special gateway-specific parameters for payments that go through the Adyen, Autorize.et, CyberSource, Merchant eSolutions, Orbital (Chase Paymentech), QValent, Vantiv, and Verifi gateways.<br><br>For each of these special parameters, you supply the name-value pair and Zuora passes it to the gateway. This allows you to add functionality that's supported by a specific gateway but currently not supported by Zuora.<br>|
|GatewayOrderId|string|false|none|A merchant-specified natural key value that can be passed to the electronic payment gateway when a payment is created. If not specified, the payment number will be passed in instead.<br><br>Gateways check duplicates on the gateway order ID to ensure that the merchant do not accidentally enter the same transaction twice. This ID can also be used to do reconciliation and tie the payment to a natural key in external systems. The source of this ID varies by merchant. Some merchants use their shopping cart order IDs, and others use something different. Merchants use this ID to track transactions in their eCommerce systems.<br>|
|GatewayResponse|string|false|none|The message returned from the payment gateway for the payment. This message is gateway-dependent.<br>|
|GatewayResponseCode|string|false|none|The code returned from the payment gateway for the payment. This code is gateway-dependent.<br>|
|GatewayState|string|false|none|The status of the payment in the gateway; use for reconciliation.<br>|
|InvoiceId|string|false|none|The ID of the invoice that the payment is applied to. When applying a payment to a single invoice, this field is only required if the `InvoiceNumber` field is null.<br>|
|InvoiceNumber|string|false|none|The unique identification number for the invoice that the payment is applied to. When applying a payment to a single invoice, this field is only required if the `InvoiceId` field is null.<br>|
|InvoicePaymentData|object|false|none|Container for the invoice payment data. This field is only required if you apply a payment to multiple invoices.<br>|
|PaymentMethodId|string|true|none|The ID of the payment method used for the payment. <br>|
|PaymentNumber|string|false|none|The unique identification number of the payment. For example, P-00000028.<br>|
|ReferenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|SoftDescriptor|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi. <br><br>Zuora passes this field to Verifi directly without verification. In general, this field will be defaulted by the gateway. For Orbital, this field contains two fields separated by an asterisk, `SDMerchantName` and `SDProductionInfo`. For more information, contact your payment gateway.<br>|
|SoftDescriptorPhone|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.<br><br>Verifi and Orbital determine how to format this string. For more information, contact your payment gateway.<br>|
|Status|string|true|none|The status of the payment in Zuora. The value depends on the type of payments.<br><br>- If you have the Invoice Settlement feature disabled, for electronic payments, the status can be `Processed`, `Processing`, `Error`, or `Voided`. For external payments, the status can be `Processed` or `Canceled`.<br>- If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, for electronic payments, the status can be `Processed`, `Processing`, `Error`, or `Canceled`. For external payments, the status can be `Processed` or `Canceled`.<br>|
|Type|string|true|none|The type of the payment, whether the payment is external or electronic.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the payment's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Origin__NS|string|false|none|Origin of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the payment was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Transaction__NS|string|false|none|Related transaction in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Payment object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_ProxyCreateRefund">ProxyCreateRefund</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaproxycreaterefund"></a>
<a id="schema_ProxyCreateRefund"></a>
<a id="tocSproxycreaterefund"></a>
<a id="tocsproxycreaterefund"></a>

```json
{
  "AccountId": "2c93808457d787030157e03190e748ea",
  "Amount": 1.1,
  "Comment": "this is comments",
  "PaymentId": "2c93808457d787030157e03197714910",
  "ReasonCode": "Standard Refund",
  "RefundInvoicePaymentData": {
    "RefundInvoicePayment": [
      {
        "InvoiceId": "2c93808457d787030157e03195604902",
        "RefundAmount": 1.1
      }
    ]
  },
  "SoftDescriptor": "thisSD",
  "SoftDescriptorPhone": "contact@example.com",
  "SourceType": "Payment",
  "Type": "Electronic"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountId|string|false|none| The ID of the account associated with this refund. This field is only required if you create a non-referenced refund. Don't specify a value for any other type of refund; Zuora associates the refund automatically with the account from the associated payment.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid account ID |
|Amount|number(double)|true|none| The amount of the refund. The amount can't exceed the amount of the associated payment. If the original payment was applied to a single invoice, you can create a partial refund by specifying an amount in this field or through the UI. If the payment was applied to multiple invoices, you can create a partial refund by using the `RefundInvoicePaymentData` field of this operation or through the UI.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a valid currency amount |
|Comment|string|false|none| Use this field to record comments about the refund.<br>**Character limit**: 255 **Values**: a string of 255 characters or fewer |
|GatewayOptionData|object|false|none|A field used to pass gateway options. Zuora allows you to pass in special gateway-specific parameters for payments that go through the Adyen, Autorize.et, CyberSource, Merchant eSolutions, Orbital (Chase Paymentech), QValent, Vantiv, and Verifi gateways.<br><br>For each of these special parameters, you supply the name-value pair and Zuora passes it to the gateway. This allows you to add functionality that's supported by a specific gateway but currently not supported by Zuora.<br>|
|GatewayState|string|false|none| The status of the payment in the gateway.<br>**Character limit**: 19 **Values**: automatically generated |
|MethodType|string|false|none| Indicates how an external refund was issued to a customer. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to ` External`. You can issue an external refund on an electronic payment. **Character limit**: 30 **Values**:<br><br>- `ACH`<br>- `Cash`<br>- `Check`<br>- `CreditCard`<br>- `Other`<br>- `PayPal`<br>- `WireTransfer`<br>- `DebitCard`<br>- `CreditCardReferenceTransaction`<br>|
|PaymentId|string|false|none| The unique ID of the payment associated with this refund. Don't specify a value for this field if you're creating an electronic non-referenced refund.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid payment ID |
|PaymentMethodId|string|false|none| The unique ID of the payment method that the customer used to make the payment. This field is only required if you create a non-referenced refund.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **V****alues**: a valid payment method ID |
|ReasonCode|string|false|none| A code identifying the reason for the transaction. Must be an existing reason code or empty. If you do not specify a value, Zuora uses the default reason code.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **V****alues**: a valid reason code |
|RefundDate|string(date)|false|none|The date of the refund, in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. The date of the refund cannot be before the payment date. This field is only required if the `Type` field is set to ` External`. Zuora automatically generates this field for electronic refunds.<br><br>With the Future Dated Credit Balance Adjustment feature enabled, you can create a non-referenced refund with a refund date. <br>* For external refunds, you can specify any date.<br>* For electronic refunds, you can only set the date to the date when the API operation is called or one day later.<br>|
|RefundInvoicePaymentData|object|false|none|Container for the refund invoice payment data. This field is only required if you apply a full or partical refund against a payment attached to muliple invoices.<br>|
|SoftDescriptor|string|false|none| A payment gateway-specific field that maps Zuora to other gateways . **Character limit**: 35 **Values**:<br><br>- 3-byte company identifier &quot;*&quot; 18-byte descriptor<br>- 7-byte company identifier &quot;*&quot; 14-byte descriptor<br>- 12-byte company identifier &quot;*&quot; 9-byte descriptor<br>|
|SoftDescriptorPhone|string|false|none| A payment gateway-specific field that maps Zuora to other gateways . **Character limit**: 20 **Values**:<br><br>- Customer service phone number formatted as: `NNN-NNN-NNNN` or `NNN-AAAAAAA`<br>- URL (non-e-Commerce): Transactions sent with a URL do not qualify for the best interchange rate<br>- Email address<br>|
|SourceType|string|false|none| Specifies whether the refund is a refund payment or a credit balance. This field is only required if you create a non-referenced refund. If you creating an non-referenced refund, then set this value to `CreditBalance`.<br>**Note**: If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, the value of this field can only be set to `Payment`.<br>**Character limit**: 13 **Values**:<br><br>- `Payment`<br>- `CreditBalance`<br>|
|Type|string|true|none| Specifies if the refund is electronic or external.<br>**Character limit**: 10 **Values**:<br><br>- `Electronic`<br>- `External`<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the refund's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Origin__NS|string|false|none|Origin of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the refund was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SynctoNetSuite__NS|string|false|none|Specifies whether the refund should be synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Refund object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

```json
{
  "Active": true,
  "DecimalPlaces": 9,
  "DisplayedAs": "name_display_name_1476935033519",
  "RoundingMode": "UP",
  "UomName": "name_1476935033519"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Active|boolean|false|none| Indicates if the UOM is available for new product rate plans. The default value is `true`.<br>**Character limit**: 5 **Values**: `true`, `false ` |
|DecimalPlaces|integer(int64)|true|none|The number of digits to the right of the decimal point that you want to measure for the unit. To use whole numbers only, set this value to 0. You can't change this value after this `UOM` is used in any product, subscription, or usage. **Character limit**: 1 **Values**: an integer between 0 and 9, exclusive |
|DisplayedAs|string|false|none|The name of the UOM that you want displayed on invoices. The default value is the `UomName` field value. **Character limit**: 50 **Values**: A string of 50 characters or fewer |
|RoundingMode|string|false|none| Specifies whether to round the UOM value up or down when the value exceeds the `DecimalPlaces` field value. The default value is `Up`.<br>**Character limit**: 4 **Values**: `Up`, `Down` |
|UomName|string|true|none| The name of the UOM, such as license or GB. This name is displayed in query results and in the web-based UI labels. If you want a different name to be displayed on invoices, then use the `DisplayedAs` field to provide the invoice label.<br>**Character limit**: 50 **Values**: a string of 50 characters or fewer |

|Description|string|false|none|A description of the usage record.<br>|

|Quantity|number(double)|true|none| Indicates the number of units used.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a valid decimal amount equal to or greater than 0 |
|StartDateTime|string(date-time)|true|none| The start date and time of a range of time when usage is tracked. Zuora uses this field value to determine the usage date. Unlike the `EndDateTime`, the `StartDateTime` field does affect usage calculation.<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Values**: a valid date and time value |
|SubmissionDateTime|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when usage was submitted.<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Values**: automatically generated |
|SubscriptionId|string|false|none|The ID of the subscription that contains the fees related to the usage data.<br><br>The ID of a subscription might change when you create amendments to the subscription. It is good practice to use the unique subscription number that you can specify in the `SubscriptionNumber` field.<br>|
|SubscriptionNumber|string|false|none|The unique identifier number of the subscription that contains the fees related to the usage data.<br><br>It is good practice to use this field when creating usage records.<br>|
|UOM|string|true|none| Specifies the units to measure usage. Units of measure are configured in the web-based UI. Your values depend on your configuration in **Billing Settings**.<br>**Character limit**: **Values**: a valid unit of measure |
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Usage object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountNumber|string|false|none|Unique account number assigned to the account. **Character limit**: 50 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- null to auto-generate<br>- a string of 50 characters or fewer that doesn't begin with the default account number prefix<br>|
|AdditionalEmailAddresses|string|false|none|List of additional email addresses to receive emailed invoices. **Character limit**: 120 **Values**: comma-separated list of email addresses |
|AllowInvoiceEdit|boolean|false|none| Indicates if associated invoices can be edited.<br>**Character limit**: 5 **Values**: `true`, `false` (default if left null) |
|AutoPay|boolean|false|none| Indicates if future payments are automatically collected when they're due during a Payment Run.<br>**Character limit**: 5 **Values**: `true`, `false` (default) |
|Balance|number(double)|false|none|Current outstanding balance for the account. **Character limit**: 16 **Values**: automatically generated |
|Batch|string|false|none| Organizes your customer accounts into groups to optimize your billing and payment operations. Required if you use the Subscribe call<br>**Character limit**: 20 **Values**:any system-defined batch (`Batch1` - `Batch50 `or by name). |
|BcdSettingOption|string|false|none|Billing cycle day setting option. **Character limit**: 9 **Values**: `AutoSet`, `ManualSet` |
|BillCycleDay|integer(int32)|false|none|Billing cycle day (BCD) on which bill runs generate invoices for the account. **Character limit**: 2 **Values**: any activated system-defined bill cycle day (`1` - `31`) |
|BillToId|string|false|none|ID of the person to bill for the account. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid contact ID for the account |
|CommunicationProfileId|string|false|none|Associates the account with a specified communication profile. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid communication profile ID |
|CreatedById|string|false|none|ID of the Zuora user who created the Account object. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|Date when the Account object was created. **Character limit**: 29 **Values**: automatically generated |
|CreditBalance|number(double)|false|none|Total credit balance for the account. **Character limit**: 16 **Values**: automatically generated |
|CrmId|string|false|none|CRM account ID for the account. A CRM is a customer relationship management system, such as Salesforce.com. **Character limit**: 100 **Values**: a string of 100 characters or fewer |
|Currency|string|false|none| Currency that the customer is billed in. |
|CustomerServiceRepName|string|false|none|Name of the account's customer service representative, if applicable. **Character limit**: 50 **Values**: a string of 50 characters or fewer |
|DefaultPaymentMethodId|string|false|none|ID of the default payment method for the account. This field is required if the AutoPay field is set to `true`. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid ID for an existing payment method |
|Id|string|false|none|Object identifier.|
|InvoiceDeliveryPrefsEmail|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the customer wants to receive invoices through email.  **Character limit**: 5 **Values**: `true`, `false` (default if left null) |
|InvoiceDeliveryPrefsPrint|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the customer wants to receive printed invoices, such as through postal mail. **Character limit**: 5 **Values**: `true`, `false` (default if left null) |
|InvoiceTemplateId|string|false|none|The ID of the invoice template. Each customer account can use a specific invoice template for invoice generation. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid template ID configured in Zuora Billing Settings |
|LastInvoiceDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the previous invoice was generated for the account. The field value is null if no invoice has ever been generated for the account.<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Values**: automatically generated |
|Name|string|false|none|Name of the account as displayed in the Zuora UI. **Character limit**: 255 **Values**: a string of 255 characters or fewer |
|Notes|string|false|none| Comments about the account. **Character limit**: 65,535 **Values**: a string of 65,535 characters |
|ParentId|string|false|none|Identifier of the parent customer account for this Account object. Use this field if you have customer hierarchy enabled. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid account ID |
|PaymentGateway|string|false|none|Gateway used for processing electronic payments and refunds. **Character limit**: 40 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- a valid configured gateway name<br>- Null to inherit the default value set in Payment Settings<br>|
|PaymentTerm|string|false|none|Indicates when the customer pays for subscriptions. **Character limit**: 100 **Values**: a valid, active payment term defined in the web-based UI administrative settings |
|PurchaseOrderNumber|string|false|none|The number of the purchase order associated with this account. Purchase order information generally comes from customers. **Character limit**: 100 **Values**: a string of 100 characters or fewer |
|SalesRepName|string|false|none|The name of the sales representative associated with this account, if applicable. **Character limit**: 50 **Values**: a string of 50 characters or fewer |
|SoldToId|string|false|none|ID of the person who bought the subscription associated with the account. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid contact ID for the account |
|Status|string|false|none|Status of the account in the system.<br>|
|TaxCompanyCode|string|false|none| Unique code that identifies a company account in Avalara. Use this field to calculate taxes based on origin and sold-to addresses in Avalara.<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>**Character limit**: 50 **Values**: a valid company code |
|TaxExemptCertificateID|string|false|none|ID of your customer's tax exemption certificate. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a string of 32 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptCertificateType|string|false|none|Type of the tax exemption certificate that your customer holds.  **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a string of 32 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptDescription|string|false|none|Description of the tax exemption certificate that your customer holds. **Character limit**: 500 **Values**: a string of 500 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptEffectiveDate|string(date)|false|none|Date when the the customer's tax exemption starts. **Character limit**: 29 **Version notes**: requires Zuora Tax |
|TaxExemptExpirationDate|string(date)|false|none|Date when the customer's tax exemption certificate expires  **Character limit**: 29 **Version notes**: requires Zuora Tax |
|TaxExemptIssuingJurisdiction|string|false|none|Indicates the jurisdiction in which the customer's tax exemption certificate was issued. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a string of 32 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptStatus|string|false|none| Status of the account's tax exemption. Required if you use Zuora Tax.<br>**Character limit**: 19 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Yes`<br>- `No`<br>- `PendingVerification`<br>|
|TotalInvoiceBalance|number(double)|false|none|Total balance of the account's invoices. **Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a valid currency value |
|UpdatedById|string|false|none|ID of the user who last updated the account. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: automatically generated |
|UpdatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|Date when the account was last updated. **Character limit**: 29 **Values**: automatically generated |
|VATId|string|false|none| EU Value Added Tax ID.<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>**Character limit**: 25 **Values**: a valid Value Added Tax ID |
|Class__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Class field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|CustomerType__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Customer Type field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. The Customer Type field is used when the customer account is created in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Department__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Department field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the account's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Location__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Location field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Subsidiary__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Subsidiary field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. The Subsidiary field is required if you use NetSuite OneWorld. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the account was sychronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SynctoNetSuite__NS|string|false|none|Specifies whether the account should be synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Account object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

|Status|Active|
|Status|Canceled|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AutoRenew|boolean|false|none| Determines whether the subscription is automatically renewed, or whether it expires at the end of the term and needs to be manually renewed. **Required:** For amendment of type TermsAndConditions when changing the automatic renewal status of a subscription.<br>**Values**: true, false |
|Code|string|false|none| A unique alphanumeric string that identifies the amendment.<br>**Character limit**: 50 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `null` generates a value automatically<br>- A string<br>|
|ContractEffectiveDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the amendment's changes become effective for billing purposes.<br>**Version notes**: -- |
|CreatedById|string|false|none| The user ID of the person who created the amendment.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the amendment was created.<br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CurrentTerm|integer(int64)|false|none| The length of the period for the current subscription term. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>**Required**: Only if the value of the Type field is set to `TermsAndConditions` and TermType is set to `TERMED`. This field is not required if TermType is set to `EVERGREEN`.<br>**Character limit**: **Values**: a valid number |
|CurrentTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the current subscription term. **Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>**Note**:<br><br>- This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>- This field is used with the CurrentTerm field to specify the current subscription term.<br>|
|CustomerAcceptanceDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the customer accepts the amendment's changes to the subscription.<br><br>This field is only required if [Zuora is configured to require customer acceptance in Z-Billing](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/W_Billing_and_Payments_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings) and the subscription is currently in the Pending Acceptance status (the value of the `Status` field is currently `PendingAcceptance`).<br>|
|Description|string|false|none| A description of the amendment.<br>**Character limit**: 500 **Values**: maximum 500 characters |
|EffectiveDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the amendment's changes take effective. This field validates that the amendment's changes are within valid ranges of products and product rate plans.<br>**Required**: For the cancellation amendments. Optional for other types of amendments.<br>**Version notes**: -- |
|Id|string|false|none|Object identifier.|
|Name|string|false|none| The name of the amendment.<br>**Character limit**: 100 **Values**: a string of 100 characters or fewer |
|RenewalSetting|string|false|none| Specifies whether a termed subscription will remain termed or change to evergreen when it is renewed.<br>**Required**: If TermType is Termed **Values**: RENEW_WITH_SPECIFIC_TERM (default), RENEW_TO_EVERGREEN |
|RenewalTerm|integer(int64)|false|none| The term of renewal for the amended subscription. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>**Required**: Only if the value of the Type field is set to `TermsAndConditions`.<br>**Character limit**: **Values:** a valid number |
|RenewalTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the subscription renewal term. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>**Required**: Only if the value of the Type field is set to `TermsAndConditions`. This field is used with the RenewalTerm field to specify the subscription renewal term.<br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>|
|ServiceActivationDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when service is activated.<br><br>This field is only required if [Zuora is configured to require service activation in Z-Billing](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/W_Billing_and_Payments_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings) and the subscription is currently in the Pending Activation status (the value of the `Status` field is currently `PendingActivation`).<br>|
|SpecificUpdateDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the UpdateProduct amendment takes effect. This field is only applicable if there is already a future-dated UpdateProduct amendment on the subscription.<br>**Required**: Only for the UpdateProduct amendments if there is already a future-dated UpdateProduct amendment on the subscription.<br>**Version notes**: -- |
|Status|string|false|none| The status of the amendment. Type: string (enum) **Character limit**: 17 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- Draft (default, if left null)<br>- Pending Activation<br>- Pending Acceptance<br>- Completed<br>|
|SubscriptionId|string|false|none| The ID of the subscription that the amendment changes.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid subscription ID |
|TermStartDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the new terms and conditions take effect.<br><br><br>**Version notes**: -- |
|TermType|string|false|none| Indicates if the subscription isTERMED or EVERGREEN.<br><br>- A TERMED subscription has an expiration date, and must be manually renewed.<br>- An EVERGREEN subscription doesn't have an expiration date, and must be manually ended.<br><br>**Required**: Only when as part of an amendment of type TermsAndConditions &#65279;to change the term type of a subscription. |GatewayState|string|false|none|The status of the payment in the gateway; use for reconciliation.<br>|

|PaymentMethodId|string|false|none|The ID of the payment method used for the payment. <br>|
|PaymentMethodSnapshotId|string|false|none|The unique ID of the payment method snapshot which is a copy of the particular payment method used in a transaction.<br>|
|PaymentNumber|string|false|none|The unique identification number of the payment. For example, P-00000028.<br>|
|ReferenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|RefundAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of the payment that is refunded. The value of this field is `0` if no refund is made against the payment.<br>|
|SecondPaymentReferenceId|string|false|none|The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway if there is an additional transaction for the payment. Use this field to reconcile payments between your gateway and Zuora Payments.<br>|
|SettledOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was settled in the payment processor. This field is used by the Spectrum gateway only and not applicable to other gateways.<br>|
|SoftDescriptor|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi. <br>|
|SoftDescriptorPhone|string|false|none|A payment gateway-specific field that maps to Zuora for the gateways, Orbital, Vantiv and Verifi.<br>|
|Source|string|false|none|How the payment was created, whether through the API, manually, import, or payment run.<br>|
|SourceName|string|false|none|The name of the source. The value is a Payment Run number or a file name.<br>|
|Status|string|false|none|The status of the payment in Zuora. The value depends on the type of payments.<br><br>- If you have the Invoice Settlement feature disabled, for electronic payments, the status can be `Processed`, `Processing`, `Error`, or `Voided`. For external payments, the status can be `Processed` or `Canceled`.<br>- If you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled, for electronic payments, the status can be `Processed`, `Processing`, `Error`, or `Canceled`. For external payments, the status can be `Processed` or `Canceled`.<br>|
|SubmittedOn|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was submitted.<br>|
|TransferredToAccounting|string|false|none|Indicates if the payment was transferred to an external accounting system. Use this field for integration with accounting systems, such as NetSuite.<br>|
|Type|string|false|none|The type of the payment, whether the payment is external or electronic.<br>|
|UnappliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The unapplied amount of the payment.<br><br>**Note**: This field is only available if you have the Invoice Settlement feature enabled.<br>|
|UpdatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who last updated the payment.<br>|
|UpdatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment was last updated.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|

|Transaction__NS|string|false|none|Related transaction in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|

See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

All field values are case sensitive: note that these values are in all-caps. **Character limit**: 21 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `ONETIME (1)`<br>- `RECURRING (2)`<br>- `USAGE (4)`<br>- `ONETIMERECURRING (3)`<br>- `ONETIMEUSAGE (5)`<br>- `RECURRINGUSAGE (6)`<br>- `ONETIMERECURRINGUSAGE (7)`<br>|
|BillCycleDay|integer(int32)|false|none| Sets the bill cycle day (BCD) for the charge. The BCD determines which day of the month customer is billed. The BCD value in the account can override the BCD in this object.<br>**Character limit**: 2 **Values**: a valid BCD integer, 1 - 31 |
|BillCycleType|string|false|none| Specifies how to determine the billing day for the charge. **Character limit**: 20 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `DefaultFromCustomer`<br>- `SpecificDayofMonth:`<br>- `SubscriptionStartDay`<br>- `ChargeTriggerDay`<br>- `SpecificDayofWeek`<br>**Note**:<br><br>- If you set this field to `SpecificDayofMonth`, you must specify which day of the month as the billing day for the charge in the BillCycleDay field.<br>- If you set this field to `SpecificDayofWeek`, you must specify which day of the week as the billing day for the charge in the WeeklyBillCycleDay field.<br>|
|BillingPeriod|string|false|none| The billing period for the charge. The start day of the billing period is also called the bill cycle day (BCD).<br>**Character limit**: 15 **Values**: one of the following<br><br>- `Month`<br>- `Quarter`<br>- `Annual`<br>- `Semi-Annual`<br>- `Specific Months`<br>- `Subscription Term` (This value is in **Limited Availability**.)<br>- `Week`<br>- `Specific Weeks`<br>**Note**: Specify the number of months or weeks in the SpecificBillingPeriod field if you set this field to `Specific Months` or `Specific Weeks`. |
|BillingPeriodAlignment|string|false|none| Aligns charges within the same subscription if multiple charges begin on different dates.<br>**Character limit**: 24 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `AlignToCharge`<br>- `AlignToSubscriptionStart`<br>- `AlignToTermStart`<br>|
|BillingTiming|string|false|none| The billing timing for the charge. You can choose to bill in advance or in arrears for recurring charge types. This field is not used in one-time or usage based charge types.<br>**Character limit**: **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `In Advance`<br>- `In Arrears`<br><br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>|
|ChargeModel|string|false|none| Determines how to calculate charges. Charge models must be individually activated in Zuora Billing administration.<br>**Character limit**: 27 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Discount-Fixed Amount`<br>- `Discount-Percentage`<br>- `Flat Fee Pricing`<br>- `Per Unit Pricing`<br>- `Overage Pricing`<br>- `Tiered Pricing`<br>- `Tiered with Overage Pricing`<br>- `Volume Pricing`<br>|
|ChargeType|string|false|none| Specifies the type of charge.<br>**Character limit**: 9 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `OneTime`<br>- `Recurring`<br>- `Usage`<br>|
|CreatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who created the `ProductRatePlanCharge` object. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the  `ProductRatePlanCharge` object was created.<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Values**: automatically generated |
|DefaultQuantity|number(double)|false|none| The default quantity of units, such as the number of authors in a hosted wiki service. This field is required if you use a per-unit pricing model.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a valid quantity value |
|DeferredRevenueAccount|string|false|none| The name of the deferred revenue account for this charge.<br>**Character limit**: 100 **Values**: an active accounting code in your Zuora Chart of Accounts<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>|
|Description|string|false|none|A description of the charge. **Character limit**: 500 **Values**: a string of 500 characters or fewer |
|DiscountLevel|string|false|none| Specifies if the discount applies to just the product rate plan, the entire subscription, or to any activity in the account.<br>**Character limit**: 12 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `rateplan`<br>- `subscription`, `account`<br>|
|EndDateCondition|string|false|none| Defines when the charge ends after the charge trigger date.<br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `SubscriptionEnd`: The charge ends on the subscription end date after a specified period based on the trigger date of the charge. This is the default value.<br>- `FixedPeriod`: The charge ends after a specified period based on the trigger date of the charge. If you set this field to `FixedPeriod`, you must specify the length of the period and a period type by defining the `UpToPeriods` and `UpToPeriodsType` fields.<br>**Note**: If the subscription ends before the charge end date, the charge ends when the subscription ends. But if the subscription end date is subsequently changed through a Renewal, or Terms and Conditions amendment, the charge will end on the charge end date. |
|Id|string|false|none|Object identifier.|
|IncludedUnits|number(double)|false|none|Specifies the number of units in the base set of units. **Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a positive decimal value |
|LegacyRevenueReporting|boolean|false|none|none|
|ListPriceBase|string|false|none|The list price base for the product rate plan charge. **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Per Month`<br>- `Per Billing Period`<br>- `Per Week`<br>|
|MaxQuantity|number(double)|false|none| Specifies the maximum number of units for this charge. Use this field and the `MinQuantity` field to create a range of units allowed in a product rate plan charge.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a positive decimal value |
|MinQuantity|number(double)|false|none|Specifies the minimum number of units for this charge. Use this field and the `MaxQuantity` field to create a range of units allowed in a product rate plan charge. **Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a positive decimal value |

|NumberOfPeriod|integer(int64)|false|none|Specifies the number of periods to use when calculating charges in an overage smoothing charge model. **Character limit**: **Values**: a positive whole number |
|OverageCalculationOption|string|false|none|Determines when to calculate overage charges. If the value of the SmoothingMode field is not specified, the value of this field is ignored. **Character limit**: 20 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `EndOfSmoothingPeriod`: This option is used by default. The overage is charged at the end of the smoothing period.<br>- `PerBillingPeriod`: The overage is charged on-demand rather than waiting until the end of the smoothing period.<br>|
|OverageUnusedUnitsCreditOption|string|false|none| Determines whether to credit the customer with unused units of usage.<br>**Character limit**: 20 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `NoCredit`<br>- `CreditBySpecificRate`<br>|
|PriceChangeOption|string|false|none| Applies an automatic price change when a termed subscription is renewed.<br>**Character limit**: **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `NoChange` (default)<br>- `SpecificPercentageValue`<br>- `UseLatestProductCatalogPricing`<br>|
|PriceIncreasePercentage|number(double)|false|none| Specifies the percentage to increase or decrease the price of a termed subscription's renewal. Use this field if you set the value to `SpecificPercentageValue`.<br>**Character limit**: 16 **Values**: a decimal value between -100 and 100 |
|ProductRatePlanId|string|false|none| The ID of the product rate plan associated with this product rate plan charge.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid product rate plan ID |
|RatingGroup|string|false|none|A rating group based on which usage records are rated. Only applicable to Usage charges.<br><br>Possible values:<br><br>- `ByBillingPeriod`: The rating is based on all the usages in a billing period.<br>- `ByUsageStartDate`: The rating is based on all the usages on the same usage start date. <br>- `ByUsageRecord`: The rating is based on each usage record.<br>- `ByUsageUpload`: The rating is based on all the  usages in a uploaded usage file (`.xls` or `.csv`).<br>- `ByGroupId`: The rating is based on all the usages in a custom group.<br><br>For more information, see [Usage rating by group](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/J_Billing_Operations/Usage/Usage_Rating_by_Group).<br>|
|RecognizedRevenueAccount|string|false|none| The name of the recognized revenue account for this charge.<br><br>- Required when the Allow Blank Accounting Code setting is No.<br>- Optional when the Allow Blank Accounting Code setting is Yes.<br><br>**Character limit**: 100 **Values**: an active accounting code in your Zuora Chart of Accounts<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>|
|RevRecCode|string|false|none|Associates this product rate plan charge with a specific revenue recognition code. **Character limit**: 70 **Values**: a valid revenue recognition code |
|RevRecTriggerCondition|string|false|none| Specifies when revenue recognition begins.<br>**Character limit**: 22 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `ContractEffectiveDate`<br>- `ServiceActivationDate`<br>- `CustomerAcceptanceDate`<br>|
|RevenueRecognitionRuleName|string|false|none|Determines when to recognize the revenue for this charge. **Character limit**: 25 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Recognize upon invoicing`<br>- `Recognize daily over time`<br>|
|SmoothingModel|string|false|none| Specifies the smoothing model for an overage smoothing charge model.<br>**Character limit**: 22 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `RollingWindow`<br>- `Rollover`<br>|
|SpecificBillingPeriod|integer(int64)|false|none| Customizes the number of months or weeks for the charges billing period. This field is required if you set the value of the BillingPeriod field to `Specific Months` or `Specific Weeks`.<br>**Values**: a positive integer |
|TaxCode|string|false|none| Specifies the tax code for taxation rules. Required when the Taxable field is set to `True`.<br><br>**Character limit**: 64<br><br>**Values**: a valid tax code<br><br>**Note**: This value affects the tax calculation of rate plan charges that come from the `ProductRatePlanCharge`. |
|TaxMode|string|false|none| Determines how to define taxation for the charge. Required when the Taxable field is set to `True`.<br><br>**Character limit**: 12<br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `TaxExclusive`<br>- `TaxInclusive`<br><br>**Note**: This value affects the tax calculation of rate plan charges that come from the `ProductRatePlanCharge`. |
|Taxable|boolean|false|none| Determines whether the charge is taxable. |TriggerEvent|string|false|none| Specifies when to start billing the customer for the charge.<br>**Character limit**: 18 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `ContractEffective` is the date when the subscription's contract goes into effect and the charge is ready to be billed.<br>- `ServiceActivation` is the date when the services or products for a subscription have been activated and the customers have access.<br>- `CustomerAcceptance` is when the customer accepts the services or products for a subscription.<br>|
|UOM|string|false|none| Specifies the units to measure usage.<br>**Character limit**: 25 **Values**: a configured unit of measure **Note**: You must specify this field when creating the following charge models:<br><br>- Per Unit Pricing<br>- Volume Pricing<br>- Overage Pricing<br>- Tiered Pricing<br>- Tiered with Overage Pricing<br>|
|UpToPeriods|integer(int64)|false|none| Specifies the length of the period during which the charge is active. |PaymentGateway|string|false|none|Gateway used for processing electronic payments and refunds. **Character limit**: 40 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- a valid configured gateway name<br>- Null to inherit the default value set in Zuora Payment Settings<br>|
|PaymentTerm|string|false|none|Indicates when the customer pays for subscriptions. **Character limit**: 100 **Values**: a valid, active payment term defined in the web-based UI administrative settings |

|SoldToId|string|false|none|ID of the person who bought the subscription associated with the account. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid contact ID for the account |
|Status|string|false|none|Status of the account in the system.<br><br>Follow the following rules to update the status of accounts:<br>- Include contact IDs in the `BillToId` and `SoldToId` fields when you change the `Status` field value to `Active`.<br>- Before changing the status of an account to `Canceled`, cancel all subscriptions associated with this account. You cannot cancel an account that has active subscriptions.<br>- You can update a Draft account to Active, assuming the Bill To/Sold To Contacts are assigned. <br>- You can update a Canceled account to the Active status at any time.<br>- You cannot update the Active or Cancelled status of an account to `Draft`.<br>|
|TaxCompanyCode|string|false|none| Unique code that identifies a company account in Avalara. Use this field to calculate taxes based on origin and sold-to addresses in Avalara.<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br>**Character limit**: 50 **Values**: a valid company code |
|TaxExemptCertificateID|string|false|none|ID of your customer's tax exemption certificate. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a string of 32 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptCertificateType|string|false|none|Type of the tax exemption certificate that your customer holds.  **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a string of 32 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptDescription|string|false|none|Description of the tax exemption certificate that your customer holds. **Character limit**: 500 **Values**: a string of 500 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptEffectiveDate|string(date)|false|none|Date when the the customer's tax exemption starts. **Character limit**: 29 **Version notes**: requires Zuora Tax |

|communicationProfileId|string|false|none|Associates the account with a specified communication profile. **Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid communication profile ID |
|Class__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Class field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|

Optional for other types of amendments.<br>**Version notes**: -- |

|RenewalTerm|integer(int64)|false|none| The term of renewal for the amended subscription. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>**Required**: Only if the value of the Type field is set to `TermsAndConditions`.<br>**Character limit**: **Values:** a valid number |
|RenewalTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the subscription renewal term. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>**Required**: Only if the value of the Type field is set to `TermsAndConditions`. This field is used with the RenewalTerm field to specify the subscription renewal term.<br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>|
|ServiceActivationDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when service is activated.<br><br>This field is only required if [Zuora is configured to require service activation in Z-Billing](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/W_Billing_and_Payments_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings) and the subscription is currently in the Pending Activation status (the value of the `Status` field is currently `PendingActivation`).<br><br>Use this field together with the `Status` field. When you set a date in this field as a service activation date, you should also set the `Status` field as the expected next phase status: `Completed` or `PendingAcceptance`.<br>|
|SpecificUpdateDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the UpdateProduct amendment takes effect. This field is only applicable if there is already a future-dated UpdateProduct amendment on the subscription.<br>**Required**: Only for the UpdateProduct amendments if there is already a future-dated UpdateProduct amendment on the subscription.<br>|
|Status|string|false|none| The status of the amendment. Type: string (enum) **Character limit**: 17 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- Draft (default, if left null)<br>- Pending Activation<br>- Pending Acceptance<br>- Completed<br>|
|SubscriptionId|string|false|none| The ID of the subscription that the amendment changes. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>**Character limit**: 32 **Values**: a valid subscription ID |
|TermStartDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the new terms and conditions take effect.<br>**Required**: Only if the value of the Type field is set to TermsAndConditions.<br>**Version notes**: -- |
|TermType|string|false|none| Indicates if the subscription is TERMED or EVERGREEN. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br><br>- A TERMED subscription has an expiration date, and must be manually renewed.<br>- An EVERGREEN subscription doesn't have an expiration date, and must be manually ended.<br><br>**Required**: Only when as part of an amendment of type TermsAndConditions &#65279;to change the term type of a subscription. Type: string **Character limit**: 9 **Values**: TERMED, EVERGREEN |
|Type|string|false|none| The type of amendment. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>**Character limit**: 18 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- Cancellation<br>- NewProduct<br>- OwnerTransfer<br>- RemoveProduct<br>- Renewal<br>- UpdateProduct<br>- TermsAndConditions<br>- SuspendSubscription<br>- ResumeSubscription<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Amendment object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

If this setting is set to `Yes`:<br><br> * If the `ServiceActivationDate` field is required, you must set this field, `ServiceActivationDate`, and `ContractEffectiveDate` fields in the Subscribe call to activate a subscription.<br> * If the `ServiceActivationDate` field is not required, you must set both this field and the `ContractEffectiveDate` field in the Subscribe call to activate a subscription. If you only set a valid date in the `ContractEffectiveDate` field, the Subscribe call still returns success, but the subscription is in `Pending Acceptance` status.<br><br>This field can also be updated when the subscription is still on version one (has not been amended before) and the [Allow update Subscription trigger dates?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_and_Order_Settings#Allow_update_Subscription_trigger_dates.3F) setting in Billing Settings is set to `Yes`. <br>|
|ContractEffectiveDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the contract takes effect.<br><br>This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`.<br><br>**Note**: This field is required in the Subscribe call. If you set the value of this field to null and both the ServiceActivationDate and ContractAcceptanceDate fields are not required, the Subscribe call still returns success, but the new subscription is in `DRAFT` status. To activate the subscription, you must set a valid date to this field.<br><br>This field can also be updated when the subscription is still on version one (has not been amended before) and the [Allow update Subscription trigger dates?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_and_Order_Settings#Allow_update_Subscription_trigger_dates.3F) setting in Billing Settings is set to "Yes".<br>|
|CurrentTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the current subscription term. This field is used with the CurrentTerm field to specify the current subscription term.<br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>|
|InitialTerm|integer(int32)|false|none| The length of the period for the first subscription term. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>**Required**: If TermType is Termed **Character limit**: 20 **Values**: any valid number. |
|InitialTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the first subscription term.<br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>**Note**:<br><br>- This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>- This field is used with the InitialTerm field to specify the initial subscription term.<br>|
|InvoiceOwnerId|string|false|none| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. A valid account ID. |
|IsInvoiceSeparate|boolean|false|none| Determines if the subscription is invoiced separately. If `TRUE`, then all charges for this subscription are collected into the subscription's own invoice.<br>**Values**: `TRUE`, `FALSE `(default) |
|Name|string|false|none| The unique identifier of the subscription. If you don't specify a value, then Zuora generates a name automatically. Whether auto-generated or manually specified, the subscription name must be unique. Otherwise an error will occur.<br>**Character limit**: 100 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- leave null to automatically generate<br>- a string of 100 characters or fewer<br>|
|Notes|string|false|none| Use this field to record comments about the subscription.<br>**Character limit**: 500 **Values**: a string of 500 characters or fewer |
|RenewalSetting|string|false|none| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. Specifies whether a termed subscription will remain termed or change to evergreen when it is renewed.<br>**Required**: If TermType is Termed **Values**: `RENEW_WITH_SPECIFIC_TERM `(default), `RENEW_TO_EVERGREEN` |
|RenewalTerm|integer(int32)|false|none| The length of the period for the subscription renewal term. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. **Required**: If TermType is Termed.<br>**Character limit**: 20 **Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- leave null to default to `0`<br>- any number<br>|
|RenewalTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the subscription renewal term.<br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>**Note**:<br><br>- This field is used with the RenewalTerm field to specify the subscription renewal term.<br>- This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>|
|ServiceActivationDate|string(date)|false|none|The date when the subscription is activated. <br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br>This field can be updated when **Status** is `Pending Activation`.<br><br>**Note**: This field is only required in the Subscribe call if the [Require Service Activation of Orders?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_and_Order_Settings#Require_Service_Activation_of_Orders.3F) setting is set to `Yes`. If this setting is set to `Yes`:<br><br> * If the `ContractAcceptanceDate` field is required, you must set this field, `ContractAcceptanceDate`, and `ContractEffectiveDate` fields in the Subscribe call to activate a subscription.<br> * If the `ContractAcceptanceDate` field is not required, you must set both this field and the `ContractEffectiveDate` field in the Subscribe call to activate a subscription. If you only set a valid date in the `ContractEffectiveDate` field, the Subscribe call still returns success, but the subscription is in `Pending Activation` status.<br><br>This field can also be updated when the subscription is still on version one (has not been amended before) and the [Allow update Subscription trigger dates?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_and_Order_Settings#Allow_update_Subscription_trigger_dates.3F) setting in Billing Settings is set to "Yes". <br>|
|Status|string|false|none| The status of the subscription.<br>**Character limit**: 17 **Values**: automatically generated **Possible values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Draft`<br>- `Pending Activation`<br>- `Pending Acceptance`<br>- `Active`<br>- `Cancelled`<br>- `Expired`<br>- `Suspended` (This value is in **Limited Availability**.)<br>|
|TermStartDate|string(date)|false|none| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. The date when the subscription term begins. If this is a renewal subscription, then this date is different from the subscription start date.<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Version notes**: -- |
|TermType|string|false|none| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. Indicates if a subscription is termed or evergreen.<br>**Character limit**: 9 **Values**: `TERMED`, `EVERGREEN` |
|Version|integer(int32)|false|none| The version number of the subscription.<br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CpqBundleJsonId__QT|string|false|none|The Bundle product structures from Zuora Quotes if you utilize Bundling in Salesforce. Do not change the value in this field.<br>|
|OpportunityCloseDate__QT|string(date)|false|none|The closing date of the Opportunity. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|OpportunityName__QT|string|false|none|The unique identifier of the Opportunity. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|QuoteBusinessType__QT|string|false|none|The specific identifier for the type of business transaction the Quote represents such as New, Upsell, Downsell, Renewal or Churn. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|QuoteNumber__QT|string|false|none|The unique identifier of the Quote. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|QuoteType__QT|string|false|none|The Quote type that represents the subscription lifecycle stage such as New, Amendment, Renew or Cancel. This field is used in Zuora data sources to report on Subscription metrics. If the subscription originated from Zuora Quotes, the value is populated with the value from Zuora Quotes.<br>|
|IntegrationId__NS|string|false|none|ID of the corresponding object in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|IntegrationStatus__NS|string|false|none|Status of the subscription's synchronization with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|Project__NS|string|false|none|The NetSuite project that the subscription was created from. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SalesOrder__NS|string|false|none|The NetSuite sales order than the subscription was created from. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|SyncDate__NS|string|false|none|Date when the subscription was synchronized with NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Subscription object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_ProxyModifyUnitOfMeasure">ProxyModifyUnitOfMeasure</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaproxymodifyunitofmeasure"></a>

```json
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|Active|boolean|false|none| Indicates if the UOM is available for new product rate plans. The default value is `true`.<br>**Character limit**: 5 **Values**: `true`, `false ` |
|DecimalPlaces|integer(int64)|false|none|The number of digits to the right of the decimal point that you want to measure for the unit. To use whole numbers only, set this value to 0. You can't change this value after this `UOM` is used in any product, subscription, or usage. **Character limit**: 1 **Values**: an integer between 0 and 9, exclusive |
|DisplayedAs|string|false|none|The name of the UOM that you want displayed on invoices. The default value is the `UomName` field value. **Character limit**: 50 **Values**: A string of 50 characters or fewer |
|RoundingMode|string|false|none| Specifies whether to round the UOM value up or down when the value exceeds the `DecimalPlaces` field value. The default value is `Up`.<br>**Character limit**: 4 **Values**: `Up`, `Down` |
|UomName|string|false|none| The name of the UOM, such as license or GB. This name is displayed in query results and in the web-based UI labels. If you want a different name to be displayed on invoices, then use the `DisplayedAs` field to provide the invoice label.<br>**Character limit**: 50 **Values**: a string of 50 characters or fewer |

|amountPerUnit|number|false|none|The actual charged amount per unit for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|

|description|string|false|none|The description of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|itemName|string|false|none|The name of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|itemNumber|string|false|none|The number for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|itemState|string|false|none|The state of the Order Line Item (OLI). See [Order Line Item states, Order states, and state transitions](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Subscriptions/Orders/Order_Line_Items/AB_Order_Line_Item_States_and_Order_States) for more information.<br><br>To generate invoice for an OLI, you must set this field to `SentToBilling` and set the `billTargetDate` field .<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` or `SentToBilling`state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing` or `SentToBilling`).<br>|
|itemType|string|false|none|The type of the Order Line Item (OLI). <br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|listPricePerUnit|number|false|none|The list price per unit for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|productCode|string|false|none|The product code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|purchaseOrderNumber|string|false|none|Used by customers to specify the Purchase Order Number provided by the buyer.<br><br>You can update this field for an Order Line Item (OLI) only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|quantity|number|false|none|The quantity of units, such as the number of authors in a hosted wiki service.<br><br>You can update this field for an Order Line Item (OLI) only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|recognizedRevenueAccountingCode|string|false|none|The recognized revenue accounting code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|revenueRecognitionRule|string|false|none|The Revenue Recognition rule for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|taxCode|string|false|none|The tax code for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|taxMode|string|false|none|The tax mode for the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
|transactionDate|string(date)|false|none|The transaction date of the Order Line Item (OLI).<br><br>You can update this field for an OLI only when the OLI is in the `Executing` state (when the `itemState` field is set as `Executing`).<br>|
