Container of the ramp definitions. It is used to create, update, or remove the ramp definition for the new subscription.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|charges|[[RampChargeRequest](#schemarampchargerequest)]|false|none|Container for the rate plan charges that are considered as part of the ramp deal.<br><br>* If this field is not specified, all the one-time and recurring regular charges of the new subscription are automatically considered as part of the ramp deal.<br>* If this field is specified, either 'chargeNumber' or 'uniqueToken' must be specified.<br>|
|delete|boolean|false|none|Whether to remove the ramp definition from the new subscription. If you want to remove the ramp definition, this field is the only required field for the `ramp` object.  <br>|
|description|string|false|none|The short description of the ramp.|
|intervals|[[RampIntervalRequest](#schemarampintervalrequest)]|false|none|Container for the intervals that the ramp is split into in its timeline. <br><br>It is required when you want to create or update the ramp definition. The ramp intervals cannot have any overlap or gap between each other.<br>|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the ramp.|

|AmendmentSubscriptionRatePlanId|string|false|none|The ID of the subscription rate plan modified by the amendment. This field only applies to amendment rate plans.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: a valid rate plan ID |

|CreatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who created the RatePlan object.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date when the `RatePlan` object was last updated.<br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|Name|string|false|none|The name of the rate plan. Leave this null in a subscribe call to inherited the `ProductRatePlan.Name` field value.<br><br>**Character limit**: 100<br><br>**Values**: a string of 100 characters or fewer or inherited from ProductRatePlan.Name |
|ProductRatePlanId|string|true|none|The ID of the associated product rate plan.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: a valid product rate plan ID |
|SubscriptionId|string|false|none|The ID of the subscription that the rate plan belongs to.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: a valid subscription ID |
|UpdatedById|string|false|none| The ID of the user who last updated the rate plan.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|UpdatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the rate plan was last updated.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |

```json
  "Name": "string",
```


### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AmendmentId|string|false|none| The ID of the amendment associated with the rate plan. This field only applies to amendment rate plans.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid amendment ID |
|AmendmentSubscriptionRatePlanId|string|false|none|The ID of the subscription rate plan modified by the amendment. This field only applies to amendment rate plans.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid rate plan ID |
|AmendmentType|string|false|none|The type of amendment associated with the rate plan. This field only applies to amendment rate plans.<br><br>**Character limit**: 18<br><br><br>**Values**: inherited from `Amendment.Type` |
|CreatedById|string|false|none|The ID of the Zuora user who created the RatePlan object.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date when the `RatePlan` object was last updated.<br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|Name|string|false|none|The name of the rate plan. Leave this null in a subscribe<br>call to inherited the `ProductRatePlan.Name` field value.<br><br>**Character limit**: 100<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 100 characters or fewer or inherited from ProductRatePlan.Name |
|ProductRatePlanId|string|true|none|The ID of the associated product rate plan.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid product rate plan ID |
|SubscriptionId|string|false|none|The ID of the subscription that the rate plan belongs to.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid subscription ID |
|UpdatedById|string|false|none| The ID of the user who last updated the rate plan.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|UpdatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the rate plan was last updated.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|Custom fields of the Rate Plan object. The name of each custom field has the form <code>*customField*__c</code>. Custom field names are case sensitive. See [Manage Custom Fields](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BB_Introducing_Z_Business/Manage_Custom_Fields) for more information.<br>|

Rate plan associated with a subscription.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargeOverrides|[[ChargeOverride](#schemachargeoverride)]|false|none|List of charges associated with the rate plan.<br>|
|customFields|[RatePlanObjectCustomFields](#schemarateplanobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of a Rate Plan object.<br>|
|newRatePlanId|string|false|none|Internal identifier of the rate plan.<br>|
|productRatePlanId|string|true|none|Internal identifier of the product rate plan that the rate plan is based on.<br>|
|uniqueToken|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the rate plan. This identifier enables you to refer to the rate plan before the rate plan has an internal identifier in Zuora.<br><br>For instance, suppose that you want to use a single order to add a product to a subscription and later update the same product. When you add the product, you can set a unique identifier for the rate plan. Then when you update the product, you can use the same unique identifier to specify which rate plan to modify.<br>|

Information about an order action of type `UpdateProduct`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargeUpdates|[[ChargeUpdate](#schemachargeupdate)]|false|none|none|
|customFields|[RatePlanObjectCustomFields](#schemarateplanobjectcustomfields)|false|none|Container for custom fields of a Rate Plan object.<br>|
|newRatePlanId|string|false|none|Internal identifier of the updated rate plan in the new subscription version.<br>|
|ratePlanId|string|false|none|Internal identifier of the rate plan that was updated.<br>|
|specificUpdateDate|string(date)|false|none|<br>The date when the Update Product order action takes effect. This field is only applicable if there is already a future-dated Update Product order action on the subscription. The format of the date is yyyy-mm-dd.<br><br>See [Update a Product on Subscription with Future-dated Updates](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Orders/AC_Orders_Tutorials/C_Update_a_Product_in_a_Subscription/Update_a_Product_on_Subscription_with_Future-dated_Updates) for more information about this feature.<br>|
|uniqueToken|string|false|none|A unique string to represent the rate plan charge in the order. The unique token is used to perform multiple actions against a newly added rate plan. For example, if you want to add and update a product in the same order, you would assign a unique token to the product rate plan when added and use that token in future order actions.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_SubmitDataQueryRequest">SubmitDataQueryRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasubmitdataqueryrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_SubmitDataQueryRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSsubmitdataqueryrequest"></a>
<a id="tocssubmitdataqueryrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "compression": "NONE",
  "output": {
    "target": "S3"
  },
  "outputFormat": "JSON",
  "query": "SELECT accountnumber, balance FROM Account WHERE Account.balance > 100"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|columnSeparator|string|false|none|The column separator. Only applicable if the `outputFormat` is `DSV`.<br>|
|compression|string|true|none|Specifies whether Zuora compresses the query results.<br>|
|encryptionKey|string(byte)|false|none|Base-64 encoded public key of an RSA key-pair. <br><br>Note that Data Query only supports 1024-bit RSA keys.<br><br>If you set this field, Zuora encrypts the query results using the provided public key. You must use the corresponding private key to decrypt the query results.<br>|
|output|object|true|none|Additional information about the query results.<br>|
|outputFormat|string|true|none|Specifies the format of the query results.<br><br>* `JSON` - Each row in the query results will be a JSON object. The format of the query result file is [JSON Lines](http://jsonlines.org/).<br>* `CSV` - Each row in the query results will be a comma-separated list of values.<br>* `TSV` - Each row in the query results will be a tab-separated list of values.<br>* `DSV` - Pass any character as your custom delimiter into the `columnSeparator` field.<br>|
|query|string|true|none|The query to perform. See [SQL Queries in Data Query](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/BA_Data_Query/BA_SQL_Queries_in_Data_Query) for more information.<br>|
|readDeleted|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the query will retrieve only the deleted record. If `readDeleted` is set to `false` or it is not included in the request body, the query will retrieve only the non-deleted records. If it is set to `true`, only the deleted records will be retrieved.<br><br>Note that Data Query is subject to Zuora Data Retention Policy. The retention period of deleted data is 30 days. You can only retrieve deleted data for 30 days through Data Query.<br>|
|sourceData|string|false|none|Specifiy that data queries run against the live transactional databases at Zuora (Data Query Live), or run against the optimized, replicated database at 12 hours freshness for high volume extraction (Data Query Unlimited).<br><br>**Note**: Data Query Unlimited is an Early Adopter feature.  If you want to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/). <br><br>* `DATAHUB` - Data queries run against the optimized, replicated database at 12 hours freshness for high volume extraction (Data Query Unlimited). Data Query Unlimited is an Early Adopter feature.  If you want to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/). <br>* `LIVE` - Data queries run against the live transactional databases at Zuora (Data Query Live).<br><br>The default value is `LIVE`.<br>|
|useIndexJoin|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether to use Index Join. Index join is useful when you have a specific reference value in your WHERE clause to index another large table by. See [Use Index Join](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/BA_Data_Query/Best_practices_of_Data_Query#Use_Index_Join) for more information.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|compression|NONE|
|compression|GZIP|
|compression|ZIP|
|outputFormat|JSON|
|outputFormat|CSV|
|outputFormat|TSV|
|outputFormat|DSV|
|sourceData|DATAHUB|
|sourceData|LIVE|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Account|[SubscribeRequestAccount](#schemasubscriberequestaccount)|true|none| This is the Account object containing the information for this particular subscription. It has all the information needed to create an account for a subscription.<br><br>**Values:** A valid account.|
|BillToContact|[SubscribeRequestBillToContact](#schemasubscriberequestbilltocontact)|false|none| This is the object that contains the contact associated with this account in the Account's `BillToId` field.<br>This field is only required if the account does not exist.<br>Values: A valid contact for the account.|
|PaymentMethod|object|false|none| This is the object defining the payment details for the Account. The Account will be updated with this payment as the default payment method.<br>Use this field if you are associating an electronic payment method with the account. A payment gateway must be enabled.<br>Values: A valid electronic PaymentMethod.|
|PreviewOptions|object|false|none|Only used if you want to call this operation in preview mode. After a call in preview mode is completed, Zuora will roll back the subscription and return only the temporary invoice data.<br>|
|SoldToContact|[SubscribeRequestSoldToContact](#schemasubscriberequestsoldtocontact)|false|none| Unless otherwise specified, this field defaults to the information in the `BillToContact` field.<br><br>**Values:** A valid contact. |
|SubscribeOptions|object|false|none| This optional object specifies parameters related to invoicing - whether to immediately generate an invoice and collect payment, and whether the invoice should cover all subscriptions or just this new subscription.<br>The default behavior is to invoice immediately for all the account's subscriptions, with the current date as the target date, and immediately collect payment if the account's `AutoPay` flag is true.<br><br><br>**Values:** A valid SubscribeOptions object. |
|SubscriptionData|object|true|none| This object contains the information on the contract's dates and terms.<br><br><br>**Values:** A valid SubscriptionData object. |

 This is the Account object containing the information for this particular subscription. It has all the information needed to create an account for a subscription.

**Values:** A valid account.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountNumber|string|false|none|Unique account number assigned to the account.<br><br>**Character limit**: 50<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- null to auto-generate<br>- a string of 50 characters or fewer that doesn't begin with the default account number prefix<br>|
|AdditionalEmailAddresses|string|false|none|List of additional email addresses to receive emailed invoices.<br><br>**Character limit**: 120<br><br><br>**Values**: comma-separated list of email addresses |
|AllowInvoiceEdit|boolean|false|none| Indicates if associated invoices can be edited.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 5<br><br><br>**Values**: `true`, `false` (default if left null) |
|AutoPay|boolean|false|none| Indicates if future payments are automatically collected when they're due during a Payment Run.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 5<br><br><br>**Values**: `true`, `false` (default) |
|Batch|string|true|none| Organizes your customer accounts into groups to optimize your billing and payment operations.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 20<br><br><br>**Values**:any system-defined batch (`Batch1` - `Batch50 `or by name). |
|BcdSettingOption|string|false|none|Billing cycle day setting option.<br><br>**Character limit**: 9<br><br><br>**Values**: `AutoSet`, `ManualSet` |
|BillCycleDay|integer(int32)|true|none|Billing cycle day (BCD) on which bill runs generate invoices for the account.<br><br>**Character limit**: 2<br><br><br>**Values**: any activated system-defined bill cycle day (`1` - `31`) |
|CommunicationProfileId|string|false|none|Associates the account with a specified communication profile.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid communication profile ID |
|CrmId|string|false|none|CRM account ID for the account. A CRM is a customer relationship management system, such as Salesforce.com.<br><br>**Character limit**: 100<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 100 characters or fewer |
|Currency|string|true|none| Currency that the customer is billed in. See [a currency value defined in the Zuora Ui admin settings](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Customize_Currencies) |
|CustomerServiceRepName|string|false|none|Name of the account's customer service representative, if applicable.<br><br>**Character limit**: 50<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 50 characters or fewer |
|DefaultPaymentMethodId|string|false|none|ID of the default payment method for the account. This field is only required if the `AutoPay` field is set to `true`.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: A valid ID for an existing payment method. This field does not support external payment methods. |
|Id|string|false|none|Internal identifier of an existing account. Only set this field if you want to assign the subscription to an existing account.|
|InvoiceDeliveryPrefsEmail|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the customer wants to receive invoices through email.<br>**Character limit**: 5<br><br><br>**Values**: `true`, `false` (default if left null) |
|InvoiceDeliveryPrefsPrint|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the customer wants to receive printed invoices, such as through postal mail.<br><br>**Character limit**: 5<br><br><br>**Values**: `true`, `false` (default if left null) |
|InvoiceTemplateId|string|false|none|The ID of the invoice template. Each customer account can use a specific invoice template for invoice generation.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: a[ valid template ID configured in Z-Billing Settings](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Manage_Invoice_Rules_and_Templates) To find the ID of your current invoice template: In Zuora, navigate to **Settings > Z-Billing > Manage Invoice Rules and Templates** and click **Show Id **next to the template you want to use.<br><br><br>|
|LastInvoiceDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the previous invoice was generated for the account. The field value is null if no invoice has ever been generated for the account.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|Name|string|true|none|Name of the account as displayed in the Zuora UI.<br><br>**Character limit**: 255<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 255 characters or fewer |
|Notes|string|false|none| Comments about the account.<br><br>**Character limit**: 65,535<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 65,535 characters |
|ParentId|string|false|none|Identifier of the parent customer account for this Account object. Use this field if you have customer hierarchy enabled.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid account ID |
|PaymentGateway|string|false|none|Gateway used for processing electronic payments and refunds. This field is only required if there is no default payment gateway is defined in the tenant.<br><br>**Character limit**: 40<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- a valid configured gateway name<br>- Null to inherit the default value set in Z-Payment Settings<br>|
|PaymentTerm|string|false|none|Indicates when the customer pays for subscriptions.<br><br>**Character limit**: 100<br><br><br>**Values**: [a valid, active payment term defined in the web-based UI administrative settings](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Payment_Terms) |
|PurchaseOrderNumber|string|false|none|The number of the purchase order associated with this account. Purchase order information generally comes from customers.<br><br>**Character limit**: 100<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 100 characters or fewer |
|SalesRepName|string|false|none|The name of the sales representative associated with this account, if applicable.<br><br>**Character limit**: 50<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 50 characters or fewer |
|TaxCompanyCode|string|false|none| Unique code that identifies a company account in Avalara. Use this field to calculate taxes based on origin and sold-to addresses in Avalara.<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br><br><br>**Character limit**: 50<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid company code |
|TaxExemptCertificateID|string|false|none|ID of your customer's tax exemption certificate.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 32 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptCertificateType|string|false|none|Type of the tax exemption certificate that your customer holds.<br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 32 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptDescription|string|false|none|Description of the tax exemption certificate that your customer holds.<br><br>**Character limit**: 500<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 500 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptEffectiveDate|string(date)|false|none|Date when the the customer's tax exemption starts.<br><br>**Character limit**: 29 **Version notes**: requires Z-Tax |
|TaxExemptExpirationDate|string(date)|false|none|Date when the customer's tax exemption certificate expires<br>**Character limit**: 29 **Version notes**: requires Z-Tax |
|TaxExemptIssuingJurisdiction|string|false|none|Indicates the jurisdiction in which the customer's tax exemption certificate was issued.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 32 characters or fewer |
|TaxExemptStatus|string|false|none| Status of the account's tax exemption. This field is only required if you use Zuora Tax. This field is not available if you do not use Zuora Tax.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 19<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Yes`<br>- `No`<br>- `PendingVerification`<br>|
|TotalInvoiceBalance|number(double)|false|none|Total balance of the account's invoices.<br><br>**Character limit**: 16<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid currency value |
|VATId|string|false|none| EU Value Added Tax ID.<br>This feature is in **Limited Availability**. If you wish to have access to the feature, submit a request at [Zuora Global Support](http://support.zuora.com/).<br><br><br><br>**Character limit**: 25<br><br><br>**Values**: a valid Value Added Tax ID |
|Class__NS|string|false|none|Value of the Class field for the corresponding customer account in NetSuite. Only available if you have installed the [Zuora Connector for NetSuite](https://www.zuora.com/connect/app/?appId=265).<br>|

|CancelledDate|string(date)|false|none| The date of the amendment that canceled the subscription.<br><br><br><br>**Values**: inherited from `Amendment`.`EffectiveDate` |
|ContractAcceptanceDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the customer accepts the contract. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`.<br><br><br>This field is only required if the [Require Service Activation of Orders?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Service_Activation_of_Orders.3F) Setting is set to `Yes`. If this setting is set to `Yes`:<br><br>- If ContractAcceptanceDate field is required, you must set this field, ContractAcceptanceDate, and ContractEffectiveDate fields in the subscribe call to activate a subscription.<br>- If ContractAcceptanceDate field is not required, you must set both this field and the ContractEffectiveDate field in the subscribe call to activate a subscription. If you only set a valid date in the ContractEffectiveDate field, the subscribe call still returns success, but the subscription is in `DRAT` status.<br>|
|ContractEffectiveDate|string(date)|true|none| The date when the contract takes effect. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`.<br><br><br>**Note**: This field is required in the subscribe call. If you set the value of this field to null and both the ServiceActivationDate and ContractAcceptanceDate fields are not required, the subscribe call still returns success, but the new subscription is in `DRAFT` status. To activate the subscription, you must set a valid date to this field. |
|CreatedById|string|false|none|The user ID of the person who created the subscription.<br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date the subscription was created. This value is the same as the OriginalCreatedDate value until the subscription is amended.<br><br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatorAccountId|string|false|none| The account ID that created the subscription or the amended subscription.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CreatorInvoiceOwnerId|string|false|none|The account ID that owns the invoices associated with the subscription or the amended subscription.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CurrentTerm|integer(int32)|false|none| The length of the period for the current subscription term. This field is only required If the `TermType` field is set to `TERMED` and its value must be greater than `0`. If TermType is set to `EVERGREEN`, this value is ignored. Default is `0`.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 20<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|CurrentTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the current subscription term. This field is used with the CurrentTerm field to specify the current subscription term.<br><br><br><br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br>|
|InitialTerm|integer(int32)|false|none| The length of the period for the first subscription term. This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`. If you use the subscribe<br>call, this field is required.<br><br><br>This field is only required if the `TermType` field is set to `TERMED`.<br><br>**Character limit**: 20<br><br><br>**Values**: any valid number. The default value is 0. |
|InitialTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the first subscription term.<br><br><br><br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br><br><br>**Note**:<br><br>- This field can be updated when `Status` is `Draft`.<br>- This field is used with the `InitialTerm` field to specify the initial subscription term.<br>|
|InvoiceOwnerId|string|false|none| This field can be updated when `Status` is `Draft`. |
|IsInvoiceSeparate|boolean|false|none| Determines if the subscription is invoiced separately. If `TRUE`, then all charges for this subscription are collected into the subscription's own invoice.<br><br><br><br>**Values**: `TRUE`, `FALSE `(default) |
|Name|string|false|none| The unique identifier of the subscription. If you don't specify a value, then Zuora generates a name automatically. Whether auto-generated or manually specified, the subscription name must be unique. Otherwise an error will occur. You can change this value only when the subscription is in `Draft` status. Once the subscription is activated, you can't change this value, nor can you use this value for a different subscription.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 100<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- leave null to automatically generate<br>- a string of 100 characters or fewer<br>|
|Notes|string|false|none| Use this field to record comments about the subscription.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 500<br><br><br>**Values**: a string of 500 characters or fewer |
|OriginalCreatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the subscription was originally created. This value is the same as the CreatedDate value until the subscription is amended.<br><br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|OriginalId|string|false|none| The original ID of this subscription.<br><br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|PreviousSubscriptionId|string|false|none| The subscription ID immediately prior to the current subscription.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 32<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|RenewalSetting|string|false|none| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. Specifies whether a termed subscription will remain termed or change to evergreen when it is renewed.<br><br><br>This field is only required if the `TermType` field is set to `TERMED`.<br><br><br>**Values**: `RENEW_WITH_SPECIFIC_TERM `(default), `RENEW_TO_EVERGREEN` |
|RenewalTerm|integer(int32)|false|none| The length of the period for the subscription renewal term. This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. If you use the subscribe<br>call, this field is required.<br><br><br>This field is only required if the `TermType` field is set to `TERMED`.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 20<br><br><br>**Values**: one of the following:<br><br>- leave null to default to `0`<br>- any number<br>|
|RenewalTermPeriodType|string|false|none| The period type for the subscription renewal term.<br><br><br><br>**Values**:<br><br>- `Month` (default)<br>- `Year`<br>- `Day`<br>- `Week`<br><br><br>**Note**:<br><br>- This field is used with the RenewalTerm field to specify the subscription renewal term.<br>- This field can be updated when Status is `Draft`.<br>|
|ServiceActivationDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the subscription is activated.<br>This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. This field is only required if the [Require Service Activation of Orders?](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/CB_Billing/Billing_Settings/Define_Default_Subscription_Settings#Require_Service_Activation_of_Orders.3F) Setting is set to `Yes`.<br>If this setting is set to `Yes`:<br><br>- If ContractAcceptanceDate field is required, you must set this field, ContractAcceptanceDate, and ContractEffectiveDate fields in the subscribe call to activate a subscription.<br>- If ContractAcceptanceDate field is not required, you must set both this field and the ContractEffectiveDate field in the subscribe call to activate a subscription. If you only set a valid date in the ContractEffectiveDate field, the subscribe call still returns success, but the subscription is in `DRAT` status.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br>|
|Status|string|false|none| The status of the subscription.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 17<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated<br><br>**Possible values**: one of the following:<br><br>- `Draft`<br>- `PendingActivation`<br>- `PendingAcceptance`<br>- `Active`<br>- `Cancelled`<br>- `Expired`<br>- `Suspended` (This value is in **Limited Availability**.)<br>|
|SubscriptionEndDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the subscription term ends, where the subscription ends at midnight the day before. For example, if the SubscriptionEndDate is 12/31/2016, the subscriptions ends at midnight (00:00:00 hours) on 12/30/2016. This date is the same as the term end date or the cancelation date, as appropriate.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|SubscriptionStartDate|string(date)|false|none| The date when the subscription term starts. This date is the same as the start date of the original term, which isn't necessarily the start date of the current or new term.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|TermEndDate|string(date)|false|none| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. The date when the subscription term ends. If the subscription is evergreen, the TermEndDate value is null or is the cancelation date, as appropriate.<br><br>**Character limit**: 29<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|TermStartDate|string(date)|false|none| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. The date when the subscription term begins. If this is a renewal subscription, then this date is different from the subscription start date. If you don't specify a value, then Zuora uses ContractEffectiveDate automatically.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 29 |
|TermType|string|true|none| This field can be updated when **Status** is `Draft`. Indicates if a subscription is [termed or evergreen](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/BC_Subscription_Management/Subscriptions#Termed_and_Evergreen_Subscriptions). A termed subscription has a specific end date and requires manual renewal. An evergreen subscription doesn't have an end date and doesn't need renewal. This field can be updated when the subscription status is Draft.<br><br><br>**Character limit**: 9<br><br><br>**Values**: `TERMED`, `EVERGREEN` |
|UpdatedById|string|false|none| The ID of the user who last updated the subscription.<br>**Character limit:** 32 **Values: **automatically generated |
|UpdatedDate|string(date-time)|false|none| The date when the subscription was last updated.<br>**Character limit:** 29<br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |
|Version|integer(int32)|false|none| The version number of the subscription.<br><br><br><br>**Values**: automatically generated |

|object_id|string|false|none|The id of the selected object of the task.<br>|

|status|string|false|none|If **Instance** is **true**, the status of the task instance.<br>|
|tags|[string]|false|none|The array of filter tags.<br>|
|task_id|integer|false|none|the id of this task's parent task. Will be null if this is the first task of the workflow|

|includedUnits|number|false|none|Number of free units that may be consumed.<br>|
|numberOfPeriods|integer|false|none|Number of periods that Zuora considers when calculating overage charges with overage smoothing.<br>|
|overagePrice|number|false|none|Price per overage unit consumed.<br>|
|overageUnusedUnitsCreditOption|string|false|none|Specifies whether to credit the customer for unused units.<br><br>If the value of this field is `CreditBySpecificRate`, use the `unusedUnitsCreditRates` field to specify the rate at which to credit the customer for unused units.<br>|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

If you import a mass usage in a single upload, which contains multiple usage files in .xls or .csv format, usage records are grouped for each usage file.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_UsageVolumePricingOverride">UsageVolumePricingOverride</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemausagevolumepricingoverride"></a>
<a id="schema_UsageVolumePricingOverride"></a>
<a id="tocSusagevolumepricingoverride"></a>
<a id="tocsusagevolumepricingoverride"></a>

```json
{
  "priceChangeOption": "NoChange",
  "priceIncreasePercentage": -100,
  "ratingGroup": "ByBillingPeriod",
  "tiers": [
    {
      "endingUnit": 0,
      "price": 0,
      "priceFormat": "FlatFee",
      "startingUnit": 0,
      "tier": 1
    }
  ]
}
```

Pricing information about a usage charge that uses the "volume pricing" charge model. In this charge model, the charge has a variable price per unit, depending on how many units are consumed.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|priceChangeOption|string|false|none|Specifies how Zuora changes the price of the charge each time the subscription renews.<br><br>If the value of this field is `SpecificPercentageValue`, use the `priceIncreasePercentage` field to specify how much the price of the charge should change.<br>|
|priceIncreasePercentage|number|false|none|Specifies the percentage by which the price of the charge should change each time the subscription renews. Only applicable if the value of the `priceChangeOption` field is `SpecificPercentageValue`.<br>|
|ratingGroup|string|false|none|Specifies how Zuora groups usage records when rating usage. See [Usage Rating by Group](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Billing/Billing_and_Payments/J_Billing_Operations/Usage/Usage_Rating_by_Group) for more information.<br>  * ByBillingPeriod (default): The rating is based on all the usages in a billing period.<br>  * ByUsageStartDate: The rating is based on all the usages on the same usage start date. <br>  * ByUsageRecord: The rating is based on each usage record.<br>  * ByUsageUpload: The rating is based on all the usages in a uploaded usage file (.xls or .csv). If you import a mass usage in a single upload, which contains multiple usage files in .xls or .csv format, usage records are grouped for each usage file.<br>|
|tiers|[[ChargeTier](#schemachargetier)]|false|none|List of variable pricing tiers in the charge.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|priceChangeOption|NoChange|
|priceChangeOption|SpecificPercentageValue|
|priceChangeOption|UseLatestProductCatalogPricing|
|ratingGroup|ByBillingPeriod|
|ratingGroup|ByUsageStartDate|
|ratingGroup|ByUsageRecord|
|ratingGroup|ByUsageUpload|

|name|string|false|none|The name of the workflow.<br>|
|ondemandTrigger|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the ondemand trigger is enabled for the workflow.<br>|
|scheduledTrigger|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the scheduled trigger is enabled for the workflow.<br>|
|timezone|string|false|none|The timezone that is configured for the scheduler of the workflow. Returns null if the scheduled trigger is disabled.<br>|
|type|string|false|none|The type of the workflow. Currently the only valid value is 'Workflow::Setup'.<br>|
|updatedAt|string(datetime)|false|none|The date and time when the workflow is updated the last time, in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.<br>|
